title: Studio Principal - Civic
description:
AC Martin, Inc. is an innovative, award-winning architecture and interior design firm with offices in Los Angeles, Sacramento, the Bay Area, and San Diego. Our work is a mix of Market-Rate Housing, Urban Mixed-Use, Hospitality, Industrial, K-12, Community Colleges, Civic/Government, Higher Education, Planning, and Programming. We foster professional and personal development and offer prospects for career advancement.

POSITION SUMMARY

The ideal candidate is a licensed architect with 20 or more years of experience or equivalent in all technical phases of architecture. You must have a bachelor and/or master’s degree in architecture or equivalent and be licensed in the state of California; additional industry certification is desired (LEED, DBIA, etc.).

The Principal runs the Civic Studio. AC Martin’s Civic Studio has a rich history in shaping the fabric of Los Angeles and has expanded since. The group is dedicated to creating high-performing public environments that serve communities with integrity, resilience, and civic pride.

Notable past projects range from L.A. City Hall, judicial courts such as the Hall of Justice, the New Resources Building, and the DGS Headquarters in Sacramento. It is not the size of the project that impacts the reach of this position. This position encompasses the leadership and market cultivation of projects ranging from renovations and/or new construction of essential facilities (police, fire, EOC) to civic centers and libraries to ground-up courthouses and state buildings.

Judicial experience is highly preferred.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Has direct oversight of a market or discipline and establishes and implements goals and objectives.
  • Develops and promotes the studio’s values and long-range plans and goals
  • Positions the studio for growth and promotes quality of work and profitability within their sector.
  • Must be market-focused and may manage project directors/managers and technical and design staff to complete projects.
  • Operates as the principal in charge or may manage projects and/or clients and hold an external lead role.
  • Participates in external professional organizations.
  • Assists in the business development plans and budgets for the studio.
  • Responsible for staffing and recruiting for the studio to maintain staff utilization and project financial health in coordination with the Managing Principal and COO.
  • Responsible for the coordination of all project efforts, administrative and technical, to ensure the most efficient and cost-effective execution of assigned projects including contracts, change orders, invoices, and payments.
  • Prepares strategic plans for project success.
  • Serves as the primary liaison contact with clients to complete projects on schedule, within budget, and with maximum client satisfaction.
  • Actively manages client budgets, schedules, and programs; project communications and documentation; office administrative tasks; and project team assignments.
  • Must utilize and update Deltek for administration of the project.
  • Estimates fees, determines scope of work, and prepares proposals and contracts on the most complex projects.
  • Responsible for contract reviews, consultant contracts, and change orders and ASRs for review with principals.
  • Provides oversight and monitoring of work of less experienced project managers.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

We offer career advancement opportunities and an excellent benefits package which includes:

  • Alternative work schedule of 40 hours per week based on a 4 ½‐day workweek.
  • Hybrid schedule of 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home, and half-day on Fridays.
  • Group medical, dental, and vision plans with HSA and FSA options.
  • Company-paid Life and AD&D coverage.
  • 401(k) Savings Plan.
  • Company paid time off and holidays.
  • Paid onsite parking.

EEO EMPLOYER

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, national origin, disability, or any other consideration made unlawful by law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

title: Physiotherapist  (ROW)
company: The Association of People with Disability
location: Yadgir Taluk, Gurumitkal taluk and Wadagera taluk of Yadgir district, India
description:
Key Responsibilities

· Community Outreach & Screenings: Conduct mobile clinical screenings, neurological assessments, and musculoskeletal evaluations at village camps, government schools, Anganwadis, and remote settlements.

· Doorstep Rehabilitation Therapy: Design and deliver customized treatment plans for conditions common in rural settings, including cerebral palsy, post-stroke paralysis, spinal injuries, and chronic musculoskeletal pain from manual labor.

· Mobile Unit Management: Oversee and maintain the therapeutic equipment carried inside the RoW vehicle, including portable electrotherapy machines (TENS/Ultrasound), mobility aids, and exercise gear.

· Assistive Device Coordination: Identify patient needs for customized assistive devices (calipers, crutches, wheelchairs), take accurate measurements, and train patients on their proper usage.

· Empowering Local Caregivers: Educate and train family members, local volunteers, and community health workers (ASHAs) in Kannada to ensure continuous home-based exercise routines between mobile visits.

· Multidisciplinary Teamwork: Work closely with the NGO’s field coordinators, community social workers, and visiting medical professionals to provide holistic, patient-centered care.

· Social Impact Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of daily field sessions, patient progress charts, and community demographic data to help generate impact reports for NGO donors and stakeholders. Submit monthly reports.



Requirements

Required Qualifications & Skills

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Physiotherapy (BPT) from a recognized institution.

· Licensure: Valid registration with the relevant state or national physiotherapy council.

· Language Skills: Fluency in spoken Kannada is mandatory to communicate effectively, build trust, and deliver training within rural Yadgir communities.

· Experience: 1–3 years of clinical experience, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked in Community-Based Rehabilitation (CBR), rural health camps, or NGO health programs.

· Field Adaptability: High willingness to travel daily in the organizational transit vehicle across rural terrains and work flexibly in varied community settings (e.g., village squares, community halls, small homes).

· Core Value Alignment: Deep empathy, cultural sensitivity, patience, and a strong commitment to rural development and social justice.



Benefits

As per the organizational norms

1. PF
2, Medical insurance
3. Travel and mobile allowance

title: Omsorgsassistent till Stångehamnsvägen 139
description:
Vill du ha ett jobb där variation i vardagen är en självklarhet och du gillar att hitta på aktiviteter till dem du är till för? Har du även möjlighet att arbeta under dygnets alla timmar? Då är en tjänst hos oss på Stångehamnsvägen 139 något för dig!  

Korttidsboendet Stångehamnsvägen 139 är ett boende för barn och ungdomar med olika funktionsnedsättningar i åldern 0-21 år. Boendet är placerat i området Kristineberg och har i dagsläget 12 inskrivna barn och ungdomar. Tillsammans med kollegor ansvarar du för att ge dem stöd och handledning. Ni utgör ett positivt team och bidrar med kvalitativa och stimulerande aktiviteter som främjar till att barnen/ungdomarna får en meningsfull vardag. Arbetslaget som du kommer att tillhöra består av 16 personer där enhetschefen är er närmsta kontakt. Samarbete med andra enheter förekommer och ska därför kännas som en självklar arbetsuppgift.

Just nu söker vi två kollegor till vårt gäng, en tillsvidareanställning och ett vikariat på ca 6 månader.

2 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Arbetsuppgifterna som omsorgsassistent grundar sig på allmänt omvårdnadsarbete med tillhörande personlig omvårdnad. Det kan exempelvis handla om sondmatning, förflyttningar, personlig hygien, matintag mm. Vi lagar även all mat själv på boendet.  I uppdraget ingår det dokumentation i datajournal samt medicinska arbetsuppgifter. Arbetstiderna är förlagda till dag, kväll, jour samt helger. I uppdraget ingår det till viss del ensamarbete.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har en undersköterskeexamen eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren finner likvärdig. Meriterande om du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom området funktionsnedsättning /psykiatri och/eller tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med målgruppen. Du har kunskaper om lågaffektivt bemötande och TSS (tecken som stöd). B-körkort är nödvändigt samt att du är tydlig i din kommunikation i tal och skrift på svenska. Grundläggande datakunskap är önskvärt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper, vi söker dig som är:

	• tydlig och trygg med tillhörande lågaffektivt förhållningssätt
	• en social lagspelare med förmåga att bygga goda relationer
	• lösningsfokuserad, självständig och kan ta egna initiativ
	• flexibel du kan rätta dig efter rådande omständigheter

Känner du att du passar in i denna beskrivning och att du har det som krävs för tjänsten?

Välkommen in med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse med rekryterande chef, upphör: 2027-10-31  .

Löpande rekrytering kan komma att tillämpas, välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

För att kunna bli aktuell för en anställning behöver du kunna visa upp följande utdrag ur belastningsregistret: Arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning. 

Finns att hitta här: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstånd/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

Du som söker och är intresserad av tjänsten, ansök redan nu om utdraget.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig ansöka via söklänken och inte via e-post eller pappersformat.

Vi har rökfri arbetstid.

Vi erbjuder ett flexibelt friskvårdsavtal.

Vi undanber oss erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna tjänst.

Läs gärna mer på  https://oskarshamn.com/

Kika gärna på vår fina film om vår stad:  https://youtu.be/_T9Cy0C-H_o

title: Kundtjänstmedarbetare Saltsjö Boo, Nacka
description:
PreZero Recycling söker tre engagerade och flexibla kundtjänstmedarbetare till sitt team i Nacka. Här får du arbeta tillsammans med ett dedikerat team i en samhällsviktig verksamhet inom miljö- och återvinningsbranschen.

Vilka är arbetsuppgifterna?

Som kundtjänstmedarbetare hos PreZero blir du en viktig del av kundtjänst teamet där du dagligen har kontakt med kunder via telefon och mejl. Du ansvarar för att ta emot, hantera och följa upp inkommande ärenden kopplade till PreZeros tjänster inom avfallshantering och återvinning. Rollen innebär både service och administration, där du säkerställer att kundernas frågor, beställningar och uppföljningar hanteras på ett professionellt och effektivt sätt. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med dina kollegor i kundtjänst samt andra interna avdelningar för att skapa en smidig och kvalitativ kundupplevelse.

Du får en gedigen introduktion och blir en del av ett engagerat team där samarbete, struktur och service står i fokus.

Dina arbetsuppgifter inkluderar bland annat:

  • Ta emot och hantera inkommande samtal och mejl från kunder gällande PreZeros tjänster.
  • Registrera, administrera och följa upp kundorder i system.
  • Säkerställa korrekt kundinformation samt hantera enklare administrativa uppgifter kopplade till orderflödet.
  • Samarbeta med kundtjänst och övriga avdelningar för att säkerställa hög servicegrad och effektiva processer.


Vad erbjuder vi dig?

Vi på PreZero erbjuder en arbetsplats med familjär stämning där vi hjälper och stöttar varandra. Utan våra medarbetare, ingen verksamhet. Vi har ett starkt fokus på att både stötta din utveckling på jobbet och underlätta för dig att kombinera arbetet med allt annat som livet erbjuder och kräver. Tillsammans arbetar vi varje dag för att främja cirkulära materialflöden och en mer resurseffektiv framtid, vilket ger engagemang och stolthet oavsett yrkesroll. Vi är noga med att bry oss om varandra, jobba säkert och att ha kul på arbetet.

Vem söker vi?

Du har antingen några års yrkeserfarenhet alternativt utbildning inom kundtjänst, ekonomi eller administration. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från kundtjänstverksamhet.

Det är en fördel om du trivs med kundkontakt, är en god administratör, och gillar att lösa problem.

Du har goda kunskaper i Google Workspace och har erfarenhet från affärssystem (till exempel order-, fakturerings-, ekonomi- och statistikprogram.

För att ha framgång i tjänsten behöver du vara ansvarsfull, serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och strukturerad. Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt och på eget initiativ identifiera förbättringar i arbetet. Du har ett prestigelöst sätt och tar med stort engagemang tag i det som behöver göras.

Vi på PreZero ser på mångfald som en styrka och vi strävar efter att skapa en arbetsplats där alla medarbetare känner sig inkluderade och uppmuntrande att bidra. Vi välkomnar alla sökande oavsett bakgrund och livssituation.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid, tillträde så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse. Placering Saltsjö-Boo, Nacka.

Vill du veta mer?

Kontakta gärna administrativ chef, Robert Rimgård, 085- 19 333 64.

Intresserad?

Skicka då in din ansökan med personligt brev och CV till nyttjobb.se@prezero.com Vi arbetar med löpande urval. Märk ansökan med ”Kundtjänstmedarbetare Nacka”.

Välkommen med din ansökan gärna redan idag men senast den 15 November.

Om du blir erbjuden tjänsten hos oss ska du uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag (max en månad gammalt) från Polisens belastningsregister.

PreZero strävar mot att främja varje medarbetares professionella utveckling samtidigt som vi stödjer en sund balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Vår företagskultur präglas av en familjär atmosfär och vi känner stolthet över att arbeta mot vår vision Zero Waste – att inget avfall ska gå förlorat. PreZero Sverige är ett avfalls- och återvinningsföretag som ingår i det internationella miljöbolaget PreZero med huvudsäte i Tyskland och verksamhet i elva länder. I Sverige är vi cirka 1 200 medarbetare på drygt 60 orter.

title: School & Community Programmer
description:
School & Community Programmer (Part- Time)

Toledo Zoo & Aquarium

The Toledo Zoo & Aquarium has been educating, inspiring, and providing enjoyment to our community for over 100 years. Come and be a part of an organization where you can work and have fun at the same time! Our Education department is currently seeking a part-time School and Community Programmer who is passionate about learning new things and giving our guests the best possible experience.

This role is responsible for supporting all educational programming, serving as primary facilitator. This includes teaching on zoo grounds, off-site at schools, and community organizations. Other tasks include writing curriculum for program areas, providing interpretive talks, performing animal demonstrations and creating other relevant programming. The ideal candidate has experience leading classrooms or teaching in informal education settings.


This position reports to the School and Community Program Coordinator and is non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

Minimum Training & Experience

  • Must be 21+ years of age or older.
  • Must have a valid drivers’ license and be insurable by the fleet insurance carrier.

  • First Aid/CPR certification preferred.
  • Pre-employment screening and background check are required.

title: Assistant Director of Operations
description:
As Assistant Director of Operations, you are a senior operational leader accountable for translating Catch22’s strategy into safe, high-quality, financially sustainable and impactful delivery across a complex portfolio within the Safer Futures Hub.

The Safer Futures Hub brings together Catch22’s specialist services that support victims of crime and young people affected by exploitation, violence, missing episodes and vulnerability. Through community, hospital and custody-based interventions, the hub provides support at critical moments to prevent harm, increase safety, strengthen victims’ access to their entitlements and create pathways to positive futures.

This role is expected to hold the following portfolio:

  • County Lines Support Service
  • Steps
  • Kent CE
  • Pan Merseyside Missing & Exploitation

You hold end-to-end responsibility for performance, quality, financial sustainability and risk, maintaining clear grip on delivery while contributing to the wider Senior Leadership and Expert Leader community to drive Mission 2030 outcomes, innovation and system reform.

You lead with autonomy and professional judgement, setting clear direction, using data, insight and service user voice to prioritise resources, and intervening early where quality, safety, outcomes or finances are at risk.

You drive continuous improvement across the portfolio, leading service redesign and digital transformation to scale effective approaches and develop more evidence-led, digitally enabled models of support for victims, young people and communities.

You build strong strategic partnerships, influencing commissioners and sector partners to shape integrated pathways, place-based models and whole-system responses aligned to Catch22’s reform agenda.

Your focus is on turning strategy into consistent practice and measurable impact, building capability through your managers, embedding learning into delivery, and escalating insight, risks and recommendations to inform organisational decision-making.

title: Principal Test Engineer
description:
Mercury Systems is seeking the best and brightest talent to help us bring cutting-edge technology to mission-critical aerospace and defense applications, advancing innovation where it matters most. Our Mixed Signal business unit is seeking an experienced Principal Test Engineer to develop and execute comprehensive test strategies for sophisticated mission-critical embedded technology designed to withstand the most rugged environments. This role requires deep expertise in digital hardware testing, ASIC/FPGA verification, and environmental qualification testing for aerospace and defense applications. You will own the complete test lifecycle from Design Verification Testing (DVT) through production test deployment, including test automation software development, test fixture design, and formal qualification documentation.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who thinks like a design engineer but lives in the test world—someone who can build test infrastructure as a product in its own right with the same rigor applied to flight hardware.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute Design Verification Test (DVT) plans and procedures for complex digital circuits, modules, and systems including ASIC integration and FPGA verification
  • Design, build, and certify test fixtures, cable harnesses, and test interface boards for complex digital subsystems
  • Develop automated test systems using modern programming languages (Python, .NET) including instrument control, data acquisition, and automated pass/fail determination; LabVIEW support for existing systems
  • Develop test firmware for embedded targets including SPI/I2C/UART communication protocols and diagnostic interfaces
  • Execute environmental and qualification testing per MIL-STD-810H (thermal, vibration, shock, acceleration) and MIL-STD-461G (EMI/EMC) standards
  • Perform ASIC integration testing including register read/write verification, state machine validation, and high-speed SPI interface testing
  • Test high-speed digital interfaces including PCIe, Ethernet, DDR SDRAM, and complex power sequencing circuits
  • Conduct burn-in testing, accelerated life testing, and reliability qualification campaigns
  • Perform root cause analysis on test failures with first-responder anomaly triage and failure mode characterization
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test procedures, and formal test reports traceable to product requirements (JAMA, DOORS)
  • Maintain test assets under configuration management with NIST-traceable calibration records
  • Prepare and present Test Readiness Review (TRR) packages for qualification events
  • Lead production test handoff activities including manufacturing test documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Interface with design engineering, program management, manufacturing, and customers to resolve technical test issues

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • Typically requires 6+ years of related experience in electronics test engineering
  • Hands-on experience testing complex digital subsystems including FPGA verification and ASIC integration
  • Experience programming skills in Python and/or .NET for test automation, data analysis, and embedded test firmware development
  • Experience with test firmware development for embedded systems including SPI, I2C, UART protocol implementations
  • Experience executing MIL-STD-810H and MIL-STD-461G qualification testing campaigns
  • Experience with RF and digital test equipment including: spectrum analyzers, network analyzers (VNA), signal generators, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, and thermal chambers.
  • This position requires you to have or obtain a government security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Active Secret clearance or higher
  • Experience with ruggedized military and space-grade electronics testing
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) for accelerating test automation development
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern development workflows and AI coding assistants
  • Proficiency in C/C++, Rust, VHDL, MATLAB, and/or SQL for specialized test applications and data management
  • Experience with radiation qualification testing at external facilities
  • Knowledge of high-speed digital design including signal integrity and power integrity analysis
  • Experience testing Intel (Xilinx) and AMD (Altera) FPGA-based systems
  • Familiarity with Cadence design tools and design verification workflows
  • Experience with 3U/6U VPX systems (VITA46, VITA65)
  • Knowledge of Design for Test (DFT) and Design for Reliability (DFR) principles
  • Requirements traceability tool experience (JAMA, DOORS)
  • Experience with statistical process control and test data trending analysis
  • Understanding of power supply testing and EMI compliance verification
  • Travel approximately 20% to external test facilities and customer sites

#LI-RL1

This position requires you to access information that is subject to U.S. export regulations. You may only access such information if you are a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. government.

title: Facilities Tech III - 3rd Shift (Sign-On Bonus)
description:
The incumbent in this position is responsible for providing superior service to both the internal and external customer. The incumbent is also responsible for the performance of the following types of maintenance work: 1) electrical, 2) HVAC, 3) carpentry 4) painting and 5) mechanical. Responsible for repairing mechanical, electrical and plumbing equipment; installs and repairs all audio systems, television and radio systems, satellite systems, CCTV systems, alarm systems, digital and analog control systems, audio-visual equipment systems and paging systems, perform maintenance painting/wall covering, and repairs and constructs carpentry structure, under general supervision

(These functions are intended as a general illustration of the work performed in this job classification and are not all inclusive for this position)

  • Maintains and repairs refrigerator equipment, boilers, and electrical, plumbing, and HVAC equipment.
  • Fabricates, repairs, and maintains equipment such as any mechanical devices, motors, and pumps throughout property.
  • Assists in building interface or accessory equipment as needed.
  • Responds to customer requests for maintenance assistance in order to provide courteous, timely and expert service.
  • Assists in the installation, removal or relocation of electronic equipment, in accordance with established priorities.
  • Fixes all property electronic equipment (except for slot machines and computers) by repairing minor damage to parts and wiring and replacing failed components, in order to ensure proper operation of all equipment according to established schedules and department standards.
  • Repair and installs structural woodwork and equipment; assist is preparing wall surface for painting and wall covering, in order to ensure proper operation of all equipment according to established schedules and department standards.
  • Performs upholstery work as required on hotel and casino chairs, sofas, gaming tables/layouts, restaurant booths and equipment.
  • Installs and maintains all tile, marble floor materials, carpet, carpet tiles.
  • Examines and performs preventative maintenance checks on various types of electronic equipment to include fire alarms, surveillance systems, and satellite systems according to established schedules under supervision, in order to ensure that potential problems are fixed before equipment becomes dysfunctional.
  • Runs milling equipment, lathes and power tools; welds materials.
  • Performs all operations incidental to any type of maintenance painting and carpentry to meet specifications.
  • Uses manual or mechanical means under general supervision. Erects scaffolding, prepares surfaces and mixes ingredients properly.
  • May work with electronic hotel lock systems.
  • May be required to work with high rise lift equipment.
  • Performs related duties and responsibilities as required.

The skills necessary for this position are typically acquired through a minimum of three years’ related engineering experience in a hotel/casino with 750 or more rooms, and/or through the completion of an AA Degree in a related field and five years’ related experience. Previous supervisory experience preferred.

  • Thorough and in-depth knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, electrical and electronic systems, welding, refrigeration, boilers and HVAC and chillers.
  • Equipment and machines used, but not limited to, are basic hand tools and testing equipment. Grinder, bandsaw, cut-off saw, buffing stand, 48 inch brake, arc welder, punch press, shear, notcher, drill presses, milling machines, and lathes. “Sencore” testing devices, i.e., oscilloscopes, tone and sweep generators, multi-meters, frequency counters, RF modulation tester, speaker loan and impedance tester, headset for line testing, voltage, and OHM meters. title: FIT & Infra Engineer
description:
Uw inzet kan levens redden!

FIT & Infra Engineer

ASTRID is een innoverend en hoogtechnologisch netwerk voor spraak en gegevens. De radiocommunicatie via het ASTRID-netwerk is specifiek bestemd voor alle hulp- en veiligheidsdiensten en ondersteunt hun onderlinge samenwerking.

Politie, brandweer en hulpdiensten kunnen dankzij ASTRID snel en veilig communiceren. Het digitale netwerk wordt in elke provincie aangevuld met een geïntegreerde meldkamer.

ASTRID is een naamloze vennootschap van publiek recht, een initiatief van de federale overheid. Om ons team in onze hoofdzetel te Brussel te versterken, zoeken wij momenteel een enthousiaste FIT & Infra Engineer .

De afdeling Field & Infrastructure Team (FIT) is verantwoordelijk voor:

  • de projecten en het beheer van de sites voor radiocommunicatie: aankoop, bouw, verbouwing, onderhoud, site sharing
  • de projecten en het beheer in verband met de technische omgeving van de provinciale meldkamers; dit betreft meer bepaald de fysieke installaties van apparatuur (de racks, de stroomvoorziening, de klimaatregeling, de data bekabeling, …)
  • de projecten en het beheer van de datacentra: fysieke installatie (inrichting, bekabeling, toewijzen van beschikbare rackruimte)
  • de projecten en het beheer van het ASTRID-gebouw (in samenwerking/overleg met de verhuurder en de preventieadviseur). Dit betreft ondermeer werken met betrekking tot electriciteit, HVAC enz.
  • het verlenen, op het terrein, van technische ondersteuning aan de gebruikers van het netwerk (troubleshooting van de radiocommunicatieproblemen)
  • het verlenen, op het terrein, van technische ondersteuning aan de projecten van de ASTRID-afdelingen.

ASTRID zoekt momenteel een Field & Infrastructure Engineer die zal instaan voor:

  • de opvolging van het preventief en correctief onderhoud van de radiocommunicatiesites in Vlaanderen
  • het verlenen van soepele en diverse technische ondersteuning op het terrein
  • het oplossen van problemen op het terrein en er een complete analyse van leveren
  • de documentatie van de sites (opvolging van het up-to-date brengen van plannen, ...)
  • het verlenen van technische ondersteuning voor de bouw of de aanpassing van telecommunicatiesites: planning, coördinatie, controle van de kosten, opvolging op de site, gedeeltelijk beheer van het contractuele deel.
  • het verlenen van technische ondersteuning voor fysieke installaties of aanpassingen in de provinciale of nationale datacentra.
  • Het beheer van de uitrol van de 2 mobiele basisstations (MTU’s) in geval van evenementen of crisissen (+ beheer van het onderhoud)
  • Uw werkterrein is vooral in Vlaanderen

  • Een diploma van bachelor of gelijkwaardig door ervaring, in een technische richting (elektronica/telecommunicatie)
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring op het vlak van de telecom basisstations en/of van de fysieke installatie in datacentra, kennis van de TETRA-wereld is een troef.
  • Bouwkundige plannen, elektrische schema’s en architectuurschema’s van radiocommunicatie hebben geen geheimen voor u.
  • U hebt ervaring met radiodekkingsmetingen
  • Zeer vlot gebruik van de MS-Office producten.
  • U bent Nederlandstalig met kennis van het Frans. U hebt een goede kennis van het technisch Engels.
  • Geen hoogtevrees (klimopleidingen voorzien)
  • Verwachte competenties : klantgericht, resultaatgericht, autonoom met gedrevenheid, analytisch vermogen, leergierig.

title: OSP Project Manager/Senior OSP Project Manager
description:
OSP Project Manager/Senior OSP Project Manager (level based upon experience)

In 1994, three visionaries turned a Bulletin Board Service with six modems and a 56k connection to the internet into a regional broadband powerhouse. Becoming a premier internet provider in the Rocky Mountain Region didn't come easy. It takes being as tough as the terrain. With a focus on rural service, Visionary has found a niche untapped by larger service organizations. In fact, this focus often means Visionary offers the service with the customer in mind and financial benefit as a distant second.


Visionary Broadband seeks a qualified individual to fill the role of Project Manager. This full-time position will join the team at Visionary Broadband, one of the top internet service providers in the Rocky Mountain region.


This role is responsible for successfully executing assigned OSP fiber network design and implementation and customer prem projects across multiple markets. The Project Manager is responsible for ensuring that work is completed on time and within budget. The Project Manager provides status updates to stakeholders, strategically manages risk, and ensures each phase of work is delivered based on the defined project schedule. The role requires an individual with strong leadership, facilitation, management and stakeholder relationship skills. This position partners across the Visionary organization, and with construction contractors to plan and execute project deliverables.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drives the delivery of OSP projects including FTTH and customer prem.
  • Manage complex regulatory/permitting issues such as NEPA, USFS, BLM etc.
  • Owns projects end to end across intake, design, permitting, contractor release, construction, splice/test, Network handoff, customer readiness, and closeout.
  • Interact with various municipalities and vendors to ensure that positive communication is maintained.
  • Manage the bid process with bidders to ensure the lowest qualified awards are made and diligently manage the contract terms throughout the life of each contract.
  • Submitting project bids and collaborating with management for review and approval.
  • Manage multiple projects concurrently, ensuring quality and delivery is on schedule.
  • Provide project level and executive project reporting including regular updates.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate project risks and develop contingency plans.
  • Builds strong working internal Visionary relationships by providing regular status updates, facilitating alignment meetings, and leading escalation discussions.
  • Builds strong working relationships with construction vendors to ensure high-quality performance and on-schedule project completion.
  • Maintain and monitor regular communication with stakeholders, including internal teams and construction partners.
  • Participate in pre-construction and regular status meetings to ensure clear expectations and scopes of work.
  • Requires regular coordination across multiple markets and should be comfortable being in the field / with construction teams as needed.
  • Ensure that all project data in Monday is kept up to date with milestone dates and relevant notes.
  • Ensure vendor invoicing, as-built documents and all other vendor deliverables are completed in a timely manner and prepare all closeout documentation as required.
  • Maintain and monitor the schedule and coordinate with various departments to ensure project requirements are met and are on time.
  • Responsible for keeping leadership and team members informed about project updates during regular daily and weekly meetings.

Requirements and Essential Knowledge/Skills:

  • 7+ years of experience within the telecommunications industry managing OSP/FTTH construction delivery, contractor management, permitting and field execution is desired including outside plant, fiber optics, telecommunications engineering, splicing, and construction project management experience.
  • Strong ability to work within critical deadlines and drive accountability.
  • Working knowledge of construction standards, fiber specifications and optical network design principles.
  • Demonstrated exceptional problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with various Outside Plant (OSP) construction methods, including aerial and underground construction practices such as directional boring, trenching and plowing
  • Experience in permitting and meeting and working with municipalities, state and government agencies.

title: Tech Lead - Data
description:
About Zinkworks

Zinkworks partners with leading Telecommunications and Financial Services organizations to modernize legacy systems, migrate mission-critical platforms to the cloud, and engineer AI-driven automation. From OSS transformation to rApp development and network intelligence, our teams simplify complexity and turn it into competitive advantage. Based in Ireland and operating across the EU, UK, and US, Zinkworks combines deep domain expertise with delivery excellence to help clients modernize faster and operate smarter.

About the Project

We're forming a dedicated delivery squad for a high-growth international technology client. The goal is to move customer support from reactive to proactive. The new platform will detect service issues from the client's operational data, assess their business impact, trigger remediation, and let affected customers know before they have to ask.

It's a greenfield, data- and AI-driven build on Google Cloud, delivered in phases. It starts with incident detection and human-approved remediation, then adds more granular detection and broader automated actions, and ends with a closed-loop system that acts autonomously within defined safety limits. You'll join a squad of around nine people, including a Solution Architect, data, ML, backend, frontend, UX, QA and platform engineers, working in the client's own tooling (Jira, Git, CI/CD).

The Role

You'll be the technical lead for the squad and the owner of its data foundations. Every detection, score and remedy in this platform depends on data arriving on time, joined correctly and trusted, so you'll design and build the ingestion, modelling and quality layers while guiding the engineering team day to day alongside the Solution Architect.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the squad technically: set engineering standards, guide design decisions, review code and unblock the team, working with the Solution Architect on design authority and integration contracts.

  • Build ingestion for multiple feeds, including high-frequency telemetry with historical backfill, customer support data, business data and third-party performance data.

  • Design a canonical data model with cross-source validation.

  • Build data quality, freshness and completeness monitoring, and serve curated marts and feature pipelines for the ML team.

  • Scale ingestion to high-volume, granular data with geographic enrichment and aggregation hierarchies.

  • Automate business data feeds from source systems and build data marts that support strategic commercial decisions.

  • Partner with platform engineering on the Google Cloud landing zone, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and cost guardrails.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant commercial data engineering experience, including time technically leading a team or workstream.

  • Strong Python and SQL.

  • Hands-on experience building batch and near-real-time pipelines on a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud (e.g. BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer/Airflow).

  • Strong data modelling skills, including joining and reconciling data from multiple sources.

  • Experience implementing data quality, freshness and completeness monitoring.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and CI/CD for data pipelines.

  • Clear communication with client stakeholders, and experience mentoring engineers.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building feature pipelines for ML models.

  • Tools such as dbt, or experience working with high-volume device or telemetry data.

  • Background in telecoms or telemetry data.

  • Experience in client-facing consultancy or managed delivery environments.

Inclusion & Diversity at Zinkworks

At Zinkworks, we are deeply committed to fostering a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that our strength lies in the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. By embracing an inclusive environment, we empower innovation and collaboration across all levels of our organisation. Based in Ireland, we are proud to support and engage with our local communities through meaningful initiatives that promote equity and opportunity. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, as we actively contribute to creating a more inclusive and connected society for all.

  • Good understanding of stock management and replenishment principles. Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Analytical and numerical ability
  • Forecasting and planning
  • Attention to detail
  • Problem-solving
  • Commercial awareness
  • Stock management
  • Data analysis
  • Organisation and prioritisation
  • Communication skills

KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS

title: Customer Service Specialist eMobility
description:
Ben jij klantgericht, administratief sterk en geboeid door elektrische mobiliteit? Als Customer Service Specialist eMobility begeleid je leaseklanten doorheen het volledige traject van hun laadoplossing, van de eerste aanvraag tot een succesvolle installatie en activatie. Je komt terecht in een groeiende mobiliteitsomgeving in de ruime regio Antwerpen.

Spreekt dit jou aan? Lees dan snel verder!

De functie inhoud
Wat je gaat doen als Customer Service Specialist eMobility:
  • Fungeren als centraal aanspreekpunt voor leaseklanten rond laadstations en laadkaarten.
  • Aanvragen voor laadoplossingen administratief verwerken en nauwgezet opvolgen.
  • Surveys, offertes en bestellingen professioneel behandelen via telefoon en e-mail.
  • Klantendossiers van aanvraag tot installatie en activatie volledig opvolgen.
  • Planningen en deadlines bewaken zodat installaties tijdig kunnen worden uitgevoerd.
  • Regelmatig contact onderhouden met klanten, installateurs en andere betrokken partners.
  • Klanten duidelijk informeren over de voortgang van hun dossier.
  • Eventuele problemen tijdens het traject tijdig detecteren en zoeken naar een passende oplossing.
  • Proactief de klanttevredenheid opvolgen en bijdragen aan een sterke dienstverlening.
  • Nauw samenwerken met collega’s van de leasemaatschappijen.
  • Verschillende dossiers tegelijkertijd beheren zonder het overzicht te verliezen.
  • Verbeterpunten binnen de huidige werking identificeren en bijdragen aan procesoptimalisaties.
  • Meewerken aan een professionele dienstverlening binnen de snel evoluerende wereld van elektrische mobiliteit.

Onze klant
Je komt terecht bij een grote en sterk groeiende mobiliteitsspeler in de ruime regio Antwerpen. Naast klassieke automotive activiteiten wordt sterk ingezet op nieuwe mobiliteitsoplossingen en elektrificatie. Een gespecialiseerd team begeleidt klanten bij slimme laadoplossingen, van advies en installatie tot het verdere beheer ervan. Je werkt binnen een professionele omgeving waar klantgerichtheid, samenwerking en verdere ontwikkeling centraal staan. Wie jij bent als Customer Service Specialist eMobility:
  • Een sterke interesse in eMobility en de transitie naar elektrisch rijden.
  • Klantgericht en gemotiveerd om ieder dossier van begin tot einde correct af te handelen.
  • Administratief sterk en nauwkeurig in het opvolgen van verschillende dossiers.
  • Technische kennis van laadstations of laadsystemen is een pluspunt, maar geen absolute vereiste.
  • Sterk in plannen, organiseren en het bewaken van deadlines.
  • Communicatief en professioneel in contacten met klanten en partners.
  • Een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands en Frans, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Resultaatgericht en hands-on ingesteld.
  • Oplossingsgericht wanneer zich tijdens een installatie of dossier onverwachte problemen voordoen.
  • In staat om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen over jouw dossiers.
  • Vlot in de samenwerking met verschillende interne en externe partijen.
  • Proactief en bereid om mee te denken over een betere dienstverlening en efficiëntere processen.

title: Community Health Extension Associate
description:
TITLE: Community Health Extension Associate

DEPARTMENT: College of Agriculture, Health, and Natural Resource/ Cooperative Extension Program

REPORTS TO: State Specialist for Health Systems

CLASSIFICATION: Staff-12 months

EFFECTIVE DATE: TBD

STANDARD WORK HOURS: 37.5 hours per week

LOCATION: Frankfort, KY, USA or Louisville, KY, USA

EMPLOYMENT STATUS: Full-Time

EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

JOB SUMMARY:

The Community Health Extension Associate supports Kentucky State University’s Cooperative Extension Program through the development, delivery, and evaluation of community-based health and wellness programs that address priority health issues in Kentucky. This position works collaboratively with Extension Specialists, faculty, community partners, and agencies to deliver research-based health education in areas such as nutrition, disease prevention, mental health, and community health system strengthening. The Associate will also work to integrate opportunities for health-related education and workforce development initiatives including those related to the Science, Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, and Mathematics (STEAM) fields into the broader portfolio of extension programming. This position contributes to statewide Extension efforts by engaging youth, families, and communities in experiential learning that promotes innovation, healthy living, and lifelong learning.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Coordinate, deliver, and evaluate hands-on health-related programs, workshops, and outreach events for youth and adult audiences (such as EXCITE, MANRRS, etc.).
  • Integrate health education (nutrition, disease prevention, wellness) into extension programming.
  • Adapt program content to meet the cultural and educational needs of diverse audiences.
  • Represent Kentucky State University Extension at community events, fairs, and local programs.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with schools, nonprofits, community organizations, and other stakeholders.
  • Assist with developing digital content, outreach materials, and educational resources.
  • Conduct needs assessments to identify community priorities related to STEAM and health.
  • Support program evaluation by collecting data, analyzing outcomes, and preparing reports.
  • Assist with writing program summaries, impact statements, and contributions for Extension reports.
  • Assist with maintaining program supplies, records, and outreach materials.
  • Support fiscal accountability by tracking program-related expenses and resources.
  • Contribute to grant-writing and reporting efforts as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Knowledge of STEAM education and community health principles.
  • Ability to design and deliver engaging, hands-on educational activities.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including public speaking and facilitation.
  • Ability to work with diverse populations, including youth, adults, and underserved communities.
  • Skill in organizing programs, events, and community partnerships.
  • Proficiency with technology tools for program delivery, reporting, and outreach.
  • Ability to collect and analyze program data for evaluation and reporting.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and travel as needed.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

This position does not have supervisory responsibility. May provide guidance to interns, volunteers, or student assistants.

OTHER DUTIES:

  • Support other Cooperative Extension initiatives and special projects as requested.
  • Participate in Extension team meetings, trainings, and statewide initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Education, Public Health, Community Development, STEAM-related discipline, or a closely related field.
  • At least 2 years of experience in Extension, education, youth development, or community program coordination.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in both STEAM and health education.

Licensing and Certifications:

None required.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Full-time, 12-month appointment.
  • Requires travel, including some evenings and weekends.
  • Work is primarily performed in office, classroom, and community settings.
  • Ability to lift up to 30 pounds occasionally.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. At this time, Kentucky State University is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa

Internal candidates are encouraged to apply.


KENTUCKY STATE UNIVERSITY is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The functions, qualifications, knowledge/skills, and physical requirements listed in this job description represent the essential duties of the job, which the incumbent must be able to perform either with or without reasonable accommodation. The Job Functions listed do not necessarily include all activities that the individual may perform.

title: Supply Chain Technician
description:
Based in Lynfield, AsureQuality has the largest Food Testing Laboratory in the Southern Hemisphere. To keep our laboratory running smoothly we need a person to support Stores, Warehousing, Inventory and Despatch within the business. This is a permanent role working 8:00am to 4:30pm, Monday to Friday (40 hours per week).

About the role

We are looking for a practical, organised and customer-focused person to join our Inventory & Logistics team.

This is a varied, hands-on role primarily focused on customer order fulfilment and dispatch, with responsibility for processing consumable orders from receipt through to picking, packing and dispatch via our third-party logistics providers.

The role combines inventory and dispatch activities with systems-based order processing, customer communication and general administration. You will need to be equally comfortable working on a computer, responding to customer enquiries and working within our inventory and dispatch areas.

Accuracy and attention to detail are important, as the role includes stock, batch and product documentation checks as well as providing information to support customer invoicing.

Key responsibilities

  • Receive and process customer orders for consumables
  • Pick, pack and prepare customer orders accurately and efficiently for dispatch
  • Arrange and coordinate dispatch through our third-party logistics and courier service providers
  • Respond to and action customer order queries, concerns and complaints, escalating where appropriate
  • Maintain accurate order, dispatch and inventory information within relevant systems
  • Receive, check, store and issue inventory as required
  • Check stock batches, expiry information and Certificates of Analysis (CoAs) where applicable
  • Support stock rotation and good inventory control practices
  • Provide accurate order and dispatch information to support customer invoicing
  • Complete general administrative and record-keeping activities associated with customer orders and inventory
  • Assist with stocktakes and inventory checks as required
  • Maintain clean, organised and safe inventory and dispatch areas
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams and service providers to resolve order and delivery issues
  • Support other Inventory & Logistics activities as required

Skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Previous experience in dispatch, order fulfilment, stores, inventory or warehousing
  • A basic understanding of warehouse and inventory processes
  • Experience picking, packing and preparing orders for dispatch
  • Good computer skills and confidence working across different systems
  • Microsoft Excel skills and experience with general data entry and record keeping
  • Confidence using email as part of day-to-day customer communication
  • Strong customer service skills and the ability to professionally manage customer queries and complaints
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy
  • Good administrative and organisational skills
  • The ability to prioritise and manage multiple orders and competing tasks
  • The ability to follow established procedures and recognise when an issue needs to be escalated
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • A reliable and practical approach with the ability to work independently as well as part of a team

Experience working with inventory or order-processing systems, batch-controlled products, Certificates of Analysis or third-party logistics providers would be advantageous.

What we're looking for

You don't necessarily need extensive warehousing experience to be successful in this role. More importantly, we're looking for someone who is organised, accurate, comfortable using systems, responsive to customers and willing to take ownership of getting an order from receipt through to dispatch.

You'll enjoy this role if you like variety, have a practical approach to problem-solving and are comfortable balancing hands-on dispatch activities with customer service and administration.

Previous experience as a Warehouse or Stores Operator, Despatch and or 3PL and courier service

Join Our Dynamic Team:

We are committed to mentoring and developing newcomers and believe in fostering a diverse, fair, and inclusive environment that nurtures learning and growth. This is a fantastic opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and kickstart your career. Apply online today!

Helping Aotearoa shape a better food world - Join us today!

title: Principal Technical Project Manager (we have office locations in Cambridge, Leeds & London)
description:
We are seeking a Principal Technical Project Manager to support our Engineering Chapter in driving improvements to tooling, platforms and ways of working within the Software Delivery Lifecycle (SDLC) and live operations across the service and company.

In this position you will work closely with the Director of Engineering and core Engineering Chapter teams: Developer Platform, Test Enablement and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).

You will play a vital role in ensuring that the objectives of those teams (and the initiatives which support them) are clearly identified and prioritised with the product managers and delivered effectively. You will engage with stakeholders across the business, ensuring that central Engineering Chapter work aligns with business needs, is communicated effectively and that outcomes are aligned with expectations.

This principal role requires someone with strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, excellent stakeholder engagement skills, who can bring a collaborative and agile approach to driving delivery across multiple strands of work.

Candidates should be highly experienced in working in an ambiguous environment, learning new principles and technologies to be able to work effectively with teams and engage credibly with the wider organisation. They should also be comfortable with balancing between meeting delivery commitments and being responsive to emerging organisational needs and priorities.

Everyday responsibilities include:

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of key technical workstreams within a programme, taking accountability for the successful completion of critical delivery outcomes.
  • Lead the management of OKRs and initiatives across Engineering Chapter teams, including the capture, definition, tracking and reporting of objectives and key results.
  • Partner with Product Managers and Service Owners to validate requirements and ensure delivery is aligned to agreed timelines, budgets and OKRs.
  • Establish and maintain delivery plans, monitoring progress against roadmaps and communicating or escalating where delivery moves away from agreed commitments.
  • Ensure delivery progress is accurately reflected in operational tools, including , to support effective planning, visibility and reporting.
  • Identify, manage and regularly review risks, actions, issues and dependencies, working collaboratively with teams to resolve challenges and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Prepare clear status updates and contribute to programme board reports and governance forums, ensuring progress, risks and decisions are communicated effectively.
  • Establish and use appropriate decision-making structures, helping teams make timely, well-informed decisions where uncertainty needs to be resolved.
  • Implement effective governance across delivery, cybersecurity, data quality, data protection, IT requirements, accreditations and relevant internal and external standards.
  • Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, adapting communication to reflect different commercial, technical and business considerations.
  • Ensure contributors are clear on what needs to be delivered, by when, and that responsible stakeholders remain informed throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Engage with technical and operational governance groups, including the Engineering Steering Group, to shape, review and ratify key engineering decisions where appropriate.
  • Lead, motivate and support contributors to delivery, including in matrix environments where there is no direct line management authority.
  • Promote service-oriented thinking across Engineering Chapter teams, helping teams remain focused on user needs, service outcomes and measurable impact.
  • Support supplier engagement and procurement activity in line with Genomics England governance, including supplier frameworks and relevant approval routes.
  • Contribute to business cases, budget planning and spend monitoring, ensuring items and services are approved, budgeted for and managed through appropriate governance.
  • Line manage and support Delivery Chapter colleagues, including pastoral support, performance reviews, development planning, training and performance management where required.
  • Contribute as a senior member of the Delivery Chapter, supporting best practice, continuous improvement and active participation in Chapter meetings and away days.

Skills and experience for success:

  • Proven track record of project and programme delivery from initiation to business as usual.
  • Agile and adaptive project, risk, and issue management with a proactive and outcome-focused approach.
  • Strong communication skills, engaging effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Commercial awareness to support informed decision-making.
  • Ability to work in a highly regulated environment with increasing compliance needs.
  • Stakeholder management, building trusted relationships across teams and leadership levels.
  • Confident decision-making with sound judgement on escalation and risk management.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative approach to problem-solving, balancing delivery priorities with business needs.
  • Track record of line management directly or in a matrix organisation.

Awareness of the following technologies and concepts:

  • The principles and benefits of Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.
  • Quality Assurance best-practices e.g. shift-left, contract-testing and Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD).
  • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and practices.
  • Measures of engineering maturity e.g. Developer Experience (DevEx) and DORA.
  • Modern CI/CD platforms e.g. GitLab (preferred), GitHub and awareness of the concepts and benefits of Continuous Delivery.
  • Observability / monitoring platforms e.g. DataDog (preferred) or New Relic.
  • AWS services e.g. EC2, ECS/Fargate, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC and management tools including AWS Organisations, Identity Center, Inspector and Security Hub.
  • Infrastructure-as-code tools e.g. Terraform (preferred) or CloudFormation.

Salary from: £77,000

Being an integral part of such a meaningful mission is extremely rewarding in itself, but in order to support our people, we’re continually improving our benefits package.   • Generous Leave: 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, additional leave for long service, and the option to apply for up to 30 days of remote working abroad annually (approval required).
  • Family-Friendly: Blended working arrangements, flexible working, enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave benefits.
  • Pension & Financial: Defined contribution pension (Genomics England double-matches up to 10%, however you can contribute more if you wish), Life Assurance (3x salary), an Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme and a Give As You Earn scheme.
  • Learning & Development: Individual learning budgets, support for training and certifications, and reimbursement for one annual professional subscription (approval required).
  • Recognition & Rewards: Employee recognition programme and referral scheme.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Subsidised gym membership, a free Headspace account, and access to an Employee Assistance Programme, eye tests, flu jabs.

Equal opportunities and our commitment to a diverse and inclusive workplace

Genomics England is actively committed to providing and supporting an inclusive environment that promotes equity, diversity and inclusion best practice both within our community and in any other area where we have influence. We are proud of our diverse community where everyone can come to work and feel welcomed and treated with respect regardless of any disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, or social background.

Genomics England’s policies of non-discrimination and equity and will be applied fairly to all people, regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, being pregnant or recently becoming a parent, race, religion or beliefs, sex or sexual orientation, length of service, whether full or part-time or employed under a permanent or a fixed-term contract or any other relevant factor.

Genomics England does not tolerate any form of discrimination, harassment, victimisation or bullying at work. Such behaviour undermines our mission and core values and diminishes the dignity, respect and integrity of all parties. Our People policies outline our commitment to inclusivity.

We aim to remove barriers in our recruitment processes and to be flexible with our interview processes. Should you require any adjustments that may help you to fully participate in the recruitment process, we encourage you to discuss this with us.

Culture

We have four key behaviours that represent what we would like Genomics England to feel like and the culture we want to encourage, in order for us to achieve our mission. These behaviours help us all work well together, deliver on our outcomes, celebrate our successes and share feedback with each other. You can read about these and other aspects of our culture here Culture | Genomics England

Blended working model

Genomics England operates a blended working model as we know our people appreciate the flexibility that hybrid working can bring. We expect most people to come into the office a minimum of 2 times each month. However, this will vary according to role and will be agreed with your team leader. There is no expectation that people will return to the office full time unless they want to, however, some of our roles require full time on site attendance e.g., lab teams, reception team.

Our teams and squads have, and will continue to reflect on what works best for them to work together successfully and have the freedom to design working patterns to suit, beyond the minimum. Our office locations are: Canary Wharf, Cambridge and Leeds.

Onboarding background checks

As part of our recruitment process, all successful candidates are subject to a Standard Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. We therefore require applicants to disclose any previous offences at point of application, as some unspent convictions may mean we are unable to proceed with your application due to the nature of our work in healthcare.

title: Sjuksköterska/Distriktssköterska
description:
Lessebo kommun finns mitt i Glasriket och har cirka 8 100 invånare, drygt 300 företag och mer än 1 miljon besökare årligen. Kommunikationerna är goda med pendlingsavstånd till Växjö och Kalmar.  Vår verksamhet baseras i de fyra orterna Lessebo, Hovmantorp, Kosta och Skruv. 

I Lessebo kommun finns en arbetsglädje och det är lätt att lära känna varandra med ett nära samarbete förvaltningar och politiker. Hos oss ska man mötas av en god service och ett gott bemötande. Det handlar om att ha ett gott samarbete mellan medarbetare och till våra medborgare. Vi satsar på utvecklingsfrågor och tillsammans skapar vi en grön kommun som vi är stolta över och där vi värnar om varandras framtid. Lessebo kommun ska vara en attraktiv och trygg plats att leva på, för alla invånare.


2 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Inom den kommunala hälso- och sjukvården i Lessebo kommun arbetar vi i team runt patienten tillsammans med övriga professioner. Som sjuksköterska ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra samt följa upp de sjukvårdsinsatser som ges till patienter i både särskilt och ordinärt boende utifrån en helhetssyn och patientansvar. Vår vård präglas av ett rehabiliterande förhållningssätt utifrån patientens behov. Du har stora möjligheter att själv planera din tid.Vi använder oss av verksamhetssystem Cambio Cosmic, Cambio Viva och Appva digitalt signeringssystem.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Du är legitimerad sjuksköterska, gärna med specialistutbildning inom äldre eller distriktssköterska. Vi ser att du är flexibel, positiv och har en god samarbetsförmåga. Är du nyutexaminerad har vi erfarna kollegor som ger stöd och du får en längre introduktion. Låter detta spännande och som något för dig, vänta inte med din ansökan, vi rekryterar fortlöpande.

B körkort krävs.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-02-01  .

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Uppgifterna behandlas och sparas enligt personuppgiftslagen.

Frågor om hur du ansöker och lägger in ditt CV ställer du direkt till 0771-693 693. Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den rekryterare eller kontaktperson som anges i annonsen.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Overhead Transmission Lines Engineer
description:
CIMA+’s Energy & Resources team is a key player in the energy transition. With more than 700 highly qualified professional in this business sector, we are one of the largest teams specializing in this discipline among consulting engineering firms in Canada. Guided by an entrepreneurial culture based on innovation, sustainability, multidisciplinary agility and collaboration, we support our clients at all stages of their projects, from feasibility studies to commissioning. From the production of electricity from renewable sources to resource transformation, our expertise markets are the driving force of a successful energy transition. Regardless of the delivery mode our clients choose, we have the skills and experience required to deliver innovative solutions adapted to their reality. Join us and immerse yourself in a dynamic, innovative, and collaborative environment where you’ll make a real impact. Together, we’ll push boundaries and go above what’s expected of us to meet the challenges of tomorrow and engineer a better world!

The CIMA+ offices in Canada are in the middle of a large growth trajectory. This means new, exciting complex projects that you will have the ability to shape and be a part of. We are actively looking for people who want to develop their skills, take on new challenges, and advance their careers within the organization.

Elevate your engineering career by joining us as a Senior Overhead Transmission Lines Engineer. In this pivotal role, you'll leverage your expertise to deliver top-tier engineering, estimating, planning, and quality management services. Using your extensive engineering knowledge, you'll direct work on high-complexity projects and operations, ensuring safety, quality, and adherence to budget and timelines. Your analytical acumen and leadership will drive engineering studies and designs, fostering innovation and excellence in every endeavor. The successful candidate will work under the supervision of T&D Lines CIMA+ Leadership Team. This team is working on some of the largest most complex infrastructure projects in Canada.

This role is hybrid (2 days a week at the office) and can be based anywhere in Canada.

Primary responsibilities

  • Lead a project design team, including junior and intermediate staff.
  • Design overhead lines and associated facilities for voltages from 60kV to 735kV in an electric utility environment, including transmission towers, foundations and hardware and fittings within PLS-CADD, PLS-Pole and PLS-Tower.
  • Prepare project documentation like reports, specifications, proposals, estimates, design basis, and test plans per CIMA+’s practices
  • Lead and execute design work packages with scope, duration, and effort estimates, and manage design tasks including scope, schedule, and cost for existing and new facilities
  • Provide signed/sealed engineering deliverables as a Professional of Record per provincial regulations and CIMA+’s practices
  • Offer technical assistance, construction support, and field reviews as required
  • Develop design criteria considering multi-disciplinary inputs from the project team
  • Lead the structural design, analysis, and detailing for structures, foundations and hardware assemblies. Review manufacturer shop drawings
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior staff. Review of designs prepared by others, following established practices.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement safe engineering solutions for the high-complexity projects and operations, ensuring they meet major scope requirements for major utilities in Canada
  • Conduct independent studies and analyses, contribute to the development of technical standards, recommend safe designs, and provide mentorship to enhance the future capabilities of CIMA+’s engineering team
  • Develop and administer procedures, methods, and controls for planning, scheduling, cost control, and technical conformance, ensuring a consistent and robust Engineering Standards process.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders, review project schedules, resources, and budgets, and monitor expenditures to ensure project completion is safe, high-quality, on time, and within budget.
  • Plan, organize, and direct complex engineering and geoscience activities, making critical technical decisions and recommendations to ensure successful project implementation and resource management at CIMA+.
  • University Degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of fifteen (15) years of experience or over 10 year as fully certified engineer
  • Registered member of a Professional Engineering association in Canada, or eligible for registration in Canada
  • Proficient with the PLS-CADD suite design /analysis software and CAD systems, along with familiarity of drawing standards
  • Effective communication abilities in English, including analytical skills, interpersonal communication, and presentations. French is an asset.
  • Construction / Field work experience is required.
  • Integrity, team spirit, and a commitment to excellence

At CIMA+, we value diversity of talent and perspective. You think you can add value, but don't meet all the job requirements? We invite you to apply, because everyone has something unique to offer. The outstanding talents that choose to join us at CIMA+ soon realize that we go all out to encourage them to grow. We look forward to hearing how you can contribute to our success.

Why choose CIMA+? Because we offer you:

  • Comprehensive Group Benefits available from day one for all permanent employees working at least 20 hours per week
  • Employee and Family Assistance Program
  • Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with up to 4% employer contribution
  • As an employee-owned company, an annual opportunity to purchase shares for all eligible employees
  • Flexible work schedule in a hybrid work mode
  • Work/Life balance policy across Canada
  • 3-5 weeks of vacation, based on years of relevant experience
  • Tailored training to improve your existing skills

At CIMA+, we recognize the richness and diversity of each individual’s experience. Compensation for this role is therefore based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, while maintaining internal equity. The level and associated salary may vary depending on the candidate’s profile.

CIMA+ uses an applicant tracking system that includes an automated match score feature. However, this score is not used to screen, assess, or select applicants. All hiring decisions are made through human review.

Ethics and integrity are fundamental values at CIMA+. That is why we are committed to ensuring equal access to resources and opportunities for candidates, regardless of their identity (race, ethnicity, colour, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, socio-economic status or background, etc.).​

In keeping with the principles of employment equity, we encourage all applications, including, but not limited to, those from women, Indigenous people, people with disabilities and visible minorities. We also encourage candidates to complete the self-identification form when applying for employment.​

We are committed to providing a workplace that is accessible. Accommodations are available in accordance with CIMA's policies. If you require an accommodation, please let us know.

Find out about The CIMA+ advantage - CIMA+.

title: Dispute Resolution Specialist - 6 month contract
description:
As a Dispute Resolution Specialist, you'll be at the forefront of complaint resolution, helping consumers and financial firms work towards fair outcomes. You'll:

  • Review and assess complaints.
  • Speak directly with consumers and financial firms to understand concerns and gather information.
  • Facilitate discussions and negotiations to support early resolution.
  • Manage key early case activities, including initial contact, information exchange and negotiation.
  • Apply AFCA's complaint resolution framework to progress complaints efficiently and fairly.
  • Work across a diverse range of matters spanning banking, insurance and superannuation.

To be successful in this role, you'll have:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and navigate challenging conversations.
  • A customer-focused, resolution-driven approach and strong stakeholder management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain momentum across a busy caseload.
  • Resilience, empathy and sound judgement when dealing with complex issues.
  • Experience in complaint handling, dispute resolution, customer service, financial services or a similar environment.
  • Confidence learning new systems, processes and subject matter, with the ability to quickly get up to speed.
  • The ability to work both independently and as part of a supportive team.

In return, you'll receive structured training, ongoing coaching and the support you need to build your dispute resolution expertise and succeed in the role.

  • Gold AWEI Accreditation 2025 – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
  • Accredited Family Friendly Workplace – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing (Please note - this role will initially require 5 days in person office attendance during the training period)
  • Additional and inclusive leave options – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at Careers@afca.org.au.

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

This role is available to working holiday Visa's - with full availibility and be able to commit to June 2027.

About AFCA

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.
