title: Staff AI Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Workload: 80–100%Location: Baden

Axpo operates 100+ power plants across 40+ energy markets. AI is now part of daily work - colleagues aren't just using it, they're building with it. Join us to create the governed foundation for AI at Axpo: controlled access to models and tools, and a secure platform for AI-assisted applications.

What you will do:

  • Set the standard for how Axpo consumes AI, and run the components that enforce it: LLM routing across providers, an MCP tool registry, identity and permissions, rate limits, budgets per team, tracing and audit. A2A will follow.

  • Build the deployment path from repository to running, SSO-protected application with secrets handling, safe defaults, and an administration interface for non-technical users.

  • Harden the infrastructure so the code does not have to be trusted: isolated runtimes, code analysis, vulnerability checks, restricted egress and dropped privileges.

  • Support the people who build on the platform: fix issues, improve documentation, turn recurring feedback into product changes.

  • Assess open-weight models and European inference providers and make suitable options available.

  • Work closely with product, security, cloud, and business teams to deliver useful, production-ready capabilities.

What you bring & who you are:

  • Solid backend and infrastructure engineering: several years building and operating production systems, with strong Python and API skills, plus containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and monitoring.

  • Genuine interest in AI models and their governance – you've built something with models, know where they fail, and the governance side (who may use which model, with which data, how usage is traced and controlled) interests rather than annoys you.

  • You write reasonable frontend code (or are keen to learn it), communicate clearly, and would rather fix the documentation than answer the same question twice.

  • Fluent in English; German is useful, not required.

  • Ideally, you're familiar with MCP, A2A, agent frameworks or evaluation tooling, as well as Django and Azure – or come from comparable frameworks and clouds.

  • Even if you don't meet every point: nobody has years of experience in this field yet, so how you approach unfamiliar territory matters more than the tools you've used – we look forward to your application.

About the team:

We're innovators and problem solvers passionate about transforming the energy industry through digital technology. We value collaboration, open communication and humor. If you want to make an impact, get things done and learn every day, we can't wait to welcome you aboard.

title: Product Manager
description:
PRODUCT MANAGER- PARTS & SUPPLIES | Carrier Enterprise | Orlando

Introduction:

Carrier Enterprise, a leading national distributor of residential and light commercial HVAC products, is seeking a dynamic Product Manager for Parts & Supplies. Join a team that excels in providing top-notch HVAC/R products, parts, and supplies through licensed HVAC/R dealers and contractors.

Company Description:

Carrier Enterprise (CE) is a premier national distributor specializing in residential and light commercial Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) products, parts, and supplies. We serve licensed HVAC/R dealers and contractors, ensuring top-quality HVAC solutions across 28 states, Puerto Rico, the Caribbean, Latin America, Mexico, and Canada. With over 200+ locations, we are well-positioned to meet our customers' HVAC/R needs.

Company Website:

www.carrierenterprise.com

Job Summary:

The Product Manager will be responsible for leading critical cross functional product development of new and existing product lines while identifying, understanding, defining, and prioritizing the future of our product assortment to support our business growth plan. The position will be responsible for product assortment, marketing, programs, promotions, product pricing, vendor negotiations, product training, monitoring, tracking, and analyzing product performance, product SKU maintenance, and managing non-performing inventory for parts and supplies across product sectors.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain sales strategy with regional representatives for all wholesale product offerings for all sales channels.
  • Develop, implement, manage, and communicate all facets of new product introduction from strategy to pricing, marketing, PIM coordination, inventory planning, product roll-out and execution on all product offerings in all sales channels for Parts and Supplies.
  • Evaluate competitive product and pricing data. Communicate with factory and sales teams on advantages and disadvantages, product gaps and voice of customer.
  • Recommend sell price positioning (max and min) to maximize market share and company profit margins.
  • Partners with Regional Pricing and Demand Planning groups to create assortment, pricing, and stocking levels for the Region.
  • Conduct regular visits to regional branches to execute performance checklists, audit local product needs, and ensure alignment with HQ strategic initiatives.
  • Lead regional requirements for branch merchandising, showroom displays, and planogramming initiatives to maximize parts and supplies product awareness
  • Coordinate and manage specialized regional programs, including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and Factory Authorized Parts (FAP) requirements across identified sales channels
  • Identify, coordinate, and facilitate required product and technical training programs for internal regional personnel and external customers
  • Provide oversight and assist regional sell-through and disposition of all products, parts and supplies
  • Identifies and removes roadblocks and obstacles that may impair product launches, execution, and deadlines to ensure we meet strategic, sales and marketing goals.
  • Develop, implement, manage internal, external and factory marketing programs in conjunction with both Carrier Enterprise HQ and Regional Marketing Directors.
  • Drives new and existing products through the stage gate process and facilitates full product execution launch. This includes but not limited to managing model supersedes, new SKU set up and designation through all stages of stage gate.
  • Defines and drives objectives on product launches and promotions providing the Concept, Features & Benefits, Customer Segmentation and Pricing Strategy.
  • Coordinates with Carrier Corp Regional Product Specific Sales Manager activities with sales team.
  • Provide oversight on all products for CE Regional reporting on a monthly/quarterly cadence for CE leadership, Carrier Corporation, and share-holder review.
  • Conducts vendor mid-year and annual reviews on movement, marketing plans and reviews performance feedback.
  • Support sales teams in all customer channels with joint customer sales calls.
  • Provide oversight for overall regional product specific Market Funds in conjunction with the CE HQ Marketing department.
  • Manage repository of product and parts and supplies, sales, and pricing information to be accessible by all sales team channels.
  • Evaluate, understand, communicate, and manage State, Local Utility rebates impacting all products, parts and supplies segments.
  • Evaluate, understand, communicate, and manage State, Local and National mandates and changes impacting all products, parts, and supplies segments.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3 - 5+ years Product Management, Product Sales experience in a high-ranking HVAC or related Product Management position.
  • Proven track record in the HVAC industry, ideally in products, services, technology, product management or in a specialized sales capacity
  • Diverse experience in product marketing, product assortment planning, and new product introduction with the ability to leverage new product innovations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft applications and Salesforce
  • Strong analytical, technical, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of product strategy and its relationship to the Wholesale HVAC industry
  • Highly organized with the ability to prioritize and track multiple tasks to successful completion
  • Exceptional leadership and managerial skills
  • A rich blend of analytical, creative, strategic, and tactical talent

Benefits:

  • Vision Insurance

  • Disability Insurance (Short-term and Long-term)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Tuition Reimbursement & Professional Development

  • Company Paid Holiday's
  • 401(k) Plan with Employer Match
  • Employee Discount Program

Full-time and part-time positions are available. To explore this exciting opportunity and other career opportunities at Carrier Enterprise, visit our careers page at www.carrierenterprise.com/careers. Learn more about our company and team.

title: Foyle Haven - Case Worker
description:
Job Description

Contract - Permanent

Rota - 35 per week (varied shifts)

Location - 23A John Street, Londonderry BT48 6JY

Salary - £28,040.00 P/A


Employee Benefits

  • Enhanced Annual Leave – 35 days per year, increasing as your length of service increases

  • Contributory Pension scheme
  • Health Cash Back & Rewards Plan
  • Christmas Savers club
  • Bluelight discount card

Plus, many opportunities to learn and develop within the organisation


Why work for us?
Depaul is a cross border charity supporting some of the most marginalised individuals, couples and families experiencing homelessness. Our mission is to end homelessness and change the lives of those affected by it. Would you like to help us to meet our mission?
We are a values led organisation and aim, at all times, to live and breathe these values in our everyday work. Our values are based on four key principles:
• We celebrate the potential of people
• We put our words into action
• We aim to take a wider role in civil society
• We believe in rights and responsibilities If you choose to work for Depaul


The Service

Foyle Haven is a day centre, based in Derry/Londonderry, supporting men and women, aged 18 and above who are experiencing homelessness or are at risk of homelessness. We operate a harm reduction, low threshold service that is committed to helping people most in need who are often excluded from society. Services include daily meal and snack provision, showering and laundry facilities, Needle and Syringe Exchange service, drug and alcohol support, recreational and social activities and much much more!


The aim of the role is to support and signpost service users into services that will improve their housing, health and wellbeing while improving the service users quality of life. This is achieved through the provision of engagement and individualised support plans, targeted interventions, signposting and group work. You will work proactively form strong relationships and gain service users' trust, striving to provide the best possible service levels at all times.


Service user focus

● To provide service user support in a person lead manner, which is both professional and respectful.

● Assess the safety and wellbeing needs of the service user and develop plans which address and reduce identified risks.

● In partnership with service users, to assess their needs and develop support plans, which are flexible and respond to the changing needs of the service users.

● Supporting people to engage with services, to stabilize and to settle into accommodation settings

● To build effective, appropriate and supportive relationships with service users, developing support plans with the aim of reducing re-offending

● Be responsible and resilient in the face of challenging behaviour and individuals who may be in crisis; disclose and discuss risks responsibly, operate within existing data sharing frameworks; acknowledge areas of limitation; and liaise with all linked professionals responsibly.

● Developing and implementing Resettlement Plans and reviewing progress with Service Users.

● Facilitate individuals to identify and maintain appropriate move on accommodation providing practical help and support throughout this transition.

● To work with service users and relevant external agencies in order to deliver meaningful and effective key working To support service users to integrate with their communities in line with good neighbourhood principals.

● To advocate on behalf of service users to achieve the best outcomes for them.

● Provide outreach work within the community based on service delivery needs



Health & Safety

● To ensure that Health and Safety standards are met within the service in accordance with Depaul’s Health and Safety policy and procedures.

● To undertake assigned duties regarding the overall health and safety and security of the service and utilize available security systems to manage risk relevant to the service.

● To ensure completion of all relevant wellbeing and health and safety checks



Administration & Record Keeping

● Carry out service administration tasks such as; upkeep of client records, financial transactions, internal and external reports, incident and accident management and other record keeping relevant to the roles.

● To remain vigilant to IT and cyber risks and comply at all times with Depaul’s IT Security policies.

Other duties

● To be a contributing team player, taking part in handovers, team meetings, core training, the mentoring of Volunteers and supporting other team members in ensuring all decision making is appropriate and consistent

● To at all times undertake your role in a professional manner maintaining a high quality standard of work in line with Depaul Values and ethos.


The above list is not exhaustive; additional areas of responsibility may be added over time and flexibility to cover for other staff roles is required from time to time.



Qualifications & Experience

· A formal Level 3 qualification in a social care field, e.g. diploma in health and social care or equivalent

And

· At least 2 years paid experience working with vulnerable women, desirably experience working with women leaving prison


OR

· At least 3 years paid experience working with vulnerable women, desirably experience working with women leaving prison

And

3 formal qualifications at Level 2 to include Math and English, e.g. GCSE’s or NVQ


Skills

· Good working knowledge of risk assessment and risk management processes

· Good IT skills, including working knowledge of using IT systems to record client information

· Good written and verbal communication skills.

· The ability to compile and present accurate written and electronic reports


Knowledge

· Have an understanding of homelessness and the issues that can lead to homelessness

· Have an understanding of what supports can be offered in homeless services to promote positive futures

· Have knowledge/experience of working with needs assessment, key working and support planning for service users, specifically relating to people who have committed offences

· Have a knowledge of the statutory and voluntary sector resources available to people experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness

· Understand the importance for Health and Safety standards in the delivery of services on a day to day basis.

· Knowledge of relevant statutory and voluntary agencies and the ability to network/liaise with all relevant bodies

· Knowledge and willingness to work within the guidelines of Depaul vision mission and values.


Circumstances

· Essential Criteria for community outreach Case Workers: Access to a car insured for business purposes during working hours, and a valid driving licence.


Access NI

This Post is subject to an Enhanced Access NI check. Having a criminal record will not necessarily debar you from working with Depaul. This will depend on the nature of the position, together with the circumstances and background of your offences or other information contained on a disclosure certificate.


NISCC

This post is subject to NISCC registration, if you do not hold a valid registration this must be completed within your probationary period.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES:
Depaul strives to create a diverse and inclusive programme and is committed to ensuring equality of access to our opportunities and equality of treatment for our staff in all our policies and practices. We welcome applications from individuals aged 18 and over from a diverse range of backgrounds.

title: Employment Consultant
description:
Make a real impact – create opportunities and change lives!!!

Are you passionate about supporting people with disability to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant at our Bridgewater, TAS site within our Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Who Are We: -

APM is a global health and human services organisation transforming lives since 1994. Be part of a 16,000-strong team across 11 countries, empowering people of all abilities to lead independent and fulfilling lives. Thrive with us, benefiting from exceptional career growth and development opportunities across our global network of brands.

About the role: -

This is a dynamic, dual-focused role where you can combine people support with sales, relationship building and administration, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference every day.

You will:

  • Support participants (many facing barriers such as disability, injury, or long-term unemployment) to become job-ready
  • Actively market candidates to employers and generate job opportunities

  • Build strong relationships with participants to understand their employment goals and position them for success.
  • Coach participants to be job-ready, competitive, and interview confident.

  • Conduct regular appointments and track participant progress toward employment outcomes.
  • Manage compliance, documentation, and data entry in line with program requirements.
  • Track performance against KPIs and achieve employment outcome targets.
  • Celebrate milestones and successful placements to build participant confidence and engagement.

What Success Looks Like: -

  • Strong employment outcomes for participants.
  • A growing network of engaged local employers.
  • Consistent achievement of KPIs and performance targets.
  • Positive, long-term placements that change lives.

About You: -

You are:

  • A natural communicator and relationship builder with confidence engaging employers.
  • Experienced in sales, business development, recruitment, or customer-facing roles.
  • Passionate about helping people overcome barriers and succeed.
  • Resilient, target-driven, and motivated by achieving outcomes.
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

Why You’ll Love It: -

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

  • Base salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success.

title: Staff AI/ML Scientist (Conversational AI)
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Staff AI / Machine Learning Scientist with the focus on Conversational AI to join our growing AI Center of Excellence team, responsible for using AI to drive innovation across the organization and accelerate positive impact on our planet and society. In this role, you will redefine how users interact with complex enterprise domain data - transforming simple text interfaces into goal-oriented, multi-step conversational agents for a variety of use cases, from sustainable procurement to supply chain resilience to decarbonisation. You will be part of the team of over 20 scientists and engineers delivering solutions for our product portfolio and enhancing operational excellence.

Your global responsibilities will include (but will not be limited to):

  • Design and test multi-turn, state-aware conversational systems using LLM reasoning loops (e.g., ReAct, Plan-and-Solve) and multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom state machines)

  • Innovate by adapting new frameworks and recent advances in generative and agentic AI

  • Promote best practices in AI / ML and mentor junior team members

  • Lead functional teams and initiatives to accelerate the adoption of Conversational AI

  • Leverage Python, MLflow, Azure stack (e.g., Azure cloud, Azure ML, Azure Data Factory) and Databricks to deliver end-to-end AI solutions to build, benchmark, and maintain AI / ML models

  • Stay in close contact with customers to evaluate their needs and recommend solutions that increase customer satisfaction and drive business value

  • Stay on top of technology trends in the area of, but not limited to, AI and apply this knowledge to the key challenges ahead of EcoVadis

  • PhD or Master’s degree in quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics/Applied Math, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Computational Linguistics)

  • 8+ years of overall experience in machine learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP), with at least 4+ years specializing in Conversational AI in production environments

  • Advanced knowledge of agentic frameworks and proven track record building autonomous or semi-autonomous agentic systems at scale

  • Experience in leading end-to-end AI initiatives in industry, from design to implementation to integration, and applying best software development practices

  • Excellent mentoring skills and accountability for high quality and timely delivery of the initiatives they lead

  • Experience of cross-functional collaboration in the development of AI-powered products (e.g., Engineers, Product Managers)

  • Experience building conversational interfaces over complex enterprise domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Procurement, Financial Risk) is a plus

  • Track record of peer-reviewed publications in top-tier NLP/AI venues (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, AAAI, KDD) is a plus

  • Offer available only for candidates eligible to work and live in Spain

  • Location: Hybrid in Barcelona (2 days per week in the office) / Full remote from Spain

In return for your expertise, we offer:

  • Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment
  • Flexible working hours
  • Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing
  • Access to professional mental health support
  • Referral bonus policy
  • Learning and development
  • Sustainability events and community involvement
  • Peer recognition program
  • Employee-led resource groups
  • Remote work from abroad policy
  • Meals and Transportation Vouchers (Coverflex card)
  • Dental Benefits
  • Life & Accident Insurance + Private Health Insurance
  • Paid employee volunteer day
  • Paid moving day (1/year)
  • Time off: 1 Community Service Day + 1 Personal Day
  • Summer Hours in July and August (36 hours per week)
  • Hybrid Monthly Allowance for electricity and Internet

Our hiring team looks forward to reviewing your CV, in English, with a guaranteed response to every application. A new job with purpose awaits you!

Don’t fit all the criteria but still think you’d be a good candidate? Please apply anyway to give our hiring team the opportunity to assess your skills and to learn more about what you could bring to EcoVadis. We’re interested in hiring from a diverse and skilled talent pool, regardless of professional and educational background.

Can the hiring process be adjusted to suit my needs? Yes. We want everyone going through the hiring process with EcoVadis to feel confident that you are able to demonstrate your full potential. We welcome applications from disabled people, people with long-term health conditions, and neurodiverse candidates. If you need any adjustments, including the provision of interview questions, please let the hiring team know.

Our team’s strength comes from everyone’s uniqueness and is founded upon mutual respect. EcoVadis commits to equity, inclusion and reducing bias in our hiring processes. EcoVadis does not accept any form of discrimination based on color, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, beliefs, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, parental status, or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. title: Montör till kund i Västerås

Arbetsuppgifter

Är du en noggrann och praktiskt lagd person med erfarenhet av montering och ett intresse för teknik och mekanik? För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara trygg i ditt praktiska kunnande, kunna arbeta självständigt och förstå hur olika delar och material samverkar i en färdig produkt. Arbetet innebär bland annat att: Montera produkter och prototyper utifrån ritningar och instruktioner. Läsa och tolka tekniska ritningar. Använda olika handverktyg och monteringsverktyg. Välja och hantera lämpliga material och infästningsmetoder, exempelvis popnit. Säkerställa att monteringen utförs noggrant och med hög kvalitet. Ha ett helhetsperspektiv och förstå hur de olika momenten påverkar slutresultatet. Arbetstiderna är måndag–fredag kl. 07.00–15.30.

Din profil

Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som har tidigare erfarenhet av montering, gärna från en mekanisk verkstad eller en tillverkande industriverksamhet. Du har grundläggande teknisk förståelse och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta utifrån ritningar. Vi tror att du har: Tidigare erfarenhet av industriell eller mekanisk montering. God verktygsvana och förståelse för olika material och monteringsmetoder. Förmåga att läsa och förstå tekniska ritningar. Ett praktiskt handlag och förmåga att se helheten i en konstruktion. Vi söker dig som har hunnit bygga upp en viss yrkeserfarenhet och som kan bidra med både praktisk kompetens och ett kvalitetstänk i det dagliga arbetet. title: Rostering Specialist
description:
An exciting secondment opportunity is available for a Rostering Specialist to join our Trade People & Culture team.

Reporting to the P&C Business Partner – Trade, you will become a key subject matter expert in rostering, labour optimisation and workforce compliance across the Burson network.

Working closely with Regional and Store Managers, you'll analyse rosters and workforce data to identify opportunities to improve labour utilisation, reduce avoidable overtime and strengthen compliance. Importantly, this role isn't responsible for building store rosters or owning labour budgets. Instead, you'll provide the insights, coaching and practical guidance that help operational leaders make better workforce decisions.

This is a great development opportunity for someone with strong operational, workforce, rostering or analytical experience who wants to broaden their exposure and make an impact across the wider Burson network.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analyse store rosters, labour utilisation and overtime trends across the Burson network to identify efficiencies, risks and opportunities.
  • Review roster exceptions and identify potential workforce compliance issues, including breaks, overtime, shift patterns and roster changes.
  • Partner with Regional and Store Managers to improve rostering practices while balancing customer service, team member experience and labour efficiency.
  • Provide practical coaching and guidance to operational leaders to build their capability and confidence in workforce planning and rostering.
  • Develop regular reporting and insights across overtime, labour utilisation, productivity and roster compliance.
  • Use workforce data to identify trends and recommend practical actions to improve performance and reduce avoidable labour costs.
  • Support continuous improvement of rostering processes, systems, reporting and workforce management tools.
  • Partner with People & Culture, Payroll, Finance and Operations to support consistent and compliant workforce management practices.

You are someone who enjoys getting behind the numbers and understanding why performance is changing, rather than simply producing a report.

You are agile, tactical and comfortable responding quickly when emerging sales or margin trends require further investigation. You are also a self-starter with strong attention to detail and the discipline to thoroughly review and validate your own work before sharing it with stakeholders.

You will bring:

  • Approximately 2–3 years' experience in commercial finance, financial analysis, management accounting or a similar analytical finance role.
  • Demonstrated experience analysing top-line commercial performance, ideally across sales, margins, products, brands, customers or locations.
  • Strong reporting capability with the ability to turn complex data into practical and commercially relevant insights.
  • Advanced Excel skills, with VBA experience highly regarded.
  • Experience creating or enhancing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with excellent attention to detail.
  • Confidence partnering with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Product, Marketing and Finance.
  • A self-starting, agile and commercially curious mindset with the ability to manage changing priorities.

description:
At Epikast, our mission is to redefine how biopharmaceutical companies engage with their most important stakeholders: patients, caregivers, and physicians.

As a Disease Specialist, you will engage with U.S. healthcare professionals through video calls, phone calls, and emails, delivering credible, data-driven education on disease areas, diagnostic challenges, and relevant therapies. You will build trusted relationships with key specialists, understand patient access barriers, and identify opportunities to improve the HCP and patient experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage and educate HCPs: Deliver credible, balanced, and tailored discussions on disease burden, diagnostic challenges, clinical developments, and relevant therapies to specialists, including hematologists, dermatologists, and disease-area experts, through virtual and remote channels.

  • Ensure compliance and integrity: Conduct all activities in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, company policies, compliance requirements, and established industry standards.


Role Requirements

  • Education: MD or PhD in a relevant scientific field required; a Bachelor’s degree is essential, with an advanced degree preferred.
  • Industry Experience: Minimum of three years of successful pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or specialty sales experience, including substantial experience in hematology/oncology.
  • Therapeutic Expertise: Direct breast cancer sales experience required, with demonstrated knowledge of the metastatic breast cancer (mBC) treatment landscape and breast oncology community.
  • Scientific Communication: Proven ability to engage clinicians and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) at a peer level, translating complex scientific information into clear, accessible, evidence-based discussions while maintaining scientific rigor.


What we offer:

  • A collaborative, international work environment with highly skilled professionals
  • A comprehensive training program covering the US healthcare system and products
  • Industry-leading compensation and benefits

This is a role based in Athens, operating on a hybrid model, focused on engaging U.S. healthcare professionals through virtual channels, including video calls, telephone, and email. Working hours are aligned to US time zones: 15.00-23.00 and exceptionally 19.00-03.00am.

The above list is not exhaustive; additional areas of responsibility may be added over time and flexibility to cover for other staff roles is required from time to time.

title: Pre-Sales Engineer (Poland)
description:
Sentrycs is a fast-paced, fast-growing startup whose mission is to keep society protected from the rapidly evolving threat of malicious drones.

With hundreds of systems deployed worldwide, we help safeguard critical infrastructure, airports, borders, military forces, and more by continuously monitoring the skies, detecting rogue drones, and surgically neutralizing them using proprietary cyber technologies.


In these roles, the Presales Engineer will work closely with our sales executives and business partners to support the sales process for Homeland Security, military, and government clients.

This position requires strong customer engagement skills and the ability to bridge the gap between client requirements and solution design. The ideal candidate will craft compelling technical solutions, deliver valuable field insights to R&D, and manage the entire technical sales cycle—from field demonstrations to tender responses—ensuring successful customer engagements.


Location: Poland (Warsaw preferred), with up to 50% travel

What will you do?

  • Partner with our sales executives and Polish resellers and integrators.
  • Lead all technical aspects of the sales cycle: discovery, demos, POCs, tender responses and closing the specifications.
  • Become a trusted advisor to customers such as the Polish Armed Forces, Border Guard, Police, State Protection Service (SOP), airports, and critical-infrastructure operators. Understand their operational needs and show how Sentrycs meets them.
  • Deliver technical presentations, live demos and POCs, including deploying and troubleshooting hardware in the field.
  • Lead the technical side of Polish public tenders , including specification and compliance documents.
  • Bring field feedback and customer requirements back to product and R&D.
  • Stay current on Sentrycs products, competitors and the Polish C-UAS market.
  • Keep field and opportunity data accurate in the CRM.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of pre-sales or sales engineering experience, preferably B2G (defence, homeland security, police, critical infrastructure).
  • Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting on-prem hardware in the field.
  • Experience leading the technical side of complex public tenders with multiple stakeholders, ideally in Poland.
  • Strong presentation and demo skills, for audiences from operators to senior officers.
  • Ability to work across sales, R&D and partners without formal authority.
  • Comfort in a fast-moving global company with ambiguity and multiple time zones.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Native Polish and fluent English.

Advantages:

  • Russian.
  • Background in RF, radio communications, or electronics (spectrum, SDR, antennas, EW/SIGINT).
  • Experience with counter-drone, radar, or C2/PSIM systems.
  • Military or homeland-security background, or drone piloting experience.
  • Basic IP networking and Linux.
  • Holds, or is eligible for, a Polish security clearance

title: EMT; 3-12-Hour Days
description:
Non-Emergency Patient Transport EMT

Location: Dobson

Schedule:

  • Three 12-hour days per week (Days vary Sunday through Saturday)
  • Rotating weekends

Every Patient. Every Family. Every Time.

At Mountain Valley, what we do is personal. Personal for those we serve and personal for us. Every day, we stand shoulder to shoulder with individuals facing the most daunting challenge of their lives—a serious or terminal illness. We help those with advanced illness navigate their day-to-day struggles, whether physical, emotional, social, or spiritual. We also strive to help our communities better understand end-of-life care. For those of us at Mountain Valley, there could never be a more important or rewarding job.

Join Our Team

Mountain Valley Hospice is seeking a compassionate and dedicated Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) to provide safe and professional patient transport to and from our hospice homes, as well as between patients’ homes and healthcare facilities. This role is essential in ensuring a smooth and comfortable transition for patients receiving hospice care.

What You'll Do

  • Safely transport patients between hospice homes, private residences, hospitals, skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), and assisted living facilities (ALFs).
  • Assist with patient movement, ensuring proper lifting and transfer techniques to prevent injury and maintain patient safety.
  • Provide basic medical support as needed during transport, including monitoring vital signs and responding to patient needs within EMT scope of practice.
  • Communicate effectively with patients, families, and hospice staff to coordinate transport logistics and ensure seamless transitions.
  • Maintain transport vehicle readiness, including checking equipment, cleanliness, and compliance with safety protocols.
  • Follow all hospice and state EMS regulations to ensure high-quality patient care during transport.

Qualifications

  • Valid North Carolina EMT certification
  • Current CPR certification
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record
  • Strong interpersonal skills and compassionate bedside manner
  • Ability to lift and transfer patients safely
  • Experience in patient transport or EMS preferred

If you're an EMT looking for a meaningful role in hospice care, we invite you to join our team and make a difference in the lives of patients and families. Apply today!

At Mountain Valley, we are committed to fostering a workplace of mutual respect and diversity. We make hiring decisions based on knowledge, skills, and abilities. Mountain Valley Hospice is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), sexual orientation, parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or any other non-merit-based factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Junior Performance Software Engineer
description:
The Role

Openchip is building exciting new RISC-V chips with AI and HPC acceleration. As a Junior Perfomance Software Engineer, you will actively participate in our performance team, helping to optimize popular AI and HPC applications and benchmarks to deliver best in class performance, and work with customers to optimize their workloads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make independent technical contributions to help their team deliver its commitments. In particular:
  • Optimize AI, HPC, and other workloads and benchmarks for our RISC-V silicon with vector extensions.
  • Identify bottlenecks with workload characterization and drive implementation of solutions.
  • Decompose applications and how they run on the underlying hardware.
  • Understand performance at a system level, from CPU, memory, storage, power utilization, etc.
  • Profile and optimize on our pre-silicon (simulators, emulators, FPGAS), and silicon environments.
  • Troubleshoot and root cause analysis, to resolve performance issues.
  • Optimize HPC and AI libraries and runtimes.
  • Work with customers to optimize their important workloads for our architecture.
  • Contribute to instrumentation of performance and power at the operating system level.
  • Integrate with CI/CD to automate performance benchmarking.
  • Present findings to senior technical leaders at our company and at industry conferences.
  • Contribute upstream where appropriate.
  • Interact with colleagues across projects to unblock issues, or to reach consensus on technical topics. In particular:
  • Work with hardware teams, influencing hardware/software co-design.
  • Work with teams developing compilers, firmware, AI stacks, middleware, etc., and contribute as necessary.
  • Collaborate with colleagues through code reviews, bug triaging, design documents,...
  • Contribute to shared team responsibilities (CI failure triaging, documentation, code fixits, rotations... ).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience in the relevant field (1-3yr).
  • Solid knowledge about computer architecture (CPU, cache, memory hierarchy, buses, etc.).
  • Proven experience with performance optimizaiton, and experience with performance profiling and analysis tools (Linux perf, iperf, lmbench, sysbench, flamegraphs, JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling, Intel (R) VTUNE, ARM SPE, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of low-level development languages (C, C++, Rust, etc.).
  • Experience with assembly language (any architecture).
  • Experience with performance benchmarks (CoreMark, FPMark, LMBench, Stream, SPEC CPU, SPEC INT, graph500, CORAL, HPGMG, CoMD, Linpack, SuiteSparse Matrix Collection, MLPERF, ResNet, BERT etc.).
  • Solid understanding of operating systems, databases, networking, and cloud technologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and identify complex issues.
  • Experience with bare metal (without OS) development for embedded systems and microcontrollers.
  • Experience with standard tools for source control (git), continuous integration, task management (Jira).
  • Experience with machine learning and/or HPC performance optimization.
  • Experience with Fortran.
  • Experience with RISC-V development at the assembly-language level.
  • Experience with statistical analysis.
  • Experience with emulators and simulators (Qemu, Gem5, Spike).
  • Experience in containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with hypervisor technology (KVM, Xen).
  • Experience with open source software development.

Soft Skills

  • Team player: communicative and collaborative person who focuses on the outcome of the team above the individual needs.
  • Curious about learning new technologies/stacks.
  • Capable of within- and cross-team collaboration at the technical level.
  • Can-do attitude, proactive and willing to step up and resolve any obstacle. Self-aware, self-starter, and self-motivated.

We are looking for outstanding people willing to join our mission to change this industry and help to build a better world.

At Openchip & Software Technologies S.L., we believe a diverse and inclusive team is the key to groundbreaking ideas. We foster a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential – regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:

Your responsibilities will include (but will not be limited to):

  • Leverage data to solve business problems of various business units at EcoVadis

  • Design AI/ML pipelines by applying the best practices in MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps

  • Build AI/ML engineering infrastructure and systems to orchestrate batch and real-time pipelines

  • Run large-scale experiments and tests to ensure quality and efficiency of ML and data pipelines

  • Partner with scientists and engineers to make AI/ML models accessible to end-users and downstream processes

  • Leverage Python, MLflow, Azure stack (e.g., Azure cloud, Azure ML, Azure Foundry) and Databricks to deliver end-to-end solutions

You have an outgoing personality along with an exceptional level of drive and a desire to pursue a career in an international and dynamic environment. You also possess excellent verbal and written communication, critical thinking and analytical skills.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • Industry experience in driving, designing and implementing production-grade AI/ML systems and integrating those into business applications as well as model monitoring at scale

  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including agile methodologies, coding standards, code reviews, source management, build processes, testing, and operations

  • Experience with REST API for ML model serving

  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases

  • Contribution to open-source libraries is a plus

title: Senior Backend Developer (Java / Spring Boot)
description:
Job Description

Sim Local is a leading global travel eSIM provider, helping millions of travellers stay connected in over 200 destinations worldwide. Through a combination of local operator partnerships, innovative digital products, and omnichannel distribution, we deliver seamless connectivity experiences for international travellers.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Developer with a strong track record of delivering production services and APIs end to end. You'll own backend services and API implementation across our multi-tenant, multi-brand eSIM and travel SIM platform, with real influence over architecture and technical decisions.

Your work will power our D2C website and mobile app, our white-label partner stores, our internal platform, and the Networks and payment integrations behind them.

Our stack: Java 17+, Spring Boot, Maven, MySQL, JPA/Hibernate, Liquibase and AWS (SQS/SNS, Lambda, Cognito, SES, CloudFormation).

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build and ship backend services and APIs across our platform — customer-facing APIs, internal back-office systems, and partner integrations
  • Build, maintain and scale our Java / Spring Boot services and API gateways, keeping them secure and reliable in production
2. Third-Party Integrations
  • Build and maintain integrations with networks, payment or 3rd party providers, including webhooks and event-driven flows
  • Design for failure — idempotency, retries and graceful handling of errors across distributed systems
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and help shape the technical direction of the platform as it scales
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities before they reach production
  • Review code — including AI-generated code — and raise the bar for quality, testability and security across the team
  • Champion automated testing, clear API documentation and good engineering habits
  • Own the services you build in production, using observability and monitoring to keep them fast, efficient and secure at scale
  • Partner with platform engineering on infrastructure, deployments and incident resolution
  • Work with the Product Owner, developers and technical leaders to deliver focused, value-driven changes to the highest standard
  • Contribute to planning, agile ceremonies and continuous improvement of how the team works
What We're Looking For Essential – All Candidates
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or other relevant discipline or equivalent work experience.
  • 4+ years of backend development experience, with a proven track record of delivering production services end to end
  • 2+ years experience building RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Strong Java (17+) and Spring Boot, including Spring Security / OAuth2 and multi-module Maven projects
  • Relational databases (MySQL or similar), JPA/Hibernate and schema migration tools such as Liquibase — including schema design and query optimisation at scale
  • Cloud-native services on AWS — SQS/SNS, Lambda, Cognito, SES, and CloudFormation or similar infrastructure-as-code
  • Asynchronous, message- and event-driven architectures, including distributed systems patterns such as idempotency and retry handling
  • Automated testing — unit testing with JUnit and Mockito, and integration testing with Testcontainers or equivalent
  • Observability and monitoring with APM tooling (Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch or similar)
  • Hands-on use of Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants, with the judgement to review, correct and take full ownership of AI-generated code
  • Strong code review skills and a track record of raising the bar for code quality across a team
  • Caching strategies and high-traffic, high-concurrency systems (e.g. Redis)
  • Integrating third-party APIs and webhooks — payment providers, telecom/carrier providers, or CRM/marketing platforms
  • Experience in a cross-functional Scrum team using Jira and Confluence
  • API documentation with OpenAPI / Swagger
  • Background in telecom, eSIM, travel or e-commerce
Personal Qualities
  • Strong delivery focus — takes ownership from design through to production
  • Proactive — spots improvements and feels empowered to drive them
  • Maintains and defends high engineering standards with good practices and habits
  • Collaborative, clear communicator with product and non-technical stakeholders
  • Passionate about development and eager to keep learning
What We Offer
  • Fully remote or hybrid — join the team in our Dublin 16 office whenever you like, or skip the long commute
  • Competitive salary, depending on experience
  • 21 days' annual leave, plus an extra day for each complete year worked, up to 25 days per year
  • Summer Fridays — half days on Fridays throughout the summer
  • Maternity benefit

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a company that cares about its people, likes to promote talent from within, and is continually growing in new markets.

title: Teknisk administratör till vår kund Alg-Börje!
description:
Trivs du i en administrativ roll där du får strukturera, dokumentera och skapa ordning och reda? Vill du vara en nyckelperson i ett drivet team där ditt arbete direkt bidrar till att säkra hög kvalitet? Då kan rollen som Teknisk Administratör hos Alg-Börje vara helt rätt för dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag då urvalet sker löpande!

Om tjänsten

Alg-Börje AB i Valbo har sedan 1980 specialiserat sig på kosttillskott baserade på havsalger och marina råvaror. Med över 40 års erfarenhet utvecklar, tillverkar och säljer det familjeägda företaget produkter med hög biotillgänglighet och dokumenterad kvalitet. Genom noggrant utvalda råvaror och ett starkt fokus på näringsnytta har Alg-Börje byggt upp ett stort kundförtroende och ett långsiktigt engagemang för hälsa.

Nu behöver Alg-Börje förstärkning av en Teknisk Administratör! I denna roll kommer du att fokusera på att bygga upp och digitalisera företagets dokumentations- och kvalitetssystem genom att strukturera processer och gå igenom underlag.

Uppdraget förväntas pågå i minst 4 månader med god chans till förlängning.

Du erbjuds

  • En nyckelroll i ett spännande skede: Du får driva och bygga upp strukturer som kommer att lägga grunden för företagets fortsatta kvalitetssäkring
  • Kompetensutveckling: En marknadsledande webbutbildning inom livsmedelssäkerhet
  • En familjär arbetsmiljö: Arbete i en prestigelös miljö där ni hjälper och stöttar varandra

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som Teknisk Administratör kommer du att kartlägga hela produktions- och leverantörskedjan i deras digitala system. Du kommer självständigt att läsa in dig på krav och regler, söka information och göra egna bedömningar utifrån lagstiftning och standarder.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

  • Bygga upp, uppdatera och förflytta dokumentation i företagets digitala system
  • Säkerställa korrekt dokumentation för allt från råvaror, recept och maskiner till tillverkning och paketering
  • Granska leverantörer, råvaror och stämma av produktspecifikationer och analyscertifikat mot gällande regler
  • Skapa och underhålla kontrollrutiner för godsmottagning, lagring och tillverkningsprocesser

Vi söker dig som

  • Har som minst en gymnasial utbildning
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift, då arbetsuppgifterna kräver det
  • God teknisk förståelse och vana av administrativa system

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Tidigare har arbetat med kvalitetssystem, certifieringar (ex. FSSC 22000) eller teknisk dokumentation
  • Har erfarenhet från livsmedelsbranschen, tillverkningsindustrin eller farmaci
  • En eftergymnasial examen inom relevant område för tjänsten

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • Tillitsfull
  • Målmedveten
  • Ordningsam
  • Ansvarstagande

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

description:

About the role:


As an IDAM Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing Ampol’s Identity and Access Management capabilities, with a strong focus on our Saviynt platform. This is a hands-on engineering role, responsible for building and improving identity solutions that enable secure, compliant, and efficient access across the organisation. You'll be responsible for solving complex identity challenges at their source, developing scalable and sustainable solutions rather than applying short-term fixes.

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys the technical side of identity, including engineering business rules, configuring integrations, developing workflows, and working with APIs and automation. You'll bring a continuous improvement mindset, helping to mature Ampol's IDAM capability while introducing best practices, new ideas, and expertise gained from other enterprise environments.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience administering Active Directory, including OU structures, attributes, and Entra Sync.
  • Strong Saviynt experience including Lifecycle Management (JML), attribute mapping, connection configuration, application onboarding, business rule development, integration design, REST APIs, and SQL/Java reporting.
  • Proven ability to engineer and configure IAM solutions, workflows, rules, and integrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with a focus on identifying and resolving underlying causes rather than implementing temporary workarounds.
  • Broad exposure to identity, security, governance, risk, and compliance practices.
  • Experience working across complex enterprise environments and bringing IAM best practices from multiple organisations.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and technical documentation skills.

title: Ecosystem Trainer (Maternity Cover)
description:
Would you enjoy working with different actors in the Tiko ecosystem to ensure that they are knowledgeable about our platform and its offers? Continue reading to find out more about our Ecosystem Trainer role in Nigeria!


About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.


Globally, our team consists of +230 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.


We are hiring an Ecosystem Trainer in FCT, Nigeria. Candidates must be currently based in and have experience working within this region.


The job

The Ecosystem Trainer will work closely with all actors across Tiko Ecosystems to ensure that they can work with our platform and its offers.


In this role, you'll be responsible for:

  • Conducting training when a new clinic, provider or retailer is onboarded onto our platform. This training will ensure that the actor is aware of how Tiko works and their role in the ecosystem, our standard operating procedure, our code of conduct and other policies they would need to comply with.
  • Tracking inventory of all actors on the platform and whether each actor has a sufficient number of people who have been trained on Tiko at all times.
  • Updating actors when new offers are introduced on the platform and providing the training on how these can be accessed, and on how they work.
  • Identifying, preventing and responding to and mitigating any kind of fraud in any ecosystem that you work in. This will involve flagging and reporting any suspicious activity or breaches of our code of conduct and standard operating procedures.


About you

You are tech-savvy and proficient in mobile, messaging and the use of applications. You have brilliant interpersonal skills and can lead a team. You're a problem solver, who has the ability to innovate and improve the way that work is done.


Requirements

  • Based in FCT, Nigeria (mandatory).
  • 4+ years of experience in community development and public health programs (SRH).
  • Over 3 years working experience in facilitating or training of trainers (ToT).
  • Proven experience in developing learning programmes
  • Degree in Social Science, Public Health, Community Development, or a related field preferred.
  • Approachable and works well in a team.
  • Experience with Salesforce is a plus.
  • Fluency in English, Swahili (mandatory).

Compensation & Benefits
The gross salary range per month for this position is ₦1,276,302 - ₦1,595,378. Your final salary will be determined based on your experience and alignment with your future colleagues.


In addition to your monthly salary, we offer you:

  • Benefits and allowances tailored to your location.
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
  • A personal development budget of €500 per year to invest in your professional growth
  • Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge.
  • The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
  • A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement


The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website Tiko – Do more with Tiko. We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.


Important Recruitment Fraud Alert
Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

  • Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
  • Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
  • Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).


If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. title: IT-infratiimin vetäjä
description:
Finnlines on yksi johtavista rahti- ja matkustajaliikennevarustamoista Itämerellä, Pohjanmerellä ja Biskajanlahdella. Yhtiö toimii seitsemässä Euroopan maassa ja kuuluu italialaiseen Grimaldi-konserniin, joka on yksi maailman suurimmista varustamokonserneista. Finnlines työllistää noin 1 800 henkilöä, joista yli 200 työskentelee Suomessa asiantuntijatehtävissä.

Haemme Finnlinesille IT-infratiimin vetäjää viemään infran tuotannon seuraavalle tasolle!

Etsimme kokenutta ja organisointikykyistä esihenkilöä, jolla on vahvaa näyttöä tiimin vetämisestä, projektien johtamisesta ja esihenkilötyöstä. Etsimällämme henkilöllä on kykyä luoda selkeitä rakenne- ja toimintatapoja sekä hyvä ymmärrys IT-infrasta aina tietoliikenteestä palvelimiin ja konesaleihin.

Infratiimin vetäjänä johdat IT Hardwaren alla toimivaa asiantuntijatiimiä, joka kehittää ja ylläpitää Finnlinesin IT-infraa. Tehtäväsi on kehittää tiimin toimintaa entistä järjestäytyneempään suuntaan ja sulavammaksi.

Tehtäväsi ja keskeiset vastuusi

Tiimin johtaminen
Toimit infratiimin esihenkilönä ja vastaat tiimin arjesta, resursoinnista ja osaamisen kehittämisestä. Tiimisi vastuulla ovat muun muassa tietoliikenne, palvelimet, konesalit ja tekninen tietoturva.

Toiminnan kehittäminen ja järjestelmäkäyttöönottoprojektit
Viet tiimin toimintaa järjestäytyneempään, tuotannolliseen suuntaan. Vastaat uudemman sukupolven järjestelmäversioiden käyttöönottojen infran projektinvedosta sekä rakennat selkeät käytännöt ja aikataulut esimerkiksi huoltoihin ja päivityksiin.

Yhteistyö sovellus- ja integraatiotiimien kanssa
Tuot rakennetta ja järjestelmällisyyttä yhteistyöhön sovellus- ja integraatiotiimien kanssa. Varmistat sovitut huoltokatkot ja selkeät toimintatavat ympäristössä, jonka tuotanto pyörii 24/7.

Sidosryhmät, viestintä ja yhteistyö
Kehität selkeitä viestintäkanavia ja toimit diplomaattisena sillanrakentajana eri sidosryhmien välillä. Pidät huolen siitä, että muutokset, huoltokatkot ja kehityshankkeet ovat ajoissa ja sujuvasti kaikkien tiedossa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • vahvaa näyttöä ja kokemusta tiimin johtamisesta, esihenkilötyöstä ja organisointikyvystä

  • vankkaa kokemusta projektien vetämisestä ja johtamisesta (mukaan lukien järjestelmäversioiden käyttöönotot)

  • hyvää ymmärrystä ja useamman vuoden kokemusta IT-infrasta (erityisesti palvelimet, virtualisointi ja konesalit; lisäksi tietoliikenne ja tietoturva. Syvää erikois- tai tietokantaosaamista ei vaadita)

  • kykyä rakentaa prosesseja ja selkeitä toimintatapoja

  • erinomaisia kommunikaatio- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä tehdä rakentavaa, pitkäjänteistä yhteistyötä eri tiimien ja ammattilaisten kanssa

  • sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta ITIL-prosesseista, muutoshallinnasta tai toimittajahallinnasta sekä taustaa käytännön infratyöstä (palvelimet ja konesalit).

Lisäksi tehtävässä tulee eteen satunnaista työmatkustamista.

Tarjoamme sinulle

  • Vakituisen tehtävän vakaassa ja kansainvälisessä Grimaldi-konserniin kuuluvassa perheyhtiössä.

  • Keskeisen roolin yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävällä toimialalla kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä.

  • Asiantuntevan tiimin tuen ja monipuoliset uramahdollisuudet modernin teknologian parissa. Meillä todistetusti viihdytään ja moni on tehnyt pitkän uran Finnlinesin palveluksessa.

  • Hybridityömallin eli osan viikosta voit työskennellä etänä ja osan merellisessä pääkonttorissamme Vuosaaren satamassa, Helsingissä.

Kattavan työterveyden, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, tapaturma- ja matkavakuutuksen sekä tietenkin erittäin hyvät matkustusedut laivoillamme.

Miksi Finnlines?

Finnlines on yksi johtavista rahti- ja matkustajaliikennevarustamoista Itämerellä, Pohjanmerellä ja Biskajanlahdella. Yhtiö toimii seitsemässä Euroopan maassa sekä merellä että maissa. Finnlines kuuluu italialaiseen Grimaldi-konserniin, joka on yksi maailman suurimmista varustamokonserneista.

Finnlines työllistää noin 1 800 henkilöä, joista yli 200 työskentelee Suomessa asiantuntijatehtävissä muun muassa rahti- ja matkustajaliikenteen, asiakaspalvelun, talouden, markkinoinnin, IT:n, oston ja myynnin, henkilöstöhallinnon sekä viestinnän parissa. Meillä moni on viihtynyt jopa vuosikymmeniä yhtiömme palveluksessa. 170 viikkolähtöä takaa sen, että tekemistä riittää ja tekemäsi työ näkyy meidän omien työntekijöidemme ja asiakkaidemme arjessa.

Finnlinesin pääkonttori sijaitsee Helsingissä Vuosaaren satamassa.

Tarjoamme sinulle paikan, jossa pääset rakentamaan ja johtamaan infratiimiä, jonka työ pitää varustamon toiminnan käynnissä. Pääset työskentelemään modernien ratkaisujen isossa kansainvälisessä ympäristössä, joka yhdistää fyysisen maailman ja huipputeknologian.

Palkkaus
Tehtävän palkkahaitari on 5 500-6 500 €/kk kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan.

  2. Haastattelu Finnlinesin kanssa

  3. Toinen haastattelu Finnlinesin kanssa

  4. Valinta

Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Nawia IT & Tech Oy:n kanssa. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana, joten suosittelemme jättämään hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Emme käsittele sähköpostilla tulleita hakemuksia. Hakuaika päättyy 1.11.2026.

title: Söker du extrajobb?
description:
Om kundföretaget

Vi söker Produktionspersonal som vill jobba extra hos våra kunder verksamma inom tillverkningsindustrin runt om i Skaraborg.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer att arbeta i team och arbetsuppgifterna kommer variera beroende på vilket uppdrag du arbetar med. Eftersom arbetet stundtals kan vara tungt är det en fördel om du inte har något emot fysiskt arbete. Du behöver vara flexibel och kunna rycka in och börja arbeta med kort varsel när behov uppstår. Kanske till och med samma dag. Ett krav är att du kan jobba dag under vardagar. Behoven gäller endast vardagar då helgarbete ej förekommer på arbetsplatserna. Du som söker måste vara studerande eller ha en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50%.

Bakgrund och personliga egenskaper

Det är önskvärt om du har gått en praktisk utbildning eller har arbetat inom industrin sedan tidigare, men det är inte ett krav. Huvudsaken är att du har motivationen och viljan att lära dig. Körkort och tillgång till bil är meriterande eftersom kollektivtrafiken inte alltid stämmer överens med arbetstiderna. Du som söker är noggrann och kan hålla ett högt tempo när du arbetar. Du har hög arbetsmoral och är positivt inställd till arbete. Vidare gillar du att jobba i team och bidrar med god stämning till arbetsplatsen.

Om oss

FIRST Personalpartner är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag inriktat mot industrin. Vi har personal för inhyrning och rekrytering. Vi arbetar lokalt och strävar alltid efter att anställa personal med efterfrågad kompetens så nära kundföretaget som möjligt. Tjänsten är en hyrrekrytering, vilket innebär möjlighet till anställning hos kundföretaget efter inhyrningsperioden. Ansökningarna behandlas löpande varvid tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Lön regleras i enlighet med bemanningsavtalet. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan redan idag!

title: Test- och verifieringsingenjör till bolag inom Försvarsindustrin
description:
Är du en teknisk, lösningsorienterad och noggrann person som vill arbeta med test, verifiering och robusta IT-system? För vår kunds räkning söker vi dig som har erfarenhet av praktiskt testarbete, systemintegration eller hårdvara och vill vara med och säkerställa driftsäkra lösningar i en verksamhet som bidrar till ett tryggare och säkrare samhälle. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om tjänsten:

I rollen som Test- och verifieringsingenjör blir du en del av ett erfaret Solutions-team som bygger, monterar och testar kundanpassade IT-system för verksamheter med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och kvalitet. Du arbetar genom hela verifieringskedjan – från byggnation och integration av komponenter till funktionella och icke-funktionella tester på systemnivå.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med ingenjörsteam och andra interna funktioner, där du bidrar till att systemen uppfyller kundspecifika krav och fungerar som avsett i sin slutliga miljö. Du kommer att arbeta i en praktisk och tekniskt avancerad miljö med både hårdvara, nätverk, kablage och systemintegration, samtidigt som du felsöker och optimerar lösningar i olika projekt.

Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med tekniskt avancerade projekt i en innovativ och växande verksamhet där utveckling, samarbete och långsiktighet står i fokus. I takt med att verksamheten växer får du goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll och växa tillsammans med organisationen.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Bygga, montera, verifiera och validera kundanpassade IT-system
  • Felsöka och lösa systemproblem under integrations- och verifieringsfaser
  • Genomföra funktionella och icke-funktionella tester på systemnivå
  • Utföra kabeltillverkning, installation och kabeldragning
  • Arbeta i laboratoriemiljö med tester, konfigurationer och systemuppbyggnad
  • Genomföra miljötester och bidra till att säkerställa robusta lösningar
  • Skapa och underhålla testspecifikationer och projektdokumentation
  • Samarbeta med ingenjörsteam för att optimera systemlösningar och processer
  • Bidra till förbättring av interna rutiner, metoder och verktyg
  • Delta i tekniska genomgångar och kundnära projektarbete
  • Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet från en liknande roll, inklusive praktiskt testarbete
  • Har erfarenhet av systemutveckling, integration och verifiering, exempelvis EMC- testning
  • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Det är inte nödvändigt, men meriterande om du även har:

  • Erfarenhet av IT-hårdvara, nätverk eller kabeldragning
  • Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin, försvarsindustrin eller annan tekniskt komplex verksamhet
  • Erfarenhet av arbete i säkerhetskritiska eller kundspecifika systemmiljöer

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en tekniskt driven och lösningsorienterad person som motiveras av att arbeta praktiskt med komplexa system. Du har några års erfarenhet med dig och är trygg i att självständigt ta dig an test-, felsöknings- och verifieringsuppgifter, samtidigt som du vet när du behöver involvera rätt personer för att komma vidare.

Du är van vid att arbeta med hårdvara och tekniska system och har ett genuint intresse för hur olika komponenter, nätverk och systemlösningar samverkar. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant, har ett starkt kvalitetsfokus och trivs i miljöer där du får felsöka, testa och bidra till att hitta hållbara lösningar.

Som person är du prestigelös, samarbetsorienterad och kommunikativ. Du fungerar väl i projektform och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika kompetenser och intressenter. Samtidigt är du initiativtagande och bekväm med att ta ansvar för dina uppgifter i en snabbrörlig verksamhet.

Eftersom du blir en del av en växande organisation tror vi också att du uppskattar förändring och ser möjligheter i att utvecklas tillsammans med verksamheten. Här får du vara med och påverka arbetssätt, bidra till förbättringar och växa i takt med både teamet och organisationen.

Om anställningen:

Denna befattning kräver att du genomgår och blir godkänd vid var tids gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där vår kund har krav på säkerhetsklassplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du till en början kommer att vara anställd av Friday. Ambitionen från både kunden och vår sida är att du på sikt blir direktanställd hos kunden.

Övrig information:

  • Omfattning: Heltid
  • Placering: Helsingborg, på plats
  • Start: Enligt överenskommelse
  • Lön: Fast månadslön
  • Rekryteringsansvarig: Ellen Brobeck, Ellen.Brobeck@friday.se

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.

Om Friday:

På Friday brinner vi för att hjälpa dig att ta nästa steg i din karriär inom IT och teknik, oavsett om du söker ditt första jobb eller redan har några års erfarenhet. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.

Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.

Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Senior / Lead Data Engineer - DataBricks
description:
Owns the design and optimisation of scalable data pipelines and lakehouse solutions on Databricks, enabling analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organisation. Acts as a technical leader — setting standards, mentoring engineers, and shaping the platform's evolution.

This is a fixed term contract initially with a view to permanency.

Core Competencies

  • Technical leadership and architectural decision-making on Databricks
  • Delivery of business value through scalable lakehouse solutions
  • Strong stakeholder communication and cross-team collaboration
  • Continuous improvement and engineering excellence

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Engineering — Design and own scalable ETL/ELT pipelines (PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Live Tables) following medallion architecture, with strong reliability, monitoring, and cost/performance optimisation.
  • Data Modelling & Lakehouse — Govern Delta Lake models and modelling standards across Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, ensuring data quality, integrity, and lifecycle management.
  • Platform & Architecture — Own Databricks platform architecture and tooling decisions (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, structured streaming), aligned with enterprise security and governance.

  • Proven experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, and Databricks SQL

Education

Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field

title: Quality Inspector - temporary on-going.
description:
Lotus Cars is renowned for crafting world-class, high-performance, and lightweight sports cars that are celebrated across the globe.

Lotus Cars Limited serves as the company’s manufacturing HQ in the UK, where we proudly produce iconic models such as the Emira and the all-electric Evija. As we continue to elevate our capabilities and global presence, we are seeking a Quality Inspector to join our dynamic Quality team at our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Hethel.

This is a temporary on-going, immediate start role, until the end of 2026.

Summary:

The Quality Inspector will provide technical support, from a production/quality perspective, in the resolution of production DPV. This is accomplished through the completion of reports/assessments/studies and the development of processes/WES. Responsible for reacting to production DPV concerns with the aim of containing or implementing a permanent countermeasure in a structured time efficient manner. OP to be directed by Manufacturing Quality Supervision/Manager.

What you'll do:

  • Work in a team environment in a constructive timely manner to resolve production DPV, detailed overview of defects and corrective actions.

  • Conduct studies to provide Root Cause Analysis and assistance in the resolution of product and process concerns.

  • Communicate/Document process-related changes to cross-functional teams to a high level.

  • Develop, manage, and provide support for troubleshooting to ensure a focus on Pareto resolution of high priority DPV concerns.

  • Participate in the development of shop floor processes to ensure that defined corrective actions are permanent.

  • Perform multi-disciplined studies with other departments, drive improvements for in-house improvement measures.

  • Assist in responding to Field Control actions in an appropriate and timely manner.

  • Understand and follow detailed work instructions relating to 4P’s and process audits to confirm WES is fit for purpose.

  • Ensure that all tasks set are completed in the required timescale. Support line Supervision with adhering to defect closure dates.

  • Participate in continuous improvement activities.

  • Understand and adhere to the Lotus ROAD behaviours.

What you'll bring:

Essential Skills

  • Automotive manufacturing experience.

  • Confident with using MS software, Excel, word, PowerPoint etc.

  • Excellent communicator.

  • Full Driving License

Key Behaviours

  • High-level problem-solving skills

  • Manages time effectively

  • Strong communication skills, both written/verbal

  • Empathy

  • Adaptable

  • Results driven

  • ROAD – Respect, One Team, Ambition and Drive

What we offer:

This is a temporary on-going - immediate start role, until the end of 2026.

This role will be paid weekly by one of our supporting agencies.

Additional Information:

  • This role does not support sponsorship

Our Company:

Group Lotus is a leading sports car manufacturer with over 75-year long history of iconic designs, groundbreaking engineering and legendary victories on the F1 track. Today we are transforming into a truly global performance car brand focused on the electrical future. In 2022 we launched the Eletre, the world’s first all-electric hyper-SUV, and in 2023 our fully-electric Hyper-GT, Emeya.

As part of the Lotus team, you push boundaries. Those of the car industry and of your own. Every member of the Lotus family has some of the pioneering mindset of founder Colin Chapman in them.

Hethel, Norfolk, England has been the home of Lotus for over 60 years, ever since Colin Chapman, our founder, started making championship-winning racing cars. In conjunction with production facilities in Norwich, and research facilities near Warwick, our UK sites offer a wide breadth of roles for all disciplines.

We're not just a car company; we're a diverse mix of talent from all walks of life. At Group Lotus, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are not just buzzwords but essential pillars of a thriving and successful organisation. Read more here: Equity, Diversity & Inclusion in Lotus Cars.
