title: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on, production-focused Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to join our growing AI Center of Excellence, responsible for using AI and machine learning to drive innovation across the organization. In this role, you will take the formal domain ontologies designed by our Knowledge Representation Architects and operationalize them into high-throughput, multi-hop systems.

Your work will directly power autonomous AI agents that solve complex sustainability challenges — including decarbonisation, sustainable procurement compliance, and supply chain resilience. You will bridge the gap between unstructured sustainability disclosures and structured graph databases, building entity-resolution pipelines that make enterprise data agent-ready.

Your responsibilities will include (but will not be limited to):

  • Graph Infrastructure and Ingestion Pipelines

    • Design, implement, and maintain high-speed GraphRAG ingestion pipelines that transform relational data (ERP, SQL), unstructured ESG reports, and streaming feeds into operational Labeled Property Graphs (Neo4j, Memgraph) and RDF Triple Stores

  • A-Box Instantiation and Entity Resolution

    • Build automated Named Entity Recognition (NER), entity linking, and deduplication workflows to resolve mismatched vendor profiles, material SKUs, and facility coordinates into unified canonical graph nodes

  • Semantic Federation and External Data Integration

    • Implement automated ETL/ELT pipelines to map and federate internal supply chain data with external, open-source ontologies and registries (such as GLEIF for corporate ownership, W3C SSN/SOSA for IoT sensors, and Copernicus for geo-hazard alerts, PROV-O for data provenance)

  • GraphRAG and Agent Tooling

    • Partner with AI/ML Engineers to build low-latency GraphRAG retrieval layers—writing optimized Cypher and SPARQL queries, implementing NL2Query tools for agents, hybrid vector-graph indexing pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool endpoints for autonomous LLM agents

  • Deterministic Guardrails and Pipeline Validation

    • Operationalize SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) shapes into automated data quality tests within CI/CD pipelines to prevent hallucinated or non-compliant data mutations from entering the enterprise knowledge graph

  • Performance Optimization and GraphOps

    • Optimize multi-hop query performance, graph partitioning, and database indexing strategies to handle sub-second traversal over billions of nodes and edges

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • 4+ years of production experience building and querying graph databases, specifically Labeled Property Graphs (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph) or RDF Triple Stores (GraphDB, Stardog, Virtuoso)

  • Strong experience in cloud technology, preferably Azure and its ecosystem (e.g., Azure Foundry, Azure Bicep, AzureML and Azure Cloud Storage)

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (RDFLib, NetworkX, PyGraphistry) for building scalable, production-grade data pipelines

  • Experience building entity extraction pipelines using modern NLP frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, spaCy) or LLM-based structured extraction

  • Hands-on experience with modern data transformation tools (dbt) and integrating graph databases with vector stores (Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector) for hybrid search architectures

  • Solid understanding of semantic web standards (RDF, RDFS and OWL, SKOS, SHACL, RDF-star, SPARQL), graph schema design principles (T-Box vs. A-Box separation), and mapping languages for dealing with heterogeneous data structures (RML, R2RML)

  • Experience working with domain-specific supply chain, carbon accounting (GHG Protocol), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) data structures is a plus

  • Direct experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose graph tools to LLM agents is a plus

  • Experience with enterprise OBDA approaches at-scale is a plus

  • Offer available only for candidates eligible to work and live in Spain

  • Location: Hybrid in Barcelona (2 days per week in the office) / Full remote from Spain

In return for your expertise, we offer:

  • Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment
  • Flexible working hours

description:

City Hall, judicial courts like Hall of Justice, the New Resources Building and the DGS headquarters in Sacramento. It is not the size of the project that impacts the reach of this position. This position encompasses the project leadership and client maintenance of projects ranging from renovations and/or new construction of essential facilities (police, fire, EOC) to civic centers and libraries to ground-up courthouses and state buildings.

title: Mjukvaruutvecklare inom C/Linux – utveckla teknik som skyddar Sverige
description:
Gillar du mjukvaruutveckling på djupet och vill arbeta med avancerad teknik som gör verklig skillnad?

På Tutus utvecklar vi nätverksprodukter för skyddad kommunikation – lösningar där säkerhet, prestanda och tillförlitlighet är avgörande. Nu söker vi en skicklig och nyfiken mjukvaruutvecklare som vill bli en del av vårt team och bidra till teknik som är viktig för Sveriges säkerhet.

Om rollen

Hos oss arbetar mjukvaru- och FPGA-utvecklare nära varandra för att utveckla säkra och robusta produkter. Du får arbeta med spännande tekniska utmaningar, hela vägen ner på bit- och bytenivå, tillsammans med erfarna kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap.

Vi tror på frihet under ansvar, stort tekniskt inflytande och att det är resultatet som räknas. Med tanke på arbetets art, arbetar vi på plats i våra säkra lokaler vid Danderyds Centrum.

Vem är du?

Du har en stabil grund inom mjukvaruutveckling, ett genuint teknikintresse och gillar att lösa komplexa problem.

Vi tror att en skicklig utvecklare med rätt grund kan lära sig det mesta. Därför värdesätter vi din tekniska förståelse, problemlösningsförmåga och nyfikenhet lika högt som vilka tekniker du redan behärskar.

Erfarenhet av C, Python och Linux ger dig de bästa förutsättningarna att snabbt komma in i rollen. Har du dessutom kunskaper inom nätverkskommunikation, Linux kernel space eller hårdvarunära utveckling är det ett plus som gör startsträckan kortare, men inget krav.

Du har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Varför Tutus?

Hos oss får du kombinera avancerad produktutveckling med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Vi är ett teknikdrivet företag med kunniga och engagerade kollegor, stort utrymme för egna idéer och en prestigelös kultur där vi hjälper varandra och har roligt tillsammans.

Vi är stolta över det vi utvecklar och den skillnad våra produkter gör för Sveriges säkerhet.

Vill du utvecklas tillsammans med oss och bidra till säkrare kommunikation? Välkommen med din ansökan!

En anställning hos oss är placerad i säkerhetsklass och säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer därför att genomföras vid anställning i enlighet med 3 kap. säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).

title: Meetings and Events internship
description:
Are you looking for an exciting adventure in the world of hospitality? The Hotel. Brussels is looking for an enthusiastic and energetic Meetings & Events Trainee to join our team. If you're eager to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic and rewarding environment, this internship is for you!

This internship offers an exciting immersion into the world of meetings and events within our hotel. Working alongside our experienced team, you will actively contribute to the end-to-end management of client events in a friendly and stimulating atmosphere.

Your Responsibilities

  • Assist with contract preparation and invoicing processes, gaining valuable administrative experience.

  • Help ensure an outstanding guest experience by supporting clients throughout their event journey and ensuring their satisfaction.

What We're Looking For

  • You are comfortable communicating in both English and French with our international clientele. Knowledge of Dutch or any additional language is a strong advantage.

  • You are currently studying Hospitality Management, Public Relations, Business, Event Management, or a related field, and have an internship agreement available from January 2027 for a minimum duration of 4 months (6 months is even better!).

  • Strong administrative and/or commercial skills are considered a major asset.

What Can You Expect from an Internship at The Hotel. Brussels?

  • Hands-on experience in hotel operations and customer service.

  • Access to internal training programmes and networking events.

  • For students living abroad, we offer a housing support allowance (internship compensation of up to €750/month).

    • Hilton Brussels Grand Place

    • Holiday Inn Brussels Airport

Recruitment Process

If you're motivated to take on this exciting challenge and contribute to our exceptional team, send us your CV!

title: Employment Consultant
description:
APM are looking for an Employment Consultant who can build strong local connections, think creatively, and help people overcome barriers to employment. If you're passionate about changing lives and creating opportunities across the Toowoomba region, this could be the role for you.

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

Working within the local community means your impact is visible every day. You'll become a trusted local connector, working closely with participants and employers to identify opportunities, strengthen workforce participation, and support local businesses with their hiring needs. This is more than recruitment. It's about helping people build confidence, secure meaningful employment and contribute to the future of their community.

Who Are We:

APM is a global health and human services organisation transforming lives since 1994. Be part of a 16,000-strong team across 11 countries, empowering people of all abilities to lead independent and fulfilling lives. Thrive with us, benefiting from exceptional career growth and development opportunities across our global network of brands.

A champion of diversity and inclusion – you believe that everyone, no matter their abilities, deserves a chance to succeed

A natural connector – you know how to create opportunities for participants and speak to stakeholders with confidence

You may also have experience in another industries or roles like sales, retail, call centre, hospitality, consulting, business development, and administration. These skills can set you up for success in this role!

Why You’ll Love It

We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures including indigenous peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people with disability.

Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! Let’s work together to break down barriers, shatter expectations and build a more inclusive world- one individual at a time.

title: Certification Engineer
description:
Role Summary – Section 1

As a certification engineer in our Global Unit TGRMHCE- E/E, Software and Autonomous Certification you will follow our various development projects and you will plan, support and oversee the certification activities in cooperation with our Technical Services inspectors, the accountable design and testing groups/units from TRATON R&D. Additionally you will support the legal requirement analysis in product development regarding global regulations but also market-specific legislation and you will closely monitor the need of certification in coordination with coming new legislation.

This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate, plan and oversee certification activities within the technical area of E/E, Software and Autonomous products and ADAS -Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
  • Be part of the homologation process —with a specific focus on E/E, Software and Autonomous projects —working within a dynamic environment and in close cooperation with technical departments, project teams and technical services.
  • Compile approval documentation for vehicles and vehicle components and provide operational assistance in obtaining UNECE/ EU and national approvals worldwide.
  • Prepare documentation in accordance with technical specifications and submit documents and products to international type approval authorities to obtain the necessary approvals.


Who You Are

You are a person that take initiative, enjoy learning new things and like to work with many different groups and colleagues. The work is both individual and collaborative which demand skills in communication and cooperation. The work and contacts is within TRATON, mainly R&D, but also externally with third party certification bodies and in some cases various extent vehicle industry working groups. You are good at creating team spirit and have the ability to share experiences and information with your colleagues in a generous way.

Previous experience from product compliance, product development and knowledge about the vehicle industry is beneficial but not necessary. You may also have experience from working with regulations, standardization and committee work.

As you may understand writing and speaking English is done on daily basis. You are interested in seeing the broader picture and when needed dig into the details. Eager to learn and an open mindset is very appreciated.

· Engineering degree or equivalent qualification

· Several years of professional experience in vehicle technology is appreciated but not mandatory

· Enjoy working as part of a team and possess strong communication and planning skills

· Business fluent proficiency in English. Swedish or German proficiency is appreciated besides English.

· Highly analytical and creative mindset and ability to clearly structure and present complex interdependencies.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.

This Is Us

Our Global Unit TGRMHCE- E/E Software and Autonomous Certification, is working with certification and coming new legislation to approved and certified vehicles. We are working with approval of vehicles and systems in development projects, special order projects, product adaptations and product maintenance projects, for both trucks and buses. We are working closely with our design departments and with the other groups within TRATON R&D. For the approval of our products, we use third-party Technical Services and authorities.

· Ensures certification compliance within the technical area of E/E, Software, autonomous systems and ADAS -Advanced Driver Assistance Systems

· Manages certification processes to comply with regulations for electronic, software, autonomous systems and ADAS -Advanced Driver Assistance Systems

· Coordinates activities with type approval authorities and technical services to meet regulations and standards in E/E , software and autonomous driving areas.

· Provides oversight to ensure compliance in E/E, software and autonomous product certifications and performs legal analysis from a certification perspective.

TRATON Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-25. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

title: Sr. Security Engineer
description:
Redwood Trust, Inc. (NYSE: RWT), together with its subsidiaries, is a specialty finance company focused on investing in mortgage related assets, and engaging in residential and commercial mortgage banking activities. Our employees are a team of disciplined, dedicated and talented professionals who do what it takes to make the Company a leader in innovation and reputation. We value everyone's contribution, actively soliciting feedback at all levels within the organization. Work gets done in a non-hierarchical, hard-working and fun environment.

For more information about our Company, please look up the Redwood Review, published quarterly, available on our website .

Position Summary

The Sr. Security Engineer is responsible for cybersecurity design, implementation, and maintenance in alignment to business initiatives. The individual acts as a senior technical resource and escalation point across security operations, threat identification and remediation, and incident response, and works hands-on across identity, endpoint, network, cloud, email, and data protection.

Redwood’s environment spans Azure, Microsoft 365, and a remaining on-premises footprint, and increasingly includes AI-driven products and services built on Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft Fabric. This engineer secures all of it. Experience with AI and machine learning systems matters here because those workloads touch borrower information and material financial data, though this role covers the full breadth of the security engineering function rather than a single specialty.

The successful candidate works closely with infrastructure engineering, application development, data, and database teams to embed security into how systems are built and operated, and with decision makers to identify, recommend, develop, implement, and support cost-effective security solutions. The security program at Redwood is being built out deliberately rather than inherited, so this role carries real influence over the standards and tooling we adopt.

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across identity, endpoint, network, cloud, email, and data protection, with emphasis on the Microsoft security stack including Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune.
  • Analyze, evaluate, and document security risks across cloud, on-premises, and AI or machine learning applications, and recommend controls proportionate to the risk.
  • Operate and tune the SIEM, build and maintain detections, and work alerts through to resolution.
  • Participate in incident response, coordinating investigation, containment, remediation, and post-incident analysis, and act with a sense of urgency when reacting to incidents and vulnerabilities.
  • Conduct vulnerability scanning and testing, document findings, and drive remediation with infrastructure, application, and database teams.
  • Contribute to Identity and Access Management architecture and standards, including provisioning and deprovisioning processes, periodic access reviews, conditional access, and privileged access.
  • Embed security into delivery through pipeline controls, infrastructure as code guardrails, secrets management, and secure configuration baselines.
  • Secure AI and machine learning workloads alongside the rest of the environment, including model APIs, data pipelines, and the controls around copilot and agent deployments, and monitor for adversarial threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, and model extraction.
  • Perform third-party and vendor security assessments, including questionnaire review, risk findings, and remediation tracking, and evaluate new services and AI features before adoption.
  • Integrate security monitoring across tools and platforms, and leverage automation and AI to assist with SOAR, incident response, and monitoring.
  • Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting for key security technologies, including Key Performance Indicators and Key Risk Indicators.
  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and runbooks aligned to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and keep them current as the environment changes.
  • Support control and regulatory obligations including SOX IT general controls, GLBA safeguards, NYDFS Part 500, and SEC cyber disclosure readiness.
  • Provide training and guidance to engineering teams on secure development and secure AI practices.
  • Support day-to-day coordination with outsourced security vendors and the managed security service provider.
  • Participate in the after-hours on-call rotation for incident response.

Required Experience & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Six or more years in cybersecurity roles spanning security engineering, security operations, or application security.
  • Hands-on experience operating a SIEM, building detections, and working real incidents through to resolution and lessons learned.
  • Experience with core cybersecurity tooling including SIEM, endpoint protection, IAM, encryption, email security, and IDS or IPS.
  • Solid cloud security foundations on Azure, including identity and access management, network controls, and native security tooling.
  • Experience securing AI or machine learning systems, including familiarity with adversarial concepts such as prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and data integrity attacks.
  • Understanding of cloud-based AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or Microsoft Copilot, and the risks introduced by agent and retrieval augmented generation architectures.
  • Practical vulnerability management experience, including scanning, prioritization, and driving remediation across teams.
  • Scripting and automation ability in PowerShell, Python, or similar, with enough familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure as code to build controls into pipelines.
  • Familiarity with NIST and CIS frameworks, and awareness of emerging AI security guidance such as NIST AI RMF and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications.
  • Experience analyzing and documenting security solutions and mapping them to business requirements.
  • Ability to set and change priorities amongst multiple competing constituencies.
  • Ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams and explain complex security topics clearly.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in financial services, mortgage, or another regulated industry.
  • Hands-on adversarial testing of LLM or agentic applications, including use of tools such as PyRIT, Garak, or Promptfoo.
  • Penetration testing or red teaming background.
  • Detection engineering experience in Sentinel or a comparable SIEM, and experience building cybersecurity runbooks.
  • Knowledge of secure API design and authentication mechanisms.
  • Experience with Fortinet, SASE, or zero trust network access.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or OneLake security and enterprise data platform protection.
  • Experience with a vendor risk management platform such as Whistic.

title: Senior Backend & Platform Engineer — Contractor (United States)
description:
Shortcut is an AI platform for financial modeling, analysis, and enterprise workflows. Our products bring AI agents into Excel, the browser, and APIs to carry out complex financial work.

We’re looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the backend, platform, and site reliability engineering (SRE) behind these agentic systems. You’ll build the infrastructure that lets agents execute reliably at scale and helps our engineers develop, test, and ship new capabilities quickly.

You should bring strong technical judgment, challenge assumptions constructively, and carry problems from investigation through verified delivery.

What you’ll own

• Backend and databases: Build reliable APIs and long-running agent workflows. Keep execution state and customer data consistent through retries, interruptions, and service changes.

• Compute and storage: Scale the sandboxes, containerized services, and persistent workspaces where agents execute code and work with financial data. Improve resource allocation, isolation, and recovery.

• Developer platform: Make full-stack environments quick to provision and easy to use for development, debugging, and integration testing.

• CI/CD: Improve builds, deployments, and self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, including caching, capacity, job isolation, and troubleshooting.

• Benchmarking infrastructure: Make agent evaluations reliable and reproducible, helping the team measure task correctness, latency, and cost as models and capabilities evolve.

• Production reliability: Own observability, investigate incidents across service boundaries, and improve availability, performance, and operational efficiency.

Requirements

• 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or SRE experience, including ownership of production systems.

• Strong backend programming and debugging skills across application code, databases, Linux, networking, and containers.

• Practical depth in relational databases: query performance, transactions, locking, connection management, migrations, and recovery.

• Experience with distributed systems, including concurrency, queues, retries, and failure handling.

• Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, object storage, and secure access between services.

• Experience building CI/CD pipelines, operating self-hosted runners, and creating reproducible development or test environments.

• Experience with production observability, incident response, and on-call coverage.

• Ability to work independently across unfamiliar stacks, explain tradeoffs clearly, and turn recurring problems into systematic improvements.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred experience

• TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside PostgreSQL and Redis.

• Managed Kubernetes platforms such as GKE or EKS, and managed compute platforms such as Modal.

• Sandboxed execution, tenant isolation, and filesystems backed by object storage.

• Private networking tools such as Tailscale or equivalent technologies.

• AI evaluation infrastructure, ephemeral full-stack environments, or build and test optimization.

Experience with equivalent technologies is welcome; we value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn across platforms.

Engagement

This is a contract role with ongoing ownership of backend and platform infrastructure. Scope, availability, duration, compensation, and on-call responsibilities will be agreed as part of the contract.

Please share your background, availability, and examples of systems you’ve scaled, difficult production issues you’ve resolved, or tooling that made an engineering team more effective.

title: Managing Director, Learning and Impact
description:
Managing Director, Learning & Impact

The Holdsworth Center is a non-profit organization founded and largely funded by Charles Butt, Chairman of H-E-B, a regional retail company. Our mission is to impact, over time, the quality of K-12 public education for all Texas students by supporting and developing leaders. Based in Austin, Texas, we were founded in 2017 in honor of Charles’ mother, Mary Elizabeth Holdsworth Butt, who was an educator, a philanthropist, and a lifelong pioneering advocate.

We partner with public school districts to help them grow outstanding leaders at all levels so that staff thrive, and students excel in every classroom. At Holdsworth, we believe leadership isn’t just about titles. We make a deep investment in leaders at both the district and campus levels, including teachers who lead students in the classroom and influence and lead their colleagues.

Purpose & Responsibilities

Holdsworth builds stronger leaders for Texas public schools so that teachers and students thrive. We work directly with superintendents, principals, and school leadership teams across Texas, and we hold ourselves to the same standard of continuous improvement we ask of the leaders we serve. That means our program evaluation work isn't a side function — it's core to how we know whether we're delivering on our mission. This work is fundamentally about being a learning organization that carefully examines its impact so we know what is working, can learn from success, and keep improving.

The Managing Director of Learning & Impact leads Holdsworth's program evaluation function, ensuring we learn from rigorous examination of the effectiveness of our work across our three program areas — Stronger Superintendents, Stronger Principals, and Redesigning School Leadership Teams. This role leads a team of senior analysts and is personally responsible for connecting that work to the broader field: building and stewarding an evaluation advisory committee of outside experts, leading partnerships with external evaluators, and ensuring our evaluation practice earns credibility both inside and outside the organization.

This is a senior leadership role reporting to the Chief Program Officer and with regular exposure to Holdsworth's President and, at times, its governing board. The person in this role needs to be as comfortable interpreting a regression output as they are explaining what it means and why it matters to various internal and external audiences.

Responsibilities:

Develop and lead the overall strategy and operating plan for the Learning & Impact team

  • Ensure Holdsworth has a strong approach to studying our impact, learning from successes and growth areas, and making adjustments to improve our programs’ impact
  • Implement and evolve Holdsworth's evaluation and measurement framework, overseeing annual cycles of evaluation in each of our three program focus areas (Stronger Principals, Stronger Superintendents, and Redesigning School Leadership Teams)
  • Build Holdsworth's approach to working with external evaluators — identifying which parts of our work merit third-party evaluation, and managing those relationships and contracts.
  • Regularly engage outside experts who can pressure-test our methods and lend credibility to our results.
  • Drive clarity and alignment across the team by translating the strategy into clear work portfolios and goals, ensuring each team member understands how their work contributes to broader success.

Lead a high-performing team

  • Lead the Learning & Impact function, currently a team of senior analysts and a coordinator, supporting evaluation across all three of Holdsworth's program areas.
  • Foster a winning team culture where all team members are valued, supported, and empowered to do their best work
  • Lead strategic talent planning by assessing current capabilities, identifying future needs, and developing short- and long-term strategies to ensure the team has the right talent to meet its goals.
  • Model and reinforce leadership excellence by setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and holding others accountable.
  • Continuously assess and, as needed, evolve team structures to ensure the team has what it needs to succeed.

Serve as a key member of the Holdsworth Center Program Leadership team (HCPL), supporting the organization to pursue its mission

  • Operate with an organizational leader mindset, contributing to strategy and decision-making beyond the scope of your direct team
  • Work closely with the Chief Program Officer and President on the overall direction of Holdsworth’s learning and impact strategy
  • Collaborate closely with programming Managing Directors to successfully mobilize our measurement framework
  • Support the broader work of The Holdsworth Center and its objectives to develop leadership in K-12 public education in Texas
  • Represent Holdsworth externally and with a variety of senior external stakeholders, including at times, engaging with the Holdsworth governing board
  • Serve as the connective link between the Learning & Impact function and the rest of the organization — helping the program leadership team, the rest of the organization, and at times the board understand what our data shows and how to act on it.

Strong candidates will have a range of prior experience and capabilities to include:

  • Strong alignment with organizational values—Drive for Excellence for Every Student, Be of Service, Believe in People. Demonstrated commitment to and engagement in learning and actions to promote excellent outcomes for every student.
  • Highly collaborative work style and ability to work well in a team environment, establish good rapport at all levels of the organization, collaborate with experts and work with and relate to people from diverse backgrounds.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive and lead in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, to adapt to an ever-changing, growing organization and to bring structure to highly ambiguous or complex topics; embraces a portfolio of work that may change over time.
  • Self-motivated individual who demonstrates initiative without waiting for direction.
  • Exceptional receptivity to feedback motivated by deep curiosity, keen learning mindset, and above all an obsession with delivering the highest impact for our leaders.
  • Superb time management and organizational skills; the ability to independently manage multiple events at one time at a rapid pace; demonstrated ability to be thorough, with strong attention to detail.
  • Advanced degree (master's or doctorate) in education, public policy, applied or quantitative social science, statistics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of both quantitative and qualitative evaluation methods. Able to balance technical rigor with practical implementation needs.
  • Deep familiarity with Texas's school accountability system and student achievement data.
  • Experience leading high-performing teams.
  • Comfort operating at the executive level: framing complex technical work in easy-to-understand language that builds confidence and trust.

Nice to Have

  • Experience serving as a third-party program evaluator, or leading relationships with an external evaluation or applied research organization.
  • Background in management consulting or a similar field where data was used to drive practical decisions under real-world constraints.
  • A strong existing network (or ability to quickly build relationships with) data/measurement experts in Texas and/or nationally

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $158,900 to $180,000
  • Compensation for the role will depend on several factors, including but not limited to your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. The Holdsworth Center also factors internal pay equity in evaluating compensation.
  • This position is eligible to participate in company benefits, including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability coverage, four weeks of paid time off, employee assistance program, pet insurance, participation in a 401k program that includes a company match, and many other additional benefits.

Job Requirements and Expectations

  • This is a full-time role based in Texas. Location is flexible within the state. The Center is based in Austin; if living outside Austin, the Managing Director should expect frequent travel to Austin (~2 times per month).

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their resume and a completed application online.

At The Holdsworth Center, every application is reviewed by a member of our team. We do not use artificial intelligence to screen, score, or filter resumes or cover letters – your materials will be read by a real person.

At the Holdsworth Center, all employment decisions are based on job requirements and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Hemtjänstsamordnare Upplands Väsby
description:
Vårdlänken söker erfaren hemtjänstsamordnare för konsultuppdrag i Upplands Väsby

Ort: i Upplands Väsby

Omfattning: Heltid

Uppdragsstart: Omgående

Uppdragsform: Konsultuppdrag, tidsbegränsat

Om uppdraget

Vårdlänken söker nu två erfarna och självgående hemtjänstsamordnare för konsultuppdrag hos en kund med verksamheter i Upplands Väsby respektive Täby.

Uppdragen är på heltid och syftar till att säkerställa en stabil och välfungerande verksamhet under en period då kunden genomför rekrytering av ordinarie personal.

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av operativ hemtjänstplanering, arbetsledning och löpande uppföljning av verksamhetens mål. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har god organisatorisk förmåga och kan snabbt sätta dig in i verksamhetens rutiner och arbetssätt.

Då verksamheterna arbetar enligt olika planeringsmodeller är det viktigt att du har erfarenhet av det arbetssätt som tillämpas på den aktuella enheten.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som hemtjänstsamordnare ansvarar du bland annat för att:

  • Planera och samordna det dagliga arbetet inom hemtjänsten.
  • Säkerställa en effektiv bemanning och fungerande schemaläggning.
  • Leda och stödja medarbetare i det operativa arbetet.
  • Följa upp verksamhetens mål, rutiner och kvalitet.
  • Hantera förändringar och lösa operativa utmaningar i den dagliga driften.
  • Bidra till kontinuitet, struktur och en god omsorg för brukarna.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av samordning och operativ planering inom hemtjänsten.
  • Har erfarenhet av arbetsledning och bemanningsplanering.
  • Är van att följa upp verksamhetsmål och säkerställa att arbetet bedrivs effektivt.
  • Har erfarenhet av relevant planeringsmodell för den aktuella verksamheten.
  • Är självgående, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad.
  • Har god kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika yrkesgrupper.
  • Kan sätta dig in i nya rutiner och verksamheter med kort introduktion.

Vem är du?

Du är en trygg och handlingskraftig person som trivs i en operativ roll med stort eget ansvar. Du har förmågan att prioritera, fatta beslut och skapa struktur även när tempot är högt.

Som konsult är du flexibel, professionell och snabbt anpassningsbar. Du förstår vikten av god planering, tydlig kommunikation och ett närvarande ledarskap för att få den dagliga verksamheten att fungera.

Vi erbjuder

  • Heltidsuppdrag i Upplands Väsby eller Täby.
  • Möjlighet till omgående start.
  • Ett ansvarsfullt uppdrag där din erfarenhet gör konkret skillnad.
  • Möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens under en viktig övergångsperiod i verksamheten.

Ansökan

Låter uppdraget intressant? Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan till Vårdlänken.

Beskriv gärna din erfarenhet av hemtjänstsamordning, operativ planering, arbetsledning och vilka planeringsmodeller du har arbetat med. Ange även din tillgänglighet för start.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, och vi ser gärna att du kan tillträda omgående.

Anställning

Du kommer att bli anställd som konsult för Vårdlänken Bemanning & Rekrytering, med varierande arbetstider och tjänstegrad efter överenskommelse.

Som konsult hos oss erbjuds du:

• Konkurrenskraftig lön och intressanta uppdrag i olika verksamheter

• Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och semesterersättning

• Stora möjligheter att själv välja arbetsplats och arbetstider

• Hjälp med resa och boende om du arbetar på annan ort

• Introduktion och kontinuerlig coachning så att du snabbt kommer in i din roll

• En dedikerad och tillgänglig konsultchef, som själv varit verksam inom ditt yrkesområde

• Inbjudningar till seminarier och konsultträffar

Vårdlänken är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag genom arbetsgivarorganisationen Almega – en trygghet för dig som konsult. Det innebär bland annat att vi har kollektivavtal och gedigna ansvars- och olycksfallsförsäkringar för våra konsulter, samt att vi betalar in till din tjänstepension från den allra första kronan du tjänar.

Ansökan

Varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan till oss via ansökningsformuläret. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vi tar tacksamt emot din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid frågor om tjänsten, var vänlig kontakta kontaktpersonen nedan. På www.vardlanken.se/lediga-jobb presenterar vi alla våra lediga uppdrag.

Om oss

Vårdlänken Bemanning & Rekrytering förmedlar intressanta konsultuppdrag och tjänster till dig som är läkare, sjuksköterska, undersköterska, fysioterapeut, arbetsterapeut, socionom, chef eller har annan profession inom vård eller socialt arbete. Vårt mål är att ge dig ett flexibelt och utvecklande arbetsliv, samtidigt som vi tillsammans bidrar till en välfungerande vård- och omsorgssektor genom rätt kompetens på rätt plats.

Vi har över 28 års erfarenhet av vårdbemanning. Våra kunder är både privata och offentliga aktörer inom hälsovård, sjukvård och omsorg över hela Sverige. Vi hjälper dem med skräddarsydda bemanningslösningar och hjälper även till att rekrytera personal till fasta tjänster. Det gör oss till helhetsleverantör av kompetens inom vård- och omsorgsområdet.

Läs mer på www.vardlanken.se, samt följ oss på Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/company/vardlanken

title: E&R EIT

CIMA+’s Energy & Resources team is a key player in the energy transition. With more than 700 highly qualified professional in this business sector, we are one of the largest teams specializing in this discipline among consulting engineering firms in Canada.   • Experience using AutoCAD and/or Microstation considered a plus.
  • Prior experience consulting or working for an electric utility considered a plus.
  • Experience using electrical design software such as SKM PowerTools, ETAP, or EasyPower considered a plus.

Required Qualifications

  • Engineer In Training (EIT) certificate

title: IT Helpdesk Agent
description:
The Opportunity

Hyatt is looking for an IT Helpdesk Agent to join its team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain.
In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for colleagues and hotel teams, providing technical support and customer service. You will manage their inquiries through to resolution, escalating issues to higher-level IT specialists or external service providers when appropriate.
Who We Are
At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and in creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and guests have been at the heart of our business and have helped Hyatt become one of the world’s leading and fastest-growing hospitality companies.
Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.
The Role
You will report to the IT Helpdesk Supervisor.
Key responsibilities include\:
  • Providing first-level technical support for colleagues in hotels and offices.
  • Documenting interactions, incidents, and resolutions in the ticketing system.
  • Acting as the single point of contact and taking ownership of issues from the time they are reported through to resolution.
  • Administering and maintaining user access to all managed systems and applications.
  • Providing ongoing updates to colleagues and hotel teams on the status of their requests.
  • Triaging tickets to the appropriate support groups, including escalating major incidents appropriately.
  • Working with Senior Agents and Level 2 support teams to route issues to the appropriate groups.
  • Demonstrating a commitment to Hyatt’s core values.
The responsibilities outlined above are not intended to be all-inclusive. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as needed.
Who You Are
You are customer-focused, organized, collaborative, and comfortable troubleshooting technical issues. You communicate clearly, take ownership of requests, and work well with colleagues and support teams. You also share Hyatt’s core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing.
Benefits
  • Company-paid health insurance.
  • Discounts at Hyatt hotels.
  • 12 complimentary hotel nights per year.
  • Payflow, offering flexibility to access your salary.
We Welcome You
Research shows that individuals often apply for jobs only when they meet all the listed qualifications. If you do not meet every requirement but feel inspired by this opportunity and believe you can bring value, we encourage you to apply.
We would love to learn more about your experience and discover how you could help make Hyatt even better.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

Målsättningen är att vi ska ha en vikarie i varje grupp som går in och täcker vid ledigheter och sjukdomar.

Vill du göra skillnad där du bor?

Som räddningstjänstpersonal i beredskap förkortat RIB, ofta kallad deltidsbrandman, bidrar du till trygghet för både medborgare och företag i ditt närområde samtidigt som du har ett annat ordinarie jobb. Du får både utbildning och ersättning, och ingår i ett starkt team som rycker ut vid bränder, olyckor och andra akuta händelser. Ett viktigt och meningsfullt uppdrag på hemmaplan.

Nu söker vi RIB personal till Sävsjö räddningstjänst.

När du jobbar som RIB innebär det att du:

  • Har en annan huvudarbetsgivare, ett ordinarie jobb
  • Har regelbunden beredskap enligt schema. I Sävsjö är det var tredje vecka.
  • Får ersättning när du är i beredskap, vid larm, under utbildning, övning eller har andra arbetsuppgifter

Innan anställning

Intervju och tester

  • Intervju
  • Rullbandstest på minst 4,5 km/tim i lutning på 8 grader i 8 minuter
  • Klättra upp i vårt höjdfordon, cirka 18 meter
  • Klaustrofobitest, här kontrollerar vi att du klarar av att jobba i vår utrustning
  • Arbetsrelaterad bana med olika moment
  • Simtest, du ska klara Guldbojen
  • Klarar du våra tester kommer du skickas på medicinsk kontroll för rök och kemdykning

Blir du anställd kommer du få introduktion på din station. Efter det anmäls du till grundutbildningen för räddningstjänstpersonal i beredskap, förkortat Grib.

Grib är uppdelad i olika steg, både på distans och platsbunden. Utbildningen börjar med en webbkurs som du själv genomför och som måste vara klar när du påbörjar distansutbildningen och platsbunden utbildning.

När du har erhållit ditt utbildningsbevis är du redo att ingå i styrkan för att åka på uppdrag. För att bli tillsvidare anställd som RIB är det en förutsättning att du tar C körkort och att du klarat Grib utbildningen inom två år.

title: Förvaltare till förvaltarenheten
description:
Drivs du av att göra skillnad för människor i utsatta livssituationer och värna deras rättigheter? Då kan du vara vår nya förvaltare!

Vilka är vi?

Norrköpings kommuns målsättning är att det i alla lägen ska vara både trevligt och enkelt för invånare, besökare och företag att komma i kontakt med kommunen. Norrköpings kommuns kontakt Norrköping är vårt gemensamma ansikte utåt och entrén in till kommunen. Vi bidrar till att göra kommunen öppen, synlig, tydlig och begriplig.

Med gott bemötande ska vi bidra till att göra Norrköpingsbornas vardag enklare. Inom kontakt Norrköping samlar vi också på oss en mängd viktig fakta och statistik som sedan används i kommunens utvecklingsarbete.

Förvaltarenheten ansvarar för kommunens mest komplexa ställföreträdarskap, ofta med inslag av psykisk ohälsa, missbruk, omfattande stödbehov och samverkan med flera olika aktörer.

Vi söker nu en förvaltare till ett föräldravikariat med möjlighet till förlängning. Läs gärna mer om rollen här: https://norrkoping.se/stod-och-omsorg/god-man-forvaltare-och-formyndare/professionella-forvaltare

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som förvaltare ansvarar du för att bevaka huvudmännens rättigheter och intressen samt förvalta deras egendom och ekonomi utifrån det förordnande du fått. I arbetet ingår att hantera inkomster, utgifter, räkningar och tillgångar samt att företräda huvudmännen i kontakter med myndigheter och andra samhällsaktörer.

Du arbetar för att huvudmännen ska få tillgång till det stöd och de insatser de har rätt till och samverkar därför med exempelvis socialtjänsten, vården och andra relevanta aktörer. En viktig del av uppdraget är också att arbeta uppsökande och möta huvudmännen i deras vardag och utifrån deras individuella livssituation.

Som förvaltare fattar du beslut i situationer där svaret inte alltid är givet. Uppdraget är ett personligt förordnande och du behöver ta hänsyn och väga huvudmannens vilja och intressen mot dennes behov och förmåga, både ekonomiskt och personligt.

Rollen innebär att du hanterar både ekonomiska och personliga frågor och behöver kunna göra välgrundade bedömningar även i komplexa och oförutsägbara situationer. Du ansvarar för att dokumentera, följa upp och redovisa dina uppdrag enligt gällande lagstiftning och regelverk.

Vem är du?

Du har en högskoleexamen inom relevant område, t.ex. beteendevetenskaplig eller socionom, alternativt annan gedigen erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Du har erfarenhet av arbete med personer i utsatta livssituationer, exempelvis inom socialt arbete, omsorg, myndighetsutövning eller ekonomisk förvaltning.

Genom tidigare erfarenheter har du skaffat dig kunskap om det svenska välfärdssystemet, exempelvis genom arbete med myndighetskontakter eller sociala insatser för personer i behov av stöd och hjälp. Du har kunskap om ekonomisk hantering, exempelvis budgetering, betalningar, uppföljning av inkomster och utgifter eller redovisning. Vi ser gärna att du har kunskap om föräldrabalken och ställföreträdarskap.

Du är van vid att arbeta med människor i komplexa livssituationer. Du känner dig trygg i att möta huvudmannen där den är, utifrån dennes behov och i den livssituation personen befinner sig i, och samtidigt fatta beslut och stå fast vid dem om så behövs.

Du har hög integritet, pålitlighet och gott omdöme och agerar sakligt och ansvarsfullt, även i känsliga situationer. Du har förmågan att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med människor i utsatta livssituationer och kan anpassa ditt bemötande efter individens behov.

Vidare har du en god samarbetsförmåga och ser värdet av kunskapsutbyte och kollegialt lärande. Du samverkar med myndigheter, vårdgivare och andra aktörer för att tillvarata huvudmannens intressen och säkerställa att rätt stöd ges. Du är ansvarstagande, noggrann och har förmåga att hålla överenskommelser.

För tjänsten krävs goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Information om tjänsten

Antal lediga tjänster: 1

Anställningsform: Vikariat på heltid, med möjliget

Längd på anställning: Till och med 31 augusti 2028

Tillträdesdatum: 1 februari 2027

Arbetstid: Dag, visst kvälls- eller helgarbete kan förekomma

Möjlighet till distansarbete: Delvis, utifrån verksamhetens förutsättningar

Sista ansökningsdatum: 25 oktober

Kontakt: Enhetschef Joakim Alstadt på joakim.altstadt@norrkoping.se

Övrig information: Vi har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet, och ersätta det med urvalsfrågor relevanta för tjänsten. Det gör det lättare att göra en objektiv bedömning av din kompetens. Du skickar in ditt CV som vanligt.

Registerutdrag: För tjänster inom äldreomsorg, verksamhet för personer med funktionsnedsättning, vuxenutbildning samt verksamhet för barn och ungdomar, ingår kontroll av registerutdrag som en del av rekryteringsprocessen

KÄNSLAN AV ATT BIDRA. MÖJLIGHETEN ATT PÅVERKA

Att arbeta i Norrköpings kommun betyder att du är med och skapar välfärden. Våra 11 000 medarbetare bidrar och gör skillnad. Varje dag. Vi erbjuder en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats för nyfikna och öppna människor som vill ha mer än ett jobb. Tillsammans skapar vi Norrköpings framtid. Vi söker dig som har kompetens att bidra till våra verksamheter oavsett kön, könsidentitet eller könsuttryck, ålder, etnisk tillhörighet, religion eller annan trosuppfattning, sexuell läggning eller funktionsnedsättning. När du söker jobb hos oss i Norrköpings kommun använder du dig av vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Du påbörjar din ansökan genom att klicka på ansök längst ner i annonsen. Du som har skyddade personuppgifter ska inte skicka in din ansökan via vår hemsida. Ta en direktkontakt med rekryterande chef alternativt rekryteringsspecialist för att diskutera hur du bäst ansöker utifrån ditt skyddsbehov. Kontaktuppgifter finner du i annonsen. Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

  • En varierande vardag med stort ansvar och många kontaktytor. Om Jefferson Wells Jefferson Wells är ett av Sveriges största bolag inom kompetensförsörjning av specialister och chefer. Vi erbjuder konsultlösningar, rekrytering och projektbaserade tjänster inom bland annat teknik, ekonomi, IT, engineering och management. description:

Bloomingdale’s has pushed boundaries, defined trends and made style a source of joy and personal expression for 150 years. Ask anyone who works here the secret to our longevity, and you’ll hear the same thing: it’s unequivocally our people. We listen to them. We respect them. We appreciate them. We welcome and embrace their diversity of background, thought and opinion while having a lot of fun along the way. After a century and a half, we’re proud to still be a work in progress, iterating and adapting to a fast-changing landscape, while maintaining core values that put our people first.

title: NON-BANK FI CREDIT ANALYST/SENIOR ANALYST
description:
Job Purpose\:

To conduct in depth analysis of Non- Bank FI cases and implement strong market relationship management to support the growth plans and achievement of Financial Institutions targets.

Credit Analysis & write ups

Relationship Management & Marketing

Policies, Processes and Procedures

8. Follow all relevant department policies, processes, standard operating procedures and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.

Day-to-day management

9. Follow the day-to-day operations related to own jobs in the NBFI Department to ensure continuity of work.

Compliance

10. Comply with all relevant CBE regulations, banking laws, AML regulations and internal CIB policies and code of conduct in order to maintain CIB’s sound legal position and mitigate any potential risks.

title: Lead Dorm Parent
description:
Position: Lead Dorm Parent


Position : Lead Dorm Parent - two positions, one male and one female

Contract term: August 2027 - July 2029

Reports to: Head of Residential Life

Functional reporting for trips and activities : Head of Auxiliary Programs and Outdoor Education

School contribution: Assigned division with one teaching day each week.


How to Apply:


All applications must be submitted via the school’s website. Candidates should prepare and upload an updated resume and a list of at least three professional references.


In lieu of a cover letter, please submit a short video introduction of no more than three minutes, and share it as an unlisted YouTube link in the “Website, Blog or Portfolio” field.


Your video should cover:

  • A brief introduction of yourself
  • Why you’re interested in this role
  • Why you believe you’d be a good fit
  • Anything else that will help us get to know you





About Canadian Academy

Canadian Academy is a not-for-profit, secular, gender-inclusive international school located in Kobe, Japan's seventh largest city. CA is accredited by CIS and WASC, an authorized three-program International Baccalaureate World School, and is a member of TABS, The Association of Boarding Schools.

Canadian Academy faculty and staff inspire minds and nurture compassion by providing a rich and engaging program that develops students' skills, promotes curiosity and a love of learning, and prioritizes well-being. Secondary students follow the IB Middle Years Programme in Grades 6-10. Most students pursue the IB Diploma Programme in Grades 11 and 12, while others follow a personalized pathway leading to a CA Diploma.

CA offers opportunities for exploration in the arts, athletics, outdoor education, service and more. Our athletics and performing arts programmes are enriched through participation in the Asia-Pacific Activities Conference, in partnership with 11 other schools in the region. CA is the only APAC member school in Japan.


Position Summary

Canadian Academy's residential programme currently serves 40 students in Grades 9-12 and is expected to grow. The school is seeking two Lead Dorm Parents, one male and one female, to provide consistent operational leadership and appropriate coverage across the residential community.

The Lead Dorm Parent is a highly student-facing role. During assigned residential duties, they act as the shift lead: organizing workflow, guiding colleagues, maintaining routines and responding to student needs. They build trusted relationships with students, support a safe and inclusive community and help daily dorm life run calmly and consistently.

The Head of Residential Life retains responsibility for residential strategy, policy, formal disciplinary decisions and significant parent communication. Lead Dorm Parents exercise professional judgement within established procedures and promptly escalate safeguarding, serious welfare, disciplinary or operational concerns.

The role combines residential work with a school-day contribution. Each Lead Dorm Parent will be linked to a school division and will complete one full teaching day each week of cover teaching or other assigned teaching responsibilities, when required.


Key Responsibilities

Residential Leadership and Daily Operations

  • Act as the shift lead during assigned morning, afternoon, evening, weekend and overnight duties.
  • Organize the workflow for each shift, allocate responsibilities and ensure clear briefings and handovers between residential staff.
  • Oversee daily routines, including room checks, check-ins, meals, evening study, curfews, room expectations and preparation for the school day.
  • Respond calmly and consistently to routine student issues, making appropriate decisions within school policy and escalating significant concerns.
  • Maintain an active and visible presence in the dormitories and contribute to a welcoming, respectful and well-organized residential environment.

Student Support and Well-Being

  • Build strong, appropriate relationships with students through regular participation in dorm life and a genuine interest in their experiences.
  • Provide day-to-day pastoral support and notice changes in attendance, behaviour, mood, health, relationships or engagement that may require follow-up.
  • Work with the Head of Residential Life, counselors, nurses, learning support staff, teachers and other colleagues to support individual student needs.
  • Follow agreed student support plans and communicate relevant information through appropriate handovers and record-keeping systems.
  • Promote independence, responsibility, healthy routines, positive relationships and a strong sense of belonging among boarding students.
  • Support student leadership, student voice and opportunities for students to contribute positively to the residential community.



Residential Programmes, Trips and Activities

  • Support and supervise a varied programme of residential activities that encourages participation, connection and student well-being.
  • Work with the Head of Auxiliary Programs and Outdoor Education on the planning and delivery of residential trips and activities.
  • Lead either the fall break or spring break residential trip and act as a supervising member of staff on the other trip, working alongside assigned faculty.
  • Take agreed time in lieu for break-trip duties, normally during the week immediately before or after the trip, subject to operational needs.
  • Complete required planning, risk assessment, student briefing, communication and logistical tasks for trips under the school's approval procedures.
  • Maintain effective supervision and duty of care during off-campus activities and respond appropriately to changes or incidents.

Teaching and School Contribution

  • Be linked to an assigned school division and contribute to communication between the school day and the residential programme.
  • Plan and deliver any assigned teaching in accordance with the expectations of the relevant division and school policies.
  • Attend relevant division meetings, training and professional learning where these are compatible with residential responsibilities.

Communication, Records and Family Engagement

  • Maintain accurate and timely attendance, welfare, incident and duty records using the school's designated systems.
  • Provide clear handovers and ensure that important student information reaches the appropriate residential and school staff.
  • Communicate routine information to parents or guardians when asked or authorized to do so by the Head of Residential Life.
  • Refer formal disciplinary decisions and disciplinary communication with parents or guardians to the Head of Residential Life and relevant administrators.
  • Attend residential staff meetings and contribute constructively to the review of routines, student support and operational practice.

Safety, Safeguarding and Operations

  • Follow all safeguarding, health and safety, emergency response and residential procedures.
  • Report safeguarding concerns immediately through the school's established procedures and maintain appropriate confidentiality.
  • Support emergency drills and help students understand evacuation, accountability and other safety expectations.
  • Identify and report maintenance, security or facilities concerns and follow up through the appropriate operational channels.

Working Pattern

  • This is a full-time role combining residential duties and school-day teaching or cover responsibilities.
  • Residential duties include mornings, afternoons, evenings and weekends according to the published rota.
  • Each Lead Dorm Parent will have two protected days off each week, usually Friday and Saturday or Friday and Sunday.
  • One of the five teaching days each week will be allocated to cover classroom teaching or other assigned teaching responsibilities within an assigned school division, for the full school day.
  • The role includes two overnight on-call duties each week.
  • Flexibility is required during trips, emergencies, major school events and other periods of residential need. Equivalent time in lieu will be agreed where additional duties are required.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree and a recognized teaching qualification. Candidates currently enrolled in a qualification program who are close to finishing will also be considered.
  • Successful experience teaching and supporting high school-aged students.
  • Experience in boarding, residential life, pastoral care, student activities or a closely related setting.
  • Level II child safeguarding training, or willingness to complete and maintain the required school safeguarding training.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with students, colleagues and families in an international community.
  • Ability to lead a shift, organize workflow, guide colleagues and respond calmly to student or operational concerns.
  • Strong organization, judgement and record-keeping skills, including confidence using Google Workspace and student management systems.
  • Willingness and ability to work mornings, evenings, weekends, overnight on-call duties and residential break trips.
  • Strong understanding of adolescent development and a commitment to student well-being and safeguarding.
  • Previous experience in an international school or boarding school.
  • Experience leading overnight trips, outdoor education, student activities or residential programmes.
  • Training or experience in first aid, crisis response, mental-health support or restorative practice.
  • An additional language that can better support our International boarding community and families.
  • Familiarity with the IB Middle Years Programme or Diploma Programme.


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Commitment

To provide the best possible learning and living environment for our highly diverse, multicultural and international student population, Canadian Academy actively seeks to recruit faculty and staff from groups traditionally underrepresented in international schools. Candidates are warmly encouraged to apply and to reach out for more information about our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and justice.

Canadian Academy offers competitive compensation and benefits for this role, including housing on or near the school campus.

title: MAINTENANCE TECH III
description:
The Engineer III performs journey to advanced level maintenance, repairs, and support functions in the areas of general maintenance, plumbing, kitchen & refrigeration equipment, carpentry, HVAC, pumps, controls and electrical devices; ensures assigned areas meet the property standard while working with minimum supervision; provides intermediate routine support duties to higher level management staff; and performs related tasks within area of assignment.

  • Operations, services and activities of a facility, lighting, plumbing, painting, carpentry and maintenance operations
  • Knowledge of plumbing codes and regulations
  • Knowledge of building system functions and inspection techniques
  • Methods and techniques of both rough an finished carpentry
  • Knowledge of electric voltage and its application to items under repair
  • Methods and techniques of equipment and tool operation and preventative maintenance
  • Safety hazards as related to work assignments related to team members and guest
  • Customer service techniques; identify, evaluate and ensure worksite conditions and practices are safe to the team members and guests
  • Provide or seek assistance in safeguarding area while maintaining compliance with all regulations
  • Pertinent federal, state, and local laws, codes, and regulations
  • Recognize, building, equipment and landscape maintenance and repair needs
  • Take appropriate action to repair and replace damaged area or tool
  • Mask and tape painting areas
  • Safely and effectively perform maintenance work and perform duties in all weather conditions
  • Operate and use required tools and equipment skillfully and safely, maintain and repair a broad range of plumbing fixtures and components pumps, valves, boiler systems, compressors, alarms systems and other items as assigned
  • Design, build, install and repair woodwork, flooring, ceiling and cabinetry
  • Recognize and select appropriate lumber types

title: Cafévärd till Pitholmsskolan
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa en trygg, välkomnande och meningsfull skolvardag för våra elever?

På Pitholmsskolan möter du ungdomar varje dag och blir en viktig vuxen i deras vardag. Vi söker nu en cafévärd som vill bidra till en positiv skolmiljö där elever känner sig sedda, trygga och inkluderade.

Ditt uppdrag

Som cafévärd ansvarar du för den dagliga driften av caféverksamheten samtidigt som du bygger relationer med elever och bidrar till skolans trygghetsarbete.

I uppdraget ingår bland annat att:

  • Planera, förbereda och sälja cafésortiment såsom smörgåsar, frukt och dryck.
  • Hantera kassa, fakturor, inköp och redovisning av dagskassor.
  • Ansvara för städning, ordning och trivsel i café- och uppehållsutrymmen.
  • Planera och genomföra aktiviteter tillsammans med elever.
  • Samordna tävlingar och aktiviteter i Uppis.
  • Stötta, handleda och samarbeta med skolans elevråd.
  • Delta i och bidra till skolans trygghetsteam.
  • Medverka vid planering och genomförande av friluftsdagar och aktivitetsdagar.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har förmåga att skapa goda relationer med ungdomar och som trivs i en roll där service, samarbete och vuxennärvaro står i fokus. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer och möter elever med ett professionellt, tryggt och respektfullt förhållningssätt. Du är tydlig i din vuxenroll och bidrar aktivt till att skapa en lugn, trygg och inkluderande miljö för eleverna.

För att lyckas i rollen har du god samarbetsförmåga och bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Du tar initiativ, planerar och organiserar ditt arbete på ett strukturerat sätt samt har förmåga att genomföra aktiviteter som engagerar eleverna. Du kan skapa ordning och struktur även när arbetsuppgifterna varierar och tempot stundtals är högt. Eftersom verksamheten styrs av elevernas behov är du också flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar.

Krav

  • Pedagogisk utbildning med inriktning mot lärare i fritidshem eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant för uppdraget.
  • Erfarenhet av arbete med högstadieelever.
  • God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift.
  • Grundläggande datorvana.

Meriterande

Utbildning som fritidsledare. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av arbete med barn och ungdomar samt erfarenhet av caféverksamhet, kassahantering eller annat servicearbete. Erfarenhet av att planera och leda aktiviteter, grupper eller elevverksamhet ses också som en tillgång i rollen.

Mer om tjänsten

Hos oss får du ett varierande och socialt arbete där du gör skillnad varje dag. Du blir en viktig del av skolans trygghetsarbete och får möjlighet att bidra till att skapa en miljö där elever utvecklas, trivs och känner sig välkomna.

Skolans uppehållsrum, Uppis, är en naturlig mötesplats där elever samlas på raster och håltimmar. Här finns caféverksamhet, aktiviteter och möjlighet till social gemenskap. Som cafévärd spelar du en central roll i att skapa en trygg och trivsam miljö för våra elever.

Mer om tjänsten

Anställningsform

Tillsvidareanställning, 100 procent. Uppehållstjänst.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-06

För arbete inom skola/barnomsorg krävs, innan anställning kan påbörjas, att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastnings- och misstankeregistret. https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/

Dina ansökningshandlingar är allmänna handlingar och hanteras enligt offentlighetsprincipen. Har du beslut om skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig kontakta Rekryteringsteamet för alternativ sökväg på telefon 0911-69 65 10 .

Om arbetsplatsen

Utbildningsförvaltningen är en av kommunens sju förvaltningar. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att skapa välfärd och hållbar samhällsutveckling. Tillsammans med pitebor, näringsliv och föreningar utvecklar vi Piteå till en ännu bättre plats att bo, leva och verka i.

Pitholmsskolan är en 4-9-skola belägen söder om Piteå. På högstadiet går cirka 224 elever fördelade på tio klasser. Vi arbetar utifrån övertygelsen att varje elev ska ges möjlighet att utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar. Vår gemensamma vision är att alla ska lyckas, känna trygghet och studiero samt uppleva att de är välkomna.

title: Tender Engineer
description:
Bli en del av vårt team som Tender Engineer!

Vi söker en Tender Engineer till vårt dynamiska internationella Tendering-team som stöttar våra sälj- och operativa team inom Global Services.

I rollen arbetar du med att ta fram anbud för utvalda projektmöjligheter och säkerställer att erbjudandet i våra anbud möter kundens krav och speglar Schneider Electrics erbjudande. Du samarbetar med kollegor inom olika tekniska och kommersiella funktioner, projektledare och interna intressenter för att leverera kvalitativa och kundanpassade anbud. Din placeringsort är Stockholm, Göteborg eller Lund.

Som en del av vårt nordiska Tendering-team arbetar du tillsammans med fyra Tender Engineers och en chef med ansvar för Norden och Baltikum. Du blir den svensktalande medlemmen med särskilt ansvar för svenska anbud och relaterad kommunikation, samtidigt som du bidrar till affärsmöjligheter i hela regionen.

Vad kommer du att arbeta med?
  • Analysera kundförfrågningar och krav samt ta fram tekniskt kommersiella anbud, inklusive kostnadsberäkningar, prissättning och bedömning av kommersiella risker.
  • Säkerställa att anbuden är i linje med Schneider Electrics erbjudande och kundernas förväntningar.
  • Bidra till att utforma anbudsdokumentation som tydligt lyfter fram värdet i Schneider Electrics erbjudande.
  • Arbeta enligt etablerade processer för anbudsgenomgång och kvalitetsgranskning.
  • Samarbeta nära säljorganisationen, projektledare och tekniska experter genom hela anbudsprocessen.
Vi tror att du har
  • Bakgrund inom elkraft, eldistribution, automation eller teknisk försäljning genom utbildning och/eller erfarenhet.
  • Erfarenhet av anbudsarbete är meriterande.
  • Erfarenhet från projektleveranser eller kommersiella roller är också värdefull.
  • Förmåga att förstå kundens behov och samtidigt ta hänsyn till affärsmässiga mål.
  • God samarbetsförmåga och stark kommunikativ förmåga.
  • Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Rollen passar dig med bakgrund inom elkraft, eldistribution, automation eller teknisk försäljning. Även du som har en teknikerbakgrund och vill ta nästa steg mot anbuds- eller projektrelaterade roller kan vara rätt person för tjänsten. Erfarenhet av anbudsarbete är meriterande men inget krav. Erfarenhet från projektleveranser eller kommersiella roller är också mycket relevant.

Vi erbjuder
