title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. 🚀

🤩 **About the role

**We are looking for an AI Engineer to build the AI layer of All Gravy: agents that plan shifts, answer manager questions, and take real actions across 2,000+ hospitality and retail locations in the Nordics and UK.

This is a build role, not a research role. You will ship agents that customers use in production, then own how well they work. We are looking for someone who has already built and shipped AI agents and who is relentlessly curious about what just became possible. The field moves faster than any roadmap, so part of the job is noticing the new capability before anyone asks you to, testing it, and telling us whether it changes what we should build.

🎯 **What you will do

**

  • Build agent harnesses. Design and ship agents that call internal and external tools to solve real customer problems, both interactively with users and autonomously in the background.
  • Own the eval loop. Build the harnesses, datasets, and offline and online evals that tell us whether an agent got better or worse. You define what "working" means and you defend the number.
  • Ship full stack. Take features end to end, from the manager and employee interfaces where schedules are built and shifts are picked up, through the backend services and data layers that power them.
  • Run it in production. Own latency, cost, failure modes, and guardrails for the agents you ship. When one misbehaves at 6am on a Saturday, you are the person who understands why.
  • Investigate what is new. Try the new models, frameworks, and techniques as they land, build small things to find out where they actually hold up, and bring back a clear read on what we should adopt and what we should ignore.
  • Work across teams. Partner with product and the other engineering teams so AI features fit the wider All Gravy ecosystem, and contribute to shared standards and architectural decisions.

✅ **What we are looking for

**

  • You have built agents that shipped to real users, not just demos. You can talk through what broke, what you changed, and what you would do differently.
  • Genuine curiosity, evidenced by things you built. You have side projects, throwaway experiments, or strong opinions formed by actually running the thing rather than reading about it.
  • Strong context and prompt engineering, including retrieval, tool design, and structured outputs. You know why an agent fails and it is usually not the model.
  • Solid production engineering in TypeScript and Node.js, or the ability to get there fast from another typed language.
  • Comfort reading and writing code, reviewing architecture, and working directly with infrastructure. You ship the fix rather than filing the ticket.
  • Judgment about when an agent is the right answer and when a well placed SQL query or a boring deterministic rule is better.

🙌 **You'll thrive here if you

**We're looking for people with great energy, a good sense of humour, and a drive for getting things over the line. You think elegantly but act pragmatically, love being part of a team, and never stop learning

  • 5+ years of proven full-stack experience across React, React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js.
  • Ability to design and architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems.
  • Startup or scale-up background. You know what it means to move fast, make pragmatic calls, and revisit them when the time is right.
  • Fluent English, spoken and written.
  • Based within European time zones, whether from our Copenhagen or London office or remotely.

An advantage if you have experience in:

  • Vercel AI SDK
  • Mastra or similar Agent framework

💎 **Why All Gravy

**

  • Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.
  • Top equipment. You'll receive all new equipment to do your best work
  • A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.
  • Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.
  • You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.
  • The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

💡 Even if you do not tick every box on this page, you might be the perfect fit for the job! We treasure our learning culture and encourage all humble people to apply.

title: Buyer

title: Shipping Operator
description:
Essential Job Functions:

1) Mental Ability – The Shipping & Storage Representative must be able to read orders and prepare reports legibly and properly. They must be able to communicate orally with all personnel in the plant. They must be able to operate a calculator for basic mathematical computations. Basic typing skills are essential because all Representatives operate a computerized scanning machine for raw material tracking.

2) Physical Ability – The Shipping & Storage Representative must be able to climb up onto an industrial truck and be able to operate two foot pedals. There could be occasional climbing up a ladder. They must be able to operate both hands/arms for driving and lift controls. They must have excellent depth perception to maneuver the clamp truck and raw materials around crowded areas with co-workers nearby. Must be able to maneuver items manually that are 50 pounds or less.

3) Safety – It is plant policy to work in a safe manner. All Shipping & Storage Representatives must ensure guards are in place, follow lock-tag-try procedures, observe hazards such as nip points, and follow plant and department safety rules.

Additional Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

1) Multi-digit number recognition

2) Good mathematical skills

3) Good handwriting.

4) Ability to work well with others.

5) Ability to work flexible hours.

6) Must be prompt.

7) Ability to constantly observe immediate area for hazards, tight spaces, pedestrians, etc…

title: Senior Overhead Transmission Lines Engineer
description:
CIMA+’s Energy & Resources team is a key player in the energy transition. With more than 700 highly qualified professional in this business sector, we are one of the largest teams specializing in this discipline among consulting engineering firms in Canada. Guided by an entrepreneurial culture based on innovation, sustainability, multidisciplinary agility and collaboration, we support our clients at all stages of their projects, from feasibility studies to commissioning. From the production of electricity from renewable sources to resource transformation, our expertise markets are the driving force of a successful energy transition. Regardless of the delivery mode our clients choose, we have the skills and experience required to deliver innovative solutions adapted to their reality. Join us and immerse yourself in a dynamic, innovative, and collaborative environment where you’ll make a real impact. Together, we’ll push boundaries and go above what’s expected of us to meet the challenges of tomorrow and engineer a better world!

The CIMA+ offices in Canada are in the middle of a large growth trajectory. This means new, exciting complex projects that you will have the ability to shape and be a part of. We are actively looking for people who want to develop their skills, take on new challenges, and advance their careers within the organization.

Elevate your engineering career by joining us as a Senior Overhead Transmission Lines Engineer. In this pivotal role, you'll leverage your expertise to deliver top-tier engineering, estimating, planning, and quality management services. Using your extensive engineering knowledge, you'll direct work on high-complexity projects and operations, ensuring safety, quality, and adherence to budget and timelines. Your analytical acumen and leadership will drive engineering studies and designs, fostering innovation and excellence in every endeavor. The successful candidate will work under the supervision of T&D Lines CIMA+ Leadership Team. This team is working on some of the largest most complex infrastructure projects in Canada.

This role is hybrid (2 days a week at the office) and can be based anywhere in Canada.

Primary responsibilities

  • Lead a project design team, including junior and intermediate staff.
  • Design overhead lines and associated facilities for voltages from 60kV to 735kV in an electric utility environment, including transmission towers, foundations and hardware and fittings PLS-CADD, PLS-Pole and PLS-Tower.
  • Prepare project documentation like reports, specifications, proposals, estimates, design basis, and test plans per CIMA+’s practices
  • Lead and execute design work packages with scope, duration, and effort estimates, and manage design tasks including scope, schedule, and cost for existing and new facilities
  • Provide signed/sealed engineering deliverables as a Professional of Record per provincial regulations and CIMA+’s practices
  • Offer technical assistance, construction support, and field reviews as required
  • Develop design criteria considering multi-disciplinary inputs from the project team
  • Lead the structural design, analysis, and detailing for structures, foundations and hardware assemblies. Review manufacturer shop drawings
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior staff. Review of designs prepared by others, following established practices.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement safe engineering solutions for the high-complexity projects and operations, ensuring they meet major scope requirements for major utilities in Canada
  • Conduct independent studies and analyses, contribute to the development of technical standards, recommend safe designs, and provide mentorship to enhance the future capabilities of CIMA+’s engineering team
  • Develop and administer procedures, methods, and controls for planning, scheduling, cost control, and technical conformance, ensuring a consistent and robust Engineering Standards process.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders, review project schedules, resources, and budgets, and monitor expenditures to ensure project completion is safe, high-quality, on time, and within budget.
  • Plan, organize, and direct complex engineering and geoscience activities, making critical technical decisions and recommendations to ensure successful project implementation and resource management at CIMA+.
  • University Degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of fifteen (15) years of experience or over 10 year as fully certified engineer
  • Registered member of a Professional Engineering association in Canada, or eligible for registration in Canada
  • Proficient with the PLS-CADD suite design /analysis software and CAD systems, along with familiarity of drawing standards
  • Effective communication abilities in English, including analytical skills, interpersonal communication, and presentations. French is an asset.
  • Construction / Field work experience is required.
  • Integrity, team spirit, and a commitment to excellence

At CIMA+, we value diversity of talent and perspective. You think you can add value, but don't meet all the job requirements? We invite you to apply, because everyone has something unique to offer. The outstanding talents that choose to join us at CIMA+ soon realize that we go all out to encourage them to grow. We look forward to hearing how you can contribute to our success.

Why choose CIMA+? Because we offer you:

  • Comprehensive Group Benefits available from day one for all permanent employees working at least 20 hours per week
  • Employee and Family Assistance Program
  • Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with up to 4% employer contribution
  • As an employee-owned company, an annual opportunity to purchase shares for all eligible employees
  • Flexible work schedule in a hybrid work mode
  • Work/Life balance policy across Canada
  • 3-5 weeks of vacation, based on years of relevant experience
  • Tailored training to improve your existing skills

At CIMA+, we recognize the richness and diversity of each individual’s experience. Compensation for this role is therefore based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, while maintaining internal equity. The level and associated salary may vary depending on the candidate’s profile.

CIMA+ uses an applicant tracking system that includes an automated match score feature. However, this score is not used to screen, assess, or select applicants. All hiring decisions are made through human review.

Ethics and integrity are fundamental values at CIMA+. That is why we are committed to ensuring equal access to resources and opportunities for candidates, regardless of their identity (race, ethnicity, colour, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, socio-economic status or background, etc.).​

In keeping with the principles of employment equity, we encourage all applications, including, but not limited to, those from women, Indigenous people, people with disabilities and visible minorities. We also encourage candidates to complete the self-identification form when applying for employment.​

We are committed to providing a workplace that is accessible. Accommodations are available in accordance with CIMA's policies. If you require an accommodation, please let us know.

title: Administrator, Enterprise Systems
description:
We are looking for a talented Enterprise Systems Administrator to join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Enterprise Systems Administrator will play a crucial role in enhancing our ERP systems, driving efficiency and effectiveness across the organization. The SA will maintain users in various platforms such as Oracle NetSuite, Maxio, Workday and other platforms. The SA will need to have knowledge about audit compliancy rules affecting system administrators and documentation of tasks. The SA will monitor help desk tickets and provide service to end users on various ERP platforms, find solutions and expected outcomes, and delivery timetables. While some project management and technical administration tasks may be involved, the primary focus will be on documentation and analysis of solutions for various issues. A strong understanding of NetSuite ERP, Maxio Billing, Workday HCM is required.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements, ensuring alignment with business and project goals.
  • Document detailed system specifications, including both functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Create comprehensive use cases, process flows, and wireframes to illustrate system functionality and user interactions.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.
  • Identify and mitigate roadblocks and risks during project planning, proposing effective solutions.
  • Develop and maintain UAT test cases and coordinate testing efforts.
  • Communicate effectively with business leaders to align project goals and expectations.
  • Monitor project progress, track deliverables, and adjust timetables as needed.
  • Provide ongoing support for system enhancements and updates.
  • Create and deliver training materials and sessions for end-users to ensure effective use of systems.
  • Other duties assigned and related to the nature of this role and company initiatives.
  • Be able to Review all ERP related issues and provide solutions. Development experience is a plus.

More information about this role:

  • This is a full-time position, working in a hybrid model, and reporting to our Ottawa (Kanata) office at 1125 Innovation Drive, Kanata, ON
  • The targeted compensation package for this role is between CAD $110,000 and CAD $140,000 subject to internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

Education:

  • BA/BS from an accredited college or university preferred.
  • ERP Admin (ADM201 and ADM211) certified is a very strong plus.
  • Certification in Business Analysis (CCBA or CBAP) is a plus.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience as System Administrator with NetSuite, Workday HCM and Maxio.
  • Minimum 5-7 years Business Analyst experience with various IT projects in a scrum Agile environment.

Talents and Desired Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Systems Administrator, with experience in ERP domains.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements.
  • Proficiency in NetSuite, Maxio, Workday HCM and other CRM/ERP software.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage requests from Help desk ticketing system and quickly turnaround working results.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, capable of managing multiple Admin tasks and requests simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (such as Agile and Scrum) and tools (such as JIRA).
  • A proactive problem-solving mindset, with a focus on identifying and implementing effective solutions.
  • Ability to work in a global, fast-paced environment.

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.

Global team. Global reach. Global impact.

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Senior AI/ML Engineer to join our growing AI Center of Excellence, responsible for using AI and machine learning to drive innovation across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include (but will not be limited to):

  • Leverage data to solve business problems of various business units at EcoVadis

  • Design, develop, deploy and maintain scalable AI/ML systems

  • Design AI/ML pipelines by applying the best practices in MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps

  • Build AI/ML engineering infrastructure and systems to orchestrate batch and real-time pipelines

  • Run large-scale experiments and tests to ensure quality and efficiency of ML and data pipelines

  • Partner with scientists and engineers to make AI/ML models accessible to end-users and downstream processes

  • Leverage Python, MLflow, Azure stack (e.g., Azure cloud, Azure ML, Azure Foundry) and Databricks to deliver end-to-end solutions

You have an outgoing personality along with an exceptional level of drive and a desire to pursue a career in an international and dynamic environment. You also possess excellent verbal and written communication, critical thinking and analytical skills.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • Industry experience in driving, designing and implementing production-grade AI/ML systems and integrating those into business applications as well as model monitoring at scale

  • Strong programming skills in Python and related ML libraries

  • Strong experience of AI/ML lifecycle, principles, and MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps tooling (e.g., MLflow, LangChain, VectorDBs, Evaluation frameworks, etc)

  • Experience in cloud technology, preferably Azure and its ecosystem (e.g., Azure Foundry, Azure Bicep, AzureML and Azure Cloud Storage) and Databricks

  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including agile methodologies, coding standards, code reviews, source management, build processes, testing, and operations

  • Experience with REST API for ML model serving

  • Experience with Docker and container orchestration

  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases

  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration in the development of AI/ML products and services (e.g., Engineers, Product Managers)

  • Contribution to open-source libraries is a plus

  • Offer available only for candidates eligible to work and live in Poland

In return for your expertise, we offer:

  • Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment

  • Referral bonus policy

  • Learning and development

title: Art Director Intern (Unpaid) - T: The New York Times Style Magazine MENA
description:
T Magazine MENA is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Design Intern to join its editorial team.

We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in graphic design, a fresh creative perspective, and a keen interest in the world of print publishing. The ideal candidate has a refined visual sensibility, an understanding of contemporary design trends, and a passion for editorial storytelling through typography, imagery, and layout.

This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in magazine production, working closely with the editorial and creative teams to bring stories to life across the pages of T Magazine MENA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and layout of print magazine pages, ensuring consistency with the publication’s visual identity.

  • Work on typography, typesetting, kerning, and layout refinement to achieve polished, publication-ready designs.

  • Support the editorial team with image placement, visual composition, and page development.

  • Prepare and organize design files for print production, ensuring accuracy and adherence to technical specifications.

  • Closely work with the Art Director to translate creative concepts into compelling visual layouts.

  • Conduct visual research and contribute fresh ideas, references, and inspiration for upcoming issues.

  • Assist with final layout checks, proofing, and design revisions ahead of print deadlines.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Adobe InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator.

  • Strong understanding of typography, editorial layouts, grid systems, and visual hierarchy.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a meticulous approach to design execution.

  • A strong interest in fashion, art, culture, publishing, and contemporary visual trends.

  • Ability to take creative direction, incorporate feedback, and work collaboratively within a fast-paced editorial environment.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.

  • A portfolio demonstrating a strong design sensibility, typographic skills, and an understanding of editorial design.

Previous experience in editorial or print design is a plus, but not required. We value curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to learn.

title: Felsökare
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Som Felsökare hos Alstom blir du hjärtat i deras tekniska team. Din vardag är omväxlande och fartfylld, där du arbetar nära deras fordon för att säkerställa att de är säkra och redo för trafik. Du kommer att vara den som rycker in när det behövs avancerad felsökning på tågens mekaniska och elektriska system. Det är en roll med stort ansvar där du får använda din analytiska förmåga för att lösa problem, dokumentera dina insatser och se till att tågen håller högsta kvalitet. Du arbetar både självständigt och i nära samarbete med skickliga kollegor för att optimera underhållet och bidra till en stabil verksamhet.

Vi söker dig som är en driven problemlösare och trivs bäst när det händer mycket. Du är noggrann, tar stort eget ansvar för att arbetet blir korrekt utfört och ser alltid säkerheten som din högsta prioritet. Att vara en lagspelare som delar med dig av din kunskap för att lyfta hela teamet faller sig naturligt för dig.

Som konsult hos Randstad är du anställd hos oss och jobbar ute hos någon av våra kunder. Du har samma fördelar hos Randstad som hos andra arbetsgivare med kollektivavtal och förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, företagshälsovård och försäkringar. Utöver det erbjuds du även en mängd karriärmöjligheter, får möta olika företagskulturer och erfarenhet från olika branscher vilket gör att du utvecklar din kompetens och får ett välfyllt CV.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan på www.randstad.se. Vid frågor vänligen kontakta oss på talent.center@randstad.se.

Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Ansvarsområden

  • Ge expertstöd vid felsökning och reparationer för att säkerställa att tågen är driftklara.
  • Analysera data från tågens system för att kunna förutse och åtgärda fel innan de blir större problem.
  • Ansvara för korrekt rapportering av arbetsordrar och checklistor med hög detaljrikedom.
  • Rangera fordon inom depån samt klargöra dem inför trafik.
  • Dela med dig av din kunskap för att utveckla kompetensen hos dina kollegor i teamet.
  • Arbeta aktivt med ständiga förbättringar och följa våra höga krav på EHS och 5S-standarder.

description:

Key Responsibilities\:

I. Primary Function

To deliver general and specialized medical physics service and supervise Resident Physicists.

II. Key Result Areas / Job Description

1.

Administration/management duties

a) Arrange adequate supply of service materials and consumables

b) Perform essential duties of the department manager / senior physicist in his/ her absence

2.

Radiation protection

a) Implement or supervise the implementation of the radiation safety measures and code of practice on radiation safety and to ensure compliance with the relevant legislative requirements on use of radiation and radioactive substance.

b) Design or provide consultation on design, including radiation shielding and protection, of new radiological facilities.

c) Provide physics supports in radiation emergencies.

d) Provide radiation safety and protection services.

3.

Professional duties

a) Perform treatment planning, dose calculation and dosimetry verification of radiotherapy treatment and conduct QA on dosimetry aspects of treatment plans produced by other staff.

b) Provide consultation and clarification to doctors and AH health professionals on treatment planning and treatment delivery.

c) Support and/or supervise the delivery of special and complex radiotherapy treatments, such as IMRT, stereotactic radiotherapy/radiosurgery, intra-vascular brachytherapy, afterloading

treatment, and TBI.

d) Operate and maintain an accurate and reliable dosimetry system in support of radiological services.

e) Advice on patient safety and assess patient radiation dose.

f) Develop and provide consultation/advice to doctors and AH health professionals on development of more effective and efficient methods and procedures in radiotherapy and diagnostic radiology.

g) Provide quality assurance and calibration services for radiotherapy, diagnostic radiology and imaging equipment.

h) Support clinical trials and statistical analysis of clinical data.

i) Acquire, update and provide in suitable format all necessary physics and dosimetry data for clinical use.

j) Develop, implement and support computer and IT applications in clinical oncology and radiology services.

k) Support equipment and material acquisition including technology assessment, preparation of tender specification, and perform acceptance testing and commissioning.

l) Perform and/or lead X-ray Workshop staff to perform maintenance, calibration and quality assurance of radiotherapy, diagnostic radiology, nuclear medicine and related equipment.

m) Support the daily operation of MRI system on equipment QA, safety, development and advice on the use of scan sequences, imaging protocols and new imaging techniques.

n) Handle the management and disposal of radioactive substances and radiological equipment.

o) Perform any other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

p) Prepare radioactive substances for clinical use.

4.

Teaching and training

a) Provide the training for medical and other health care professionals

on medical physics and radiation protection.

b) Provide training for Resident Physicists.

(a)

A Master degree in Physics (General, Medical, Radiation, Health or Applied Physics) or Engineering (Electronic, Electrical, Computer, Microwave, Biomedical, Telecommunications or Medical Electronic Engineering) from a local university, or equivalent, and

Two years’ Resident Physicist training in HA or other relevant training. (see Remarks 2)

OR

Electronic Disciplines)

Candidates may be advised to approach the Hong Kong Council for Academic Accreditation for assessment on equivalent qualifications, if in doubt.

3. Commitment to patient care

4. Leadership

5. Interpersonal skills

7. Problem-solving

9. Enthusiasm

Jeg er en blid og aktiv gutt på 7 år som bor i Finsland, sammen med familien min. Jeg digger å utforske, leke og være i bevegelse! title: DNA:lle myymälämyyjäksi, Kuopio
description:
Tervetuloa DNA Myymälään rakentamaan myyntiuraa!

DNA:n Kuopion myymälätiimi etsii nyt uutta vahvistusta, joka haluaa kehittyä, oppia ja onnistua myynnin parissa. Me tarjoamme sinulle loistavan mahdollisuuden kasvaa osana palkittua työyhteisöä!

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • 💸 Kilpailukykyinen palkkaus: Pohjapalkka + myyntiprovisiot, takuupalkka 13,76 €/h ICT-alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Pystyt omalla myynnillisellä otteellasi vaikuttamaan tuntuvasti omaan ansaintaasi. Keskiansio myyjillä on ollut 3000 euroa/kk.

  • 🚀 Kattava perehdytys: Perehdytyksemme antaa sinulle vahvan pohjan myynnin saloihin.

  • 👥 Kannustava työympäristö: Ylläpidämme positiivista ja tsemppaavaa ilmapiiriä, jossa jokainen voi kasvaa ja kehittyä omassa roolissaan. Tukenasi ovat esihenkilöt, tiimikaverit ja jatkuvat valmennukset.

  • 🏅 Taitojen kehittämistä ja mahdollisuuksia: Saat arvokkaita taitoja ja hyvää kokemusta, joita voit hyödyntää työurallasi jatkossakin. Myyntikilpailut pitävät työsi inspiroivana ja tavoitteellisena.

Meille hakeminen on helppoa, voit hakea myös ilman CV:tä ja tietojen täyttö vie enintään muutaman minuutin aikaasi – älä siis mieti, vaan toimi heti!

Miksi juuri DNA?

DNA:lla pääset kehittymään myyntityön ammattilaiseksi turvallisessa ja kannustavassa ympäristössä. Lisäksi arjessa tukenasi on kokeneita esihenkilöitä sekä innostava tiimi. Vauhtia ja fiilistä lisäävät energiset myyntikilpailut ja onnistumisten juhlistaminen. 🏆

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Myyjänä DNA kaupassa palvelet asiakkaita kasvotusten ja chat-ympäristössä. DNA kaupan myyjänä vastaat niin DNA:n tuotteiden myynnistä, esillepanosta kuin myymälän perustehtävistäkin. Myymälässä tehtäväsi on välittää sujuvaa palveluasennetta, tehokkuutta ja mieleenpainuvaa asiakaskokemusta. Pääsetkin tekemään aktiivista myyntityötä huomioiden asiakkaiden yksilölliset tarpeet.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Haemme innostuneita ja tavoitteellisia henkilöitä, jotka haluavat oppia uutta ja menestyä myynnin parissa. Meille tärkeintä on motivaatio ja rohkeus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin, sinua tuetaan joka askeleella. Aikaisempi kokemus myyntityöstä katsotaan eduksi, mutta kokemustakin tärkeämpää on oikea asenne, sillä perehdytyksemme varmistaa, että sinulla on kaikki työssä tarvittavat taidot.

Tehtävä edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä, hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja valittavalta henkilöltä tullaan tarkistamaan luottotiedot.

Hae mukaan helposti ilman CV:tä!

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten jätä yhteystietosi kohdasta "Hae työpaikkaa". Mikäli herää jotain kysyttävää, ota rohkeasti yhteyttä soittamalla tai WhatsAppissa puh. 040 714 7995 – Tanja H. / Rainmaker.

Tehtävän perustiedot

Aloitus: Mahdollisimman pian
Paikkakunta: Kuopio
Työsopimus: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva
Työaika: 30-37,5 h/vko myymälöiden aukioloaikojen mukaisesti
Palkka: 2500-5500 e/kk tavoitepalkka 30 h viikkotunneilla. Toteutunut palkka muodostuu pohjapalkasta + myyntiprovisiosta. Takuupalkkana ICT-alan TES minimissään 13,76 €/h ja keskimäärin myyjämme tienaavat yli 3000 €/kk

title: Architectural Market Sector Principal- Community & Culture
description:
Why This Role Matters:

You are a relationship builder, market leader, and trusted advisor who is passionate about creating places that strengthen communities and enrich culture. In this role, you will drive the growth and success of our Community & Culture (C&C) Practice by cultivating strategic client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and leading pursuits that expand our impact across public, civic, cultural, and community-centered markets.

You bring a unique blend of business development, leadership, and architectural expertise. As a visible leader within the communities we serve, you will champion stakeholder engagement, generate and convert opportunities, and guide multidisciplinary teams in delivering innovative environments that inspire connection, belonging, and growth. You'll play a critical role in growing our practice, mentoring future leaders, and strengthening CPL's reputation as a trusted partner for communities and cultural institutions.

What You'll Do:

Practice Growth & Business Development

  • Serve as a leader and ambassador for CPL's Community & Culture Practice within the marketplace.
  • Build, strengthen, and maintain relationships with municipal leaders, community organizations, cultural institutions, public agencies, private sector partners, and other key stakeholders.
  • Identify, pursue, and secure new opportunities while expanding existing client partnerships across community-focused markets, including libraries, parks and recreation, civic facilities, museums, theaters, government and judicial centers, emergency services, operation centers, zoos and aquariums, and workplace environments.
  • Lead business development efforts including networking, conferences, industry involvement, strategic pursuits, community engagement initiatives, and proposal development.
  • Maintain a strong client portfolio and contribute to achieving practice revenue, profitability, and annual growth goals.

Client Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, guiding visioning, planning, stakeholder engagement, and decision-making processes.
  • Lead client presentations, workshops, public meetings, community outreach efforts, and stakeholder engagement sessions.
  • Ensure exceptional client experiences through proactive communication, collaboration, and responsive leadership.
  • Promote CPL's value proposition and strengthen our reputation as a premier partner in creating meaningful community and cultural destinations.

Project & Operational Leadership

  • Provide executive oversight of multiple projects, ensuring successful delivery of scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
  • Guide project teams in developing effective strategies, work plans, and creative design solutions that reflect community needs and aspirations.
  • Allocate resources effectively to support project performance and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, billing, and resource planning.
  • Advocate for innovative, sustainable, and people-centered design solutions that foster connection, engagement, and long-term community impact.

Strategic Leadership

  • Monitor industry trends, community needs, demographic shifts, cultural priorities, market conditions, and emerging technologies to drive practice growth.
  • Develop and leverage performance metrics that support informed business decisions and practice health.
  • Collaborate with Practice Leaders and firm leadership to shape strategy and execute key initiatives.
  • Influence organizational success through effective communication, relationship building, stakeholder collaboration, and change leadership.
  • Champion CPL's community-driven design philosophy by helping clients create places where people connect, share, and thrive.

What You Bring:

  • A Professional Degree (or Master’s) in your field from an accredited institution and have at least 12 years of related work experience, with at least 5 in a Project Manager role – or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Professional licensure (RA)
  • Recognition as an expert in your field, often serving on professional organization boards and committees
  • Elevated level of financial acumen
  • Ability to manage complexity with a have a track record of providing quality designs for a wide range of project types
  • In-depth knowledge of construction processes, plans, and specifications, as well as their application and relevance to public works and construction projects.

What We Offer:

Benefits for Regular Full-Time & Part-Time Employees Working 30+ Hours/Week

  • Healthcare for you and your family: Medical, Dental & Vision insurance
    • Single HDHP Medical plan with 100% paid premium
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match
  • Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • FREE Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance for you and your family
  • FREE Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • PTO + Sick Time + 8 Holidays per year
  • Retirement Savings Plan with contribution from CPL to grow your retirement funds
  • Internal Mobility & Career Advancement
  • Licensure Assistance

Additional benefits available to FT Employees Working 40+ Hours/Week

  • Tuition Assistance: You may be eligible for continuing education assistance
  • Student Loan Assistance Program: CPL will contribute up to $100/month for 5 years ($6,000 total) toward student loan debt

What Does It Look Like Working Here?

We believe that building a strong community is about establishing a prevailing sense of fellowship among our team members, friends, and neighbors.

  • Collaboration – working with others towards the best solution, placing great emphasis on the collective wisdom of our internal teams.
  • Family – celebrating others’ successes, genuinely caring about the happiness and well-being of our team members and recognizing their own families as extensions of the CPL family.
  • Fun – not taking oneself too seriously, fully understanding that fun at work is conducive to productivity.
  • Inspiration – contributing to an uplifting workplace that facilitates growth and success by maintaining a positive, upbeat attitude.
  • Integrity – doing what is ethically right and providing reliable follow-through on commitments.
  • Ingenuity – seeking new opportunities and consistently identifying unexpected and practical ways to solve problems.

The rate for this position generally ranges between $150,000 to $185,000. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the New York Pay Transparency Law. It is based on what a successful New York applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in New York or perform the position from New York. Similar positions located outside of New York will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by New York Equal Pay Transparency Law. description:
Til vår asfaltfabrikk på Jessheim

Bas Fagoperatør- produksjon

Om stillingen

Veidekke Industri AS ser etter deg som vil bidra til å bedre veistandarden gjennom optimal produksjon og leveranse.   • Kan kommunisere på Engelsk

  • Førekort kl. B/BE

Profil

Veidekkes verdier Profesjonell – Redelig – Entusiastisk – Grensesprengende er viktige for oss, og du må kunne stå for disse.

  • Like å jobbe utendørs med fysisk arbeid

  • Opptatt av din egen og andres sikkerhet

  • Praktisk anlagt, like å jobbe i team og er opptatt av kvalitet i arbeidet

  • En bidragsyter til godt samspill med dine kolleger på laget

  • Motivert, engasjert og har evnen til å se hva som skal gjøres

  • Fleksibel og mobil

Vi tilbyr

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Gode velferdsordninger

  • Gode kollegaer som heier på hverandre

  • Gode muligheter for å bygge deg et godt nettverk

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Lokasjon: Gardermoen Alle 246

Spørsmål om stillingen kan rettes til:

Nils Jørgen Strømnes

Produksjonsleder tlf. 481 70 442

Søknadsfrist: 1. desember 2026

Veidekke er en av Skandinavias største entreprenører. Selskapet utfører alle typer bygg- og anleggsoppdrag, vedlikeholder veier og produserer asfalt, pukk og grus. Involvering og lokalkunnskap kjennetegner virksomheten. Omsetningen er om lag 43 milliarder kroner, og nær halvparten av de 7 800 medarbeiderne eier aksjer i selskapet. Veidekke er notert på Oslo Børs og har siden starten i 1936 alltid gått med overskudd.

Stillingen inngår i Veidekke Infrastruktur, som driver landsdekkende anleggsvirksomhet med prosjekter innenfor vei, bane, kraftanlegg, industrianlegg og flyplasser for private og offentlige kunder. Selskapet er Norges største asfaltentreprenør og nest største produsent av pukk og grus. I tillegg har selskapet betydelig aktivitet innen drift og vedlikehold av det offentlige veinettet i hele landet. Årlig omsetning er på NOK 10,4 milliarder (2025), og virksomheten har ca. 2 100 ansatte, hvorav 1 250 fagarbeidere og 850 funksjonærer.

title: Senior D365 Finance & Operations Application Lead
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on Senior D365 Finance & Operations Application Lead to own the functional operation, development roadmap, and continuous improvement of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment.

You will be the primary IT partner for Finance, Procurement, Logistics, and Operations, combining business process expertise with technical capabilities, application governance, and delivery coordination.


Working closely with our Senior D365 Engineer in India, who leads technical architecture and development, you will drive the transition from external vendors to sustainable internal engineering and support capabilities.

This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end application ownership, without direct line management.


Key Responsibilities

Application Ownership & Business Partnership:

  • Own D365 Finance & Operations and its business-critical integrations, including connected expense, reporting, and integration services.
  • Translate Finance, Procurement, and Logistics requirements into functional solutions, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
  • Provide expertise across GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory, Tax, and related workflows.
  • Ensure application reliability, business continuity, and readiness for financial closing periods.
  • Define service expectations, escalation paths, and SLAs/OLAs with business and IT stakeholders.


Functional Engineering & Delivery:

  • Perform hands-on D365 configuration, troubleshooting, and selected enhancements.
  • Read, debug, and review X++ code, contributing to development where appropriate.
  • Define functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with the Senior D365 Engineer on solution design, technical feasibility, and delivery planning.
  • Coordinate testing, UAT, releases, deployments, business acceptance, and documentation.


Internalization & Vendor Management:

  • Lead the transition of agreed development and support activities from external partners to internal teams.
  • Coordinate knowledge transfer, source code, technical assets, documentation, and operational handovers.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, support processes, and delivery capabilities across Switzerland and India.
  • Manage vendor performance, service agreements, transition milestones, risks, and dependencies.
  • Reduce external dependencies while maintaining service continuity and quality.


Operations, Governance & Budget:

  • Own application service quality, incident coordination, problem resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee integrations, application security roles, access reviews, segregation of duties, and audit compliance.
  • Ensure alignment with ITSM, security, change, and release management processes.
  • Coordinate distributed engineering resources, delivery commitments, and stakeholder communication.
  • Act as Cost Center Owner, managing application budgets, licensing, contracts, and external service costs.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and improved reliability.


What You Bring:

  • 8+ years in ERP, enterprise applications, consulting, or application management, ideally including 5+ years with D365 Finance & Operations.
  • Strong functional knowledge of Finance, Procurement, and operational ERP processes.
  • Hands-on D365 configuration, troubleshooting, and practical X++ development experience, including code analysis and debugging.
  • Experience managing application roadmaps, requirements, delivery, integrations, testing, and production support.
  • Proven ability to manage external ERP partners, knowledge transfer, and transitions to internal engineering teams.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams and coordinating technical delivery without direct line authority.
  • Understanding of application security, financial controls, audit requirements, and ITSM practices.
  • Strong business partnering, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent English communication skills.


Additional advantages: Advanced X++ development, Azure, Power Platform, Logic Apps, REST APIs, Power BI, Linux, automation, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, ITIL, German language skills, and relevant Microsoft certifications.


What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Established trusted functional ownership and a transparent D365 roadmap.
  • Built an effective delivery partnership with our India-based engineering team.
  • Transitioned agreed vendor activities into sustainable internal capabilities.
  • Improved application reliability, support processes, and financial closing readiness.
  • Delivered hands-on improvements while strengthening governance, documentation, and audit readiness.
  • Reduced vendor dependency and improved budget transparency.


Your Mindset

You combine business understanding, technical expertise, and strong ownership. You are equally comfortable working with Finance stakeholders and engineers, translating complex requirements into practical solutions.

You communicate clearly, challenge existing processes constructively, and focus on reliable, maintainable solutions that deliver measurable business value.

As our Global IT application portfolio evolves, additional business application responsibilities may be assigned.

title: Clinical Analytics Lead, Middle East and Gulf
description:
Proximie is on a mission to improve healthcare by transforming the world’s operating rooms into connected ecosystems of people, devices, and data.

Our Intelligence Suite transforms operating room (OR) performance, keeping teams in sync and workflows on track to maximise throughput. Simultaneously our computer vision and AI capabilities capture real-time data and detect surgical events – improving quality of data outputs. The result: ORs are optimised like never before – with predictive analytics and automated notifications ensuring patients and staff are in the right place at the right time.

Once practitioners are in the OR, our Surgical Suite enables real-time remote access and creates a secure video record of every procedure; improving training, education, and collaboration. It is an intuitive asset which helps instil a culture of continuous learning, accelerates the adoption of cutting-edge medical devices, and enhances surgical performance across the entire global workforce – improving outcomes and saving lives.

Proximie was commercialised in 2019 and is available in over 500 facilities globally.

Check out our Founder and CEO Nadine’s Origins Story here:

Position Overview

Proximie’s Intelligence Suite is transforming operating room performance across the globe. By leveraging ambient computer vision and AI, it synchronises surgical teams, optimises workflows, and maximises OR throughput. Our technology captures real-time intraoperative data, detects surgical events automatically, and integrates seamlessly with EHR systems. The result is predictive analytics and automated notifications that keep operating rooms running at their best - eliminating manual data entry, improving accuracy, and enhancing decision-making in real time.

As adoption of our Intelligence Suite accelerates across hospitals and health systems, Proximie is expanding its Clinical Analytics function to deliver deeper, more actionable insights to our customers. We are seeking a Clinical Analytics Lead to shape and deliver advanced analytics capabilities for our customers across the Middle East and the Gulf.

This role will be pivotal in translating data into meaningful insights that demonstrate return on investment, optimise OR efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in clinical operations. You will partner closely with customers, understanding their operational challenges, delivering bespoke analytics solutions, and guiding them in maximising the value of Proximie’s data-driven tools.

We are looking for a strategic and analytical thinker with a strong understanding of hospital and health system operations, particularly for surgery. You will combine technical and analytical rigour with the ability to communicate complex insights clearly and persuasively. You’ll need to be comfortable diving into datasets as you are engaging with senior stakeholders, helping them interpret insights that drive measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver bespoke analytics capabilities, including analysis of operational and clinical workflows, hospital performance metrics, and ROI assessments.

  • Lead continuous insight generation, from trend analysis to post-launch evaluation enabling customers to optimise OR performance and operational efficiency.

  • Identify opportunities for workflow and process improvement across hospital and healthcare systems, and map how Proximie’s solutions can drive measurable outcomes.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Support teams to translate data-driven insights into improved product adoption, clinical engagement, and install base growth.

  • Provide customer-derived insights and performance data to inform Proximie’s product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plans.

  • Collaborate with Business Development and Sales teams to articulate the value of Proximie’s data and analytics capabilities, shaping proposals and strategic partnerships.

  • Support Customer Success and Sales teams in building scalable frameworks and repeatable processes that help hospitals extract maximum value from Proximie’s solutions.

  • Conduct competitive and market analyses to identify emerging trends, technologies, and business models that inform enterprise strategy and product positioning.

  • Contribute to ideation and prioritisation of new analytics features and capabilities that extend the value of the Proximie Intelligence Suite.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) or equivalent practical experience.

  • Deep experience in healthcare analytics or clinical operations, ideally within hospitals, surgical environments, or health systems.

  • Proven ability to translate complex datasets into actionable insights that improve operational performance, efficiency, and ROI.

  • Deep understanding of perioperative or procedural workflows, and how data informs decision-making across clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders.

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in tools highly desirable such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent data visualisation and reporting platforms.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability, capable of influencing senior stakeholders and bridging the gap between technical and clinical audiences.

  • Commercial acumen, with demonstrated experience using analytics to identify growth opportunities, improve product adoption, or demonstrate value to enterprise customers.

  • Collaborative mindset, comfortable operating across matrixed teams including Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to deliver shared outcomes.

  • Self-starter who thrives in an agile, fast-paced environment, with the ability to prioritise and execute effectively across multiple customer engagements.

Why Work for Proximie?

  • You will be encouraged to grow in your role, take ownership and gain responsibilities. Proximie’s values are Ownership, Deliver Results, Build Trust and Go Beyond.

  • Generous annual leave.

  • Two “well-being” days per year plus the day off for your birthday.

  • “Summer Fridays” – early office closing on Fridays during summer months.

  • Annual bonus programme – based on individual contribution.

  • To support your professional growth, all permanent employees will have access to an annual stipend of $1,000 to assist with personal development activities.

  • Flexible working hours - we trust our people to manage their time and to focus on wider results.

  • A flat organizational structure where every opinion matters, ideas are cultivated, and innovation is encouraged.

  • Proximie is a truly global company with teams across the UK, Europe, United States and the Middle East with that you will have opportunities to see the world.

Proximie is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under the law.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Upstream delivers a cloud-based, AI-powered behavioral intelligence platform for physical AI and smart mobility. Upstream empowers customers with advanced AI-driven cybersecurity solutions, including detection and response (XDR), AI Security, quality and operational intelligence, cyber threat intel, SOC services, and more.


Upstream is looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join our core platform engineering team, focusing on developing and maintaining our AI-powered automotive data management platform. As a Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate scalable, production-grade data and ML platform components, ensuring high reliability and performance.


You will work closely with our Data Engineering and Data Science teams to develop and enhance our Iceberg-based data platform, including a data lake, query engine, and MLOps tools, providing a solid AI-ready foundation for our automotive solutions. These solutions support millions of connected vehicles worldwide, focusing on cybersecurity (XDR), vehicle quality, and operational intelligence. You will work with technologies such as Iceberg, Trino, Prefect, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, JupyterHub, MLflow, and dbt.


This role is full-time and is Herzliya, Israel-based.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest and transform batch data on our data lake, enabling analytics and ML with strong data quality, governance, observability, and CI/CD.
  • Build and expand our foundational data infrastructure, including our data lake, analytics engine, and batch processing frameworks.
  • Create robust infrastructure to enable automated pipelines that will ingest and process data into our analytical platforms, leveraging open-source, cloud-agnostic frameworks and toolsets.
  • Develop and maintain our data lake layouts and architectures for efficient data access and advanced analytics.
  • Develop and manage orchestration tools, governance tools, data discovery tools, and more.
  • Work with other team members of the engineering group, including data architects, data analysts, and data scientists, to provide solutions using a use case-based approach that drives the construction of technical data flows.
  • End-to-end ownership mindset with a proactive, production-first approach

Requirements

  • BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
  • At least 4 years of experience with designing and building data pipelines, analytical tools and data lakes
  • Experience with the data engineering tech stack: ETL & orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow, Argo, Prefect), and distributed data processing tools (e.g Spark, Kafka, Presto)
  • Experience with Python is a must
  • Experience working with open-source products - Advantage
  • Experience working in a containerized environment (e.g. k8s) - Advantage
  • Development experience, using a general purpose programming language (Java, Scala, Kotlin, Go, etc.) - Advantage


Upstream is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

title: IEA Employment Consultant - Bendigo
description:
Make a real impact – create opportunities and change lives!!!

Are you passionate about supporting people with disability to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant at our Bendigo, VIC site within our Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Who Are We: -

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

About the role: -

This is a dynamic role where you get to combine people support with sales, relationship building and administration, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference every day.

You will:

  • Support participants (many facing barriers such as disability, injury, or long-term unemployment) to become job-ready
  • Actively market candidates to employers and generate job opportunities
  • Build strong relationships with local businesses to create sustainable employment pathways
  • Success in this role comes from your ability to balance people support with proactive employer engagement and outcome delivery.

Key Responsibilities: -

  • Build strong relationships with participants to understand their employment goals and position them for success.
  • Coach participants to be job-ready, competitive, and interview confident.
  • Assist participants with resumes, interview preparation, job search strategies and facilitate access to training and upskilling opportunities.
  • Drive employment outcomes by actively advocating on behalf of participants to employers and securing job placements.
  • Generate new employment opportunities through cold calls, employer visits, and face-to-face engagement with employers to generate job opportunities.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of employers to consistently convert opportunities into placements.
  • Identify and capitalise on hidden job opportunities through proactive business development.
  • Pitch candidates confidently, positioning their skills to meet employer needs.
  • Influence hiring decisions by promoting the commercial and social value of inclusive recruitment
  • Negotiate job trials, work experience placements, and wage subsidies to secure employment outcomes.
  • Maintain and grow employer relationships to drive repeat business and ongoing vacancies.
  • Achieve and exceed KPI targets across placements, engagement, and activity levels.
  • Conduct regular appointments and track participant progress toward employment outcomes.
  • Manage compliance, documentation, and data entry in line with program requirements.
  • Track performance against KPIs and achieve employment outcome targets.
  • Celebrate milestones and successful placements to build participant confidence and engagement.

What Success Looks Like: -

  • Strong employment outcomes for participants.
  • A growing network of engaged local employers.
  • Consistent achievement of KPIs and performance targets.
  • Positive, long-term placements that change lives.

About You: -

You are:

  • A natural communicator and relationship builder with confidence engaging employers.
  • Experienced in sales, business development, recruitment, or customer-facing roles.
  • Passionate about helping people overcome barriers and succeed.
  • Resilient, target-driven, and motivated by achieving outcomes.
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

Why You’ll Love It: -

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

  • Base salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success.
  • Ongoing training and career development – we are committed to your growth.
  • Supportive and inclusive team environment where your contributions make a difference every day.
  • Celebrating milestones – we love to recognise and rewards hard work with fun events.
  • EAP | Employee Wellbeing Program.
  • Purchased Annual Leave.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Funded Certificate IV in Community Services or Mental Health Peer Support (eligibility criteria applies).
  • Service recognitions.
  • APM Family Hub.
  • Maxxia | Vehicle salary packaging.

To be considered, you will have...

  • Eligibility to work in Australia.
  • A current driver’s licence and a comprehensively insured vehicle.
  • A MyGovID (Standard level).
  • Willing to complete a National Police Check.
  • Able to pass a Working with Children Check.
  • Available to work Full-Time Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm.

At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures including indigenous peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people with disability.

Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! Let’s work together to break down barriers, shatter expectations and build a more inclusive world- one individual at a time.

title: Physiotherapist
company: The Association of People with Disability
description:
Rehabilitation and Community-Based Rehabilitation

  • Conduct comprehensive physiotherapy assessments for children and adults with disabilities.

title: Director of Information Technology
description:
Location: Irving, Texas (on-site)
Employment type: Full-time
About the role
Pei Wei is seeking a hands-on Director of Information Technology to support technology operations across Pei Wei, Pei Wei Express, Pick Up Stix, and Leeann Chin, a portfolio of approximately 215 locations. The Director works directly across restaurant and enterprise systems, service needs, platform improvements, vendors, and business partners. When operational demands permit, the Director also advances technology strategy, roadmaps, and longer-term planning.
The Director leads a lean technology organization serving domestic operations and a globally distributed workforce. The Technology Manager reports to this role and coordinates operational priorities and escalations; the Director remains actively engaged in hands-on work, drawing on specialists' deeper expertise in particular systems.
The environment combines shared services with brand-specific POS, ordering, loyalty, and payment platforms--for example, the current inventory lists Xenial for Pei Wei Express and NCR Aloha for Pei Wei and Pick Up Stix. Portfolio work spans restaurant, digital, infrastructure, and enterprise systems; platforms and project status evolve.
What you'll do
* Work directly on operational and technical needs across the portfolio, including service issues, platform configuration, troubleshooting, remediation, and follow-through; draw on specialist expertise where appropriate.
* Set service and coverage objectives with the Technology Manager, who coordinates daily service delivery and is the team's operational escalation point. Stay engaged in service issues and major incidents as needed; improve tiered schedules, backups, handoffs, and service across time zones.
* Lead measurable improvement of platform configuration, asset and configuration-item lifecycle, ownership, and documentation. Personally contribute to the work and improve Freshservice workflows, data quality, and adoption.

title: Solutions Engineer
location: London, London, City of, United Kingdom
description:
About Equals

Equals is the next-generation global money movement platform built for exceptional businesses operating across borders. We bring international payments, embedded finance, and more together into a single connection that simplifies operations and strengthens financial control. With deep expertise and integrated infrastructure, Equals turns financial complexity into reliable solutions.



With our headquarters in London and teams around the UK and Europe, you will join a very close-knit, talented and supportive team from various backgrounds who believe that bringing different perspectives together helps us understand our customers' needs. United, by one thing, making money management straightforward and cost-effective for our customers.



About the role

Equals sells to programme managers: payment service providers, acquirers and platforms that run accounts, payments, FX or cards for their own customers on our infrastructure, through an API integration or a white-label setup.



As a Solutions Engineer you are the technical lead in the sale. You work with our Platform Sales team and our partnerships teams to understand what a prospect needs, design a solution that works for them and for us, scope it in a Statement of Work, and hand it cleanly to implementation. You will lead technical discovery, run demos and sandbox walkthroughs, answer RFPs and due diligence, and tell sales early when a deal will not work.



Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects: their systems, their customers, their flow of funds, and their integration or white-label requirements.
  • Design the solution across accounts, payments, FX and card issuing, and document it clearly: architecture, flows, responsibilities and risks.
  • Write the Statement of Work: deliverables, scope, assumptions and dependencies, so what is signed is what we can deliver.
  • Qualify opportunities on product fit with the seller, and flag early where a deal needs Product, Compliance or Engineering input.
  • Run demos, API walkthroughs and sandbox sessions for prospects' technical and product teams.
  • Provide the technical content for RFPs, RFIs and due diligence questionnaires.
  • Hand over to Implementation and Technical Account Management with complete documentation.
  • Capture product gaps and requests from the field and feed them to Product with the commercial context.
  • Improve the team's demo environments, templates and technical sales material.

Accountabilities

  • Win rate on deals you support.
  • Time from discovery to solution proposal.
  • SoW accuracy: delivered without material re-scoping.
  • Quality of handover to Implementation.



Your profile

Skills & experience

  • Three or more years as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer or technical consultant in a SaaS or API-first business, ideally in payments or fintech.
  • Strong on REST APIs, webhooks and integration patterns, and confident with Postman, cURL and API specifications.
  • Has worked with enterprise clients to design and scope technical solutions, and written SoWs.
  • Has supported RFPs and due diligence with accurate technical input.
  • Knowledge of payments, card issuing, banking-as-a-service or embedded finance is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication; confident running a technical workshop.

Attitude & behaviours

  • Customer-first, with a knack for making complex things simple.
  • Commercially aware: understands why the deal matters as well as how the solution works.
  • Straight about what we can and cannot do.
  • Organised across several live opportunities at once.
  • Collaborative with Sales, Product, Engineering and Compliance.



Diversity & inclusion

Equals is committed to building a workplace where everyone can be themselves. We actively welcome different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences, and we'll work with you to understand what you need to do your best work. We're an equal opportunities employer and proud of it.


We offer hybrid working across our teams, balancing time in the office — for collaboration, events and the relationships that make work rewarding — with the flexibility to work remotely where roles allow.

title: Electrical Estimator
description:
Electrical Project Manager / Estimator

Industrial Electrical Group

About Conti LLC

Conti LLC delivers the complete lifecycle of industrial construction services, from design/build and preconstruction through field installation, startup, commissioning, training, and ongoing maintenance support. Our team partners with industrial and manufacturing clients to provide high-quality electrical, automation, and construction solutions that drive safety, efficiency, and operational success.

At Conti, we are committed to building lasting client relationships through technical expertise, exceptional project execution, and a culture focused on safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Position Summary

Conti LLC is seeking an experienced Electrical Project Manager / Estimator to join our Industrial Electrical Group. This individual will play a key leadership role in both preconstruction and project execution by developing accurate cost estimates, managing project budgets and schedules, coordinating project resources, and ensuring successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in industrial electrical construction, estimating, project management, and client relationship management. This position offers the opportunity to lead projects from conceptual budgeting and estimating through construction and project closeout.

Reports To: Director
Position Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Location: Local Candidates Preferred

Essential Responsibilities

Estimating & Preconstruction

  • Prepare complete and accurate estimates by reviewing project drawings, specifications, bid documents, and customer requirements.
  • Perform quantity takeoffs and develop labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor cost estimates.
  • Analyze project scope and identify potential risks, gaps, and value-engineering opportunities.
  • Solicit and evaluate vendor and subcontractor quotations.
  • Resolve discrepancies by gathering and analyzing information from project stakeholders.
  • Prepare competitive proposals and bid packages utilizing estimating software such as Accubid, McCormick, or similar platforms.
  • Review construction documents, specifications, and project requirements to ensure estimate accuracy and completeness.

Project Management

  • Manage industrial electrical projects from award through completion and closeout.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and staffing plans.
  • Identify required resources and assign responsibilities to project team members.
  • Coordinate activities between clients, contractors, suppliers, field personnel, and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor project performance against established budget, schedule, and quality objectives.
  • Create action plans to address schedule delays, cost impacts, and project risks.
  • Track project progress and provide regular status updates to management and clients.
  • Review contracts, construction plans, specifications, and scope documents to ensure successful execution.

Client Relations & Leadership

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact throughout project execution.
  • Lead project meetings and facilitate communication between office and field teams.
  • Interact effectively with clients, inspectors, subcontractors, and field personnel.
  • Support business development efforts through excellent customer service and professional project leadership.

Change Management & Project Controls

  • Evaluate change requests and determine project impacts related to cost and schedule.
  • Prepare and negotiate change orders.
  • Secure customer approvals for scope modifications.
  • Monitor labor productivity, procurement activities, and project profitability.
  • Implement corrective actions when projects deviate from established goals.

Quality & Safety

  • Ensure quality control of all project documentation, drawings, specifications, and PDF packages distributed to project teams.
  • Promote and support Conti’s commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements, and industry standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Electrical Project Management and Estimating experience.
  • Experience managing industrial electrical construction projects.
  • Strong understanding of industrial electrical systems, construction practices, project controls, and budgeting.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, specifications, one-line diagrams, and construction documents.
  • Experience using estimating software such as:
    • Accubid
    • McCormick
    • Bluebeam
    • Similar estimating platforms
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Valid Driver’s License.
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within industrial manufacturing, automotive, food and beverage, warehousing, distribution, or process facilities.
  • Experience with:
    • Medium-voltage power distribution systems
    • Industrial power systems
    • Controls and instrumentation
    • Manufacturing facility infrastructure
    • Electrical construction projects ranging from service work to large capital installations
  • Scheduling experience utilizing Microsoft Project.
  • PMP Certification, Journeyman Electrician License, Master Electrician License, or related industry certifications are a plus.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to walk active construction sites and navigate rough or uneven terrain.
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety glasses, hearing protection, and work boots.
  • Ability to work in office, industrial, and construction environments.
  • Ability to regularly operate a computer, calculator, copier, scanner, and related office equipment.

Work Environment

  • Combination of office, manufacturing facility, and construction site environments.
  • Frequent communication with employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.
  • Travel required up to 50% based on project and client needs.
  • Exposure to varying weather conditions and industrial work environments during site visits.

Why Join Conti LLC?

  • Lead impactful industrial electrical construction projects from estimating through completion.
  • Work with a highly skilled team that values collaboration, safety, and professional growth.
  • Gain exposure to complex manufacturing, power distribution, controls, and infrastructure projects.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Opportunity for long-term career development within a growing organization.

Join Conti LLC and help deliver innovative industrial electrical solutions that power the future of manufacturing and industry.
