title: Infor-ERP-Spezialist (m/w/d)
description:
# **Infor ERP Specialist (m/f/d)**

**Role Overview:**
Implement, support and optimize Otis Baan/Infor ERP systems. This role requires a deep understanding of business processes and how the ERP system can be leveraged to improve efficiency. The ERP Specialist will work closely with various departments to understand their needs and translate them into effective solutions. The candidate will join the Baan/Infor EMEA team.

**On a typical day you will:**

  • Implementation & Configuration: Participate in ERP implementations, including requirements gathering, system configuration, data migration, user training, and go-live support.
  • Support: Provide ongoing support to end-users, troubleshooting issues, and resolving problems related to the ERP system. Perform regular system maintenance tasks and identify areas for optimization.
  • Business Process Analysis: Identify opportunities for improvement through the use of the ERP system. Work with different departments to understand their requirements and translate them into effective solutions within the ERP system.
  • System Integrations: Manage integrations between the ERP system and other applications. Ensure data integrity and seamless data flow between systems.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure the ERP system complies with relevant Otis regulations and security policies.
  • Project Management: May be involved in managing small to medium-sized projects related to the ERP system.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven experience of minimum 5 years, in implementing, maintaining, and supporting Baan4, Baan5 or Infor LN.
  • Strong understanding of business processes preferably in Finance or Project, Service, Manufacturing.
  • DB know-how including SQL.
  • Baan programming know-how, at least able to read programs. In addition, Exchange schemes and Tools, including pVRC understanding.
  • Fluent English. German is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical users, in an international environment.
  • Experience in project management is a plus.

title: Erfaren montör | Konecranes | Markaryd
description:
Vill du arbeta praktiskt med montering i en modern industriverksamhet? Konecranes i Markaryd söker en noggrann och erfaren montör. Här får du bidra till tillverkningen av produkter och lösningar inom lyftteknik tillsammans med ett team där kvalitet, säkerhet och samarbete står i fokus.

Om jobbet

Som montör arbetar du med montering av komponenter och produkter enligt instruktioner och ritningar. Du använder handverktyg och annan relevant utrustning, kontrollerar att arbetet håller rätt kvalitet och rapporterar eventuella avvikelser. Arbetet kan även innefatta materialhantering och dokumentation av utförda moment.

Du samarbetar med kollegor i produktionen för att säkerställa ett effektivt arbetsflöde och en trygg arbetsmiljö. I rollen är det viktigt att arbeta strukturerat, följa säkerhetsrutiner och bidra till förbättringar i det dagliga arbetet.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som trivs med praktiskt arbete och har ett intresse för teknik och industri. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, arbetar noggrant och har lätt för att samarbeta. Du är också flexibel och tycker om att lära dig nya moment och arbetssätt.

Kravprofil

  • Betydande erfarenhet av montering eller annat praktiskt arbete inom industri är ett krav.

  • Förmåga att följa arbetsinstruktioner och arbeta noggrant.

  • Grundläggande teknisk förståelse och vana att använda handverktyg.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.

  • Förmåga att samarbeta och bidra till en säker arbetsmiljö.

Vi erbjuder dig

Du får möjlighet att arbeta i en teknisk industrimiljö hos Konecranes och utveckla din kompetens inom montering och produktion. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, kvalitet och säkerhet är viktiga delar av vardagen.

Som en av oss

Som anställd bemanningskonsult hos Lernia får du marknadsmässig lön, semester, pensionsavsättning, försäkringar och anslutning till vårt kollektivavtal. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård. Under uppdraget får du stöd av en konsultchef som hjälper dig i ditt uppdrag, stöttar din utveckling och säkerställer att du trivs på arbetsplatsen.

Om Lernia

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt nätverk kan vi erbjuda spännande uppdrag hos attraktiva arbetsgivare som hjälper dig utveckla din kompetens och karriär.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka din ansökan redan idag. Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare via e-post bemanning.vaxjo@lernia.se.

title: Undersköterska timanställning till Capio Geriatrik Dalen
description:
Om oss

Välkommen till en av Stockholms största geriatriska kliniker! Vi söker undersköterskor för timanställning. Även sjuksköterskestudenter är varmt välkomna att söka!

Capio Geriatrik Dalen har lång och bred erfarenhet av att bedriva geriatrisk vård. Vi är specialiserad på geriatrisk utredning, behandling och omvårdnad. Vanliga diagnoser är bl.a. infektioner, hjärt- och kärlsjukdomar, njursvikt, KOL och diabetes. Målet under vårdtiden är en god personcentrerad vård med hör patientsäkerhet, där alla känner sig välkomna och respekterade. Den geriatriska patienten är komplex och därför behövs ett multiprofessionellt team, bestående av flera olika professioner, för en säker och välfungerande vård.

Vi erbjuder geriatrisk slutenvård med direktintag dygnet runt, året om. Patienterna kommer via slutenvården, akutmottagning, ambulans, närakut, äldreboende och vårdcentral. Vi har även en specialistmottagning för utredning av kognitiv svikt. På sjukhusområdet finns även tillgång till röntgen och närlaboratorium.

Din roll

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara basal omvårdnad, venprovtagning, EKG, bladder-scan, katetersättning, NEWS, sårvård samt vissa teamuppgifter. Undersköterskan har en självklar del i medicinska ronder och temakonferenser. Vi arbetar personcentrerat och alla viktiga beslut gällande patientens omvårdnad och behandling fattas gemensamt i team.

Vi erbjuder dig

  • Närvarande chefer

  • Individanpassad inskolning

  • En trygg anställning genom kollektivavtal och försäkringar

    Anställningsform Vistidsanställning/timanställning

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska och som har minst 1 års erfarenhet av arbete på vårdavdelning. Meriterande är om du har något eller några års erfarenhet av kliniskt arbete inom geriatrik eller internmedicin. Du har goda kunskaper i svenska språket och vi ser gärna att du även besitter andra språkkunskaper.

Du är prestigelös och bemöter människor med respekt. Du arbetar personcentrerat och är intresserad av att utveckla dig själv, dina kollegor samt verksamheten. Du förenar självständigt arbete med en mycket god förmåga att samarbeta och prioritera och du har en god kommunikativ förmåga. Självklart tycker du att det är viktigt att arbeta med och utveckla patientsäkerhet och arbetsmiljö. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Det är krav på personliga egenskaper såsom:

  • Initiativtagande & drivkraft

  • Flexibilitet & anpassningsförmåga

  • Samarbetsförmåga & laganda

  • Engagemang & uthållighet

  • Struktur & ansvarskänsla

  • God Kommunikationsförmåga

Ansökan

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Annonsen kan därför tas bort tidigare än planerat, så vänta inte - skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Publicerat: 2026-10-15

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-31

title: Engineering Designer- Water & Wastewater
description:
ENGINEERING DESIGNER

Why This Role Matters

As an Engineering Designer I, you will be a key member of our civil engineering team, helping plan and design municipal water, wastewater, drainage, utility, and public infrastructure projects throughout the region.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career designer seeking hands-on experience and the opportunity to see projects progress from field investigation through design and construction. You will work closely with experienced engineers, project managers, and technical professionals who will support your growth and encourage you to contribute your ideas.Your work will include collecting and interpreting field data and assisting with the layout and design of water mains, sanitary sewers, storm drainage systems, and related municipal utilities. You will help turn existing field conditions and project requirements into accurate, practical, and constructible designs.

Working under the guidance of a licensed Professional Engineer or Project Manager, you will contribute to projects of varying size and complexity. As your experience grows, you will have opportunities to take on greater design responsibility and advance within the firm.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to municipal water, wastewater, drainage, utility, and public infrastructure projects
  • Perform field investigations and collect information about existing utilities, structures, and site conditions
  • Document and verify field measurements, observations, photographs, and other project information
  • Interpret survey information, record drawings, utility data, and technical documents
  • Assist with the layout and design of water mains, sanitary sewers, storm sewers, and related utilities
  • Use AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and other software to prepare engineering plans, profiles, details, drawings, and models
  • Review work for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with project standards
  • Assist with engineering calculations, quantity estimates, reports, permits, and technical documentation
  • Research applicable municipal and regulatory requirements, codes, and design standards
  • Coordinate with engineers, surveyors, architects, and other project team members
  • Help identify utility conflicts, missing information, and constructability concerns
  • Participate in site visits and observe construction activities
  • Maintain organized project files and complete assignments within established schedules and budgets

What You Bring

  • An Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Technology, or a related field—or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 0 to 2 years of civil engineering or design experience, including internships or co-op experience
  • An interest in municipal water, wastewater, utility, and public infrastructure projects
  • A hardworking, focused, and dependable approach to completing assignments
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work
  • The ability to collect, organize, interpret, and evaluate field and technical data
  • The ability to perform basic to moderately complex engineering calculations
  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Civil 3D, MicroStation, OpenRoads, Revit, or similar design software
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • An understanding of construction drawings and specifications is a plus
  • EIT or NICET certification is a plus but is not required

Why You'll Enjoy Working Here

  • Be part of a collaborative team where innovation, quality, and client service are valued.


What We Offer:

Benefits for Regular Full-Time & Part-Time Employees Working 30+ Hours/Week

  • Healthcare for you and your family: Medical, Dental & Vision insurance
    • Single HDHP Medical plan with 100% paid premium
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match
  • Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • FREE Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance for you and your family
  • FREE Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • PTO + Sick Time + 8 Holidays per year
  • Retirement Savings Plan with contribution from CPL to grow your retirement funds
  • Internal Mobility & Career Advancement
  • Licensure Assistance

Additional benefits available to FT Employees Working 40+ Hours/Week

  • Tuition Assistance: You may be eligible for continuing education assistance
  • Student Loan Assistance Program: CPL will contribute up to $100/month for 5 years ($6,000 total) toward student loan debt

What Does It Look Like Working Here?

We believe that building a strong community is about establishing a prevailing sense of fellowship among our team members, friends, and neighbors.

  • Collaboration – working with others towards the best solution, placing great emphasis on the collective wisdom of our internal teams.
  • Family – celebrating others’ successes, genuinely caring about the happiness and well-being of our team members and recognizing their own families as extensions of the CPL family.
  • Fun – not taking oneself too seriously, fully understanding that fun at work is conducive to productivity.
  • Inspiration – contributing to an uplifting workplace that facilitates growth a positive, upbeat attitude.
  • Integrity – doing what is ethically right and providing reliable follow-through on commitments.
  • Ingenuity – seeking new opportunities and consistently identifying unexpected and practical ways to solve problems.

The rate for this position generally ranges between $31.00-39.00 hourly. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the New York Pay Transparency Law. It is based on what a successful New York applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in New York or perform the position from New York. Similar positions located outside of New York will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by New York Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employees already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. A potential new employee's pay history will not be used in compensation decisions.

CPL is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such affirms the right of every person to participate in all aspects of employment without regard to gender, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, disability, citizenship, military or veteran status, gender expression and/or identity, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

CPL does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiting professionals or agencies, nor do we accept resumes from any source that does not reference a specific, open position. CPL will not be responsible for any fees arising from the use of resumes submitted by recruiting professionals or agencies that do not have a current placement fee agreement with CPL. All initial communication with recruiting professionals or agencies must go through our Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Medewerker Service Desk & Veiligheidsoplossingen
description:
Jij kiest voor veiligheid én service

Als Medewerker Service Desk & Veiligheidsoplossingen ben je een belangrijke schakel in het waarborgen van de digitale veiligheid binnen de Vlaamse Overheid. Je ondersteunt medewerkers en externe partners bij vragen rond toegangsbeheer, digitale loketten en toepassingen.

Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers en zorgt ervoor dat vragen, meldingen en incidenten correct, efficiënt en klantgericht worden behandeld. Dankzij jouw communicatieve vaardigheden, technische interesse en oplossingsgerichte aanpak draag je dagelijks bij aan een veilige en vlotte dienstverlening.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
  • Behandelen van binnenkomende vragen en meldingen via telefoon, e-mail en ticketingsystemen.
  • Registreren, analyseren en opvolgen van incidenten en serviceaanvragen volgens vastgelegde procedures.
  • Escaleren van complexe dossiers naar de tweede of derde lijn of gespecialiseerde teams wanneer nodig.
  • Proactief opvolgen van dossiers en zorgen voor een correcte en tijdige afhandeling.
  • Kennis delen met het contactcenter door scripts aan te maken of te actualiseren in de redactieomgeving.
  • Interne procedures opstellen, actualiseren en documenteren in Confluence.
  • Initiatief nemen om briefings en opleidingen te organiseren voor collega's.
  • Werken in een hybride omgeving vanuit Diegem, Brussel en thuis.
  • Je bent communicatief sterk en hebt oog voor detail, zowel in de contacten met klanten als met collega's.
  • Je staat open voor feedback en draagt actief bij aan een positieve teamsfeer.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met IT en digitale toepassingen en begrijpt de basisprincipes van informatiebeveiliging.
  • Je bent analytisch ingesteld en vindt graag oplossingen voor complexe vragen.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, georganiseerd en blijft rustig onder druk.

title: Hotwire PR Account Director
description:
As a key member of Hotwire’s B2B Tech team, you will manage a portfolio of clients, delivering strategic, integrated marketing and communications campaigns that drive client success and account growth.

Combining strong commercial acumen with exceptional client relationship and project management skills, you will identify new opportunities, provide strategic counsel and deliver impactful campaigns across media relations, social media, events and owned content.

You will also play an important role in mentoring junior team members, contributing to new business opportunities and working closely with senior leadership to drive client satisfaction, team development and agency growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive account growth and commercial success: Identify opportunities to grow existing client accounts, develop new business opportunities and contribute to the wider growth strategy of Hotwire Marketing Services.
  • Provide strategic client counsel: Develop a strong understanding of clients’ business objectives, challenges and priorities, translating these into strategic recommendations and integrated campaigns that deliver measurable results.
  • Identify new opportunities: Proactively challenge existing plans, bring forward innovative campaign ideas and identify opportunities to expand client relationships through Hotwire’s broader range of marketing services.
  • Manage a diverse client portfolio: Oversee a portfolio of approximately 6–8 clients, managing account budgets, resource allocation, team hours and project profitability.
  • Build trusted client relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, providing confident strategic advice and consistently delivering high-quality work that exceeds client expectations.
  • Deliver integrated campaigns: Lead the planning and execution of integrated communications campaigns across media relations, social media, events and owned content, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
  • Leverage media and influencer networks: Build and maintain strong relationships with media and influencers, identifying opportunities to strengthen client visibility and deliver impactful campaigns.
  • Lead projects and campaign delivery: Oversee multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard, while acting as a key quality checkpoint for the team.
  • Lead and develop team members: Manage and mentor junior team members within the B2B Tech team, supporting their professional development, building capability and creating opportunities for growth.
  • Support senior leadership: Partner closely with the Associate Director or Director to deliver account objectives, contribute to team strategy and support the successful running of the business.
  • Champion collaboration and teamwork: Work collaboratively across local and global teams, share knowledge and commercial insights, and actively contribute to new business pitches and wider agency initiatives.
  • Maintain a proactive, curious mindset: Continuously explore clients’ evolving needs, ask insightful questions to uncover business challenges and opportunities, and stay ahead of industry trends to deliver forward-thinking solutions.
  • B2B PR experience ideally from an agency
  • A strong, proven track record in B2B Comms – you should however have a true passion for emerging technology and the space as a whole
  • Experience working with global brands; understanding the need for localisation
  • Excellent team leadership ability with true desire to motivate and develop a team
  • Strategic and innovative thinking, both for clients and the agency
  • Superb client relationship skills
  • Experience of managing team hours – spotting over servicing and any issues which may arise from holidays etc.
  • A solid network of influencer contacts spanning media, social media and wider stakeholders (e.g. analysts, think tanks, academics etc.)
  • An entrepreneurial outlook, with a strong track record of new business experience
  • An ability to multi-task and keep your cool under pressure

Why Us:

  • Flexibility – We understand that life doesn’t always fit around the 9-5; and that work/life integration is crucial. We currently require people in our London office 2-3 days week, but fully support a ‘thoughtful working’ policy
  • Global Reach & Opportunity – You will have the opportunity to work within global teams, connecting with clients and colleagues locally and globally.
  • Great Benefits – Strong benefits package includes 25 days holiday, enhanced family leave, up to 10% pension contributions, private health insurance, life insurance, income protection scheme for long-term sickness, a paid 6-week sabbatical after every 4 years of continuous service, and paid time off for community involvement. Hotwire offers a variety of bonus opportunities to include business development, annual company bonuses and referral bonuses.
  • Development Opportunities – A strong learning and development program with training opportunities at all levels.
  • Autonomy – The freedom and support to be limitless, and the opportunity to own your career and create the future you want.
  • Variety – No day is the same as the last. Both within our own walls, and with our clients, we navigate change daily and there’s always an opportunity to stretch your skills, learn something new, seek out a new challenge, and gain expertise.
  • Our Amazing Team – We are connected, ambitious, and friendly. We don’t step on toes to get ahead, we build each other up, develop and teach each other and understand that each person’s individual success is a win for all.

We engage in Thoughtful Working, empowering our talent to determine the best way to work for our clients, our team and Hotwire every single day.

title: Tech Programmer - Building Automation Systems (BAS)
description:
Tech Programmer - Building Automation Systems (BAS)

Conti LLC
Location: Southeast Michigan / Northern Ohio (Field-Based)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Conti LLC

Conti LLC is a leading provider of building automation, controls, and energy solutions throughout the Midwest. Our Building Automation team delivers controls installation, programming, commissioning, and startup services for commercial and industrial facilities across Southeast Michigan and Northern Ohio.

Unlike many competitors where a single technician is responsible for selling, engineering, programming, and commissioning systems, Conti provides dedicated project managers, engineers, electricians, and support teams so our Tech Programmers can focus on what they do best: bringing systems to life and ensuring successful project execution.

We invest heavily in our people and provide long-term career growth opportunities for individuals looking to build a career in building automation and controls.

Position Summary

Conti LLC is seeking a motivated and technically minded Tech Programmer to support commercial Building Automation System (BAS) projects throughout Southeast Michigan and Northern Ohio.

This role is ideal for candidates with approximately 2-3 years of experience in building automation, controls, commissioning, or HVAC controls, although strong entry-level candidates and experienced senior technicians will also be considered.

The successful candidate will work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Electricians, and Customers to commission, program, troubleshoot, and startup building automation systems. This position requires a self-starter who can work independently in the field, remain organized, communicate effectively, and solve problems in fast-paced construction environments.

Key Responsibilities

Building Automation Programming & Commissioning

  • Program, startup, commission, and troubleshoot Building Automation Systems.
  • Configure and integrate HVAC controls, field devices, controllers, and BAS equipment.
  • Download, adjust, and verify control programs provided by engineering teams.
  • Validate system functionality and ensure performance meets project requirements.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, sequences of operation, and control schematics.

Field Project Execution

  • Travel to project sites throughout Southeast Michigan and Northern Ohio.
  • Meet with Conti Project Managers, Engineers, Electricians, General Contractors, and subcontractors.
  • Assess site readiness and coordinate startup activities.
  • Execute commissioning and startup activities according to project schedules.
  • Ensure work is completed safely, accurately, and efficiently.

Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Diagnose and resolve system issues during installation and startup.
  • Work with engineering teams to identify solutions and implement corrections.
  • Remain calm and focused when challenges arise in the field.
  • Provide clear documentation of issues, corrective actions, and system status.

Documentation & Communication

  • Maintain accurate commissioning reports and project documentation.
  • Communicate progress updates with Project Managers and internal teams.
  • Document system changes, startup activities, and field observations.
  • Coordinate with contractors and customers to support project milestones.

Typical Day

  • Review project schedule and weekly goals provided by the Project Manager.
  • Travel to project sites.
  • Meet with the appropriate Conti team members and review daily objectives.
  • Assess installed equipment and system readiness.
  • Configure equipment and perform programming or commissioning activities.
  • Validate system operation and troubleshoot deficiencies.
  • Document completed work and communicate progress to Project Managers.
  • Coordinate with electricians, contractors, customers, and other stakeholders throughout the day.

Types of Projects

  • Commercial Office Buildings
  • Healthcare Facilities
  • Industrial Facilities
  • Educational Institutions
  • Municipal Buildings
  • Large Commercial HVAC Control Systems
  • Building Automation and Energy Management Systems

Requirements

  • 2-3 years of Building Automation, Controls, HVAC Controls, Commissioning, or related experience preferred
  • Ability to interpret control drawings and technical documentation
  • Strong communication and customer interaction skills
  • Mechanical and electrical troubleshooting aptitude
  • Valid driver's license
  • Reliable personal vehicle for travel to project sites
  • Ability to travel throughout Southeast Michigan and Northern Ohio

Preferred Qualifications

Bonus Skills

  • Honeywell Controls experience
  • Niagara 4 experience
  • Niagara AX experience
  • Distech Controls experience
  • CAD programming experience
  • Python programming experience
  • C/C++ programming experience
  • Previous BAS startup and commissioning experience

Technologies & Platforms

Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:

  • Niagara 4
  • Niagara AX
  • Honeywell Building Automation Systems
  • Distech Controls
  • HVAC Control Systems
  • BAS Programming Platforms
  • Field Controllers
  • Building Management Systems (BMS)

What Makes Someone Successful at Conti?

Our strongest employees:

  • Take ownership of projects
  • Show initiative without being micromanaged
  • Stay organized under pressure
  • Communicate effectively with project teams and customers
  • Focus on finding solutions instead of dwelling on problems
  • Thrive in fast-paced construction environments
  • Desire long-term career growth within the organization

Work Environment

  • Approximately 95% field-based role
  • Projects located throughout Southeast Michigan and Northern Ohio
  • Flexible schedule based on project needs
  • Typical site arrival by 8:30 AM, though earlier start times may be required
  • Fast-paced, team-oriented atmosphere
  • Supported by dedicated Engineers, Project Managers, and Electricians

Additional Benefits Include:

  • Gas Card
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package
  • Long-Term Career Growth Opportunities
  • Professional Development and Training
  • Exposure to Large Commercial Automation Projects

Join Conti LLC

If you're looking to build a long-term career in Building Automation and want to work with a team that provides the tools, support, and resources necessary for success, we'd like to hear from you. Conti LLC offers a collaborative environment where motivated individuals can continue growing their technical and professional skills while working on some of the region's most exciting commercial automation projects.

title: Employment Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about supporting people with disadvantages to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant at our Campbelltown, NSW site within our Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Who Are We:

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

Who You Are:

A champion of diversity and inclusion – you believe that everyone, no matter their abilities, deserves a chance to succeed

A natural connector – you know how to create opportunities for participants and speak to stakeholders with confidence

Innovative and solutions focused – You see the challenge as an opportunity and have experience creating pathways to success

You may also have experience in another industries or roles like sales, retail, call centre, hospitality, consulting, business development, and administration. These skills can set you up for success in this role!

What You’ll Be Doing:

Find the perfect match – you’ll support participants with disability to prepare for, find and maintain sustainable employment.

Boost Confidence – You will help participants see their strengths, overcome obstacles, and take on their new employment with a renewed sense of purpose

Shake Things Up – You will provide creative solutions to overcome employment challenges, making sure every participant has the tools and support for success

Advocating – You will be an advocate for inclusive hiring practices and workplace adjustments

Celebrate the Moments That Matter – Every successful placement is a success, and we are all about celebrating success, big and small with our participants

Building lasting connections – You will form partnerships with companies that are passionate about diversity and inclusion, making sure everyone has a chance to shine!

Why You’ll Love It at Campbelltown...

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

  • Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success

  • Ongoing training and career development – we are committed to your growth

  • Supportive and inclusive team environment where your contributions make a difference every day

At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures including indigenous peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people with disability.

Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! Let’s work together to break down barriers, shatter expectations and build a more inclusive world- one individual at a time.

title: Rektor till anpassad grundskola
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa förutsättningar för att alla elever ska lyckas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar?

Utbildningskontoret arbetar för att ge alla barn och elever en utbildning av hög kvalitet. Nu söker vi en rektor till den anpassade grundskolan i Strängnäs kommun.

Den anpassade grundskolan erbjuder en trygg, tillgänglig och utvecklande lärmiljö där elevens lärande, delaktighet och självständighet står i fokus. Verksamheten präglas av hög kompetens, stort engagemang och nära samverkan mellan olika professioner.

Som rektor leder du verksamheten tillsammans med två biträdande rektorer. Totalt arbetar ca 75 personer (pedagoger, elevassistenter, specialpedagog, kurator och administrativ personal) och närmare 80 elever är inskrivna på skolan. Tillsammans skapar ni förutsättningar för medarbetare att lyckas i sitt uppdrag och för elever att utvecklas så långt som möjligt utifrån sina förutsättningar.

Anpassad grundskola är en skolform som har ett ökande elevantal. Verksamheten har varit och är inne i en expansiv fas, som bland annat innefattar ett arbete med att finna långsiktigt och hållbara lösningar för lokaler.

Du ingår i utbildningskontorets ledningsorganisation och bidrar aktivt till utvecklingen av hela kommunens utbildningsverksamhet.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som rektor ansvarar du för verksamhet, personal, arbetsmiljö, ekonomi och kvalitet inom den anpassade grundskolan.

Du leder verksamheten genom ett tillitsbaserat ledarskap där samarbete, delaktighet och gemensamt ansvarstagande är viktiga framgångsfaktorer. Du skapar förutsättningar för lärande och utveckling genom att ta vara på medarbetares kompetens och bygga starka relationer både inom och utanför den egna verksamheten.

I uppdraget ingår bland annat att:

	• leda och utveckla verksamheten utifrån skollag, läroplan och kommunens mål
	• ansvara för det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet med fokus på elevernas lärande, utveckling och välmående och en tillgänglig utbildning utifrån elevernas individuella förutsättningar
	• skapa goda förutsättningar för ett främjande, förebyggande och tillgängligt elevhälsoarbete
	• leda och utveckla medarbetare mot gemensamma mål
	• säkerställa en god arbetsmiljö och en hållbar ekonomi
	• samverka med vårdnadshavare, myndigheter och andra aktörer kring elevernas bästa
	• bidra till utveckling och samverkan inom hela utbildningskontoret.

Vi söker dig som ser värdet av att bygga broar mellan människor, professioner och verksamheter och som vill bidra till att utveckla framtidens utbildning i Strängnäs kommun.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har:

	• relevant pedagogisk högskoleutbildning med lärarlegitimation.
	• flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta som rektor med ansvar för personal-, ekonomi- och arbetsmiljöfrågor. Det är särskilt meriterande om din erfarenhet kommer från kommunal skolverksamhet.
	• avslutad statlig rektorsutbildning 
	• god kunskap om grundskolans uppdrag, styrdokument och systematiskt kvalitetsarbete.
	• god digital kompetens och van att använda IT som ett stöd i ditt arbete.
	• god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i både tal och skrift.
	• B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du är/har:

	• erfarenhet av att leda elevhälsoarbete i tvärprofessionellt team.
	• erfarenhet av att samverka med andra myndigheter i komplexa elevärenden.
	• erfarenhet av arbete med elever som har stort stödbehov, särskilt meriterande om din erfarenhet kommer från anpassad skolform. 
	• specialpedagogisk kompetens.
	• erfarenhet av förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete.

Som ledare är du trygg, tydlig och kvalitetsmedveten. Du arbetar utifrån ett helhetsperspektiv och skapar engagemang, delaktighet och tillit genom att ta vara på medarbetarnas kompetens och erfarenheter. Du har mod att fatta beslut när det behövs och förmåga att skapa samsyn när olika perspektiv möts. Med ett lyhört och kommunikativt ledarskap bygger du förtroendefulla relationer, stärker samverkan och får människor att växa, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Du är flexibel och lösningsorienterad och har förmåga att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar samtidigt som du behåller fokus på verksamhetens mål och elevernas bästa.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Välkommen in med din ansökan redan idag!

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Välkommen till Strängnäs kommun! Strängnäs kommun har drygt 39 000 invånare och är strategiskt belägen i Mälardalen med utmärkta kommunikationsmöjligheter. Här är det nära till storstaden Stockholm som nås med tåg på under 50 minuter, och ännu närmare ligger Eskilstuna. Vår kommun är en attraktiv plats för både boende och arbete, där du får möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad för samhället och dess invånare.

Hos oss finns en mängd meningsfulla och utmanande arbetsuppgifter, med möjligheter att växa och utvecklas i din yrkesroll. I Strängnäs kommun arbetar över 2 500 kunniga och engagerade medarbetare, som alla bidrar till att skapa en positiv vardag för invånarna. Vi värdesätter en arbetsplats där alla känner sig inkluderade och där det finns utrymme att påverka. 

För arbete med barn/ungdomar skall utdrag ur belastningsregister visas innan anställning. Detta gäller, from 15 juli 2026, även för alla tjänster hos Vuxenutbildningen. 

Även arbete i hemmet åt äldre personer eller vuxna med funktionsnedsättning omfattas av registerkontroll. För dessa tjänster innebär det att slutkandidater, för att vara aktuella för anställning i Strängnäs kommun, måste visa upp utdrag ur både belastningsregistret och misstankeregistret innan anställning kan erbjudas.

Strängnäs kommun tillämpar rökfri arbetstid för att skapa en hälsosam arbetsmiljö för alla medarbetare, kollegor och brukare. 

Ansökningsprocess och personuppgiftshantering:

	• Som sökande ansvarar du för att dokumentera din kompetens tydligt, så att vi kan göra en saklig och rättvis bedömning av din ansökan.
	• Strängnäs kommun hanterar dina personuppgifter i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning. Du kan läsa mer om vår personuppgiftshantering på vår hemsida: https://www.strangnas.se/kommun-och-politik/overklaga-beslut-rattssakerhet/personuppgifter-i-strangnas-kommun

Strängnäs kommun har valt mediekanaler för denna rekrytering och undanber därför kontakt med annonssäljare och rekryteringstjänster.

Vi ser fram emot att få veta mer om dig och hur du vill bidra till Strängnäs framtid.

title: Kundenberater gesucht für Großbank – Deutsch/Schwedisch
description:
Har du erfarenhet av kundservice och ett genuint intresse för bank och finans? Är du serviceinriktad, lösningsorienterad och talar flytande svenska och tyska? Då får du här möjlighet att utvecklas i en kvalificerad kundnära roll hos en av Nordens största banker.

Om tjänsten

Perido söker nu en Customer Service Advisor som är flytande i svenska och tyska till vår kund, en av Nordens största banker med verksamhet över hela Norden och tjänster för såväl privatpersoner som företag. Tjänsten är placerad på bankens kontor strax norr om Stockholm.

I rollen som Customer Service Advisor blir du bankens ansikte utåt mot kunderna. Du ingår i ett engagerat team där ni tillsammans stöttar användare via telefon och e-post. Du hjälper kunderna att navigera i bankens digitala verktyg och besvarar frågor kring fakturor, transaktioner, reklamationer, krediter och räntor. Målet är alltid att leverera högsta möjliga kvalitet och säkerställa en mycket tillfredsställande kundkontakt.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

  • Ge förstklassig support och rådgivning via telefon och mejl - på svenska och tyska
  • Hantera och besvara frågor rörande fakturor, transaktioner, reklamationer, krediter och räntor
  • Vägleda och hjälpa kunder i bankens digitala tjänster (hemsida och app)
  • Arbeta aktivt för att säkerställa hög kvalitet och bästa möjliga kundupplevelse

Dina egenskaper

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för bank, finans och kundservice och som motiveras av att utvecklas inom branschen. Du har ett professionellt och förtroendeingivande bemötande och känner dig trygg i kontakten med kunder. Du är serviceinriktad ut i fingerspetsarna, med ett professionellt och kundfokuserat förhållningssätt. Du är snabblärd, har god systemvana och tar dig an nya arbetssätt och system med lätthet. Som person är du noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och trivs i en föränderlig miljö. Du är en prestigelös lagspelare med en positiv inställning som gärna bidrar till teamets gemensamma mål och framgång.

Låter detta som en spännande tjänst?

Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan, varmt välkommen med den redan idag!

Kvalifikationer:

  • Erfarenhet av service, exempelvis från kundtjänst eller annat serviceyrke med mycket kundkontakt
  • Bekväm med telefon och mejl som främsta arbetsverktyg
  • Ett uttalat intresse för bank, finans eller kortverksamhet
  • Flytande kunskaper i svenska och tyska (i både tal och skrift)
  • Goda kunskaper i engelska

Meriterande:

  • Erfarenhet från bank, finans eller reglerad verksamhet
  • Erfarenhet av att hantera komplexa ärenden kopplat till kreditkort och lån

Omfattning och tillträde

Heltid, konsultuppdrag i 6 månader, initialt genom Perido. Därefter möjlighet till förlängning alt. överrekrytering till banken med ambitionen att uppdraget går över i en tillsvidareanställning. Start enligt överenskommelse.

Vi hjälper dig till nästa steg i yrkeslivet

Vår vision är att alla ska trivas och vara engagerade på jobbet. Hos oss finns en stor variation av uppdrag, där du kan bli anställd direkt hos ett företag eller arbeta som konsult via Perido. Vi är ett av Sveriges största konsultföretag för tjänstemän, vilket ger dig många möjligheter. Som konsult blir du en viktig del av vår organisation och bidrar med din kompetens ute hos våra kunder. Läs mer om oss på Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

De flesta frågor eller funderingar kan du hitta svar på under perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. Om du fortfarande inte hittat svaret du söker är du välkommen att kontakta oss på fraga@perido.se. Ange alltid tjänstens referensnummer 36015 i ämnesraden. Vänligen notera att vi endast tar emot ansökningar på vår hemsida och att vi inte har möjlighet att svara på hur du ligger till i processen eller vilket kundföretaget är om det utelämnats ur annonsen.

title: Industrial Engineering Co-op
description:
Mission

As our Mechanical Engineering Co-op Student – Industrial, you will support mechanical and piping engineering activities on a variety of industrial projects. You will work closely with experienced engineers and designers and gain practical experience in the preparation of engineering calculations, technical documents, drawings, and project deliverables for multidisciplinary projects.

The position will provide exposure to industrial facilities and systems in sectors such as mining, oil & gas, utilities, water treatment, and power generation.

Main Responsibilities

  • Assist with mechanical and piping design activities for industrial projects.
  • Assist with the preparation and review of mechanical drawings, piping layouts, equipment arrangements, and other engineering deliverables.
  • Assist with the preparation of equipment datasheets, technical specifications, material take-offs, and vendor document reviews.
  • Perform basic engineering calculations and technical research under the supervision of experienced engineers.
  • Assist with equipment and piping selection and preparation of technical comparisons.
  • Support coordination with other engineering disciplines, clients, vendors, and contractors.
  • Participate in site visits, field reviews, and collection of existing-condition information, as required.
  • Assist with maintaining project documentation, technical comment logs, and engineering records.
  • Support the development and improvement of engineering calculation tools, templates, and workflows.

Profile

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, with at least three years of the program completed.
  • Previous mechanical engineering internship or co-op experience is considered an asset.
  • Exposure to industrial projects, including mining, oil & gas, utilities, water/wastewater, or power generation, is considered an asset.
  • Completion of coursework in fluid mechanics and thermodynamics.
  • Completion of coursework covering pump and compressor fundamentals, including basic principles of operation, performance, and selection.
  • Familiarity with mechanical equipment and piping systems, including pumps, compressors, valves, and heat exchangers, is considered an asset.
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD, Plant 3D, SolidWorks, Caesar II, or similar engineering/design software is considered an asset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • A desire to learn and continually develop.
  • Strong personal commitment to health and safety.
  • Valid driver’s licence.

The salary for this position ranges from $24.63 to $30.05 per hour, depending on your academic profile, the number of credits earned, and your previous co-op or internship experience. The final offer and salary may be adjusted based on your unique profile."

Please note that our co-op, internship and student job opportunities are offered to individuals that are presently enrolled in a program at an educational institution. To be admissible for an internship, your work experience must meet the requirements from your study program and must be recognized by your educational institution. If you have completed your studies or will graduate by the start date, we invite you to consult our employment opportunities on our career page.

title: Drupal Developer (SSE)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Drupal Developer with strong expertise in Drupal 9/10/11, PHP, custom module development, and enterprise-level Drupal 7 migration. The candidate will be responsible for data migration, backend architecture, workflow development, and building scalable, maintainable Drupal applications.

Responsibilities
  • Develop, customize, and maintain Drupal-based websites, including custom modules, themes, and reusable components.
  • Execute Drupal 7 to Drupal 9/10/11 migrations using custom Migrate API source, process, and destination plugins.
  • Handle complex data mapping, entity references, content consolidation, and data validation during migrations.
  • Develop custom Drupal modules using PHP 8.x, object-oriented programming (OOP), and Symfony design patterns.
  • Build and maintain content models using Paragraphs, Media, Taxonomy, Content Moderation, Views, and Search API.
  • Develop responsive front-end interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Twig templates.
  • Integrate third-party systems and external services using REST APIs and other web services.
  • Develop configurable workflows and dynamic form-authoring interfaces within Drupal.
  • Optimize application performance, security, scalability, and reliability.
  • Follow WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, SEO best practices, and GDPR requirements.
  • Manage Drupal configuration and deployments using Configuration Management (CMI), Composer, Drush, and Git.
  • Proactively troubleshoot and resolve bugs, migration issues, and other technical challenges.
  • Participate in Agile sprints, code reviews, testing, and collaborative problem-solving.

title: Enhetschef till Gata/Park
description:
Gata- och parkchef till Melleruds kommun

Vill du leda verksamheten som får Mellerud att fungera, varje dag?

När snön faller ska vägarna fungera. När våren kommer ska parker och grönytor vakna till liv. Gator och offentliga miljöer ska vara trygga, välskötta och tillgängliga året runt.

Nu söker Melleruds kommun en engagerad och handlingskraftig gata- och parkchef som vill leda och utveckla arbetet med några av kommunens mest synliga verksamheter. Hos oss får du ett jobb där resultatet av det du och dina medarbetare gör märks. Varje dag.

Melleruds kommun strävar efter att erbjuda en attraktiv arbetsplats genom att värna om en god arbetsmiljö med hög delaktighet. Vår organisation bygger på öppenhet, ärlighet och integritet. För oss är trygg välfärd för alla generationer och omtanke för varandra två viktiga grundpelare.

Vi är den lilla kommunen med de stora möjligheterna, våra verksamheter karaktäriseras av korta beslutsvägar där du som medarbetare verkligen kan göra skillnad med ditt engagemang.

Om verksamheten

Som gata- och parkchef leder du Gata- och parkenhetens verksamhet och har en central roll inom Samhällsbyggnadsförvaltningen. Enheten arbetar bland annat med frågor som rör gator, parker och allmänna platser, trafikfrågor, kommunens verkstad samt kommunens snöröjning.

Det här är en tjänst för dig som tycker om kombinationen människor, ledarskap, teknik, ekonomi och praktisk problemlösning.

Du behöver kunna växla mellan långsiktig planering och det som händer här och nu. Ena dagen arbetar du med utveckling och investeringar, nästa dag behöver verksamheten hantera ett snöoväder eller någon annan situation som kräver snabba prioriteringar.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som gata- och parkchef kommer du bland annat att:

  • leda, stötta och utveckla medarbetarna inom verksamheten
  • planera och följa upp drift och underhåll av gator, parker, verkstad och grönytor
  • utveckla det förebyggande och långsiktiga underhållsarbetet
  • ansvara för verksamhet, ekonomi och arbetsmiljö inom ditt område
  • arbeta med trafiksäkerhet och frågor som rör allmän plats
  • planera och följa upp vinterväghållning
  • bidra till trygga, tillgängliga och attraktiva offentliga miljöer
  • arbeta med upphandlingar, entreprenörer och leverantörer
  • driva utveckling mot smartare, effektivare och mer hållbara arbetssätt
  • samverka med andra kommunala verksamheter, myndigheter, företag och kommuninvånare
  • Delaktig i Samhällsbyggnadsförvaltningens ledningsgrupp och bidrar till samarbete inom förvaltningen

Du kommer tillsammans med VA-enheten ansvara för projekt inom gatu- och ledningsarbeten. Till din hjälp finns ett team med bl a projektledare, driftledare och verksamhetsutvecklare, men det kommer även ingå att du själv håller i egna projekt.

I vårt interna utvecklingsarbete för rollen finns ett tydligt fokus på långsiktiga underhållsplaner, förebyggande underhåll, kvalitet i parkmiljöerna, hållbarhet, tillgänglighet, ekonomi och uppföljning.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker framför allt en bra ledare.

Du är trygg i ditt ledarskap och kan skapa struktur, engagemang och arbetsglädje. Du vågar fatta beslut, men tror samtidigt på delaktighet och på att medarbetarna som arbetar närmast verksamheten sitter på viktig kunskap.

title: Rehabilitation/Senior Rehabilitation Consultant
description:
Make a Meaningful Difference. Build a Career That Matters.

At APM WorkCare, we believe that when people are supported through life's challenges, they can achieve incredible things. As a Rehabilitation/Senior Rehabilitation Consultant, you'll play an important role by empowering individuals to return to work, regain independence, and create positive, lasting outcomes.

What We Offer

  • Flexibility that genuinely works for you – Manage your own diary, work flexibly with hybrid arrangements, and focus on achieving outcomes rather than clock-watching. Heading interstate for a holiday or extended stay? You can work from any APM office across Australia, giving you the freedom to balance work and life in a way that suits you.

  • Be rewarded for the difference you make – Alongside a competitive salary, you'll have access to quarterly performance incentives, with Consultants able to earn up to an average of $4,800 per quarter ($19,200 annually) in additional payments. Know someone great? Earn referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for eligible hires.

  • Invest in your growth from day one – Your development doesn't stop after onboarding. You'll receive structured clinical mentoring and support, participate in monthly Lunch & Learn sessions with experienced practitioners, gain access to clinical journal resources, and attend external professional development opportunities through our ARPA memberships. Across the broader APM Group, you'll also have access to leadership, wellbeing, and personal development programs, including workshops delivered by renowned speakers such as Hugh van Cuylenburg. Whether your goal is to become a clinical specialist, team leader, or manager, we'll help you get there.

  • Build a career, not just a job – We believe great talent should have room to grow. Take advantage of leadership development programs, acting opportunities, interstate secondments, and relocation options across our national network. You'll also have access to APM's dedicated Mobility Consultant, who can help you explore career opportunities across APM's businesses throughout Australia. Best of all, more than 90% of APM WorkCare leadership positions have been filled internally, so career progression isn't just possible, it's proven.

  • Benefits that support your wellbeing – Enjoy access to Fitness Passport, with potential savings of $500-$1,500+ each year, plus an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), discounted private health insurance, novated leasing, salary packaging options, and hundreds of discounts across retail, travel, dining, and entertainment.

  • More time for the things that matter – Need extra time to travel, spend with family, or simply recharge? You can purchase up to two additional weeks of annual leave through pre-tax salary deductions, giving you greater flexibility to create the work-life balance that works for you.

What You'll Be Doing

In this varied and rewarding role, you will:

  • Conduct assessments, identify rehabilitation goals, and develop tailored rehabilitation and return-to-work plans that support sustainable outcomes.

  • Deliver rehabilitation services including workplace assessments, ergonomic assessments, job task analysis, activities of daily living assessments (OT), vocational support, and development of return-to-work plans.

  • Collaborate with employers, insurers, treating health professionals, and community stakeholders, including participating in case conferences to facilitate recovery and successful return-to-work outcomes.

  • Facilitate workshops and wellbeing programs, build referral relationships, and contribute to positive client outcomes and business growth.

  • Manage a diverse caseload with access to leading clinical transcription technology and innovative rehabilitation services including our award-winning Virtual Reality pain program and psychosocial screening tool APMiQ.

About You

You're someone who enjoys building meaningful relationships, solving problems, and helping people achieve their goals. You'll bring empathy, resilience, and a genuine passion for supporting others to overcome challenges and succeed.

You'll also have:

  • Qualifications in Occupational Therapy with ESSA registration

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine connections with a diverse range of people.

  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

  • Experience in occupational rehabilitation, injury management, workplace health, mental health, employment services, or a related field (highly regarded).

  • Confidence working collaboratively with employers, healthcare professionals, and community partners.

  • A current driver's licence and willingness to travel locally across Adelaide.

  • A valid Working With Children Check (or willingness to obtain one), National Criminal History Check, and full Australian working rights.

New to Occupational Rehabilitation?

We welcome clinicians looking to transition into occupational rehabilitation. Whether you're coming from private practice, hospital, community health, mental health, or another allied health setting, you'll receive structured onboarding, mentoring, and ongoing support to help you build confidence and succeed in your new career.

Why Our Team Loves Working Here

"APM genuinely invests in its people and supports career growth wherever life takes you. The support I received relocating interstate allowed me to continue growing professionally, develop new skills, and build valuable connections while embracing a new lifestyle."

We enjoy:

  • Flexibility and autonomy to manage their own day and achieve genuine work-life balance.

  • Supportive leadership that is approachable, collaborative, and invested in their success.

  • Variety in their work, with exposure to different schemes, industries, and client journeys where no two days are the same.

  • Career growth opportunities, supported by ongoing development and clear progression pathways.

  • Innovative tools and technology that support efficiency and improve client outcomes.

  • A collaborative team culture where people support one another and celebrate success together.

  • Meaningful work that makes a genuine difference in the lives of clients, employers, and communities every day.

What Our Teams Say

About APM WorkCare

APM WorkCare is the founding brand of the APM Group and has been supporting Australians on their recovery, wellbeing, and return-to-work journeys for decades. As part of a global organisation of more than 16,000 employees across 11 countries, we're united by one purpose: enabling better lives. Through meaningful career opportunities, ongoing learning and development, and career mobility across the broader APM Group, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career while making a lasting impact on the people and communities we support.

We Encourage You to Apply

You don't need to tick every box to apply.

If you're passionate about helping people overcome challenges, build confidence, and achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you. We welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, and communities and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

If you're looking for a career with purpose, where you can grow professionally while making a meaningful difference every day, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Internship at the Policy, Advocacy & Press unit
description:
Are you committed to supporting women’s rights and eager to deepen your understanding of how advocacy and policy can drive change, while contributing to Kvinna till Kvinna’s work for women’s rights and lasting peace?

Then an internship with Kvinna till Kvinna’s Communications & Policy Department at our head office in Stockholm during the spring semester 2027 could be for you.

About The Internship

You would be part of the Policy, Advocacy & Press Unit, which develops reports, policies and recommendations based on evidence from our programme countries. We facilitate spaces for internal exchange across the organisation, organise meetings and events with external stakeholders and represent Kvinna till Kvinna in policy processes, meetings and conferences. Our work focuses on women’s participation in peacebuilding and women’s rights in conflict and post-conflict settings.

The internship is intended to make a practical contribution to the work of the organisation through fulfilling identified duties and responsibilities, and to offer a learning opportunity for you as an intern.

The internship is based in Stockholm, and you will be part of a group of other interns, our communications team, as well as our global organisation.

Key tasks may include

  • Different types of research on our thematic areas: feminist peace; gender-based violence and SRHR; political and economic rights; environment and climate, and feminist movement building.

  • Assisting the drafting of position papers and background material for our advocacy work, in English and Swedish.

  • Assisting the fundraising and communication team in different activities.

  • General administrative tasks and logistics, including organisation of events, meetings, workshops, note-taking, etc.

  • Support the drafting of advocacy messages and texts for external communication such as social media, the website and our newsletter.

About You

We believe you have strong research skills, enabling you to support policy and advocacy initiatives with well-structured analysis and materials. Additionally, your strong communication skills in both English and Swedish allow you to draft clear and impactful advocacy messages for diverse audiences. A strong background in or solid knowledge of Swedish politics from a gender equality perspective is meritorious.

Furthermore, you share our values: Courage, Commitment, and Credibility, as a means of embracing diversity, practicing intersectional feminism, and challenging inequities.

Requirements

  • Studies in Political Science, Global Development Studies, Peace and Conflict Studies, International Relations, Human Rights, or the equivalent.

  • University credits in Gender Studies, or knowledge of and interest in Gender Equality and Women’s Rights demonstrated in other ways.

  • Solid analytical skills, writing skills, and research skills.

  • Fluency in English and Swedish.

  • Good knowledge of advocacy stakeholders such as the EU, UN and the Swedish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Terms & Conditions

  • At Kvinna till Kvinna, you will become part of an inspiring workplace with dedicated colleagues working for women’s rights and gender equality around the world, as well as a group of interns based at the office in Stockholm.

  • The internship is intended for you who are looking for an internship as part of your current studies, preferably where you receive reimbursement from CSN, Erasmus+ or other funds, or as part of a labour integration programme supporting internships, for instance through Arbetsförmedlingen.

  • You’ll be able to combine internship tasks with university assignments, if applicable, during regular working hours.

  • The internship is unpaid. You will be covered by Kvinna till Kvinna’s accident insurance during the internship.

  • The internships are normally approximately 20 weeks, starting at the beginning of 2027.

Application

Submit your application via the application button, including a CV in English or Swedish, and your answers to the application questions.

Deadline for application: 28 October.

If you have any questions regarding internships at Kvinna till Kvinna, please reach out to hr@kvinnatillkvinna.se.

title: Circle K Luleå Persön söker butikssäljare heltid
description:
Vart är du på väg?

Nu söker vi butikssäljare – ja, alltså riktiga servicehjältar!

Vi vill bli världsbäst på service. Och därför söker vi nu fler servicehjältar. Vad gör en sådan? Jo, du möter våra kunders behov med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett härligt leende – ofta samtidigt som du kanske fyller på kaffemaskinen eller lägger upp en korv. För vi är en butikskedja som erbjuder allt från god mat och bakverk, till bra drivmedel och fräscha toaletter. Är du vår nästa talang? Då hittar du vänner för livet här på Circle K.

Vi söker nu dig som vill jobba som butikssäljare hos oss på Circle K Persön. Tjänsten är på heltid och är tillsvidare med inledande provanställning på sex månader. Schemat för denna tjänst är rullande på ett tre veckors schema enligt följande: vecka 1. tisdag- fredag 4:45-13, vecka 2 måndag 4:45-13, tisdag 9-15, onsdag 10-17 torsdag och fredag 11-21:15, vecka 3 måndag-onsdag 11-21:15b30 Lörsdag-söndag 7:30-15:45.

Ensamarbete förekommer. För att vara aktuell för tjänsten hos oss behöver du ha körkort och då det är svårt att ta sig till stationen kommunallt behöver du ha tillgång till egen bil.

Som butikssäljare hos oss har du en månadslön som baseras på din tidigare erfarenhet inom service. Månadslönen vid heltidsarbete varierar mellan 27400-33065 kr/månad. Utöver din månadslön får du extra OB-ersättning för arbete under kvällar, helger och röda dagar. Eftersom vi har en CV-lös och fördomsfri rekrytering behöver du styrka din tidigare erfarenhet genom att uppvisa arbetsgivarintyg under rekryteringsprocessen. För att söka tjänsten fyller du enkelt i dina uppgifter, anger vilka tider du kan arbeta och genomför därefter ett kort servicetest som tar cirka 10 minuter. Är du vår nya butikssäljare som gillar varierande arbetsuppgifter och att ge service utöver det vanliga? Vi jobbar med löpande urval i rekryteringen så sök tjänsten omgående för att inte missa chansen!

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan senast 30.10.2026

Om dig:

  • Du är en teamplayer – du sätter laget före jaget.
  • Du är en fixare – du hittar lösningar på allt.
  • Du älskar människor.
  • Du är en allkonstnär: Du gillar att ha koll på allt, och tycker om att göra många saker samtidigt.
  • Du vill lära dig nya saker och utvecklas, kanske är du redo för mer ansvar.
  • Du har förmodligen arbetat inom service och är redo för nästa steg i karriären.
  • Du pratar och förstår svenska.
  • Du är över 18 år.

Om oss:

  • Vi är en plantskola för social skills – vi lägger en bra grund för alla framtida yrken. Och du får ett snyggt CV!
  • För dig som redan kommit en bit i yrkeslivet kan vi erbjuda ett utvecklande och mångsidigt jobb.
  • Du får kunskap om hur det är att driva butik.
  • Du lär dig att bli en ledare med förståelse för service.
  • Du får specialistkunskap – vi kan allt från att driva butik och sälja drivmedel, till marknadsföring och ledarskap.
  • Du får en möjlighet till att göra karriär inom företaget – kanske vill du driva din egen butik, eller sikta mot ett jobb på vårt huvudkontor.
  • Du får ett roligt jobb med härliga kollegor.
  • Vi är ett internationellt företag med kollegor runt omkring i hela världen.
  • Våra stationer kan ha biluthyrning, då är körkort B-manuell ett krav.
  • Vi erbjuder dig ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag och personalrabatt på alla våra stationer.

Circle K är ett framgångsrikt globalt företag med mer än 17 300 butiker i 27 länder. Totalt har vi cirka 150 000 anställda som arbetar i våra butiker och på kontoren. Vårt nätverk består av butiker som drivs både i bolags- och franchisedrift. Vår kultur och våra värderingar: One Team, Take Ownership, Play to Win och Do the Right Thing är grunden i allt vi gör. Vi vill göra det enkelt för våra kunder längs vägen genom att erbjuda bra produkter och snabb service i världsklass.

För den här tjänsten krävs att du antingen är medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, har permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige, eller är asylsökande med giltig rätt att arbeta. Under rekryteringsprocessen behöver du kunna visa upp handlingar som styrker ditt medborgarskap eller din arbetsrätt i Sverige.

Vi förbehåller oss rätten att göra bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidater i rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Architectural Market Sector Principal- Healthcare Practice
description:

You are a relationship builder, market leader, and trusted advisor who is passionate about shaping the future of healthcare environments. In this role, you will drive the growth and success of our Healthcare Practice by cultivating strategic client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and leading pursuits that expand our impact across the market.

You bring a unique blend of business development, leadership, and architectural expertise. As a visible leader in the healthcare community, you will champion client engagement, generate and convert opportunities, and guide multidisciplinary teams in delivering innovative, patient-centered healthcare environments. You'll play a critical role in growing our practice, mentoring future leaders, and strengthening CPL's reputation as a trusted partner for healthcare systems, providers, and organizations.

What You'll Do:

Practice Growth & Business Development

  • Serve as a leader and ambassador for CPL's Healthcare Practice within the marketplace.
  • Build, strengthen, and maintain relationships with healthcare systems, hospitals, physician groups, healthcare administrators, and industry partners.
  • Identify, pursue, and secure new opportunities while expanding existing client partnerships.
  • Lead business development efforts including networking, conferences, industry involvement, strategic pursuits, and proposal development.
  • Maintain a strong client portfolio and contribute to achieving practice revenue, profitability, and annual growth goals.

Client Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, guiding facility planning, project visioning, and strategic decision-making.
  • Lead client presentations, workshops, planning sessions, and stakeholder engagement efforts.
  • Ensure exceptional client experiences through proactive communication and responsive leadership.
  • Promote CPL's value proposition and strengthen our reputation as a premier healthcare design partner.

Project and Operational Leaders

  • Provide executive oversight of multiple projects, ensuring successful delivery of scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
  • Guide project teams in developing effective strategies, work plans, and project solutions.
  • Allocate resources effectively to support project performance and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, billing, and resource planning.
  • Advocate for innovative, sustainable, and forward-thinking healthcare design solutions that improve patient outcomes, staff efficiency, and operational performance.

Strategic Leadership

  • Monitor industry trends, healthcare delivery models, regulatory requirements, market conditions, and emerging technologies to drive practice growth.
  • Develop and leverage performance metrics that support informed business decisions and practice health.
  • Collaborate with Practice Leaders and firm leadership to shape strategy and execute key initiatives.
  • Influence organizational success through effective communication, relationship building, and change leadership.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Architecture and Professional Licensure (RA).
  • 12+ years of experience, including 5+ years leading healthcare projects, teams, and client relationships.
  • Proven success developing healthcare client partnerships, generating new business opportunities, and growing a project pipeline.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare facility planning, design, construction, regulatory requirements, and project delivery.
  • Experience working with healthcare systems, hospitals, ambulatory care facilities, specialty clinics, behavioral health facilities, or other healthcare environments.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and business acumen with the ability to influence, inspire, and drive results.

What We Offer:

Benefits for Regular Full-Time & Part-Time Employees Working 30+ Hours/Week

  • Healthcare for you and your family: Medical, Dental & Vision insurance
    • Single HDHP Medical plan with 100% paid premium
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match
  • Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • FREE Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance for you and your family
  • FREE Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • PTO + Sick Time + 8 Holidays per year
  • Retirement Savings Plan with contribution from CPL to grow your retirement funds
  • Internal Mobility & Career Advancement
  • Licensure Assistance

Additional benefits available to FT Employees Working 40+ Hours/Week

  • Tuition Assistance: You may be eligible for continuing education assistance
  • Student Loan Assistance Program: CPL will contribute up to $100/month for 5 years ($6,000 total) toward student loan debt

What Does It Look Like Working Here?

We believe that building a strong community is about establishing a prevailing sense of fellowship among our team members, friends, and neighbors.

  • Collaboration – working with others towards the best solution, placing great emphasis on the collective wisdom of our internal teams.
  • Family – celebrating others’ successes, genuinely caring about the happiness and well-being of our team members and recognizing their own families as extensions of the CPL family.
  • Fun – not taking oneself too seriously, fully understanding that fun at work is conducive to productivity.
  • Inspiration – contributing to an uplifting workplace that facilitates growth and success by maintaining a positive, upbeat attitude.
  • Integrity – doing what is ethically right and providing reliable follow-through on commitments.
  • Ingenuity – seeking new opportunities and consistently identifying unexpected and practical ways to solve problems.

The rate for this position generally ranges between $150,000 to $185,000. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the New York Pay Transparency Law. It is based on what a successful New York applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in New York or perform the position from New York. Similar positions located outside of New York will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by New York Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employees already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. A potential new employee's pay history will not be used in compensation decisions.

CPL is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such affirms the right of every person to participate in all aspects of employment without regard to gender, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, disability, citizenship, military or veteran status, gender expression and/or identity, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

CPL does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiting professionals or agencies, nor do we accept resumes from any source that does not reference a specific, open position. CPL will not be responsible for any fees arising from the use of resumes submitted by recruiting professionals or agencies that do not have a current placement fee agreement with CPL. All initial communication with recruiting professionals or agencies must go through our Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Physiotherapist
company: The Association of People with Disability
description:
Rehabilitation and Community-Based Rehabilitation

  • Conduct comprehensive physiotherapy assessments for children and adults with disabilities.
  • Develop and implement individualized rehabilitation plans based on functional needs.
  • Provide physiotherapy interventions for neurological, developmental, orthopedic, and musculoskeletal conditions and also address the needs of 21 disabilities.
  • Monitor progress and modify treatment plans based on regular evaluations.
  • Deliver physiotherapy services at Community Rehabilitation Centers (CRCs), schools, Anganwadi Centers, and beneficiaries' homes.
  • Promote functional independence and community participation of persons with disabilities.
  • Support disability inclusion initiatives within the community.

Caregiver and Family Empowerment

  • Train parents and caregivers in home-based therapy, positioning, handling, transfers, mobility, and daily living activities.
  • Develop easy-to-follow home exercise programs.
  • Strengthen caregiver confidence to continue rehabilitation independently.

Early Identification and Early Intervention

  • Screen children aged 0–8 years for developmental delays and disabilities.
  • Provide early intervention services to enhance developmental outcomes.

Assistive Devices and Accessibility

  • Refer and Assess beneficiaries for appropriate assistive devices such as wheelchairs, walkers, standing frames, orthoses, and adaptive equipment along with AAT team.
  • Participate in assessment camps and assistive device distribution programs.
  • Educate beneficiaries and caregivers on the proper use and maintenance of assistive devices.

Coordination and Networking

  • Collaborate with Occupational Therapists, Speech Therapists, Special Educators, Psychologists, Medical Officers, Community Coordinators.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate beneficiary records, assessment reports, therapy notes, and follow-up documentation.
  • Update beneficiary information in the organization's Management Information System (MIS).
  • Submit monthly reports, field visit reports, and program updates on time.

Monitoring and Quality Improvement

  • Participate in case reviews, supervision visits, and multidisciplinary meetings.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and rehabilitation standards.
  • Contribute to monitoring, evaluation, learning, and documentation of program outcomes.


Requirements

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) – Mandatory.
  • Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) – Preferred.
  • Registration with the State Physiotherapy Council (preferred).

Experience

  • 0 to 1 years of experience in physiotherapy or rehabilitation services.
  • Experience working with NGOs, Community-Based Rehabilitation (CBR), Early Intervention, pediatric rehabilitation, or disability programs are desirable.
  • Fresh graduates with a strong interest in community rehabilitation are encouraged to apply.

Essential Skills

· Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills.

· Knowledge of pediatric, neurological, and orthopedic rehabilitation.

· Excellent communication, counseling, and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently in community settings.

· Strong documentation and report-writing skills.

· Computer proficiency (MS Office and MIS).

As per the organization norms

1. PF
2. Medical insurance
3. Gratuity
4. Travel and mobile phone allowance
