title: Ohjaaja (yötyö), Lastensuojeluyksikkö Vaahterakangas
description:
Tule tiimiimme Vaahterakankaan lastensuojeluyksikköön Iisalmeen! Haemme ohjaajaa yöpainotteiseen työhön toteuttamaan kanssamme turvallista ja laadukasta lastensuojelutyötä!


Humanan lastensuojelupalveluille yhteinen kuvaava tekijä on asiakaslähtöisyys. Uskomme, että jokaisen perheen ja lapsen haasteet ovat ratkaistavissa oikea-aikaisella ja tarpeen mukaisella tuella, hoidolla ja kasvatuksella. Toiminnassamme korostuu vastuullisuus, inhimillisyys ja yksilöllisyyden kunnioittaminen. Meillä jokainen työntekijämme on hyvinvaikuttaja ja elämänarvon kasvattaja.


Millainen työ sinua odottaa?

Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen. Työtä tehdään kolmessa vuorossa, mutta työ painottuu yövuoroihin. Työn alkamisesta sovitaan yhdessä kanssasi. Lisäksi pyrimme ottamaan huomioon jokaisen omat erityisosaamisalat ja motivaatiotekijät.

Ohjaajana tuet ja kannustat lapsia ja nuoria arjen haasteissa sekä osallistut nuoren hoidon ja kasvatuksen arviointiin. Työn lähtökohtana on asiakkaan kuuleminen, kunnioittava kohtelu sekä osallisuuden tukeminen. Työtä tehdään aina tiiviissä yhteistyössä huoltajien, lähiverkoston, koulutoimen ja sosiaaliviranomaisten kanssa. Myös yksikkömme sisällä toteutamme moniammatillista vuoropuhelua ja hyödynnämme jokaisen koulutusalan asiantuntijuutta hoitoprosessissa systemaattisesti.

Laajensimme syksyllä 2023 toimintaamme avaamalla uuden erityistason intensiivisen tuen lastensuojeluyksikön Iisalmeen keskustan tuntumaan, hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärelle. Vaahterakankaan lastensuojeluyksikössä on kaksi 7-paikkaista asuinyksikköä tarjoten kodinomaisen ja turvallisen kasvuympäristön lastensuojelun sijoituksen tarpeessa oleville lapsille.

Yksikön tilat ovat hirsirakenteiset ja erityisesti tätä toimintaa varten suunnitellut, joten työskentely-ympäristö on aistiystävällinen, ergonominen ja allergiavapaa. Täällä fyysiset rakenteet tukevat työhyvinvointia ja laadukkaan lastensuojelutyön toteuttamista

Voit lukea lisää Humanassa työskentelystä ja hyvinvaikuttajistamme täältä.


Miksi tarttua tähän tilaisuuteen?

Pääset mukaan työtiimiin, jossa arvostamme energistä työotetta, iloa, ystävällisyyttä ja aitoa halua tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä lasten, nuorten ja heidän perheidensä eteen. Tulemme tekemään kaikkemme sen eteen, että työympäristö olisi mahdollisimman mukava ja ilmapiiri hyvä.

Lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Koemme Humanassa erittäin tärkeänä tukea henkilöstömme kehittymistä ja uramahdollisuuksia. Omien kattavien sisäisten kouluttautumismahdollisuuksiemme lisäksi voimme neuvotella palkallisista koulutusvapaista sekä työnantajan osallistumisesta koulutuksesi kustannuksiin. Osaamisemme vahvistaminen on meidän kaikkien etu!

  • Humanan työntekijänä olet oikeutettu kattavaan työterveyshuoltoon.

  • Epassin liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu on Humanassa 400 euroa vuodessa (työaikaehdon täyttyessä). Tällä edulla hankit helposti teatteriliput ja kuntosalikortit tai piipahdat vaikkapa suuhygienistillä!

  • Humanasta saat itsellesi arvovastuullisen työnantajan. Uskomme vahvasti mahdollisuuksiimme hyvinvaikuttaa ihmisiin ja yhteiskuntaan. Olemme ylpeitä arvoistamme: sitoutuminen, vastuullisuus sekä kohtaaminen ja ilo.

Lue lisää Humanan eduista täältä!

Palkkaus

Tehtävän peruspalkka sijoittuu 2526,70-2860,61 euroa/kk välille riippuen aiemmasta soveltuvasta työkokemuksestasi. Lisäksi tehtävässä maksetaan yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaiset lisät vuorotyöstä.


Minkälaista työkaveria etsimme?

Odotamme sinulta sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkintoa (lähihoitaja).

Huomioithan, että tehtävään valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 momentin mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rikosrekisteriote. Lisäksi valitulla henkilöllä tulee olla hankittuna sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattikortti työsuhteen alkaessa.

Odotamme sinulla olevan aikaisempaa kokemusta lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelystä, erityisesti kokemusta lastensuojelutyöstä ja/tai lasten ja nuorten psykiatrisesta hoitotyöstä. Lisäksi arvostamme kohtaamisen taitoja, empatiaa, yhteistyötaitoja sekä joustavaa työotetta.

Arvostamme avarakatseisuutta ja innokkuutta alati kehittyvää lastensuojelun työkenttää kohtaan. Toivomme sinulta löytyvän myös hyvät organisointi-, yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä positiivinen, kannustava ja joustava työote.


Kiinnostuitko? Seuraavaksi haluamme kuulla sinusta!

Tartu tilaisuuteen ja lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 31.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä sinulle antaa arkisin klo 8-16 yksikönjohtaja Eveliina Hassinen p. 0406801922 eveliina.hassinen@humana.fi.

Huomioithan, että tietoturvasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse. Jätä oma hakemuksesi suoraan hakulinkkimme kautta.

Humana on johtava pohjoismainen sosiaalialan toimija, joka tarjoaa yksilöllisiä sosiaalipalveluita lähellä ihmistä ja perheen arkea. Meitä on Suomessa 2 300. Autamme ja tuemme 5 000 ihmistä erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa. Visiomme mukaisesti uskomme siihen, että jokaisella on oikeus hyvään elämään - ja tätä visiota toteutamme hyvinvaikuttamalla ihmisiin ja yhteiskuntaan.

title: ERP Logistics Consultant
description:
abra is looking for an ERP Logistics Consultant to join our team!

We are looking for an experienced ERP Logistics Consultant to lead business analysis and process optimization initiatives within logistics and supply chain environments. The role involves gathering business requirements, translating them into system specifications, supporting ERP implementation projects, and working closely with end users and stakeholders to improve operational efficiency.

Full-time | Hybrid | Travel to customer sites across Israel

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements in logistics and supply chain domains and translate them into system specifications.
  • Work closely with business users, process owners, and key stakeholders.
  • Lead and optimize logistics processes including procurement, inventory management, warehousing, distribution, and shipping.
  • Support ERP projects throughout the full lifecycle, from requirements gathering and implementation to go-live.
  • Prepare functional specifications, requirements documents, and process documentation.
  • Collaborate with technical teams on system integrations, configurations, and operational reporting requirements.
  • Provide ongoing support and guidance to end users.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering & Management, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in ERP projects within logistics and supply chain domains.
  • Strong understanding of logistics processes, including procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, goods receipt and issuance, stock counts, distribution, shipping, sales processes, and supply chain workflows.
  • Proven experience gathering, documenting, and leading business and user requirements.
  • Excellent analytical, process-oriented, and problem-solving skills.
  • High-level technical and technological understanding, including interfaces, system configurations, and operational reporting.
  • Strong documentation and specification writing skills.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites throughout Israel.

Advantages

  • Experience working directly with warehouse managers, procurement teams, operations teams, distribution teams, and customer service representatives.
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise ERP implementations.
  • Knowledge of supply chain optimization and process improvement methodologies.
  • Experience working in consulting or customer-facing environments.

title: Senior Researcher
description:
The Mix Global is a brand strategy & research agency for people who want to make insights famous for the world's leading brands.


Since 2012, The Mix has been combining the best of quantitative, qualitative, strategy, and creative to create market research campaigns that answer what, why, how, and who in equal measure. Oh, and we work a 4-day week - that is right, we don’t work Fridays!

Based in London and New York, but operating globally, the team is a bunch of diverse, committed, enthusiastic, and hardworking people. Together, we work with some of the world’s biggest brands including Diageo, Nike, Just Eat and LEGO.

This position is based in London.


What you'll be doing:


In a nutshell, you’ll be delivering compelling and commercially relevant strategies based on insight gathered from primary research which is designed, conducted and analysed by you and the team at The Mix. This is a role for someone who loves to get their hands dirty and be IN the work, while also leading a team of brilliant researchers and strategists to achieve outputs we can all be proud of.


What this means on a daily basis:


  • You will lead the day-to-day management of multiple qualitative research projects.
  • You will have an active involvement in all aspects of the research – from the study design through to client debriefing (including defining a recruitment spec, carrying out the study using different qual methodologies, moderating online or face-to-face, working on analysis documents and creating compelling strategic narratives that are insight-led and evidence-based).
  • You will utilise and delegate appropriately to more junior members of the team to maximise the use of your time.
  • You will manage clients on projects, with support from a Director.
  • You will be alert to commercial sensitivities and proactively explore better working practices.
  • You will proactively investigate how we can optimise our research approaches in robust and creative ways.


We are looking for someone who has:


  • 4+ years of agency or client-side research/insights experience.
  • Full process knowledge – the ability to cover all aspects (from designing qualitative methodologies for brand clients, writing a recruitment spec and a discussion guide to creating reports) with no supervision.
  • Proficiency extracting insight and creating engaging deliverables from multiple sources/stages.
  • Experience with tackling clients’ business questions and presenting findings to clients.
  • Experience working on large-scale multi-market projects.
  • Track record of running complex research projects.
  • Initiative and creativity in problem-solving.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication – the ability to consolidate a large amount of information into clear, actionable recommendations.


Bonus if you have:


  • Experience working with FMCG clients
  • Qualitative & Quantitative knowledge/experience
  • Experience delivering strategy in addition to research reports
  • Line management experience, understanding strengths and areas for development of the different team members to successfully manage, mentor and develop them.
  • A desire to help the agency beyond project work with thought leadership and new business pitches
  • Being commercially sensitive of clients, with a good understanding of how decisions are made in different kinds of corporations.


If this sounds exciting and fitting, we’d love to hear from you!

Perks of working for The Mix:


  • We have been working a 4-day week since 2017 - that is right, we don’t work Fridays!
  • 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays (in addition to Fridays off, of course).
  • A lovely office based in Barbican and flexibility work from home whenever you please.
  • A health cash plan via Healthshield with up to 100% cashback on everyday healthcare costs such as dental, optical, and physiotherapy, up to agreed limits.
  • Access to MyPerks, a rewards platform that offers discounts on everything from fashion, holidays, and entertainment to health and beauty and weekly shopping from major supermarkets.
  • Access to the Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Being part of a lovely culture which consistently gets praised in our anonymous internal surveys.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer – Embedded Linux & RTOS
description:
Avenga is an international engineering firm helping businesses operate with AI at the core. With 6,000+ experts worldwide, we combine engineering expertise with AI-native thinking to turn ambitious ideas into real-world impact across industries, technologies, and markets.

At the core of the role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer – Embedded Linux & RTOS to join a global technology project focused on embedded operating systems, real-time software solutions, and advanced development tools.

You will work with cutting-edge technologies that enable customers to develop next-generation IoT devices, embedded applications, and connected systems across various industries. The project involves supporting complex hardware and software environments, including real-time operating systems, embedded Linux platforms, development tools, and cloud-based solutions.

In this role, you will investigate and resolve sophisticated technical challenges involving operating systems, hardware architectures, software applications, and their interactions. You will collaborate with global engineering teams, product managers, and customers to provide expert technical guidance, troubleshoot complex environments, and ensure successful implementation and operation of embedded solutions.

This is an opportunity to work with advanced embedded technologies, take ownership of challenging technical issues, and contribute to the continuous improvement of products, development practices, and customer support processes.

Core skills you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 8–12 years of professional experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), embedded Linux, and related development technologies.

  • Strong knowledge of embedded Linux environments and Linux distributions, including Debian and CentOS.

  • Hands-on experience with development tools, compilers, and IDEs, including Eclipse, Eclipse-based IDEs, and Visual Studio Code.

  • Strong understanding of systems programming languages, including C/C++, Python, and Rust.

  • Experience working with compilers and development toolchains such as GCC and Clang.

  • Experience troubleshooting and debugging complex software and hardware issues in real-time embedded environments.

  • Understanding of cloud-based applications, SaaS architectures, and related cloud technologies.

  • Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and version control systems such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.

  • Experience working with Linux and Windows host environments.

  • Familiarity with major processor architectures, including PowerPC, Intel, ARM, and RISC-V, as well as multi-core systems.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, multicast, and routing.

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • 3–5 years of experience in customer-facing technical support or engineering roles.

  • Experience with build systems and tools such as Makefiles and similar technologies.

  • Knowledge of device drivers, Board Support Packages (BSP), hardware design, and hardware-software integration.

  • Experience with virtualization and cloud infrastructure technologies.

  • Familiarity with NFV, OpenStack, DPDK, DPI, and Software-Defined Networking (SDN).

  • Knowledge of security-enhanced Linux, network security, and VoIP technologies.

  • Experience supporting complex embedded systems across different hardware architectures.

  • Experience mentoring engineers, delivering technical training, or leading technical support initiatives.

The impact you'll create

  • Provide advanced technical support to customers developing embedded systems, IoT devices, and real-time software solutions.

  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues involving embedded Linux, RTOS, hardware platforms, development tools, and software applications.

  • Analyze interactions between hardware designs, operating systems, and application software to identify root causes and deliver effective solutions.

  • Set up, configure, and maintain laboratory environments to reproduce customer systems, hardware configurations, and technical issues.

  • Work with development tools, IDEs, compilers, and debugging utilities to investigate customer environments and resolve technical challenges.

  • Perform root cause analysis of issues related to embedded operating systems, device drivers, networking, system performance, and hardware-software integration.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product management, and development teams to investigate defects, identify solutions, and improve product reliability.

  • Communicate directly with customers to understand technical challenges, provide troubleshooting guidance, and ensure effective issue resolution.

  • Support customers throughout the product lifecycle, from initial implementation and integration to ongoing maintenance and optimization.

  • Investigate and resolve complex multi-layered technical issues involving hardware, software, networking, and development environments.

  • Manage technical escalations and coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of critical issues.

  • Document technical investigations, troubleshooting procedures, root causes, and resolutions to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

  • Develop technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and support materials for customers and internal engineering teams.

  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training to less experienced Customer Support Engineers.

  • Participate in technical discussions with engineering, product management, sales, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Take ownership of complex technical investigations and independently drive issues toward resolution.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on technical support processes, engineering practices, and customer experience.

People are at the core of Avenga. We provide equal opportunities regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, or any other characteristic. We are committed to a respectful environment where everyone can be themselves, share their ideas, and feel that they belong.

title: Executive Director
description:
Legal Services Alabama seeks an Executive Director

Legal Services Alabama’s Executive Director, Guy Lescault, has announced his retirement at the end of 2026. LSA now seeks an experienced and passionate leader to serve as our next Executive Director.


About LSA

LSA is the sole federally funded statewide civil legal aid organization in the State of Alabama. It is private, non-profit law firm serving low-income families and individuals in all 67 counties of the state. It was created in 2004 with the merger of three civil legal aid entities, Legal Services North-Central Alabama, Metro Birmingham Legal Services and Legal Services Corporation of Alabama.


With a 2026 budget of $12 million and approximately 120 staff, including 65 attorneys, LSA operates eight program offices and a statewide call center which receives over 120,000 calls each year. LSA receives 75% of its funding from the federal Legal Services Corporation and 25% from a diverse mix of local, state and federal sources as well as foundations and individual giving.


In 2025, LSA closed over 13,000 cases. LSA advocates specialize in areas of the law that disproportionately impact the poor, with practice groups in Housing, Consumer, Public Benefits, Elder and Education.


Service Area and Office Locations

LSA serves all 67 counties in Alabama with offices in Anniston, Birmingham, Dothan, Huntsville, Mobile, Montgomery, Tuscaloosa and Selma, and the statewide Call Center located in the Montgomery Central Office.

Executive Director Role

The Executive Director is the organization’s chief executive and public leader, responsible for strategic leadership, program excellence, financial sustainability, fundraising, compliance, and community and political relations. The Executive Director leads a seasoned senior management team and works closely with the 27-member Board of Directors, whose members include local attorneys, community representatives eligible for representation and individuals supportive of access to justice.

Page Break

Page Break

The responsibilities of the Executive Director include:


  • Providing strategic, mission-driven leadership to advance access to justice throughout the State of Alabama.
  • Ensuring delivery of high-quality legal services across throughout the State with diverse programs and service models.
  • Serving as the primary public representative of LSA at the local, state, and national levels, including with courts, government agencies, funders, and community partners.
  • Leading fundraising efforts for operations, innovation, and capital improvements; engaging directly in major donor cultivation and stewardship.
  • Recruiting, developing, and supporting senior leadership and staff; fostering an inclusive, high-performing organizational culture.
  • Overseeing fiscal management, long-term financial planning, audits, and risk management.
  • Partnering with the Board of Directors to support governance, strategic planning, and fiduciary oversight.


Desired Qualifications and Experience of the Executive Director

  • Deep commitment to LSA’s mission and dedication to equitable, client-centered high quality legal services delivery which focuses on serving low-income and marginalized communities and ensuring access to justice.
  • Significant senior nonprofit leadership experience; experience in a legal aid organization preferred.
  • Significant experience managing large budgets and diverse funding streams, including federal and state grants.
  • Significant experience managing personnel across multi-site operations.
  • Strong fundraising, communications, external relations, and organizational leadership skills.
  • Ability to maintain organizational compliance and strong relationships with government and private funders without being risk-averse in a manner that supports strong client service delivery. Knowledge of and experience leading compliance with the requirements of the Legal Services Corporation is strongly preferred.
  • Residence in Montgomery or willingness to relocate.
  • JD is required. Membership in the Alabama State Bar or willingness to become licensed and join the State Bar within a reasonable period is preferred.


Compensation

The salary range is $125,000 to $150,000, commensurate with experience. LSA provides a generous and comprehensive benefits package; additional details are available upon request.

Page Break

Page Break

How To Apply

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. To receive full consideration, candidates are urged to submit their applications by August 14. Applications must include a current resume; and a letter expressing in detail your interest in the position, your qualifications and what you hope to contribute to the organization’s future. Professional references will be required later in the process.


Materials should be emailed to pattipap@gmail.com in Microsoft Word or PDF format.


LSA is assisted in its search for an Executive Director by Patricia Pap, Consultant, Management Information Exchange, 508-737-4010, pattipap@gmail.com. Candidates with questions about the position, listed qualifications, or the search process are encouraged to contact her.


An initial round of interviews for selected applicants will be held virtually on September 2 and 3.


Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

LSA is committed to providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of everyone and is free from all forms of employment discrimination based on every characteristic protected under the law and beyond.


Decisions related to hiring, compensating, training, evaluating performance, promoting, or terminating are made fairly, and are based on job-related qualities and abilities. LSA provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. We examine our unconscious biases and take responsibility for always striving to create an inclusive environment that makes every employee and candidate feel welcome.

description: • The Security Officer assist Team Leader Security & Assistant Manager Security in effectively and efficiently manage the security function of Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel & Villas so that its guests, colleagues, operations, and assets are protected and secure.

title: Lead Job Coach
company: Goodwill of the Olympics and Rainier Region
description:
Our vision is that every person has the opportunity to learn, work, and thrive in all aspects of life.

To achieve our vision, we are committed to dismantling racism and advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion so we can help people reach their fullest potential through our education, job placement, and career pathway services. We do our work with great gratitude for the community donations, purchases, and partnerships that make our mission possible.

Position Summary: The Lead Job Coach provides administrative, data management, and team supervisory support for all Disability Services programs. This person will support and guide the work of job coaches in the department in addition to providing the program manager with the needed leadership support for internal and external stakeholders. The Lead Job Coach will also carry a caseload and will be responsible for supporting participants with developmental disabilities and/or barriers to employment in a variety of work settings.

The Lead Job Coach provides direct employment support and on-the-job training to individuals with disabilities participating in community employment services, while also supporting any caseload needs of the job coaches. This position promotes competitive integrated employment through person-centered planning, informed choice, skill development, employer engagement, and community inclusion. The Lead Job Coach supports quality service delivery and works collaboratively with participants served, employers, families and community partners to achieve meaningful employment outcomes.

Hourly Rate: $21.03 - $23.94 per hour

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: The Lead Job Coach responsibilities include the following and other duties as assigned:

  • Provides functional leadership and day-to-day operational guidance to team members, serving as a primary resource for workflow coordination, training, problem resolution, and decision support, while acting as a point of contact in the manager's absence without formal supervisory authority or responsibility for personnel decisions
  • Provide support and mentorship to a team of job coaches, ensuring all data requirements and contract service requirements are met
  • Support the program manager in supervisory and administrative needs, including coordinating with businesses and partners regarding program needs and concerns
  • Provide specific programming support for growing and maintaining the School to Work Program person-centered training and support to individuals placed in community jobs.
  • Assist individuals in obtaining and maintaining competitive integrated employment
  • Conduct vocational discovery, assessments and career exploration
  • Develop Individualized Employment plans in collaboration with the participant and their support team that supports the participant in achieving meaningful career advancement and employment
  • Provide person-centered training and support to individuals placed in community jobs.
  • Perform task analysis at employment sites and develop job/work procedures for each participant.
  • Conduct worksite analyses and recommend workplace accommodations when appropriate
  • Document and track participant progress through timely case notes, performance evaluations, data entry, and file management, ensuring accurate records and measurable advancement toward employment goals and outcomes
  • Provide information on a regular basis to the Program Manager, employers, family members, and outside referral sources.
  • Promote best practices in Group and Individual Supported Employment.
  • Maintain professional relationships with the business community and establish support at each individual job site.
  • Assist Work Experience Supervisors with monitoring staff service quality.
  • Assist with resolving workplace concerns while promoting long term employment success
  • Participate in program awareness, recruitment, community and employer partnerships, and other advancement activities for the organization's mission through outreach, collaboration, and effective communication.

title: House Coordinator (Full Time)
description:
Position Summary

  • The House Coordinator is responsible and accountable for coordinating the activities and providing clinical and supervisory leadership and expertise for the overall Department of Nursing for a specific shift including Med-Surg, ICU, Emergency, Surgery and Oncology. The House Coordinator works closely with all departments to coordinate services necessary for optimal patient care. She/he contributes to the vision, mission, strategic plan of the organization, and is accountable for the Standards of Care and Practice in the areas of responsibility where clinical nursing is practiced. The House Coordinator performs “house” supervisory duties, charge nurse duties on the medical/surgical unit and provides direct “hands on” patient care as needed in any department during her/his shift. The House Coordinator is responsible to make rounds to patients on the Medical Surgical unit and ICU every shift as well as make rounds to all Nursing departments in the Medical Center at least every four (4) hours and as needed. The House Coordinator serves as the clinical back up RN to the specialty areas (ED, ICU, ONC and PACU/SDS). In addition, the House Coordinator possesses knowledge of CMS (HCFA) standards specific to Critical Access Hospitals, New Hampshire Department of Health guidelines, New Hampshire Board of Nursing rules, and the rules, regulations, policies, procedures and Standards of Nursing Practice of Weeks Medical Center.

Accountability

  • The House Coordinator is accountable first, to the Department Manager, Medical Surgical Services and second to the Chief Nurse Executive. The House Coordinator communicates with all department managers and supervisors as needed for the purpose of information sharing and / or collaborative decision making.

Interrelationships

  • Works closely with medical staff, clinical staff, support staff and the administrative team of Weeks Medical Center. The House Coordinator ensures that standards or practice are met and will function in the capacity of mentor providing ‘hands on’ support to clinical departments as needed. Collaboration with the RN Case manager is essential for the House Coordinator so that criteria are met for admissions, observations, transfers, SNFs and discharge planning.

Qualifications

  • Current registered nurse license in the State of New Hampshire.
  • Critical Care course required; a House Coordinator without a critical care course must complete the critical care course within 6 months of hire or promotion to the position.
  • Current clinical experience for at least five (5) years required; strongly prefer at least two (2) years of experience in ED and ICU. A House Coordinator without prior critical care experience must orient to both the ED and ICU to be able to fully function as the second RN in either department.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, conflict management and time management skills required.
  • BSN, BS or BA strongly preferred.
  • Current BLS, ACLS, Basic Dysrhythmia course certifications required.
  • PALS and MOAB required within one year of hire.
  • NRP, TNCC within 2 years of hire.

Supervisor Expectations

  • Maintains skills and competencies as required for department staff. Serves as a role model and mentor for all staff providing assistance and guidance as necessary.
  • Accepts supervisory responsibilities collaborating and coordinating with all departments to ensure that patient care / customer service needs are being met.
  • Accepts professional responsibility and accountability for the quality of care / service provided. Quality of work upholds Weeks Medical Center mission and goals.
  • Provides input during budget process and assists in ensuring department adherence to budget.
  • Responsible for staff relations on a daily basis:
  • Directs, guides, and coaches staff,
  • Schedule staff using consistent, fair practices,
  • Discipline in conjunction with the manager,
  • Provide input into the hiring, evaluation, and termination process,
  • Train new staff in conjunction with manager,
  • Mentor staff on new processes and equipment.
  • Works with Department Manager to ensure all staff evaluations and competencies are completed on time.
  • Monitors Kronos timekeeping system for department staff. Completes bi-weekly payroll for department if assigned.
  • Works a scheduled shift with flexibility regarding work time and scheduled hours based upon needs of department.
  • Ensures monthly staff meetings are held with all staff in conjunction with department manager. Rounds with staff (i.e. Studer model of rounding) on a monthly basis at minimum.
  • Recognizes and acts upon opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Identifies Risk Management situations, follows up with staff involved and completes and submits the proper occurrence report to the Risk Manager or HR Director (for employee incidents) within 24 hours of incident. Facilitates the post event huddle with staff involved. Appropriately notifies manager and/or administrator on call as each situation warrants.
  • Responsible for ensuring a safe work environment with no staff injuries.
  • Participates in development of disaster plan and ensures staff participation in disaster drills.
  • Establishes annual Leader Evaluation Management (LEM) goals that support department and organizational goals.
  • Ensures staff working on goals
  • Develops 90 day plans
  • Ensures LEM data kept current
  • Demonstrates collegial attitude while working with colleagues and members of the four hospital North Country Healthcare Affiliation.

Service Excellence Criteria

  • Make a positive first impression. First impressions define our personality to others and set the tone. By making a positive first impression, our patients, families and colleagues will feel welcome in our Medical Center environment.
  • Treat others as guests. Act as a host and greet others as you would welcome a good friend.
  • Be an effective communicator. See that patients, families and colleagues are appropriately informed. Talk with others promptly if you are having a problem with them – follow the “Commitment to My Co-Workers”.
  • Practice service recovery skills. Turn negative service or a negative impression into a positive outcome for the patient, family or colleague.
  • Be professional in image and appearance. Represent the Medical Center as a professional in image and attitude. Act as a role model for the Medical Center’s dress code policy. Also, act as a role model for the Medical Center’s Code of Conduct.
  • Practice teamwork. Work with your team to develop a common vision and common goals. Support your team members to achieve these goals and to provide excellence in patient care and services.
  • Project a positive attitude. Demonstrate an attitude of striving to find and implement positive approaches. Be part of the solution, not part of the problem. Do not openly criticize your colleagues in front of others or to patients and families.
  • Strive for excellence in all endeavors. Always look for ways to work more effectively. Strive for higher quality in a cost effective environment.

Essential Functions of the Job

  • Maintains required skills and competencies for Registered Nurse and House Coordinator, including skills for Med Surg, ICU and ED. Demonstrates excellence in clinical practice as outlined in the skills competency tool and standards of nursing practice. Serves as a role model and mentor for clinical staff providing “hands on” assistance and guidance as necessary.
  • Accepts professional responsibility and accountability for the quality of care provided. Quality of work upholds Weeks Medical Center mission and goals. Rounds in each clinical department minimally every 4 hours and more often as necessary.
  • Provides hands on clinical assistance to staff without hesitation. Provides relief coverage for staff to take a meal break when staff in their own department or the manager cannot provide this meal break coverage.
  • Accepts supervisory responsibilities collaborating and coordinating with all departments to ensure that patient care needs are being met throughout the House.
  • Mentors, guides and actively assists staff (throughout the house) in day to day activities of nursing practice as the need arises, and without prompting.
  • Demonstrates fiscal responsibility by ensuring that staffing is adjusted according to census, minimizing overtime and ensuring proper and economical use of equipment and supplies.
  • Identifies Risk Management situations, follows up with staff involved in these situations and completes and submits the proper occurrence report to the Risk Manager or HR Director (for employee incidents) within 24 hours of incident. Facilitates the post event huddle and documents opportunities for improvement. Appropriately notifies manager and/or administrator on call as each situation warrants.
  • Actively works to support departmental goals. Monitors, encourages and coaches staff as necessary to promote and ensure progress and growth. Documents coaching sessions in Performance Manager for direct reports. In collaboration with the appropriate Department Manager, counsels staff as necessary to address deviations of accepted policies and/or Standards of Practice to ensure that the highest quality of care is being attained. Notifies employee’s Manager by email of each corrective action discussion.
  • Measurable Goal: Promotes accountability for staff by completing audits and providing feedback to the staff regarding their documentation. The expectation is that ten audits per assigned nurse each month will be completed.

    Exceeds – greater than ten audits per month for each assigned employee.
    Meet – ten audits per month for each assigned employee have been completed by the House Coordinator.
    Needs Improvement – less than ten audits per month for each assigned employee.
  • Collaborates with Department Manager to facilitate interviews, orientation, and growth of staff. Facilitates continued education for staff by participating as instructors in monthly educational events for staff and also participating as instructors in the annual competency process including SIM lab education, policy updates, training on new equipment etc.
  • Participates in the annual staff evaluations, policy reviews and compliance with CAH and Life Safety standards. Actively participates in at least one IHI or CMS quality initiative or other focused quality area as determined and approved by the Manager.
  • Adhere to Medication Safety policies in regards to appropriately bar-coding medications and patient ID bands. Obtaining a witness whenever a barcode override for a medication to be administered is necessary. Meeting this standard would be using barcode override 3% (or less) of the time.

title: Stockholms Hamnar söker arbetsledare fastighetsdrift
description:
Vill du arbeta med några av Stockholms mest spännande fastigheter och lägen? Stockholms Hamnar söker nu en arbetsledare till enheten Fastighetsdrift. Här får du en utvecklande tjänst i en unik miljö.

Enhetens uppdrag är att säkerställa en tillfredsställande driftsfunktion i fastighetstekniska installationer i Stockholms Hamnars byggnader, med fokus på bra hyresgästservice och hållbar energiutveckling. Som arbetsledare ansvarar du för att leda, samordna och följa upp arbetet både för den egna driftorganisationen och för de entreprenörer som anlitas. Du säkerställer att avtal följs, att arbetet utförs enligt gällande rutiner och att kvaliteten motsvarar verksamhetens krav. Du rapporterar till chefen för fastighetsdrift.

I första hand arbetar du i Stockholm men du kommer också att arbetsleda egen och inhyrd personal i våra hamnar i Kapellskär och Nynäshamn. Vi sitter i moderna lokaler med sjöutsikt i Värtahamnen i Stockholm.

Din roll som arbetsledare fastighetsdrift

  • Leda, samordna, planera samt följa upp drift-, underhålls- och servicearbeten inom vårt fastighetsbestånd.
  • Ansvara för att framtagna rutiner och arbetsprocesser följs.
  • Dagligen uppfölja upp felhantering, jourhantering, driftlarm och åtgärdsstatus.
  • Genomföra driftmöten med dokumentation och åtgärdsuppföljning.
  • Löpande hantera fakturor och driftstatistik till enhetschef.
  • Operativ ledning och samordning av entreprenörer enligt gällande ramavtal.
  • Daglig kontakt med externa leverantörer.
  • Medverka i upphandling av serviceavtal.
  • Ansvara för att systematiskt brandskyddsarbete utförs enligt plan.
  • Vara byggherrerepresentant i driftavtal, upprätta och följa upp riskhantering och arbetsmiljöfrågor.
  • Samla in och sammanställa energistatistik.

Det här tar du med dig in i rollen

  • YH-utbildning eller gymnasial utbildning inom fastighetsteknik, VVS, el, energi, drift- och underhållsteknik eller annan inriktning som Stockholms Hamnar bedömer relevant
  • Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete inom fastighetsdrift, teknisk förvaltning eller motsvarande relevant erfarenhet och aktuell erfarenhet av att leda och fördela arbetsuppgifter inom fastighetsdrift eller i projekt
  • Erfarenhet av att planera och följa upp tekniska åtgärder inom exempelvis VVS, kyla, el samt styr- och regler
  • Erfarenhet av driftentreprenad ABFF, AB04 eller ABT06
  • Vana av digitala driftövervakningssystem (BAS, SCADA, energisystem etc.)
  • Förmåga att läsa tekniska ritningar och dokumentation
  • Grundläggande kunskap i arbetsmiljö, säkerhet och tillämpliga regelverk
  • Goda datorkunskaper
  • Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift, och god engelska i tal och skrift
  • B-körkort

Meriterande erfarenheter och kompetenser:

  • Högre utbildning inom fastighetsförvaltning, energioptimering, värmepumpteknik, styr- och reglerteknik eller byggteknik
  • BAS-P/BAS-U
  • Ledarskapsutbildning
  • Erfarenhet av upphandling, LOU eller LUF, och kontakt med entreprenörer
  • Erfarenhet av energioptimering
  • Erfarenhet av underhållsplanering
  • Erfarenhet av fastighetssystem, till exempel Citect och Faciliate

Är det här du?

Vi fäster stor vikt vid dina personliga kompetenser och söker dig som är lösningsorienterad och van att arbeta strukturerat, självgående och organiserat. Du har ett gott omdöme och förmåga att se helheten i komplexa situationer.

Rollen kräver att du är kvalitetsmedveten, ansvarstagande och självgående, samtidigt som du har en god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med många kontaktytor. Du kommunicerar tydligt, lyhört och bidrar till konstruktiva lösningar i samarbetet med både kollegor och entreprenörer. Du har också lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar och förstår vikten av att anpassa och planera arbetet utifrån hamnverksamhetens behov, där oförutsedda händelser och nya prioriteringar är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du motiveras av att leverera lösningar som håller vad de lovar över tid.

Vi erbjuder

Som anställd i Stockholms Hamnar arbetar du på ett modernt företag med strategisk betydelse för Stockholmsregionens utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig ett omväxlande jobb med stort utrymme för egna initiativ i en händelserik miljö med trevliga kollegor och bra personalförmåner. Håller du dessutom med om att samarbete och en positiv attityd i vardagen skapar arbetsglädje för alla kommer du att trivas hos oss i Stockholms Hamnar.

Stockholms Hamnar värnar om att ha en öppen atmosfär och vi är stolta över vår goda laganda. Våra anställda har ett stort engagemang i sitt arbete och för verksamheten. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på Stockholms Hamnar

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan

Om du tycker att tjänsten som arbetsledare passar väl in på dina kvalifikationer och hur du vill arbeta, skicka din ansökan snarast, senast 2 november 2026.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Morgan Sehlberg, rekryteringskonsult, tel. 08-508 117 22, alternativt enhetschef Fredrik Nodemar, fredrik.nodemar@stockholmshamnar.se

Provanställning tillämpas och bakgrundskontroll genomförs före anställning.

Stockholms Hamnar arbetar för en alkohol- och drogfri arbetsmiljö. Därför kan slumpmässiga alkohol- och drogtester förekomma under anställningen.

Stockholms Hamnar arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.

Om Stockholms Hamnars fastigheter

Stockholms Hamnar förvaltar byggnader om 170 000 kvm samt mark som ligger i anslutning till hamnverksamheten. Fastigheterna ligger främst i Frihamnen i Stockholm samt i anslutning till hamnarna i Nynäshamn och Kapellskär.

Byggnaderna som Stockholms Hamnar förvaltar har ofta en lång historia samt särpräglad arkitektur, vilket gör lokalerna unika och mycket eftertraktade och skapar möjlighet för spännande verksamheter.

Om Stockholms Hamnar

Stockholms Hamnar är en av världens största passagerarhamnar och en av Sveriges största godshamnar. Stockholms Hamnar finns i Stockholm, Norrtälje och Nynäshamn. Medelantalet anställda är 140. Läs mer på www.stockholmshamnar.se.

title: Engineer I
description:
ENGINEER I – WATER & WASTEWATER

Why This Role Matters:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Civil Engineer with a focus on Water and Wastewater to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience in designing water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including water distribution systems, water storage facilities, pump stations, water and wastewater treatment plants, sewer collection systems, and sewer pump stations.

This role involves coordinating with multidisciplinary professionals on municipal, industrial, and commercial water and wastewater projects, performing technical analyses, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations, and optimizing system performance. The Engineer I will report to a Project Manager or Principal and will be responsible for developing impactful designs for various water and wastewater engineering projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop designs for water and wastewater projects, including sanitary pump stations, waterlines, sewer systems, and treatment facilities. Perform technical analyses and calculations to ensure efficient and sustainable system performance.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplined teams including environmental scientists, surveyors, and other engineers to deliver comprehensive water and wastewater solutions for municipal, industrial, and commercial clients.
  • Ensure that all projects comply with local, state, and federal environmental regulations and standards, including permitting and reporting requirements.
  • Prepare detailed cost estimates, construction schedules, and feasibility studies to support the planning and execution of projects.
  • Provide technical support during project construction, including reviewing plans, conducting site inspections, and resolving engineering issues. Mentor and support junior team members in developing their technical skills.
  • Develop and review engineering designs, drawings, and specifications to ensure high-quality deliverables that meet client expectations and project objectives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with clients by understanding their needs, providing regular updates, and delivering innovative and cost-effective solutions.
  • Delegate and provide oversight for the work assigned to Engineering Designers or interns

What You Bring:

  • You earned a BS in civil engineering or a related field, and have at least four (4) years of relevant experience – or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Professional licensure (PE) is required
  • You’re proficient in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, and/or other industry best programs, as well as the Microsoft Office Suite
  • You are proficient in Hydro CAD, Sewer GEMS, Water GEMS or equivalent.
  • You have strong interpersonal skills and communicate effectively both verbally and via written correspondence
  • You have an aptitude for juggling multiple projects concurrently without losing sight of crucial details
  • You can understand and carry out complex technical oral or written instructions


What We Offer:

Benefits for Regular Full-Time & Part-Time Employees Working 30+ Hours/Week

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match

  • Voluntary Life Insurance for you and your family

  • PTO + Sick Time + 8 Holidays per year
  • Retirement Savings Plan with contribution from CPL to grow your retirement funds
  • Internal Mobility & Career Advancement
  • Licensure Assistance

Additional benefits available to FT Employees Working 40+ Hours/Week

  • Tuition Assistance: You may be eligible for continuing education assistance
  • Student Loan Assistance Program: CPL will contribute up to $100/month for 5 years ($6,000 total) toward student loan debt

What Does It Look Like Working Here?

We believe that building a strong community is about establishing a prevailing sense of fellowship among our team members, friends, and neighbors.

  • Collaboration – working with others towards the best solution, placing great emphasis on the collective wisdom of our internal teams.
  • Family – celebrating others’ successes, genuinely caring about the happiness and well-being of our team members and recognizing their own families as extensions of the CPL family.
  • Fun – not taking oneself too seriously, fully understanding that fun at work is conducive to productivity.

  • Integrity – doing what is ethically right and providing reliable follow-through on commitments.
  • Ingenuity – seeking new opportunities and consistently identifying unexpected and practical ways to solve problems.

The rate for this position generally ranges between $85,000 to $112,000. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the New York Pay Transparency Law. It is based on what a successful New York applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in New York or perform the position from New York. Similar positions located outside of New York will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by New York Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employees already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. At Broadridge, we believe our mission is simple yet powerful: to earn our clients' confidence every day by delivering real business value through leading technology-driven solutions that set the standard for the financial services industry and beyond. We’ve built a culture where our associates are empowered to grow, innovate, and contribute to meaningful work. Our workplace is grounded in FACS: Flexible, Accountable, Connected, and Supported, ensuring that we not only deliver for clients but also foster balance, connection, and belonging for our associates. We are also deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion—creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to thrive.

About the Role

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to design, build, and enhance the cloud and automation platforms that power Broadridge products and services. In this role, you will work closely with development teams to understand their needs, deliver innovative solutions, and drive highly secure, scalable, and resilient DevOps capabilities across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve the DevOps platform supporting Broadridge product and service delivery.
  • Responsible for administrative-level activities across Jenkins, GitLab, JFrog, and Chef.
  • Collaborate with development teams to gather requirements, ideate, and translate solutions into secure and scalable implementations.
  • Develop automation frameworks and scripts to streamline CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and deployments.
  • Drive best practices in enterprise software delivery, including configuration management, release processes, and observability.
  • Support global-scale systems leveraging modern networking, distributed architectures, containers, and microservices.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure effective collaboration, security compliance, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • 5-8 years’ experience DevOps toolsets Terraform, Jenkins, Chef, Docker, JF Proven experience in the administration of Jenkins, GitLab, JFrog, and Chef (e.g., user management, backups, upgrades, Architecture)
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS cloud services (Azure or GCP experience a plus).
  • Skilled in DevOps toolsets including Terraform, Jenkins, Chef, Docker, JFrog (Kubernetes proficiency highly beneficial).
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, source control (Git), configuration management, and monitoring practices.
  • Proficiency with scripting/programming languages such as Python, GoLang, or Shell.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the organizational skills to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cloud/DevOps certifications (e.g., AWS DevOps Engineer, CKA, Terraform Associate).
  • Familiarity with advanced networking, master/slave architectures, and modern design patterns.
  • Hands-on experience across multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

Background Check Process

  • Background Check Process Broadridge requires employees to complete a background check that is completed by one of our service providers.
  • We use this service to complete the following checks: Employment verification Education verification Credit inquiry Canadian criminal record check.

Compensation

Salary Range: CAD $100,000 - $120,000. Compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location.

Workplace Flexibility

We are committed to supporting flexible work arrangements, investing in technology or other resources to enable you to work from home effectively, wherever possible. At this time this is a hybrid role, and therefore you should have a basic home office set up, high-speed internet, and the ability to work without distractions during core business hours.

Accessibility & Accommodation

Broadridge is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace ensuring that equal employment opportunities are provided to all individuals, regardless of race, colour, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, creed, age, disability, religious affiliation, or national origin or citizenship. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please notify our recruitment team.

Use of AI in Hiring

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

Broadridge Financial Solutions (NYSE: BR)

Broadridge Financial Solutions (NYSE: BR) is a global technology leader with trusted expertise and transformative technology, helping clients and the financial services industry operate, innovate, and grow. We power investing, governance, and communications for our clients – driving operational resiliency, elevating business performance, and transforming investor experiences. Our technology and operations platforms process and generate over 7 billion communications annually and underpin the daily average trading of over $15 trillion in equities, fixed income, and other securities globally. A certified Great Place to Work®, Broadridge is part of the S&P 500® Index, employing over 15,000 associates in 21 countries.

LinkedIn Facebook Instagram Twitter YouTube Glassdoor The Muse

Broadridge is committed to creating an engaging workplace for the most talented associates in our industry. We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and healthy environment that promotes flexibility and accountability. As a leading provider of technology, communications, and data and analytics solutions to businesses around the world, it is critical that we understand, embrace, and operate in a multicultural environment. Every associate has unique strengths, which, when fully appreciated and embraced, allow individuals to perform at their best, leading to our success. We believe that our associates are our most important asset. Encouraging professional development opportunities is a core part of our culture. title: Physiotherapist

description:
Rehabilitation and Community-Based Rehabilitation

Coordination and Networking

title: VP Product
description:
We are seeking a VP Product to own and scale the product organization of DoktorABC. This role is responsible for defining product strategy, driving execution across multiple platforms, and ensuring that the product serves as the backbone of a complex, regulated telehealth marketplace.

Reporting directly to the COO, the VP Product will act as a central integrator between Business, Engineering, Medical, Operations, and Marketing — translating company strategy into clear product direction and shipped outcomes.

This is a senior leadership role for a proven product builder who can operate at both strategic and hands-on levels in a fast-growing, high-complexity environment.

Helfy is a technology-driven group building the next generation of digital healthcare infrastructure. At the core of the group is DoktorABC, a leading telehealth marketplace operating across multiple international markets.

DoktorABC functions as an end-to-end telehealth marketplace, connecting:

  • Patients seeking fast, convenient access to care
  • Licensed doctors providing online consultations and prescriptions
  • Pharmacies fulfilling prescriptions and OTC products
  • Medication & OTC products, including regulated treatments
  • Delivery partners ensuring fast, reliable home delivery

The platform seamlessly combines medical consultation, prescription handling, pharmacy fulfillment, and last-mile delivery into a single digital experience. Operating in regulated environments, DoktorABC enables millions of patients to receive treatment without queues, friction, or unnecessary in-person visits.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the B2C product strategy aligned with growth and revenue goals
  • Translate COO-level objectives into clear product roadmaps and measurable outcomes
  • Balance short-term growth experiments with long-term SaaS platform scalability
  • Own product discovery, experimentation, and prioritization frameworks

B2C Marketplace, SaaS & Platform Ownership

  • Own the full marketplace product experience across patients, doctors, pharmacies, and internal operations
  • Ensure healthy balance between supply, demand, and operational constraints
  • Build tools that scale doctor throughput, pharmacy efficiency, and patient satisfaction
  • Drive product solutions for multi-market and multi-regulation environments

Retention, Activation, PLG & Lifecycle (Critical Ownership Area)

  • Own product-led growth (PLG) across the entire user journey
  • Drive activation, habit formation, repeat usage, and long-term engagement
  • Design onboarding and activation flows that demonstrate value within minutes
  • Optimize B2C funnels from first visit to repeat purchase and subscription usage
  • Partner with Marketing and Data to improve cohort retention, LTV, and expansion
  • Use retention as the primary product success metric, ahead of feature velocity

Execution & Delivery

  • Partner closely with Engineering to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions
  • Ensure strong product rituals: planning, discovery, delivery, and retrospectives
  • Make clear trade-offs and unblock teams in high-pressure environments
  • Ensure product releases meet regulatory, medical, and operational requirements

Leadership & Team Building

  • Build, lead, and mentor a large, multi-disciplinary product organization (Product Managers, UX, Research)
  • Directly manage senior product leaders and managers
  • Establish clear ownership, accountability, and career paths
  • Build a culture of outcome ownership, clarity, and execution excellence

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a key partner to Engineering, Marketing, Medical, Operations, Legal, and Data
  • Align stakeholders around clear priorities and trade-offs
  • Represent Product at the leadership level and in strategic discussions

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 8+ years of experience in senior product leadership roles (VP / Head of Product)
  • Strong B2C product background (not internal tools or pure enterprise)
  • Proven experience with PLG, SaaS products, and eCommerce flows
  • Proven experience driving retention, activation, conversion, and LTV through product
  • Experience leading consumer-facing funnels at scale
  • Proven experience leading complex, multi-sided platforms or marketplaces
  • Experience managing and scaling product teams of 8+ people
  • Strong background in product strategy, discovery, experimentation, and execution
  • Deep understanding of data-driven decision making (funnels, cohorts, A/B testing)
  • Experience working closely with Engineering, Marketing, and Operations
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluent English

Big Advantage

  • Experience in regulated B2C industries (healthcare, pharma, fintech)
  • Strong eCommerce, subscription, or marketplace background
  • Experience scaling B2C products from Israel to global markets

title: Timvikarie till Munkmoraskolan (F-5)
description:
Värmdö är skärgårdens mötesplats med en unik kombination av naturens stilla skönhet och en mer stadslik livsstil. Vårt uppdrag är inte ett utan många: skola, fastigheter, socialtjänst, hamnar, vård, bibliotek, omsorg och många fler. Vi verkar för att alla Värmdöbor kan leva ett rikt och fritt liv. Vi vill vara de som möjliggör drömmen om en livskraftig trygg miljö för hem, familj och företag.

Ska vi lyckas med det fullt ut måste vi ha olika kompetenser och arbeta tillsammans för en gemensam och tillitsfull arbetskultur, byggd på modiga, ansvarstagande medarbetare som förstår invånarnas behov och önskemål.

Beskrivning Enhet/Avdelning

Munkmoraskolan är en liten skola som växer, vi har idag åk F-5 och ca 165 elever. Skolan ligger i centrala Gustavsberg i Värmdö kommun med bra bussförbindelser och har nyrenoverade ljusa, fina och ändamålsenliga lokaler. Vi har en fantastisk utemiljö med stora lekytor och två konstgräsplaner. Dessutom har vi nära till lekparker och skogsområden.

På Munkmoraskolan arbetar vi för att ge alla elever ett tryggt och hållbart lärande för livet, hållbarhet för individen och hållbarhet för vår omvärld. Skolan har certifierats för sitt arbete och är både Generation PEP-skola samt certifierad Grön Flagg och har nyligen också tilldelats Skolverkets utmärkelse "Hållbar skola". Elevernas trivsel och trygghet utgör grunden för allt vårt arbete. Hos oss på Munkmoraskolan är alla elever allas elever!

I rollen som timvikarie kommer du att arbeta vid kortare och längre frånvaro för ordinarie pedagoger eller för att under kortare period förstärka kring enskild elev eller grupp. Din roll är att täcka upp där det bäst behövs och följa arbetslaget på skolan/ fritidshemmet och utföra givna arbetsuppgifter. I första hand söker vi timvikarier till vårt fritidshem men även du som är intresserad av att arbeta som lärarvikarie är välkommen att söka.

Att börja arbeta som timvikarie är ofta en bra start för att komma in i verksamheten som sedan kan leda till längre uppdrag. Vi på Munkmoraskolan har egna vikarier som vi anlitar vid behov. Detta gör att du som timvikarie snabbt kommer in i verksamheten och lär känna våra elever samt personal.

Vi söker i första hand dig som har en pedagogisk utbildning och/eller erfarenhet av pedagogiskt arbete. Även du som studerar eller du som har andra erfarenheter som kan berika vårt fritidshem är välkommen att söka. Du ser möjligheter istället för hinder och skapar goda, respektfulla och ödmjuka möten med våra elever, föräldrar och kollegor. Vi lägger stor vikt vid sociala kompetenser och personlig lämplighet.

Som person är du flexibel och har god förmåga att ta egna initiativ samtidigt som du har lätt för att samarbeta med olika människor i olika åldrar.

För denna tjänst är uppvisande av giltigt utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister en förutsättning för anställning.

Anställningen avser timvikariat vid behov i verksamheten.

Värmdö kommun erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag och semesterväxling till extra lediga dagar. Vi arbetar även aktivt för att skapa hälsofrämjande arbetsplatser med en god arbetsmiljö och tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Vill du veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta oss, se kontaktperson nedan.

Kontaktuppgifter till arbetstagarorganisationerna hittar du på https://www.varmdo.se/fackligaorganisationer eller via Servicecenter, 08-570 470 00. Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

Många kan konfigurera ett nätverk. Färre kan analysera en komplex IT-miljö, identifiera riskerna innan de blir problem och hjälpa kunden att fatta rätt strategiska beslut.


Det är den personen vi söker.


Hos Certezza arbetar du med organisationer där IT-säkerhet är en affärskritisk fråga. Här förväntas du inte bara kunna tekniken, du ska också kunna omsätta den till genomtänkta lösningar som håller över tid.

Rollen

Du arbetar med design, säkerhetsarkitektur och utveckling av komplexa infrastrukturlösningar. I vissa uppdrag leder du kunden genom hela resan, från analys och förstudie till implementation och överlämning. I andra fungerar du som senior specialist och teknisk rådgivare. Oavsett uppdrag är målet detsamma: att skapa robusta, säkra och långsiktiga IT-miljöer.

Vi tror att du

  • Har flera års erfarenhet av nätverk och IT-infrastruktur.
  • Är trygg i tekniska beslut och kan motivera dem inför både tekniker och ledning.
  • Har arbetat strategiskt med säkerhetsarkitektur eller större infrastruktursatsningar.
  • Är van att ta ett konsultmässigt ansvar och bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer.

Teknisk erfarenhet av Cisco, Check Point, Clavister, Windows, Linux, VPN, TCP/IP och större nätverksmiljöer ser vi som en självklar grund. Hos oss får du kombinera teknik, strategi och rådgivning tillsammans med några av Sveriges mest erfarna cybersäkerhetskonsulter.

Vi intervjuar löpande och ser fram emot din ansökan.

Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta Mona Faghihi, Rekryteringsspecialist, på Mona.Faghihi@certezza.net. Skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev så snart som möjligt då vi gör ett löpande urval och intervjuar kontinuerligt. En bakgrunds- och registerkontroll kommer utföras innan beslut om anställning fattas.

All kontakt med annonsförsäljare och rekryteringsföretag undanbedes.

title: Training Leader
description:
Prolec GE Waukesha is now part of The GE Vernova Group

JOB SUMMARY


The Training Leader is responsible for leading the site's training and workforce development strategy to ensure employees possess the skills, knowledge, and certifications required to operate safely, efficiently, and effectively. This role partners with Operations, EHS, Quality, Engineering, and Human Resources teams to develop and deliver training programs that support production goals, compliance requirements, quality standards, and employee career development.

The Training Leader plays a critical role in building a skilled workforce through structured onboarding, technical skills development, leadership training, qualification programs, and continuous improvement initiatives


PRINCIPLE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Training & Workforce Development

  • Develop and implement the site's annual training strategy aligned with business and operational objectives.
  • Supervise training department coordinators directly and training instructors indirectly
  • Conduct training needs assessments to identify skill gaps across production, maintenance, quality, engineering, and support functions.
  • Create and maintain training matrices, certification requirements, and employee qualification records.
  • Monitor and ensure hourly employees are completing required training within established timeframe.
  • Establish career development pathways for hourly employees.
  • Support workforce planning initiatives by identifying future skill requirements.


New Employee Onboarding

  • Lead and continuously improve the site onboarding process for new hires.
  • Develop structured onboarding programs that accelerate employee productivity and engagement.
  • Coordinate orientation activities, plant introductions, and job-specific training requirements.
  • Monitor onboarding metrics and new hire effectiveness.


Technical & Operational Training

  • Partner with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Engineering leaders to develop technical training programs.
  • Support certification and qualification processes for production equipment and critical manufacturing operations.
  • Ensure employees are trained on standard work, manufacturing procedures, quality requirements, and process controls.
  • Coordinate training related to new equipment, technology implementations, and process improvements.


Safety & Compliance Training

  • Collaborate with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) teams to ensure compliance with all required safety training programs.
  • Maintain records and documentation required for audits, customer requirements, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure completion of mandatory training including:
  • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
  • Hazard Communication
  • Confined Space
  • Powered Industrial Vehicles
  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
  • Emergency Response Procedures
  • Environmental Compliance Requirements


Learning Management & Documentation

  • Administer the site's Learning Management System (LMS).
  • Track and report training completion, certifications, qualification status, and compliance metrics.
  • Maintain training documentation in accordance with company quality systems and record retention requirements.
  • Develop and manage digital and instructor-led training materials.


Leadership & Employee Development

  • Facilitate leadership development programs for supervisors, team leaders, and emerging leaders.
  • Coach managers on employee development, skills progression, and succession planning.
  • Support employee development programs that improve retention and internal mobility.


Continuous Improvement

  • Utilize operational and training metrics to improve workforce capability and training effectiveness.
  • Support Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives through targeted training programs.
  • Analyze training outcomes and implement corrective actions to improve performance.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Experience facilitating technical and operational training programs.
  • Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with high attention to detail
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Learning Management Systems.
  • S/he must be thoroughly knowledgeable of all processes, procedures and instructions that are applicable. It is expected that the supervisor act as a role model and as an agent of the Company.
  • An excellent team player with strong people skills; able to build relationships at all levels of the organization
  • Basic team-building and fundamental leadership skills
  • Effective communication skills, including verbal (logical and organized), written, listening and presentation to all levels in the Company
  • Proven ability to facilitate small to medium-size groups
  • Ability to positively motivate employees
  • Leads by example and possesses solid leadership skills
  • Ability to be objective regarding co-workers and trainees performance
  • Even temperament and ability to take constructive criticism
  • Open and receptive to change; ability to challenge status quo
  • Computer use skills; Word, PowerPoint, Excel, E-mail



Required Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Education, Organizational Development, Business, Engineering, Industrial Technology, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Training, Learning & Development, Workforce Development, or Human Resources within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

Preferred Education / Experience

  • Experience within industrial manufacturing, power generation, energy, aerospace, automotive, or heavy manufacturing environments.
  • CPTD, ATD, SHRM, PHR, Six Sigma, Lean, or related professional certifications.
  • Experience supporting unionized workforces.
  • Knowledge of ISO, quality management systems, and manufacturing compliance requirements.
  • Experience with skills matrices, qualification systems, and workforce capability development




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Key Working Relationships

Functional Leaders: Engineering, Human Resources, Operations, Quality


Physical Demands

Must be able to stand for extended periods.


Working Conditions

Primarily based within a manufacturing facility with regular interaction on the production floor.

Must be able to conduct classroom, practical, and hands-on training in industrial environments.

Ability to travel occasionally between facilities.

May require personal protective equipment (PPE) and exposure to manufacturing environments.
