title: Quality Inspector, 3rd Shift
description:
Prolec GE Waukesha is now part of the GE Vernova Group


Prolec GE Waukesha is seeking a detail‑oriented Quality Inspector to join our team in Goldsboro, NC. In this role, you will inspect critical subassemblies, audit product quality against specified requirements, and ensure compliance with ISO standards. This position plays a key part in supporting manufacturing operations and maintaining product integrity throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with supervisors and shop personnel to ensure product and process integrity.
  • Audit all elements of the ISO standard across multiple functions.
  • Assess product conformance to engineering drawings, manufacturing procedures (MPs), standard procedures (SPs), and overall quality requirements.
  • Identify non‑conforming materials and documents; investigate issues, label, segregate, and facilitate resolutions.
  • Audit products to validate the effectiveness of operator inspections and confirm compliance with standards and customer requirements.
  • Validate mechanical and electrical transformer components and assemblies, including checks for insulation levels, electrical clearances, weld and paint quality, and overall cleanliness.
  • Partner with Purchasing, Engineering, Manufacturing, and suppliers to communicate requirements, verify processes, and identify improvement opportunities. Routine supplier visits are expected.
  • Assist with training new employees and retrain individuals as needed based on inspection findings.
  • Gather data and perform root‑cause analysis related to non‑conformance tracking, FDRs, audits, and assessments to help eliminate recurring issues.
  • Provide ongoing support to the manufacturing process with a strong focus on product quality and continuous improvement.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Broad knowledge of product and process quality principles, including problem identification, analysis, and reporting.
  • Strong computer literacy with proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Effective training skills with an ability to influence and lead quality‑focused initiatives.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and organizational abilities.

Education & Experience

Required:

  • Associate degree in an engineering‑related field or equivalent technical experience.
  • 3–5 years of experience in transformer technical processes (skilled manufacturing or engineering).

Preferred:

  • ASQC certification.

Why Join Us?

Culture:

  • We take pride in a culture rooted in strong values, meaningful behaviors, and a deep sense of purpose. Our commitment to our people, community, and the environment shapes who we are and how we work. At Prolec, you’ll feel supported, included, and connected.

Leadership:

  • Our leadership philosophy centers on inclusivity, growth, and transparency. We invest in our people through comprehensive training, ongoing professional development, continuous coaching, and clear performance expectations - empowering everyone to achieve their highest potential.

Environment:

  • We create an environment where employees can excel. From modern facilities and collaborative spaces to innovative technology and engaging company events, we provide the tools and atmosphere that enable high-quality work and seamless teamwork.

Wellness:

  • We recognize that well-being extends beyond the workplace. That’s why we support our employees and their families through programs that promote personal, financial, physical, and family wellness. Our holistic approach ensures you can thrive both professionally and personally.

Prolec-GE Waukesha, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.

title: Architecture Intern - Healthcare Practice
description:
Kickstart Your Career with an Internship at CPL

Are you a student eager to turn classroom learning into real-world impact? At CPL, a nationally recognized Architecture & Engineering firm, we believe in empowering the next generation of designers, engineers, and innovators. Our internship program is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience, collaborate with seasoned professionals, and contribute to projects that shape communities.

Summer Cycle Dates

May 17th - August 6th

Spring Co-op - If interested

January 11th - May 11th or August 6th


Why Intern with Us?

  • Real Projects, Real Impact – Work on meaningful assignments that go beyond “busy work.”

  • Mentorship & Learning – Learn from industry experts who are invested in your growth.

  • Collaborative Culture – Join a team that values creativity, curiosity, and fresh perspectives.

  • Career Pathways – Explore your future in architecture, engineering, planning, design, or project management.

Who We’re Looking For
We welcome students from all backgrounds of study—Architecture, Engineering (MEP and Civil), Interior Design, and related fields—who are:

  • Curious, motivated, and eager to learn.

  • Excited to bring their ideas to the table.

  • Ready to embrace teamwork and new challenges.


What You'll do

  • Create, update, and maintain AutoCAD and Revit architectural models
  • Participate in conceptual design activities under the supervision of a Project Manager
  • Attend, participate in design team charrettes, preparing meeting minutes for distribution
  • Participate in product research, evaluation, and selection
  • Coordinate detailing across disciplinary teams to ensure compatibility between all building systems and material selections
  • Assist in the development of project specifications
  • Prepare architectural documents for agency approval throughout the bidding and construction administration process
  • Perform shop drawings and submittal reviews
  • Attend construction meetings, maintaining a photographic record of work progress and preparing field reports for distribution
  • Assist the marketing department in obtaining professional, on-site project photos
  • Copy and print drawings as requested

About our Healthcare Practice:

The spaces we design together have a profound impact on people’s lives. That’s what makes our co-creation so powerful. As with any complex diagnosis, CPL understands that a single choice can impact seemingly disparate processes and that any one underlying issue can appear very different depending on who’s looking at it. With this knowledge, and our deep understanding of patient and caregiver needs, we can design environments that are as complex and elegant as the human body. When we give shape to healthcare, the results are potent. Our solutions can enable people to live longer, healthier, and fuller lives

Purpose Built for the Unexpected

Acute care demands high performance from caregivers, with little time to react. Acute care spaces should empower them to work quickly and intuitively, with built-in flexibility to adapt to the unexpected. Our process brings stakeholders to the table to create custom spaces that maximize operational effectiveness through LEAN design while adhering to multiple overlapping healthcare codes and standards. In addition, we work with clients to ensure that spaces are configured to adapt to future care models, including dramatic shifts toward virtual and hybrid care. And when design is complete, our change management strategies help foster a smooth, efficient implementation. Additionally, the intuitive designs we create together enhance the patient journey f rom arrival to discharge, with a focus on convenience, wayfinding and more, providing a comforting and healing environment f rom end-to-end.

What We Offer:

Benefits for Regular Full-Time & Part-Time Employees Working 30+ Hours/Week - not applicable to interns

  • Healthcare for you and your family: Medical, Dental & Vision insurance
    • Single HDHP Medical plan with 100% paid premium
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match
  • Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • FREE Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance for you and your family
  • FREE Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • PTO + Sick Time + 8 Holidays per year
  • Retirement Savings Plan with contribution from CPL to grow your retirement funds
  • Internal Mobility & Career Advancement
  • Licensure Assistance

Additional Benefits Available to FT Employees Working 40+ Hours/Week

  • Tuition Assistance: You may be eligible for continuing education assistance
  • Student Loan Assistance Program: CPL will contribute up to $100/month for 5 years ($6,000 total) toward student loan debt

How to Get Involved

We’re now collecting registrations of interest for upcoming internship opportunities. If you want to grow your skills, build your network, and make a tangible difference, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to register your interest and be among the first to hear about our internship openings.

Be part of something bigger. Start your journey with CPL today.

LEARN MORE

CPL is proud to be not only an equal opportunity employer, but a diverse and motivating place to work. Visit our website (that’s ) to see what we’re all about.

It is based on what a successful New York applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in New York or perform the position from New York. Similar positions located outside of New York will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by New York Equal Pay Transparency Law. title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Is het jouw passie om de digitale klantreis van onze members zo aangenaam mogelijk te maken? Heb jij een sterk gevoel voor design en weet je hoe je gebruikersbehoeften vertaalt naar slimme, gebruiksvriendelijke ontwerpen? Dan ben jij misschien onze nieuwe UX/UI Designer.

Bij ON THAT ASS draait alles om beleving. Niet alleen bij onze boxershorts, maar ook in de manier waarop members onze website en hun accountomgeving ervaren. Met meer dan 800.000 memberships in 18 Europese landen is een sterke digitale customer journey belangrijker dan ooit.

In onze snelle en dynamische omgeving blijven we continu verbeteren. Van nieuwe ideeën en slimme optimalisaties tot commerciële kansen die bijdragen aan onze groei. Jij zorgt ervoor dat iedere klik logisch voelt, onze digitale omgeving er aantrekkelijk uitziet en members gemakkelijk hun weg vinden.

Jouw rol

Samen met onze UX/UI Designer en Customer Journey-specialisten werk je aan het creëren en continu verbeteren van de digitale ervaring van ON THAT ASS-members. Je vertaalt gebruikersbehoeften en complexe vraagstukken naar slimme designs die onze platforms makkelijker maken in gebruik en bijdragen aan een hogere conversie.

Met jouw creatieve blik weet je design, gebruikerservaring en commercie te combineren. Je kijkt kritisch naar onze website en accountomgeving. Wat werkt goed? Waar lopen members tegenaan? En welke verbeteringen kunnen we doorvoeren om hun ervaring nog beter te maken?

Daarnaast ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor ons CRO-proces, waarin experimenteren centraal staat. Je komt met ideeën, vertaalt deze naar sterke hypotheses en designs en gebruikt A/B-testen om te ontdekken wat écht werkt voor onze members.

Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van de customer journey. Van kleine aanpassingen die direct resultaat opleveren tot grotere verbeteringen die onze digitale omgeving naar een hoger niveau tillen. Zo draag je met jouw werk bij aan een betere member experience en de verdere groei van ON THAT ASS.

Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je onderzoekt en brengt gebruikersbehoeften in kaart en vertaalt deze naar gebruiksvriendelijke ontwerpen voor onze digitale platforms.

  • Je analyseert knelpunten in de customer journey, ontdekt verbeterkansen en signaleert commerciële mogelijkheden waarop we snel kunnen inspelen.

  • Je ontwikkelt wireframes, prototypes en high-fidelity designs in Figma voor onze websites en accountomgevingen.

  • Je helpt mee met het verder ontwikkelen en verbeteren van ons bestaande design system, zodat we consistent en efficiënt kunnen blijven ontwerpen.

  • Je bent medeverantwoordelijk voor het CRO-proces en werkt aan creatieve experimenten en A/B-testen om onze conversie te verhogen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Customer Journey, CRM, IT en Data om ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.

  • Je kijkt verder dan alleen onze website en zet jouw UX-kennis in om de volledige customer journey te verbeteren. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan e-mails, social ads en ons loyaltyplatform.

  • Je zet AI-tools slim in binnen je designproces om sneller van idee naar een sterk ontwerp te komen.

Over jou

Jij bent een UX/UI Designer met een sterk gevoel voor design en een goed begrip van gebruikersgedrag. Figma kent voor jou weinig geheimen en je weet hoe je een aantrekkelijk ontwerp combineert met een prettige en logische gebruikerservaring.

Je kijkt verder dan alleen het visuele aspect. Je wilt begrijpen waarom members bepaalde keuzes maken, waar ze afhaken en hoe je met slimme verbeteringen het verschil kunt maken. Daarbij combineer je creativiteit met een commerciële blik en durf je bestaande oplossingen kritisch te bekijken.

Je werkt graag samen met verschillende disciplines, schakelt snel en neemt zelf initiatief. Met jouw nieuwsgierigheid en passie voor het vak voel je je thuis in een ambitieuze organisatie waar volop ruimte is voor nieuwe ideeën en waar je de resultaten van jouw werk terugziet.

Skills en eigenschappen waar wij naar op zoek zijn:

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als UX/UI Designer, bij voorkeur binnen een e-commerceomgeving.

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Uitstekende kennis van Figma en ervaring met het ontwikkelen van wireframes, prototypes en high-fidelity designs.

  • Ervaring met conversieoptimalisatie en A/B-testen.

  • Een sterk portfolio waarin je jouw designvaardigheden laat zien en de keuzes achter jouw ontwerpen goed kunt onderbouwen.

  • Een proactieve en commerciële mindset. Je ziet kansen, neemt initiatief en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen.

  • Je bent een echte teamspeler die houdt van korte lijnen, snel schakelen en samenwerken met verschillende disciplines.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je hiervoor terug?

Bij ON THAT ASS krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis, creativiteit en ideeën in te zetten om onze digitale member experience iedere dag een beetje beter te maken.

Je komt terecht in een ambitieuze, energieke en professionele organisatie waar we snel schakelen, graag nieuwe dingen proberen en continu kijken hoe het slimmer en beter kan. Je werkt samen met verschillende specialisten en krijgt de kans om direct bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van ON THAT ASS.

En natuurlijk belonen we jouw inzet graag:

  • Een salaris tussen de € 3.532 en € 5.294 bruto per maand, waarbij je op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring wordt ingedeeld in onze salarisschaal.

  • Een functie van 32–40 uur per week met veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en zelfstandigheid.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer.

  • Dagelijks een heerlijke, volledig verzorgde lunch op kantoor.

  • Legendarische teamuitjes, leuke activiteiten en exclusieve ON THAT ASS-extra's. Want naast hard werken vinden we het minstens zo belangrijk om onze successen samen te vieren!

Interesse in deze baan?

Wil jij jouw creativiteit en UX/UI-kennis inzetten om de digitale ervaring van onze members naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Voeg bij je sollicitatie direct je portfolio toe. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw werk, de keuzes achter je designs en hoe jij met jouw ideeën het verschil maakt.

title: Patient Services Representative
description:
Purpose of Position:

The purpose of the Front Office Team Member position is to support the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered pediatric care by serving as a welcoming, knowledgeable, and reliable first point of contact for children and their caregivers. This role ensures efficient front office operations that promote access to care, positive patient experiences, and the financial sustainability of the health center through accurate, compassionate, and professional administrative support.


Contribution to Carevide’s Mission:

The Front Office Team Member plays a vital role in advancing the health center’s mission by creating a welcoming, safe, and family-centered environment for children and their caregivers. As the first and last point of contact, this position helps set the tone for each visit by demonstrating warmth, patience, and professionalism in every interaction.

Access to Patient & Family-Centered, High Quality Care: This role supports access to high-quality pediatric care by assisting families with scheduling, insurance, referrals, and administrative processes clearly and compassionately, recognizing that caregivers may be navigating stress, time constraints, or complex systems. Through culturally sensitive and compassionate interactions, the Front Office Team Member helps build trust with families, reduces barriers to care, and supports positive, long-term relationships that promote children’s health and well-being. By collaborating closely with clinical teams and upholding the organization’s values, the Front Office Team Member contributes to a positive patient experience and helps ensure that every child and family feels respected, supported, and cared for.

Financial Success & Sustainability of the Mission: The Front Office Team Member supports the financial sustainability of the health center by ensuring accurate and timely collection of patient information, insurance details, and required documentation. By helping families understand coverage, eligibility, and financial processes clearly and respectfully, this role reduces barriers to care while supporting appropriate reimbursement for services provided. Through attention to detail, effective communication, and collaboration with billing and clinical teams, the Front Office Team Member helps minimize errors, delays, and insurance claim denials that can impact revenue. By fostering positive, trusting relationships with families and encouraging continuity of care, this role contributes to patient retention and the long-term financial health of the pediatric center, ensuring the health center can continue to serve children and families in the community.


Essential Responsibilities of Check-in

Position Summary

Check-in is responsible for delivering a high-quality, patient-centered experience by managing front desk operations, coordinating patient check-in, and ensuring accurate registration, and payment collection. This role plays a critical part in maintaining efficient clinic flow, data accuracy, and compliance with Carevide’s policies.

Patient Experience & Customer Service

  • Greet patients, families and caregivers in a professional, patient-centered manner and assist with questions or concerns.
  • Utilize the AIDET customer service model to ensure patients and caregivers are consistently acknowledged and informed throughout their visit.
  • Maintain professionalism in managing patient concerns, conflicts, or lobby disturbances and notify the supervisor when necessary.
  • Identify and escalate any potentially infectious patients upon arrival following clinic protocols.
  • Coordinate and notify staff of time-sensitive visits, including proper workflows for rooming “48-hour babies.”
  • Monitor patient progress through registration and eligibility process and assist patient, or caregiver in maintaining efficient clinic flow.

Patient Registration & Intake Management

  • Verify patient identity using appropriate identifiers to ensure accurate account and chart access.
  • Review patient appointment notes, registration alerts and Patient FYIs in Epic to identify if additional financial information or PCP change is required prior to check in; direct to eligibility as appropriate.
  • Resolve all registration alerts and eligibility exceptions prior to completing check in.
  • Verify, and update if needed, all patient demographic information including but not limited to:
    • Address
    • Phone Number(s),
    • Email Address,
    • Guarantor information based on visit type
    • Financial/Insurance Changes
  • Review patient registration forms to identify documents requiring annual renewal, ensure all required information is updated, and obtain patient or caregiver signatures in accordance with Carevide policies and Epic workflows. Forms include, but not limited to:
    • Patient Acknowledgement
    • Authorization to Release Information
    • UDS Intake Form
    • Sliding Fee Discount Program screening
  • When applicable, update the family size and income within the patient’s chart based on the UDS Intake Form.
  • Capture patient photos in accordance with organizational procedures.
  • Collect and copy valid IDs and current insurance cards (front and back) when not obtained through the patient portal.
  • Ensure correct guarantor is added to visit based on program and visit type.
  • Create and attach Claim Information record in Epic when required based on the visit type, payer, or program eligibility including:
    • Family Planning
    • Early and Periodic Screening, Diagnostic and Treatment (EPSDT)
  • Complete the check-in process ensuring active insurance payer(s) are added in correct filing order or grant program is attached based on visit type.
  • Update appointment status in Epic according to Carevide’s Epic workflow:
    • “Present” - when patient arrives
    • “Arrived / On-site - Good to Go” - when all registration and financial requirements are complete and patient is ready for the clinical team.

Scheduling & Appointment Coordination

  • Assist patients and caregivers of walk-in patients with scheduling same-day or future appointments as needed.
  • Perform daily appointment confirmation calls the day prior to scheduled visits and clearly communicate the following to the patient or caregiver:
    • Time of arrival for appointment
    • Expected payment amounts
    • Required documentation needed for financial screening (ex: proof of income) or billing of insurance

Payment Collection & Account Management

  • Collect and post patient payments, including co-pays, co-insurance, and sliding fee amounts to the patients account in Epic.
  • Provide the patient or caregiver with a receipt for all collected payments.
  • Follow Carevide’s collection procedure for OB patients on a self-pay agreement. Follow Carevide’s collection policy for patients unable to pay at time of service.
  • Inform patients or caregivers of outstanding balances from previous visits and collect payment following Carevide’s collection policy.
  • Review accounts for credit balances and coordinate with the billing team to apply credits to current visits as appropriate.
  • Reconcile daily cash and check collections against Epic “Cash Drawer” to ensure accuracy.

Reporting & Administrative Responsibilities

  • Assist front office team with daily scanning of patient documents and filing in the patient’s chart within the Epic system.
  • Participate in scheduled lobby checks and communicate delays or extended wait times to patients. Lobby checks to be completed at 9:00a, 11:00a, 2:00p & 4:00p.
  • Maintain compliance with Carevide’s policies, payer requirements, and regulatory standards
  • Collaborate with front office team members to maintain a clean, organized, efficient, and patient-focused environment.
Essential Responsibilities of Check-out

Position Summary

Check-out is responsible for ensuring accurate and efficient patient check-out, payment collection, and scheduling of follow-up care. This role plays a key part in revenue cycle integrity, patient satisfaction, and maintaining smooth clinic operations through effective communication, attention to detail, and adherence to organizational policies.

Patient Experience & Customer Service

  • Greet patients, families and caregivers in a professional, patient-centered manner and assist with questions or concerns.
  • Utilize the AIDET customer service model to ensure patients and caregivers are consistently acknowledged and informed throughout their visit.
  • Monitor patient progress through registration and eligibility process and assist patient, or caregiver in maintaining efficient clinic flow.
  • Provide a positive closing experience by thanking patients and caregivers for choosing Carevide for their healthcare needs or some other expression of gratitude.

Check-Out & Charge Processing

  • Verify patient identity using appropriate identifiers to ensure accurate account and chart access
  • Complete the check-out process in Epic, ensuring all visits are properly finalized, based on visit type, with current insurance payer(s) in the correct filing order or program payer attached if applicable.
  • Review visits and ensure attachment and completion of “Claim Information” record for applicable insurance payers and grants payers based on type of visit.
    • Family Planning: ensure information is updated with current date and services
    • Early and Periodic Screening, Diagnostic and Treatment (EPSDT)
  • Update appointment status in Epic according to Carevide’s Epic workflow:
    • “Completed” - once all check-out processes are reviewed and completed.
  • Review Appointment Status for visits completed by providers and ensure all visits are updated before end of day.

Payment Collection & Reconciliation

  • Collect and post any remaining patient balances at time of service, including co-pays, co-insurance, outstanding balances if applicable.
  • Provide the patient or caregiver a receipt for all payments collected.
  • Follow Carevide’s collection policies for patients unable to pay at time of service.
  • Review accounts for credit balances and coordinate with the billing team to apply credits to current visits as appropriate
  • Reconcile daily cash and check collections against Epic “Cash Drawer” to ensure accuracy

Scheduling & Follow-Up Coordination

  • Schedule follow-up and return appointments according to provider check-out instructions, recalls and health maintenance recommendations documented in Epic.
  • Provide patients or caregivers with detailed appointment reminder card for scheduled visits.
  • Assist patients, families and caregivers of walk-in patients with scheduling same-day or future appointments as needed

Registration Support & Data Accuracy

  • Retrieve and review incoming referrals and schedule appointment as indicated.

Reporting & Administrative Responsibilities

  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of documentation for each visit related to check-out and billing processes
  • Complete daily deposit tasks including:
    • Taking daily collected payment to the bank
    • Complete deposit worksheet
    • Scan required deposit documents to Finance daily by 4:00pm.
  • Assist front office team with daily scanning of patient documents and filing in the patient’s chart within the Epic system.
  • Participate in scheduled lobby checks and communicate delays or extended wait times to patients. Lobby checks to be completed at 9:00a, 11:00a, 2:00p & 4:00p.
  • Maintain compliance with Carevide’s policies, payer requirements, and regulatory standards
  • Collaborate with front office team members to maintain a clean, organized, efficient, and patient-focused environment.
Essential Responsibilities of Eligibility

Position Summary

Eligibility is responsible for verifying insurance coverage, determining financial eligibility, and ensuring accurate patient financial information prior to and during visits. This role supports revenue cycle integrity and patient access to care by managing pre-registration, eligibility verification, and financial screening processes, including the Sliding Fee Discount Program. The position requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to delivering a patient-centered experience.

Patient Experience & Customer Service

  • Greet patients, families and caregivers in a professional, patient-centered manner and assist with questions or concerns.
  • Utilize the AIDET customer service model to ensure patients and caregivers are consistently acknowledged and informed throughout their visit.
  • Verify patient identity using appropriate identifiers prior to discussing protected health or financial information.
  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when discussing sensitive financial and insurance information.

Pre-Registration Management

  • Perform daily pre-registration process 6-7 days prior to appointment date, to verify:
    • Current insurance coverage and benefits
    • Current Referral and/or Pre-authorization on file in patient chart if applicable
    • Current Sliding Fee screening
    • Current enrollment in Grant Program if applicable to visit type
    • Every patient chart is updated with current family size and income details
  • Monitor schedules daily for newly scheduled patients and complete the pre-registration process prior to the patient’s visit.
  • Update Patient FYI in Epic with insurance and financial details and ensure accuracy of pre-registration data.
  • Work with scheduling staff and review Team Chat for newly scheduled patients who may need a referral and/or pre-authorization.
  • Retrieve insurance information for new patients; process verification and contact patient or caregiver to explain benefits, patient cost share and referral/authorizations.

Insurance Verification & Eligibility Management

  • Verify insurance eligibility 6-7 days prior to appointments, including:
    • Coverage status and benefits
    • Primary Care Provider (PCP) assignment
    • Primary and secondary coverage
    • Patient financial responsibility (co-pay/co-insurance)
    • Requirement for Referral and/or Prior Authorization for OB and GYN services
  • Resolve all eligibility exceptions prior to the patient’s arrival when possible.
  • Contact patient or caregiver to obtain missing or updated insurance information and facilitate PCP changes when needed prior to appointment.
  • Update Appointment Notes with needed financial data if unable to obtain by contacting the patient or caregiver.
  • Ensure current insurance cards (front and back) are on file in the patient chart.
  • Add new insurance payers and terminate inactive coverage within Epic.

Financial Screening & Sliding Fee Program

  • Conduct financial screenings in a confidential setting to determine eligibility for available grant programs offered at Carevide.
  • Ensure documentation and/or application for screened grant program(s) is complete, current, and accurate, including proof of income or required documentation is received.
  • Completion of warning letter if documentation of income is not provided.
  • Update patient chart with current family size and income data obtained during financial screening process.
  • Clearly explain to the patient or caregiver the purpose of the financial screening process and benefits of the grant programs offered at Carevide.
  • Completion of Prenatal Financial Agreement for uninsured prenatal patients and explain payment expectations following Carevide’s procedure.
  • Identify and refer patients who may qualify for Medicaid/CHIP to Outreach & Enrollment staff.

Payment Collection & Account Management

  • Collect and post patient payments, including co-pays, co-insurance, and sliding fee amounts to the patients account in Epic.
  • Provide the patient or caregiver with a receipt for all collected payments.
  • Follow Carevide’s collection procedure for OB patients on Carevide’s prenatal self-pay agreement.
  • Follow Carevide’s collection policy for patients unable to pay at time of service.
  • Inform patients or caregivers of outstanding balances from previous visits and collect payment following Carevide’s collection policy.
  • Review accounts for credit balances and coordinate with the billing team to apply credits to current visits as appropriate.
  • Reconcile daily cash and check collections against Epic “Cash Drawer” to ensure accuracy.

Clinic Flow & Visit Processing

  • Ensure correct guarantor is added to visit based on program and visit type.
  • Create and attach Claim Information record in Epic when required based on the visit type, payer, or program eligibility including:
    • Family Planning
    • Early and Periodic Screening, Diagnostic and Treatment (EPSDT)
  • Complete the check-in process ensuring active insurance payer(s) are added in correct filing order or grant program is attached based on visit type.
  • Update appointment status in Epic according to Carevide’s Epic workflow:
    • “Arrived / On-site - Good to Go” - when all registration and financial requirements have been completed and patient is ready for the clinical team
  • Collaborate with front office and clinical staff to ensure efficient patient flow and timely service.

Reporting & Administrative Responsibilities

  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of eligibility, insurance, and financial documentation.
  • Maintain compliance with Carevide’s policies, payer requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Assist front office team with daily scanning of patient documents and filing in the patient’s chart within the Epic system.
  • Collaborate with front office team members to maintain a clean, organized, efficient, and patient-focused environment.
Daily Responsibilities of The Patient Services Representative:
  • If opening, ensure doors are unlocked by the designated time and all lights are turned on.
  • If closing, ensure doors are locked, all collected payments are balanced and deposit slip and forms are completed in accordance with Carevide’s deposit procedures.
  • Deposit is to be taken to the bank by 4:00 p.m. the following business day.

Expectations:

Employee is expected to:

  • Assist all front office team members when needed to reduce any delay in registration and ensure the process moves smoothly.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by their supervisor, the Practice Manager and/or AR Manager.
  • Perform job duties in a friendly manner and with a positive attitude.
  • Treat patients and caregivers with respect at all times.
  • Treat supervisors and coworkers with respect at all times.
  • Work cooperatively and communicate with health center staff, providers, and patients and caregivers as necessary.
  • Keep any information seen, read or heard confidential according to HIPAA guidelines.
  • Keep personal matters out of the work place.
  • Fulfill job duties daily.
  • Participate in ongoing training activities as provided by the organization related to assigned tasks and providing patient-centered care.
  • Keep their supervisor informed of any work-related issues.
  • Keep their workspace and the front office clean, organized, and clutter-free.
  • Regularly check lobby spaces and the front office counter for cleanliness, organization, and any other issues that affect appearance, safety, and or customer service.
  • Inform Housekeeping and Facilities of areas that require attention in and around your workstation and the lobby area.
  • Inform supervisor of any non-approved absenteeism/tardiness at least 2 hours before scheduled start time.
  • Fill out time off request forms in advance with as much notice as possible, a minimum of 2 weeks.


General Qualifications and Requirements:

Knowledge and Skills

Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions with accuracy and efficiency. Must demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with patients and staff in a fast-paced environment. Detail-oriented, neat and organized, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage a busy schedule, and adapt to changes in workflow and scheduling as needed. Ability to multitask and work as part of a team to perform scheduling, check-in, eligibility, and check-out functions in Epic as necessary to successfully perform in the role.

Education

Graduation from an accredited High School or equivalent.


Qualifications

Computer skills are necessary. A minimum of one-year of customer service experience is required; experience in a medical office setting is a plus.

Reporting Relationship

Reports directly to the Accounts Receivable Manager, with collaborative oversight and coordination with the Practice Manager.

title: Entry Assistant Designer - Topshop

title: 1st shift, Robot Cell Operator, LSPB1 10HR Line 15 Sides Build
description:
Position Description:

Operate and support the 40.2 robotic cell to meet production needs safely, reliably, and efficiently under the direction of the Production Supervisor and Production Coordinators.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Below are examples of the type of duties you could be responsible for:

  • Perform drill bit changes using appropriate hand tools.
  • Interpret the Keyence vision system and respond appropriately to system information.
  • Complete routine operator preventive maintenance.
  • Interpret cell and robotic fault messages and clearly communicate the information to the maintenance team.
  • Communicate production needs, issues, and status updates with the Production Supervisor and Production Coordinators.
  • Maintain reliable and punctual attendance.
  • Learn and apply new skills as required to support the operation
  • Wearing approved personal protective equipment such as safety shoes, gloves, safety glasses with side shields, respirators, hearing protection, etc.
  • Completing assigned duties in accordance with safety, policies, and practices, including your individual safety, as well as the safety of co-workers, and the safe use of equipment in the workplace

Tools & Equipment:

Below is a list of examples of the potential tools and equipment you may find yourself working with, depending upon your department and location. Wabash provides all the necessary training for you to feel comfortable and confident to excel at your new career with us.

  • Hammers
  • Wrenches
  • Hoists
  • Line carts
  • Multi-Head Drills
  • Tuggers
  • Circular Saws
  • Drills
  • Impacts
  • Rivet Guns
  • Staplers
  • Caulk Applicators
  • Routers

Qualifications:

  • Must be able to pass a pre-employment drug screen
  • Basic reading, writing, & verbal skills

Knowledge, Training, Skills and/or Experience:

The position requires the ability to operate within a robotic-cell environment, complete routine operator preventive maintenance, interpret the Keyence vision system, recognize cell and robotic fault messages, and communicate production or maintenance needs clearly. Job-specific training will be provided as applicable.

Benefits:

  • Vacation
  • Paid Holidays
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits
  • 401k with match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

Working Conditions/Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. An employee in this position works in an environment in which safety, environmental, and health concerns may demand constant attention. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to fumes or airborne particles, as well as moving mechanical parts and vibrations. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at job sites where the noise level can be very loud with high temperatures at times. Due to the work environment, all employees on the production floor must wear the necessary personal production equipment (PPE). At Wabash, we pride ourselves on being empowering. Wabash is committed to provide equal employment opportunity for its associates and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, and sex.

Physical Demands:

As a Robot Cell Operator, you are regularly required to stand, walk, lean, push, climb, sit, bend, kneel, stoop, handle, and operate tools or controls for the entirety of their shift. The employee needs full range of motion in arms and hands, all assemblers must be able to successfully communicate with fellow employees as well. Some assemblers also work in small spaces throughout their shift and frequently lift and/or carry objects weighting up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus, along with good hand-eye coordination.

Behavioral Attributes:

  • Identifies the existence and cause of a problem
  • Communicates information clearly and promptly
  • Takes initiative, persists at tasks, and pursues completion of objectives
  • Shares information with others to help them perform their jobs safely
  • Copes successfully with unexpected events
  • Develops plans to achieve objectives & identifies resources needed to accomplish objectives
  • Resolves conflicting priorities and accomplishes work on time

Leadership Attributes:

At Wabash, we pride ourselves on being empowering. Below are some of our key values:

  • Embrace Diversity and Inclusion -- Solicit and respect the input of others, celebrate differences, and strive for transparency and inclusiveness.
  • Seek to Listen -- Actively listen to reach the best solution and make the strongest decisions.
  • Always Learn -- Strive to improve; do not quit or settle for the status quo.
  • Be Authentic -- Demonstrate honesty, incredible energy, and grit in everything you do.
  • Win Together -- Collaborate, seek alignment, and excel at cross-group communication to succeed as one team and One Wabash.

title: SAP Platform Engineer (m/f/d)

Share our values and become part of the team to shape the future of Knauf together.

title: Rehabilitation Consultant

title: Redthread Team Leader- King's College Hospital
description:
The Team Leader role has responsibility for the operational oversight of Redthread’s delivery within King's College Hospital and any community work undertaken in the surrounding area. The role is part of the wider youth work team within Redthread with a primary focus on youth violence and mental health interventions in a health care setting. The role leads the hospital’s Youth Violence Intervention Programme, supporting young people aged 11–25 who attend following violence or where there are concerns about exploitation or extra-familial harm. The Team Leader also oversees the Young Women's Service, which provides longer-term support to young women affected by community violence, and the Mental Health Youth Work Pilot for 11–18-year-olds admitted following deliberate self-harm. The role includes line management of the team’s Youth Workers, ensuring the service operates effectively and supporting young people both in hospital and after discharge to access the help they need and want.

Main duties include:

  • To recruit, manage, motivate, coach and develop a staff team including carrying out annual appraisals and regular supervision meetings. To manage their health, safety and wellbeing.
  • To promote and embed Catch22’s vision and values in local service delivery
  • To ensure all service user information, interventions and other data as required by the contract are recorded on the relevant data management system in line with Catch22’s policy.
  • To manage operational risk, health and safety, governance and safeguarding issues in line with Catch22, Catch22 and Commissioner policies.
  • Carry out regular case file audits as per the Audit Policy and Procedure
  • Be responsible for the allocation of referrals and ensure caseload management structures are in place
  • Adhere to reporting requirements, deadlines and requests, ensuring all required information is recorded accurately as instructed.
  • Hold a small caseload of young people and support them in the hospital and post discharge

Essential

  • Relevant level 3 or 4 qualification in health & wellbeing, youth provision or similar or demonstrable equivalent experience

Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience of working with young people with challenging needs.
  • Experience of Inter-agency working. Work within/ in partnership with Children’s and Family Services/ Youth Justice Services/ Youth services.
  • Experience of delivering training to young people/professionals
  • Working with young people in group and one-to-one settings.
  • Knowledge of issues around risk and vulnerability amongst young people.
  • An awareness of the current issues relating to at risk and vulnerable young people.
  • Knowledge of engagement and intervention strategies.
  • Knowledge of Children Act/LSCB Procedures and other appropriate youth policies.
  • Understanding and experience of Performance Management with regard to practice and target achievement.
  • Experience of using recording and data collation systems

Essential

  • Ability to manage conflict & negotiation skills.
  • Experience and skills to lead a team, setting objectives and priorities, monitoring performance against agreed targets.
  • Reviewing skills in enabling staff to reach full potential and achieve targets through individual supervision, annual appraisal and learning development programmes.
  • The ability to contribute to ongoing service evaluation and review
  • Communicate well in a range of settings, with different people.
  • Good organisational skills (for self and others).
  • To be able to use a range of leadership styles as appropriate.
  • Work effectively in a team.
  • Manage conflicting demands.
  • To be able to adopt a flexible approach to all aspects of work.
  • Problem solving and a “can do” attitude.
  • Basic ICT skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Job description:

Purpose:

The Business Information Security Officer (BISO) for Operational Technology (OT) and Customer Facing solutions serves as the primary security liaison between the cyber security organization and business units responsible for OT environments and externally delivered solutions. This role owns the security program for these domains, driving secure onboarding of systems and partners, maintaining documentation standards, participating in design and architecture reviews and leading security assessments for both OT networks and customer-facing solutions.

This is a highly cross functional role requiring deep technical security knowledge, strong stakeholder communication skills and an understanding of industrial control systems (ICS), and enterprise solution delivery. The BISO acts as a security strategist ensuring that security is embedded into processes from initial designs through ongoing operations post-delivery.

Reports to: NORAM Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Location: Sterling Heights, MI or Montreal, CAN

Department: IT Cyber Security Services

Key Responsibilities: Onboarding & Vendor/System integration

- Leading the security onboarding process for new OT Systems and customer facing solutions, ensuring all assets are assessed, documented and approved before production deployment.

- Define and enforce security requirements, including network segmentation standards, access control models, and identity management policies for OT and customer solution environments.

- Coordinate with procurement, legal and IT teams to ensure that third party vendors meet security baseline requirements through contract review and vendor risk assessments.

Documentation & Standards Management

- Own the security documentation library for OT and customer-facing solution domains including network diagrams, network flows, security control matrices, security plans and backup solutions.

- Develop and maintain security standards and procedures specific to OT environments.

- Ensure documentation remains current through periodic review cycles and is aligned with applicable compliance frameworks.

- Collaborate with engineering, operations and product teams to capture security architecture decisions and maintain accurate as

-built documentation. Design Review & Architecture Participation

- Participate in architecture design review as a security SME. EQUANS is an equal opportunity employer.

- Review proposed OT system architectures, network designs and customer solution designs for security gaps

– providing documented findings and remediation recommendations. Security Review & Risk Assessment

- Lead security reviews for OT network changes, new customer-facing solutions and significant modifications to existing deployments, producing risk assessment reports with prioritized findings.

- Coordinate penetration testing and vulnerability assessments activities scoped to OT and customer solution environments; track findings through remediation.

- Assess and communicate residual risk to business stakeholders and CISO, facilitating informed risk acceptance decisions when appropriate.

- Serve as the security point of contact for customer security questionnaires, audits and third party security assessments related to delivered solutions.

Minimum Qualifications Required Education/Experience

- Minimum of 7+ years in information security with at least 3 years focused on OT/ICS security or customer-facing solution security in a solutions provider, or managed services context.

- Demonstrated experience conducting security design reviews, architecture assessments, and risk analysis for complex networked environments.

- Working knowledge of OT/ICS security standards and frameworks.

- Familiarity with enterprise IT security frameworks

- Experience managing security documentation programs

- Strong understanding of network security principles; segmentation, DMZ design, firewall policy, remote access, identity and access management.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to present security risk to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

- CISSP, CISM, GICSP or equivalent

- Direct experience with DCS, PLCs, historians or industrial IOT networks

- Experience working alongside regulated industries such as energy/utilities or manufacturing.

- Background in solutions delivery or managed security services

- Experience with security tooling relevant to OT and enterprise environments

- Familiarity with secure remote access solution implementations and designs.

Working Environment

The working environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is not exposed to weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. The position could require some lifting.

title: Senior AI Engineer (LLMs & Agentic AI)
description:
About You

You are a Senior AI Engineer passionate about building production-grade LLM applications and agentic AI systems. You thrive in collaborative environments where you design, implement, and optimize AI capabilities that power conversational experiences and intelligent workflows.

You enjoy solving complex AI challenges, integrating cutting-edge LLM technologies, and continuously improving production systems through experimentation, evaluation, and engineering best practices. You're comfortable making production design decisions autonomously within a small, lightly-managed team, and defending those decisions directly to engineering leadership.

Note: This role operates under a contractor model and requires availability to work in the U.S. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices for production backend services (APIs, async I/O, typing/schema validation, error handling, and testing).
  • Strong SQL skills working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred).
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade LLM and agentic AI applications.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying MCP servers in production (server-side, consumed by other users or systems), including tool and resource definitions, context management, and multi-step orchestration.
  • Understanding of MCP transports (stdio vs. Streamable HTTP) and authentication/authorization patterns for remote servers (OAuth/OIDC, scoped and resource-level access).
  • Experience integrating hosted LLM APIs such as Anthropic and OpenAI into production environments.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, prompt versioning, fallback strategies, and cost/latency optimization, with direct ownership of these concerns in production.
  • Experience designing intent classification and routing solutions for natural language applications, resolving user intent into the correct API and data-source calls.
  • Experience building conversational AI solutions or multi-API orchestration workflows.
  • Experience developing LLM evaluation methodologies and demonstrated ability to reverse-engineer and work within a partially documented, brownfield Python codebase.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to explain your own technical work in first-person depth under sustained technical questioning, clearly distinguishing what you personally built, what you contributed to, and what you only observed.
  • Strong spoken English (B2+) to discuss technical scenarios live with US-based stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience deploying, fine-tuning, and evaluating open-source models using Hugging Face.
  • Experience with GPU acceleration and inference optimization.
  • Experience implementing MLOps practices, including CI/CD, observability, and reproducible pipelines.
  • Experience with vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Applied NLP experience.
  • Experience building client-facing AI products.
  • AWS experience (Batch, ECS, Lambda, SQS).

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain MCP servers, tool and resource definitions, and context management capabilities.
  • Design and implement intent evaluation, classification, and routing workflows, including orchestrating resolution into the correct API and data-source calls, with aggregation across multiple sources.
  • Integrate Anthropic and OpenAI models into production environments.
  • Manage prompt versioning, fallback strategies, and LLM performance optimization.
  • Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to validate model quality and production performance.
  • Write SQL against model inputs and outputs to support evaluation and monitoring.
  • Support the backend behavior of the chat / MCP interface.
  • Work within an existing, partially documented codebase, tracing behavior and making safe, incremental changes.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and AI specialists to deliver production-ready AI solutions.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to AI platform design.
  • Continuously improve AI systems through experimentation, optimization, and engineering best practices.
  • Experience building production AI applications with Python and LLM technologies.
  • Must have personally authored/built an MCP server deployed in production and used by other users or systems (not simply integrated, consumed, or built as a local proof of concept).
  • Hands-on brownfield experience, adding significant features to a production Python codebase.
  • Experience designing and deploying conversational AI or agentic AI solutions.
  • Strong experience with prompt engineering, LLM integrations, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Strong spoken English (B2+)

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Hemtjänstsamordnare Täby
description:
Vårdlänken söker erfaren hemtjänstsamordnare för konsultuppdrag Täby

Ort: Täby

Omfattning: Heltid

Uppdragsstart: Omgående

Uppdragsform: Konsultuppdrag, tidsbegränsat

Om uppdraget

Vårdlänken söker nu två erfarna och självgående hemtjänstsamordnare för konsultuppdrag hos en kund med verksamheter i Upplands Väsby respektive Täby.

Uppdragen är på heltid och syftar till att säkerställa en stabil och välfungerande verksamhet under en period då kunden genomför rekrytering av ordinarie personal.

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av operativ hemtjänstplanering, arbetsledning och löpande uppföljning av verksamhetens mål. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har god organisatorisk förmåga och kan snabbt sätta dig in i verksamhetens rutiner och arbetssätt.

Då verksamheterna arbetar enligt olika planeringsmodeller är det viktigt att du har erfarenhet av det arbetssätt som tillämpas på den aktuella enheten.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som hemtjänstsamordnare ansvarar du bland annat för att:

  • Planera och samordna det dagliga arbetet inom hemtjänsten.
  • Säkerställa en effektiv bemanning och fungerande schemaläggning.
  • Leda och stödja medarbetare i det operativa arbetet.
  • Följa upp verksamhetens mål, rutiner och kvalitet.
  • Hantera förändringar och lösa operativa utmaningar i den dagliga driften.
  • Bidra till kontinuitet, struktur och en god omsorg för brukarna.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av samordning och operativ planering inom hemtjänsten.
  • Har erfarenhet av arbetsledning och bemanningsplanering.
  • Är van att följa upp verksamhetsmål och säkerställa att arbetet bedrivs effektivt.
  • Har erfarenhet av relevant planeringsmodell för den aktuella verksamheten.
  • Är självgående, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad.
  • Har god kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika yrkesgrupper.
  • Kan sätta dig in i nya rutiner och verksamheter med kort introduktion.

Vem är du?

Du är en trygg och handlingskraftig person som trivs i en operativ roll med stort eget ansvar. Du har förmågan att prioritera, fatta beslut och skapa struktur även när tempot är högt.

Som konsult är du flexibel, professionell och snabbt anpassningsbar. Du förstår vikten av god planering, tydlig kommunikation och ett närvarande ledarskap för att få den dagliga verksamheten att fungera.

Vi erbjuder

  • Heltidsuppdrag i Upplands Väsby eller Täby.
  • Möjlighet till omgående start.
  • Ett ansvarsfullt uppdrag där din erfarenhet gör konkret skillnad.
  • Möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens under en viktig övergångsperiod i verksamheten.

Ansökan

Låter uppdraget intressant? Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan till Vårdlänken.

Beskriv gärna din erfarenhet av hemtjänstsamordning, operativ planering, arbetsledning och vilka planeringsmodeller du har arbetat med. Ange även din tillgänglighet för start.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, och vi ser gärna att du kan tillträda omgående.

Anställning

Du kommer att bli anställd som konsult för Vårdlänken Bemanning & Rekrytering, med varierande arbetstider och tjänstegrad efter överenskommelse.

Som konsult hos oss erbjuds du:

• Konkurrenskraftig lön och intressanta uppdrag i olika verksamheter

• Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och semesterersättning

• Stora möjligheter att själv välja arbetsplats och arbetstider

• Hjälp med resa och boende om du arbetar på annan ort

• Introduktion och kontinuerlig coachning så att du snabbt kommer in i din roll

• En dedikerad och tillgänglig konsultchef, som själv varit verksam inom ditt yrkesområde

• Inbjudningar till seminarier och konsultträffar

Vårdlänken är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag genom arbetsgivarorganisationen Almega – en trygghet för dig som konsult. Det innebär bland annat att vi har kollektivavtal och gedigna ansvars- och olycksfallsförsäkringar för våra konsulter, samt att vi betalar in till din tjänstepension från den allra första kronan du tjänar.

Ansökan

Varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan till oss via ansökningsformuläret. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vi tar tacksamt emot din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid frågor om tjänsten, var vänlig kontakta kontaktpersonen nedan. På www.vardlanken.se/lediga-jobb presenterar vi alla våra lediga uppdrag.

Om oss

Vårdlänken Bemanning & Rekrytering förmedlar intressanta konsultuppdrag och tjänster till dig som är läkare, sjuksköterska, undersköterska, fysioterapeut, arbetsterapeut, socionom, chef eller har annan profession inom vård eller socialt arbete. Vårt mål är att ge dig ett flexibelt och utvecklande arbetsliv, samtidigt som vi tillsammans bidrar till en välfungerande vård- och omsorgssektor genom rätt kompetens på rätt plats.

Vi har över 28 års erfarenhet av vårdbemanning. Våra kunder är både privata och offentliga aktörer inom hälsovård, sjukvård och omsorg över hela Sverige. Vi hjälper dem med skräddarsydda bemanningslösningar och hjälper även till att rekrytera personal till fasta tjänster. Det gör oss till helhetsleverantör av kompetens inom vård- och omsorgsområdet.

Läs mer på www.vardlanken.se, samt följ oss på Linkedin: www.linkedin.com/company/vardlanken

Notre innovation continue est alimentée par les idées audacieuses, les perspectives nouvelles et les voix passionnées que nos équipes apportent à tout ce que nous faisons.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Market Research Analyst
description:
About the Role: Attentive AI is a construction technology company building the future of takeoff and estimating software. As we continue to scale our go-to-market motion, our Data Operations function plays a central role in sustaining a high-velocity outbound sales engine. We are seeking a detail-oriented, entry-level Data Analyst to join this team and support a growing roster of 15+ Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) with clean, enriched, and actionable B2B prospect data across the US and Canadian construction market. This role offers direct, measurable impact on pipeline quality and revenue generation from day one.

Key Responsibilities:
Prospecting & Data Management
  • Source and maintain a high-quality B2B prospecting database targeting general contractors, subcontractors, specialty trades, and material suppliers.
  • Use ZoomInfo and Seamless.AI to research, enrich, and verify contact-level and company-level data.
  • Perform regular data hygiene tasks including deduplication, validation, and formatting of prospect records.
  • Organize and maintain structured spreadsheets and tracking files to support SDR outreach workflows.
Market Research & GTM Support
  • Conduct market research to identify new target segments, whitespace opportunities, and construction trade verticals.

  • Support go-to-market strategy execution by preparing segmented and prioritized lead lists aligned to campaign goals.
  • Monitor competitor activity and construction market trends to surface relevant intelligence for the sales team.
Reporting & Analysis
  • Build and maintain Excel/Google Sheets-based dashboards and reports tracking pipeline coverage, data quality metrics, and SDR outreach performance.
  • Identify patterns and trends in lost-deal data, outreach response rates, and ICP match rates.
  • Present weekly data readouts to the Senior Data Analyst and sales leadership.
Requirements:
Must-Have Skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets including formulas, pivot tables, filters, and data formatting.
  • Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of ZoomInfo and/or Seamless.AI for prospecting and contact enrichment.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct structured market research and synthesize findings.
  • Understanding of B2B sales motions, GTM strategy, and outbound pipeline fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and the practical application of AI in everyday tasks using AI to work faster and more accurately, with sound judgment on when and how to apply it.
Nice to Have
  • Exposure to LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, or RocketReach.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) for data entry and management.
  • Basic Python or SQL knowledge for data manipulation and automation (not required but a strong plus).
  • Knowledge of the US/Canada construction industry NAICS codes, trade segments, procurement cycles.
Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 0–1 year of relevant experience in data operations, sales operations, market research, or business analytics.

title: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on, production-focused Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to join our growing AI Center of Excellence, responsible for using AI and machine learning to drive innovation across the organization. In this role, you will take the formal domain ontologies designed by our Knowledge Representation Architects and operationalize them into high-throughput, multi-hop systems.

Your work will directly power autonomous AI agents that solve complex sustainability challenges — including decarbonisation, sustainable procurement compliance, and supply chain resilience. You will bridge the gap between unstructured sustainability disclosures and structured graph databases, building entity-resolution pipelines that make enterprise data agent-ready.

Your responsibilities will include (but will not be limited to):

  • Graph Infrastructure and Ingestion Pipelines

    • Design, implement, and maintain high-speed GraphRAG ingestion pipelines that transform relational data (ERP, SQL), unstructured ESG reports, and streaming feeds into operational Labeled Property Graphs (Neo4j, Memgraph) and RDF Triple Stores

  • A-Box Instantiation and Entity Resolution

    • Build automated Named Entity Recognition (NER), entity linking, and deduplication workflows to resolve mismatched vendor profiles, material SKUs, and facility coordinates into unified canonical graph nodes

  • Semantic Federation and External Data Integration

    • Implement automated ETL/ELT pipelines to map and federate internal supply chain data with external, open-source ontologies and registries (such as GLEIF for corporate ownership, W3C SSN/SOSA for IoT sensors, and Copernicus for geo-hazard alerts, PROV-O for data provenance)

  • GraphRAG and Agent Tooling

    • Partner with AI/ML Engineers to build low-latency GraphRAG retrieval layers—writing optimized Cypher and SPARQL queries, implementing NL2Query tools for agents, hybrid vector-graph indexing pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool endpoints for autonomous LLM agents

  • Deterministic Guardrails and Pipeline Validation

    • Operationalize SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) shapes into automated data quality tests within CI/CD pipelines to prevent hallucinated or non-compliant data mutations from entering the enterprise knowledge graph

  • Performance Optimization and GraphOps

    • Optimize multi-hop query performance, graph partitioning, and database indexing strategies to handle sub-second traversal over billions of nodes and edges

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • 4+ years of production experience building and querying graph databases, specifically Labeled Property Graphs (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph) or RDF Triple Stores (GraphDB, Stardog, Virtuoso)

  • Strong experience in cloud technology, preferably Azure and its ecosystem (e.g., Azure Foundry, Azure Bicep, AzureML and Azure Cloud Storage)

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (RDFLib, NetworkX, PyGraphistry) for building scalable, production-grade data pipelines

  • Experience building entity extraction pipelines using modern NLP frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, spaCy) or LLM-based structured extraction

  • Hands-on experience with modern data transformation tools (dbt) and integrating graph databases with vector stores (Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector) for hybrid search architectures

  • Solid understanding of semantic web standards (RDF, RDFS and OWL, SKOS, SHACL, RDF-star, SPARQL), graph schema design principles (T-Box vs. A-Box separation), and mapping languages for dealing with heterogeneous data structures (RML, R2RML)

  • Experience working with domain-specific supply chain, carbon accounting (GHG Protocol), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) data structures is a plus

  • Direct experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose graph tools to LLM agents is a plus

  • Experience with enterprise OBDA approaches at-scale is a plus

  • Offer available only for candidates eligible to work and live in Poland

  • Location: Hybrid in Warsaw (2 days per week in the office) / Full remote from Poland

In return for your expertise, we offer:

  • Support with all the necessary office and IT equipment

  • Flexible working hours

  • Wellness allowance for mental and physical wellbeing

  • Access to professional mental health support

  • Referral bonus policy

  • Learning and development

  • Sustainability events and community involvement

  • Peer recognition program

  • Employee-led resource groups

  • Optional (fully covered or co-financed) health care and life insurance

  • Multisport card

  • Multikafeteria

  • Lunch card

  • Hybrid work organization

  • Remote work from abroad policy

  • Internet and Electricity bill allowance

  • Additional day for community service when volunteering

title: DSV Söker C-Chaufför till Landskrona
description:
u är DSV-anställd och intresserad av en tjänst i ett annat land, vänligen kontakta din HR-avdelning för att diskutera processen och kraven för att ansöka

DSV är en dynamisk arbetsplats som främjar samhörighet och mångfald. Vi bedriver vår verksamhet med integritet samt med respekt för olika kulturer och individers värdighet och rättigheter. När du kommer till DSV arbetar du för ett av de allra bäst presterande företagen inom transport- och logistikbranschen.

Du kommer att ingå i ett kunnigt team med mer än 150 000 anställda i över 90 länder, som arbetar passionerat för att leverera fantastiska kundupplevelser och tjänster av hög kvalitet. Vi strävar efter att ligga i framkant i arbetet mot en mer hållbar framtid för vår bransch och att göra affärer på naturens villkor.

Vi söker nu en C-Chaufför Till Landskrona- är det du?


Om rollen

DSV är en globalt orienterad, ambitiös och handlingskraftig koncern med hög puls, som har alla trasportprodukter på hyllan. Till vår verksamhet i Landskrona söker vi nu C-chaufförer. Som chaufför spenderar du en stor del av arbetstiden bakom ratten. Visst terminal-arbete förekomma såsom lastning och lossning av gods varför hantering av truck är meriterande.


Vi förväntar oss att du har nedanstående erfarenheter och kvalifikationer

  • C-körkort
  • Du har YKB
  • Du har ADR Grund
  • Du har Digitalt Färdskrivarkort
  • Du har väldigt goda kunskaper i det svenska språket och grundläggande kunskaper i det Engelska språket är meriterande
  • Truckkort, CE-körkort,samt tidigare erfarenhet från branschen är meriterande såväl som geografisk kännedom och grundläggande fordonskännedom och fordonsvård.
  • Tidigare erfarenheter från distributionsyrket är meriterande
  • Lasta och leverera styckegods
  • Ansvarar för att åtagande i form utav utkörningen av gods sköts enligt rutiner samt ansvar över Lastbilen man kör på dagarna, följer policy, regler & lagar
  • Har du god teknik/datorvana är det meriterande

Vem är du?

Som person ser vi att du är ansvarsfull, samarbetsvillig och serviceminded. Vi ser även att du är flexibel, punktlig, alert plikttrogen och uppmärksam. Då du i många hänseenden kommer vara företagets ansikte utåt är det av stor vikt att du kan sätta såväl kundens som företagets bästa främst. Du bör dessutom ha ett ekonomiskt tänkande i din körning samt goda geografiska kunskaper.


Som medarbetare hos DSV får du:

  • Friskvårdsbidrag och personalförmåner via Benify
  • Trygga villkor genom kollektivavtal och försäkringar
  • Möjlighet att hyra fritidshus till förmånliga priser
  • Goda möjligheter till personlig och professionell utveckling i en internationell milj

Information och ansökan

Rollen är en timanställning vid behov med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort är Landskrona.

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Björn Mårtensson, på Bjorn.Martensson@se.dsv.com.

Ansökningar hanteras löpande, och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag 2026-11-05 så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Rekryteringsprocessen består bland annat av urval, intervju och referenstagning. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs en bakgrundskontroll på aktuella slutkandidater för att säkerställa att de aktuella kandidaterna inte har en bakgrund som är oförenlig med DSV:s värdegrund.

Alkohol och drogtest genomförs före anställning.

Välkommen med din ansökan!
