title: Senior IT Functional Analyst – Finance, EMEA
description:
Berlin Packaging is the world’s largest Hybrid Packaging Supplier®, providing packaging solutions in glass, plastic, and metal to companies across a wide range of industries, including food & beverage, beauty, healthcare, and industrial markets. As a “one-stop shop,” we combine design & innovation, manufacturing services, and supply chain capabilities to help customers bring their products to market in the most efficient and impactful way. With more than a century of experience in the packaging industry, Berlin Packaging operates on a global scale, supported by an extensive network of suppliers, warehouses, and commercial teams. This unique hybrid model allows the company to offer both standard and highly customized solutions, helping customers increase sales, reduce costs, and improve productivity through smarter packaging.

What sets Berlin Packaging apart is its entrepreneurial mindset and strong customer focus. Employees are encouraged to think like owners, act decisively, and collaborate across functions and geographies to deliver measurable results.

Core Beliefs:

The company’s culture is built around innovation, creativity, speed, and a continuous drive to “help customers become greater, faster,” making it a dynamic environment for people who want to make an impact.

Role Summary:

The Senior IT Functional Analyst – Finance, EMEA is the IT reference point for EMEA Finance processes. The role owns functional analysis and process design across the full Finance value chain, translates business requirements into ERP solutions, and ensures operational continuity on legacy platforms while actively contributing to the design and rollout of Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O. The candidate acts as a trusted partner to Group and Country Finance leaders, internal developers, and external implementation partners, guaranteeing scalability, internal control compliance, and adoption across EMEA countries.

Key Responsibilities:

• Finance Functional Analysis & Process Design Lead end-to-end functional analysis and process design across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, and Closing & Reporting; ensure design choices are scalable, usable, and compliant with internal control and statutory standards

• Requirements to ERP Solutions Translate Finance business requirements into ERP solutions on the current platforms and on the future Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O target architecture; drive fit-gap analysis, solution options, and to-be process documentation

• Delivery & Vendor Coordination Collaborate with internal developers and external partners to manage enhancements, releases, and issue resolution on local Finance systems; review functional specifications, oversee testing, and ensure deployment quality

• Finance Application Support & Problem Resolution Provide second/third-level (L2/L3) functional support for Finance applications across EMEA, acting as the primary escalation point for incidents affecting GL, sub-ledgers, intercompany, and closing processes; perform structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis, coordinate timely resolution with internal teams and vendors, and ensure operational continuity during critical business cycles such as month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closes; collaborate with the IT Service Desk to maintain prioritized ticket workflows, track resolution SLAs, and drive recurring-issue elimination through permanent fixes and knowledge base updates

• Microsoft Dynamics Transition Support Contribute to the EMEA transition to Microsoft Dynamics ERP: data and process readiness, template design alignment, country localization requirements, cutover planning, and hypercare for Finance scope

• Internal Control, Compliance & Audit Ensure documentation and governance of Finance/ERP processes, including change requests, functional specifications, segregation-of-duties considerations, and audit-related evidence; act as functional counterpart for internal and external auditors

• User Adoption, Training & Stakeholder Engagement Support user adoption and training activities for Finance users across EMEA countries; act as escalation point for complex functional issues, balancing local needs with regional standards; prepare materials and facilitate recurring State of Work sessions with Group and Country Finance leaders to track progress vs. roadmap, KPIs, risks/decisions, and follow-ups

• Continuous Improvement & Data Quality Identify proactive and reactive improvement opportunities across Finance processes and supporting systems, building business cases when relevant; support data quality initiatives across Finance master data (Chart of Accounts, vendors, customers, fixed assets, cost centers), driving harmonization and remediation in line with the EMEA data strategy.


Minimum Qualifications:

• 8–10 years of experience as an IT Functional Analyst with a strong Finance domain focus in multi-country, multi-company environments

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of core Finance processes: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Period-End Close, Statutory and Group Reporting

• Solid experience with at least one enterprise ERP (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, JDE, AS/400-based platforms) including configuration and functional design

• Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, statutory accounting principles, and audit requirements (e.g., IFRS / local GAAPs, SOX-like control environments)

• Proven ability to write functional specifications, lead UAT, and govern releases through structured change management

• Fluent in English; working proficiency in Italian

• Availability to be onsite in Milan 3 days/week and to travel across EMEA when required.


Preferred Qualifications:

• Direct experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (implementation, rollout, or run); knowledge of Dataverse, Power Platform, and the Microsoft data stack is a strong plus

• Experience supporting ERP harmonization / single-template programs across multiple countries and legal entities

• Exposure to M&A integration of acquired entities into a Finance ERP template

• Familiarity with consolidation and EPM tools (e.g., Tagetik, OneStream, Hyperion, BPC) and tax/e-invoicing frameworks across EMEA jurisdictions

• Additional European languages (French, Spanish, German, Dutch) appreciated

• Certifications in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O, ITIL, or relevant Finance/audit qualifications are a plus.


Ways of Working:

• Business partnership mindset — proximity to Finance stakeholders, listening, and translating business pain points into governed solutions

• Standards first — reusable design, harmonized processes, and disciplined change control to protect data and control integrity.


What We Offer:

  • A collaborative and innovative work environment, with a hybrid working model (minimum 2 days per week on site).
  • Compensation package range: €45,000 – €65,000 yearly Gross.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and AI-driven transformation.

title: Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer - iOS/Android, KMP & DevOps
description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real‑world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI‑assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform‑specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server‑side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data‑related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self‑hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server‑side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI‑assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI‑generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior‑level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands‑on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands‑on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long‑term, full‑time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform‑specific behavior.
  • Container‑based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full‑time role with a long‑term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time‑tracking tool that records mouse‑click and keyboard‑activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

title: Skills Facilitator
location: London, London, City of, United Kingdom
description:
About First Intuition
First Intuition is the UK’s leading provider of accountancy training, supporting over 10,000 students annually across our network of training centres. We deliver ACCA, CIMA, ACA and AAT qualifications alongside our Impact Skills Programme (ISP) for apprentices. As we launch the SkillsLab, we’re expanding our expertise in human skills development for early career professionals, building on our proven track record with 1,600+ corporate clients.


About SkillsLab
SkillsLab represents First Intuition’s strategic expansion into professional skills development beyond technical accountancy training. We’re building a market-leading proposition that delivers diagnostic-driven, personalised skills development to both FI apprentices and external employer clients. Our ambition is to grow from £3M to £12M+ by 2030, with external client revenue as a key growth driver.


We deliver a structured curriculum across six professional skills domains, using a blended model that combines facilitated sessions, coached workplace application, and self-directed learning. Our programmes serve learners from Level 3 through to Level 7, with each pathway personalised through behavioural diagnostics that identify individual development priorities and track measurable progress over time.


Role Purpose
The Skills Facilitator is a specialist delivery role at the heart of our professional skills proposition. You will facilitate high-impact learning experiences that develop real-world professional capability, using diagnostic data to personalise every session and demonstrating measurable progress to learners and their employers.


This is not a traditional teaching role. You are a facilitator of learning – guiding discussion, running immersive simulations and experiential activities, interpreting diagnostic outputs in real time, and connecting professional skills to each learner’s workplace reality. You will be expected to demonstrate commercial awareness, contribute to client retention through delivery excellence and play an active role in developing SkillsLab's content and methodology.


As a key member of the delivery team, you will help establish the facilitation standards that differentiate SkillsLab in the market. As the team and client base grow, there will be opportunities to specialise in programme areas, mentor new facilitators, lead on curriculum development, and take on client-facing responsibilities.


Key Responsibilities

Facilitation & Delivery

• Deliver professional skills sessions across in-person and virtual classrooms, including client-site settings, ensuring all sessions are full prepared and followed up with post-session activities

• Facilitate across the full SkillsLab curriculum - including all professional skills domains, multiple apprenticeship levels (L3-L7), and commercial programmes for external clients

• Use diagnostic assessment data to understand learner starting points, differentiate within mixed-ability groups and tailor facilitation to individual and cohort needs

• Adap delivery appraoch and pitch for different audiences, early career apprentices, experienced professionals and senior leaders

• Deliver with confidence and credibility in corporate client environments, representing SkillsLab's brand and commercial proposition

• Provide personalised learner feedback within 7 working days of each session, integrating diagnostic data and sharing insights with Skills and Development Coaches
• Participate in formal observations (minimum 2 per year, Good or above required) and peer observations, using structured feedback to continuously improve practice
• Pilot and evaluate new delivery approaches, digital tools, and technology-enhanced learning methods for potential adoption across programmes
• Complete all other duties as required


Collaboration, Commercial Contribution & Development

• Actively participate in the SkillsLab Community of Practice, sharing insights, resources, and evidence-based best practice across regions
• Collaborate with Skills and Development Coaches to ensure a seamless learner experience – facilitated sessions, coaching touchpoints, and workplace application must connect coherently
• Support the commercial team by contributing to client demonstrations, taster sessions, and proposal content where your delivery expertise adds value
•Build subject matter expertise across SkillsLab's skill doimanins, with the expectation of developing deep specialism in at least two
• Undertake regular CPD focused on facilitation practice, diagnostic interpretation, sector knowledge, and emerging approaches to professional skills development
• Contribute to internal upskilling across FI where Skills Labs methods are being embedded into wider apprenticeship delivery


Essential Requirements
Education & Qualifications
• Level 4 Certificate in Education and Training (or willingness to achieve within first 12 months). Level 3 Award in Education and Training as an absolute minimum at point of hire.
• Strong understanding of adult learning principles, experiential learning methodologies, and facilitation techniques
• Knowledge of how professional skills (communication, leadership, critical thinking, influencing, resilience, commercial awareness) apply across different organisational levels


Experience
• Demonstrable experience facilitating skills-based training or workshop-based learning to professional or corporate audiences
• Proven ability to deliver engaging learning experiences across both face-to-face and virtual environments, adapting approach for different audience levels
• Experience working with employers or corporate clients in a delivery or advisory capacity
• Track record of using data, diagnostics, or assessment outputs to inform an personalise delivery
• Background in professional skills development, business education, leadership & management, or corporate training


Technical Skills
• Confident and credible delivering in corporate and client-site environments as well as training centres
• Ability to interpret behavioural diagnostic data and translate it into practical facilitation adjustments
• Proficient with virtual delivery platforms (Teams, Zoom), learning management systems, and digital content tools
• Strong skills in Microsoft Office suite, with the ability to create visually engaging session materials


Personal Attributes
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills – able to command a room, read an audience, and adapt in real time
• Commercial awareness – understands how professional skills delivery creates value for employer clients and can articulate this
• Creative and resourceful – brings energy, ideas, and a willingness to experiment with new approaches
• Self-motivated with the discipline to manage a demanding delivery schedule across multiple programmes, levels, and locations
• Collaborative by nature – works effectively across regions, functions, and with external stakeholders

• Committed to continuous improvement in own practice, seeking feedback and acting on it


Desirable Requirements
• Experience within apprenticeship delivery, including familiarity with UK Apprenticeship Standards and EPA requirements
• Knowledge of the accountancy and finance sector, professional qualifications (AAT, ACCA, CIMA, ICAEW), or leadership & management programmes
• Level 5 teaching or training qualification, or willingness to work towards one
• Coaching qualification or experience in skills development coaching
• Experience with diagnostic or psychometric assessment platforms (e.g. behavioural profiling, strengths-based tools)
• Experience in learning design, curriculum development, or programme innovation
• Portfolio demonstrating range of facilitation work across different audiences and levels


What We Offer
• Competitive salary with performance-related progression opportunities
• Opportunity to shape professional skills delivery for a growing business unit with genuine commercial ambition
• Professional development budget for continuous learning and industry engagement
• Comprehensive benefits package including pension, healthcare and training opportunities
• Collaborative culture within the established First Intuition Group whilst building something new

title: Assemly Technician
description:

title: Alumni Specialist
company: Goodwill of the Olympics and Rainier Region
description:
Our vision is that every person has the opportunity to learn, work, and thrive in all aspects of life.

To achieve our vision, we are committed to dismantling racism and advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion so we can help people reach their fullest potential through our education, job placement, and career pathway services. We do our work with great gratitude for the community donations, purchases, and partnerships that make our mission possible.

Position Summary: The Alumni Specialist supports participants after job placement by providing ongoing engagement, career advancement resources, and retention services that promote long-term employment success. This role is responsible for maintaining strong relationships with program graduates, supporting retention outcomes, and building an engaged alumni network that connects participants to continued education, training, employment, and career advancement opportunities.

Working closely with Career Navigators, Training Coordinators, Business Development staff, employers, and community partners, the Retention Specialist ensures participants remain connected to Goodwill services and have access to resources that support continued growth and stability in their careers.

This position works collaboratively across Goodwill teams to provide client-centered services that support successful transitions from training to employment to alumni engagement. The role maintains a strong commitment to anti-racism, equity, diversity, and inclusion, ensuring equitable access to opportunities and improved long-term employment outcomes for all participants.

Hourly Rate: $20.98 - $22.80 per hour

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: The Alumni Specialist responsibilities include the following and other duties as assigned:

Post-Placement Support

  • Provide ongoing follow-up and support to participants after job placement.
  • Monitor participant progress, employment stability, and workplace satisfaction.
  • Develop and implement strategies to effectively reconnect with disengaged participants and alumni.
  • Support re-engagement in Goodwill services when participants experience employment challenges or barriers to retention.
  • Facilitate participant access to community resources, supportive services, education, and training programs.
  • Coordinate with Career Navigators, case management, and workforce development teams to deliver comprehensive, individualized participant support.
  • Promote a participant-centered approach focused on long-term employment success and career growth.

Retention Coordination and Career Advancement

  • Conduct regular participant check-ins at designated retention milestones.
  • Collaborate with employers to monitor participant retention and performance, identify workplace success factors, and collect feedback to support ongoing participant development.
  • Support the resolution of workplace concerns when appropriate and consistent with program guidelines.
  • Partner with training teams to share participant retention feedback and identify opportunities for program improvement.
  • Partner with Business Development staff to address retention challenges and improve employment outcomes.
  • Monitor and track alumni employment outcomes, including retention, wage progression, career advancement, and engagement metrics.
  • Maintain data quality and prepare reports to support grant, contract, and program performance requirements, identifying and escalating trends or concerns that may impact retention outcomes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying employer trends and opportunities to enhance equitable access, participant preparation, retention, career advancement, and overall success
  • Facilitate career development workshops and alumni-focused employment readiness activities.
  • Guide alumni in achieving career advancement goals through access to employment opportunities, career pathways, workforce services, credential attainment, apprenticeships, and advanced training programs.
  • Collaborate with the Business Development team to expand alumni access to employer-sponsored advancement opportunities and promote continuous learning and professional growth.

Alumni Engagement & Network Development

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with program alumni.
  • Support a seamless participant transition from training to employment and ongoing alumni engagement.
  • Develop, coordinate, and implement an alumni engagement strategy designed to strengthen ongoing participant connections with Goodwill.
  • Plan and support alumni events, networking opportunities, recognition programs, and engagement activities that foster ongoing community involvement and professional connections.
  • Promote alumni and participant success stories through testimonials, program highlights, and outreach efforts, while creating opportunities for alumni to serve as mentors, guest speakers, volunteers, and program ambassadors
  • Maintain alumni records and oversee communication platforms and outreach initiatives, including newsletters, email campaigns, social media, and other engagement activities that support ongoing alumni participation.
  • Represent Goodwill at participant, alumni, employer, and community engagement activities.
  • Promote continued engagement with Goodwill's workforce development programs and services.

title: EPM Technical Analyst
description:
Role Purpose

Own the technical side of Oracle EPM Cloud implementation, consolidating from Oracle Fusion GL to Oracle FCCS, and maintain/administer the system after go-live. The expectation for this role is to partner and work closely with the Finance team while also being part of the ongoing implementation.


Key responsibilities

  • Overtime Data integration: Build and maintain automated loads from the source ERP/GL ledgers into EPM using Data Management / Data Integration. Handle mappings, load rules, scheduling and error handling.
  • Master data and metadata:
    Maintain entity, account and intercompany dimensions, including hierarchy changes when entities are acquired, closed, or restructured. Coordinate with Finance on the chart of accounts mapping.
  • Environment management: Administer the EPM Cloud instances (Dev/Test and Prod), including patch and monthly update testing, migrations between environments, backups and snapshots.
  • Security and access: Set up users, roles and segregation of duties with SSO/identity integration. Support audit and SOX-type access reviews including periodic user recertification.
  • Close support:
    Monitor the consolidation cycle during month-end including scheduling of jobs, mapping changes and troubleshooting load failures.
  • Implementation support: Take part in design workshops, build and run test scripts, support UAT and cutover, and write technical documentation and runbooks.
  • Ongoing support: Act as first-line technical support for Finance users, and manage the relationship with Oracle and the implementation partner.
  • Report Creation support: Support Finance teams with creation of Financial Reports and dashboards in Oracle FCCS application


Individual Profile

      • Strong experience in IT or finance systems, with hands-on Oracle FCCS experience.
      • Solid grasp of consolidation concepts: currency translation, intercompany eliminations, and ownership changes.
      • Experience with data integration using EPM Data Exchange, pipeline creation
      • Comfortable with security and controls in a finance setting.


    Our working environment

    We are committed to working in the location where we do our best work. As a small and growing company with great offices in great locations, most employees will aim to be in the office 2 days a week and 3 days working from home/ other locations.

    Here at EXA, we believe the future includes everyone, we are open to all applications to create an environment and culture that includes one and all. We are a proud global community, that wants to drive diversity of thought though our employees and culture. We want you to come as you and make yourself and EXA successful.

    Due to the amount of applications, we may not be able to respond to all applicants. If you do not hear from EXA in 3 weeks after applications, you have been unsuccessful.

    All successful applicants will go through background screening.

title: 2nd Shift Machine Helper
description:
We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Machine Helper to assist operators in the setup, operation, and cleanup of presses in our production facility. The Machine Helper will be responsible for ensuring smooth operations by supporting the machine operator, monitoring board quality, addressing maintenance needs, and ensuring the production schedule is followed efficiently. This role offers opportunities for advancement and cross-training in other departments.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Set-Up and Operation Support:
    • Set up slotting, feed, and die-cut sections on machines following proper setup techniques.
    • Assist the operator with machine operations and ensure smooth production flow.
    • Work at a pace set by the machine operator to maintain optimal production levels.
  • Quality Control:
    • Monitor board quality, including checking for loose liners, warps, dimensions, caliper, and other defects.
    • Report quality issues to the operator and sort defective products as needed to maintain machine efficiency.
  • Equipment Support:
    • Turn in maintenance work orders for necessary repairs and proactively assist in the maintenance of equipment.
    • Follow all company safety and housekeeping protocols to ensure a safe and clean work environment.
  • Scheduling and Production Efficiency:
    • Assist operators in adhering to the production schedule and recommend improvements to optimize cost, quality, and service goals.
    • Report any scheduling or maintenance issues.
  • Cross-Training and Advancement:
    • Cross-train on other machines as needed to increase skills and flexibility.
    • Be willing to progress to a machine operator role as opportunities arise.
  • Administrative Duties:
    • Complete necessary reports accurately and on time.
  • Additional Responsibilities:
    • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Job Requirements:

Education and Experience:

Preferred:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Prior work experience in the corrugated industry and 6 months of experience as a Flexo or DieCut Helper or in the Press and Finishing Departments.

Skills:

  • Language Skills: Ability to read and follow instructions on factory masters.
  • Mathematical Skills: Proficient in reading a tape measure with speed and accuracy, and capable of calculating figures, percentages, measurements, and applying basic math concepts.
  • Reasoning Ability: Ability to apply common sense to carry out instructions and handle problems involving concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Technical Skills: Basic understanding of equipment design and operation, production specifications, and product quality standards.

Physical Demands:

  • Regularly required to stand, walk, talk, and hear.
  • Frequently required to use hands to manipulate materials and perform tasks.
  • Occasional sitting, and ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Vision abilities required: close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment:

  • Regular exposure to moving mechanical parts, wet/humid conditions, and occasional exposure to fumes, high places, airborne particles, and vibration.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Why Pratt Industries?

  • Competitive compensation and benefits packages.
  • Opportunities for growth and development within a leading company in the packaging industry.
  • A culture of safety, teamwork, and excellence.

title: ITS Superintendent

Location: Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) Projects
Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Miami/Fort Lauderdale, FL

Benefits: Full health and pension benefits through Local Union; company PTO program; company vehicle (where applicable); CDL sponsorship available

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated ITS Superintendent to lead Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) construction, maintenance, and operations activities on FDOT roadway projects throughout Florida. This leadership role is responsible for managing field personnel, subcontractors, project schedules, safety compliance, quality control, and coordination with FDOT representatives, engineers, and project stakeholders.

The ITS Superintendent will oversee the installation, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of advanced transportation technologies while ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with FDOT specifications and standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and supervise ITS field crews, technicians, subcontractors, and specialty vendors.
  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee day-to-day ITS construction and maintenance activities on FDOT projects.
  • Ensure compliance with contract requirements, FDOT standards, project specifications, and company policies.
  • Coordinate project schedules, manpower, equipment, materials, and logistics.
  • Lead installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of ITS infrastructure, including:
    • IP Cameras and Digital Video Systems
    • Dynamic Message Signs (DMS)
    • Vehicle Detection Systems and Wrong Way Vehicle Detection (WWVD)
    • Edge Computing Technologies
    • Emergency Vehicle Preemption Systems
    • Transit Signal Priority Systems
    • Adaptive Traffic Signal Control Systems
    • Ramp Metering Systems
    • Fiber Optic and Wireless Communication Networks
    • Ground-Mounted and Pole-Mounted ITS Cabinets
    • UPS Backup Power Systems
  • Review project plans, specifications, permits, and maintenance requirements.
  • Conduct field inspections to ensure quality workmanship and compliance with safety procedures.
  • Coordinate utility locates, underground infrastructure identification, and asset inventories.
  • Oversee system integration, testing, diagnostics, and final acceptance activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex electrical, communications, networking, hardware, and software issues.
  • Maintain project documentation including daily reports, schedules, material tracking, and work progress updates.
  • Participate in project meetings with FDOT personnel, consultants, contractors, and company management.
  • Ensure proper use and maintenance of vehicles, bucket trucks, manlifts, test equipment, and specialized tools.
  • Mentor and develop technicians and foremen to enhance workforce capabilities and performance.
  • Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and operational excellence.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ITS, traffic signal, roadway electrical, transportation technology, or related infrastructure projects.
  • Previous supervisory, foreman, or superintendent experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of FDOT ITS systems, specifications, standards, and maintenance practices.
  • Experience with fiber optic communications, networking, electrical systems, and traffic technologies.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction plans, wiring diagrams, specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, project management software, and manufacturer-specific diagnostic platforms.
  • Valid Driver’s License required.
  • CDL preferred; company-sponsored CDL program available for qualified candidates.
  • Ability to work outdoors year-round in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to inspect and safely operate aerial equipment, bucket trucks, and manlifts.
  • OSHA certification and MOT/TTC certifications are a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FDOT ITS construction or maintenance experience.
  • Experience managing multiple crews and concurrent project activities.
  • Knowledge of fiber optic testing, network switches, wireless communications, and roadway electrical systems.
  • Traffic signal and ITS certification(s) preferred.
  • Experience with FDOT maintenance contracts and asset management programs.

Work Environment

  • Union-supported position with comprehensive benefits package.

title: Bottom Stacker- 3rd Shift

REPORTS TO: Corrugator Supervisor/Leadman

High school diploma or GED.

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

6 months’ experience in the corrugator.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume, and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.

Product layouts and production specifications

Product quality specifications

Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction, and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect, and communication.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

  • Containers (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • CI/CD platform : Jenkins & GitHub Actions

  • Cloud container platforms: Amazon EKS/ECS and ECR; Azure AKS and ACR (including image scanning/signing where available).

# **Desired skills and qualifications**

  • Masters' degree Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Extensive experience as IT/Solution Architect (functional/technical) including the ability to take into consideration demanding requirements in terms of security, compliance, robustness, scalability and availability.

title: Performance Improvement Industrial Placement
description:
At EDF, success is personal. We don’t define it – you do. Join our Performance Improvement Industrial Placement and you’ll shape your future, your way – while helping Britain achieve net zero. This is your chance to gain hands-on experience and contribute to the smooth running of nuclear operations.

"Electricity is such a vital component in everyone’s lives. It powers schools, businesses and hospitals, so I knew that if I did my placement within EDF then I would have a really large impact on society, and that made my placement a lot more fulfilling.” Priyanka, Science and Engineering Industrial Placement.

The Opportunity

This placement offers a salary of £26,050 per annum and the chance to work at one of our key nuclear sites. You’ll join the Performance Improvement team at either Heysham 1 or 2, where you’ll support daily operations and help drive meaningful change.

You’ll gain experience in performance monitoring, data analysis, organisational learning and testing new training programmes. This placement offers a unique opportunity to work across multiple functions and develop a broad understanding of nuclear operations.

What You’ll Experience

During your Performance Improvement Industrial Placement, you’ll work at #Heysham1 or #Heysham2 within the Performance Improvement department. Past students have supported safety campaigns, developed analytical methods to optimise performance, and helped prepare contractors for major projects.

This placement offers practical learning in a professional environment, supported by experienced teams and mentors. You’ll apply academic knowledge to real industry contexts while completing degree-relevant modules and gaining insight into business operations within the energy sector.

Your Work Location

You’ll be based on site at either Heysham 1 or 2, within the Performance Improvement Department.

Who You Are

To be eligible for this EDF industrial placement, you need to be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a bachelor’s degree (2:2 or higher). We welcome applications from a wide range of disciplines, but an interest in driving improvement is essential.

It is a requirement that those who join us have the right to work in the UK. Whilst sponsorship may be a possibility, we reserve the right in our decisions to give priority to those who already have the right to work in the UK.

To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Security Vetting, which will, ordinarily, require you to have been a resident of the UK for at least three of the past five years.

Pay, Benefits and Culture

Alongside a starting salary of at least £26,050 per annum and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.

At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That’s why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that’s unique to you. Here, Success is Personal – it’s your journey, powered by us.

Everyone is welcome at EDF; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities.

As a Disability Confident employer, we're committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and encourage candidates to tell us about any support they may need. Should you disclose a disability and meet the minimum criteria (which will include holding a relevant degree discipline/grade and achieving the required pass mark for Stage 1 Testing) for the role you’ll be progressed to the first stage of the selection process. Some of our roles at EDF attract large volumes of applications. When this happens, we’ll apply the Disability Confident scheme’s guidance on taking practical and appropriate steps selecting disabled candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job.

Our Recruitment Process

We'll guide you through every stage and keep you updated along the way. You'll be supported by real people, with opportunities to ask questions, learn more and receive feedback where possible.

For our Early Careers Programmes, we use a combination of automated decision-making, assessment technology and human review.

Find out more by visiting:

Join us and find your success at EDF.

#SuccessIsPersonal #EDFcareers #LI-Onsite #DestinationNuclear #Heysham1 #Heysham2

Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us. Join us and drive the transition towards An Electric Britain.

title: Operation Specialist
description:
The Operations Specialist is responsible for driving operational excellence across Apex Clean Energy’s assets in Texas by ensuring all sites’ peak performance. The Operations Specialist will be responsible for electrical work in the maintenance, operation, and repair of substations, and other Balance of Plant electrical equipment while supporting a region-wide team of Site and Facility Managers at various utility-scale wind and solar sites. Reporting directly to the Director of Operations within our Asset Management department, this position will utilize comprehensive project planning and management practices to proactively monitor, anticipate, and circumvent risk to ensure safety, minimize down time and consistently deliver exceptional results for our clients.

Primary Responsibilities

• Perform advanced and highly skilled electrical work in the maintenance, operation, and repair of substations, and other Balance of Plant electrical equipment

• Monitor and operates the Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System controlling the electric distribution system and switching

• Apply knowledge of electronics and electrical systems to diagnose and correct problems

• Evaluate and monitor abnormal system conditions, monitoring routine preventative maintenance programs; establishing and maintaining routine operating procedures

• Use various electrical test equipment and instruments such as: meggers, portable transformer gas analyzers, volt meters, resistivity and conductivity meters, current meters, etc., as maintenance aids in performing troubleshooting and non-destructive testing of substations

• Evaluate the work and performance of others

• Provide regional support to site managers as needed at project sites located near and around Troy, TX.

• There will be occasional travel to support other Texas projects from time to time as needed.

To succeed as an Operations Specialist at Apex Clean Energy, you'll need to excel within the following criteria:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college
  • At least five years of professional experience in the maintenance of overhead, underground, and other Balance of Plant electrical systems on wind and solar facilities
  • Extensive knowledge of all substation equipment including electrical, mechanical, and control equipment
  • Protection and control experience with microprocessor relay communication and event analysis
  • Knowledge to perform advanced and highly skilled electrical work in the maintenance, operation, and repair of substations and other Balance of Plant electrical equipment
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems
  • Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects
  • Ability to document, plan market, and execute programs
  • Established project management skills
  • Ability to travel up to 50% between project sites in the state of Texas.

Work Environment:

Works in both an indoor office environment and an outdoor environment, occasionally at night which may be subject to inclement weather. Extended hours may be required to complete scheduled repairs.

How You’ll Grow

At Apex Clean Energy, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the dynamic, fast-paced renewable energy industry. From on-the-job learning experiences to a robust multi-week onboarding experience to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

What Apex Can Offer You

At Apex Clean Energy, we know that great people make a great company. We value our people and offer employees a broad, best-in-class range of benefits.

  • A mission-driven, energetic environment that supports and encourages our people to do their best work every day.
  • A respect for and celebration of individuality, differences, and uniqueness
  • Collaborative and driven professional workforce committed to supporting your ideas and feedback and accelerating your potential
  • Ongoing support and guidance such as on-the-job learning, hands-on experience, and mentorship
  • Training, strategies, and tools to support your personal and professional growth
  • Team atmosphere of diverse professionals committed to making an impact as an organization
  • Opportunities to volunteer and give back to our local communities
  • Exceptional benefits such as medical and dental; 401(k) with corporate match
  • Base and bonus commensurate with experience
  • Responsible Paid Time Off plus standard company holidays
  • Benefits Offered: comprehensive high-deductible health plans, dental and vision insurance plans, short-term and long-term disability, group life insurance, 401(k) corporate matching, flexible spending arrangements, company paid parking and cell phone, fitness and wellness corporate discounts

Apex Clean Energy, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer that recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

title: Fysioterapeut med intresse för teambaserat arbetsätt
description:
Vill du ha en av regionens bästa rehabenhet som arbetsplats?

Stora Höga Läkarhus & Rehab startade 1 oktober 2022 i helt nyrenoverade lokaler centralt i Stora Höga, många patienter har valt oss som sin vårdgivare, det ser vi som ett riktigt gott betyg.

Eftersom vi växer söker vi nu ytterligare en fysioterapeut till vårt fantastiska team.

För oss är det självklart att vi arbetar gemensamt mot samma mål och att vi alltid sätter patienten i centrum. För att lyckas är det viktigt att vårt team verkar i en god arbetsmiljö där nytänkande får ta plats.

På vår enhet har vi samlat både vårdcentral, rehab och BVC i samma lokaler, allt för att kunna erbjuda våra patienter bästa möjliga vård.

Vårt arbetssätt är teambaserat i ett nära samarbete mellan patientens vårdcentral och vår rehab mottagning.

Hos oss är beslutsvägarna korta.

Du som söker är legitimerad fysioterapeut och trygg i både person och profession samt har ett patientfokuserat arbetssätt.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av mottagningsarbete inom primärvårdsrehab. Arbetet som fysioterapeut hos oss innebär att få arbeta med självständiga bedömningar, undersökningar och behandlingar av olika medicinska patientgrupper. Besöken sker både på mottagningen samt hembesök hos patienten.

Om du har en särskild kompetens, ett specialområde eller ett särskilt intresse är vi lyhörda och intresserade av att ta fram eller utveckla fler gruppverksamheter som möter våra patienters behov.

Är du det minsta intresserad att prova ett nytt arbete skall du höra av dig och komma och besöka oss. Vi vill visa dig vår fina mottagning och informera om hur vi tillsammans skulle kunna skapa en unik utvecklingsmöjlighet för dig som fysioterapeut.

Intervjuer kommer ske löpande varför anställning kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Tjänstgöringsgrad och tillträde efter överenskommelse.

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt kontakt med annonssäljare eller rekryteringsföretag

title: Victim Engagement Practitioner
description:
Please see full Job Description & Person Specification

The Victim Engagement Practitioner plays a key role in delivering trauma-informed support to victims involved with Leicester City Youth Justice Service. The post exists to ensure that victims are offered timely, specialist support, have opportunities to participate in restorative approaches where appropriate, and are kept informed throughout the youth justice process.

You will ensure that victims receive a high quality service through the effective management of the team’s performance, maintaining organisational and professional standards expected of the victim service. You will ensure that victims’ needs are reviewed and met in line with the key targets and contractual expectations.

You will maintain a close working relationship with police partners, statutory services and voluntary agencies ensuring relationships are effectively managed and pathways of support for victims remain seamless to provide a high quality and consistent service. You will provide management oversight of presenting risks and needs ensuring matters are managed and escalated appropriately and actions taken expediently as deemed appropriate to the presenting situation.

Working as part of Catch22 Victim Services and embedded within Leicester City Youth Justice Service, the role acts as a bridge between organisations, ensuring victims' voices are heard and their needs are considered within assessment, intervention and decision-making processes. The role contributes to improving outcomes for victims, increasing engagement with support services, and strengthening restorative and victim-centred practice across the Youth Justice Service.

Qualifications

  • **Essential:** GCSE level English and Maths (or equivalent); a recognised qualification relevant to working with children and/or young people
  • **Desirable:** Professional qualification such as DIPSW, CQSW, Diploma in Education Social Work, Diploma in Youth and Community Work, Nursing Qualification, or equivalent recognised professional qualification from agencies contributing to Youth Offending Team activities

- En vana av att utforska och tillämpa AI i ditt arbete för att hitta smartare lösningar, dra insikter och optimera arbetsflöden.

- Kompetens kring användbarhet och UX är meriterande.

Hos oss jobbar du i en av Europas ledande IT-koncerner som kännetecknas av stark framåtanda, prestigelöshet och entreprenörskap. Det ger dig möjlighet att arbeta nära kunden, göra egna bedömningar och känna stolthet i din yrkesroll som optiker.

Du får arbeta med modern teknisk utrustning och fördjupa dig inom bland annat ögonhälsa, samtidigt som du får stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka din arbetsvardag. Vi tror på korta beslutsvägar, engagerade team och en personlig arbetsmiljö där din kompetens verkligen gör skillnad.

Du samarbetar nära dina kollegor för att erbjuda en hög servicenivå och en positiv kundupplevelse, samtidigt som du bidrar till kvalitet, utveckling och ett välfungerande dagligt arbete i butiken.

  • Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och professionellt på svenska.

Meriterande

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är engagerad, ansvarstagande och har ett stort eget driv. Du är trygg i din yrkesroll, trivs med att arbeta självständigt och tar gärna egna initiativ. Med ett genuint intresse för människor och en stark servicekänsla skapar du förtroende hos kunderna och strävar alltid efter att ge dem bästa möjliga upplevelse. Du är kommunikativ, lyhörd och trivs med att arbeta i team, samtidigt som du uppskattar möjligheten att påverka och utveckla din egen arbetsplats.

Varför ska du jobba hos Glasögonmagasinet?

Hos Glasögonmagasinet får du mer än ett jobb – du blir en del av ett engagerat team där kompetens, personligt bemötande och arbetsglädje står i centrum.

Vi tror på människan bakom yrkesrollen. Därför ger vi våra medarbetare möjlighet att ta ansvar, påverka sin vardag och utvecklas i sina roller. Med korta beslutsvägar, stark lokal förankring och nära samarbete skapar vi en arbetsplats där idéer får ta plats och där vi lyckas tillsammans.

Här möts optik, mode, service och synhälsa. Oavsett om du arbetar som optiker, butikssäljare eller butikschef bidrar du till något viktigt – att hjälpa människor att se bättre och känna sig trygga i sina val.

Vi är stolta över våra team, våra personliga butiker och vår ambition att alltid sätta kunden i fokus. Hos oss får du vara med och göra skillnad, varje dag.

Om tjänsten

  • Omfattning: Enligt övenskommelse.

  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidare.

  • Lönetyp: Månadslön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi erbjuder

  • En arbetsplats där optikerns kliniska kompetens och självständighet står i centrum.

  • Modern teknisk utrustning och möjlighet att arbeta med fördjupade undersökningar och ögonhälsa.

Välkommen med din ansökan och möjlighet att bli en del av vårt team!

title: Wastewater Treatment Operator
description:
Job Description

Position Title:

FLSA Classification:

Job Grade:

Wastewater Treatment Operator

Non-Exempt


Department:

Reports to:

Last Revision Date:


Plant Engineer Manager


Position Summary

This position operates, monitors, calibrates, and maintains wastewater treatment equipment and control systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

Driving Company Performance

  • Collect samples from influent flow, effluent flow and operation basins to meet permit requirements and assess system performance.
  • Maintain accurate data records on operational parameters, daily activities, maintenance and collected samples for compliance reporting and operational analysis.
  • Trouble shoot and repair all equipment in the wastewater treatment plant, including plant drainage system with the cooperation of maintenance department staff.
  • Handle used oil, universal waste, and recycling for the facilities.
  • Perform inspections and assign preventive maintenance for the facilities.
  • Manage chemical inventory in the facilities.
  • Work with chemical supplier to improve the treatment and use of chemicals.
  • Maintain communication with other departments, management and employees and notify them of any problems and/or concerns that may restrict the efficiency of production.
  • Ensure all paperwork is filled out in a clear, legible and accurate format, and completed with required information. Ensure all required information is documented in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  • Utilize continuous improvement mindset, assist in identifying opportunities to improve processes.
  • Follow Good Manufacturing Practices.
  • Maintain a clean, sanitary, and safe work area.
  • Follow all required work safe practices. This would include wearing all required PPE in designated areas, confined space safety, safe chemical handling, fall restraints, etc.
  • Responsible for food safety, pre-requisite programs and food quality related to designated area.
  • Report any food safety and food quality related issues to management immediately.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Employee Development

  • Safety Training

Qualifications

Required

Preferred

Work Experience

Eighteen (18) months experience



Experience in food and beverage industry

Five (5) years experience in maintenance role

Education

High School diploma or Equivalent or equivalent combination of education and experience


Technical Knowledge

  • Professional experience with ammonia refrigeration systems
  • Able to inspect equipment and troubleshoot potential issues
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills; able to write legibly to complete paperwork
  • Basic Math skills
  • Follow and comply with all safety standards


Additional Skills/Notes


  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Dependability
  • Adherence to safety requirements and wearing required PPE
  • Able to work in a team environment
  • Able to multi-task and be organized
  • Pass all pre-employment screens, including drug, background and criminal checks


Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions:

This position operates in a fast-paced manufacturing warehouse environment that is exposed to wet conditions. The employee may have some exposure to dust, fumes, and cleaning chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is moderate. Employees are required to wear required PPE that is in compliance with OSHA regulations, including hearing protection. Employees may experience swings in work-related demands of this position.

While performing the duties of this job, employees are regularly required to stand, walk, kneel, and bend throughout the entire shift.

Employees must occasionally lift and/or move 50 pounds, including above shoulder height. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus. Must have full range of body motion.

Hours

Shift

Weekends, overtime and holidays as required


Rate of Pay: $28 - $31 per hour


Note

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) of this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee(s) will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. title: Inside Sales Engineer
description:
Inside Sales Engineer - Commercial HVAC Products | Carrier Enterprise

Introduction:

Carrier Enterprise, a leading national distributor of residential and light commercial HVAC products, is seeking an Inside Sales Engineer to join our team. We are particularly interested in recent graduates with Bachelor's degrees in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering who are ready to launch their careers in a dynamic, technical sales environment. Join a team that excels in providing top-notch HVAC/R products, parts, and supplies through licensed HVAC/R dealers and contractors.

Company Description:

Carrier Enterprise (CE) is a premier national distributor specializing in residential and light commercial Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) products, parts, and supplies. We operate primarily in the B2B environment, selling our products through licensed HVAC dealers and contractors. These dealers are independent companies that sell, deliver, and service Carrier, Bryant & Payne products to residences and businesses in their respective markets. With over 200+ locations across 28 states, Puerto Rico, the Caribbean, Latin America, Mexico, and Canada, we are well-positioned to meet our customers' HVAC/R needs.

Company Website:

Job Summary:

The Inside Sales Engineer will provide customer sales and support for Commercial contractor sales of HVAC equipment and HVAC parts, and supplies. This role is an exciting opportunity for a self-driven individual—especially **recent engineering graduates—**who will be responsible for working collaboratively with the commercial sales team as a technical advisor and product advocate. The successful candidate will be responsible for configuring, pricing, and quoting technical and financial solutions that position CE as a viable solution for the customer and marketplace. This position is eligible for performance-based bonuses and incentives. This is an ideal entry-level role for Mechanical and Electrical Engineering graduates seeking to apply their technical knowledge in a real-world commercial environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Respond to Business Opportunities: Respond to new business opportunities based on sales leads from Account or Sales Managers and generate quotes for commercial sales with assigned accounts.
  • Support Sales Team: Assist Account Managers and Sales Managers with new and existing accounts, and introduce new products to Engineers and Mechanical Contractors.
  • Complete Bids and Submittals: Complete bids, submittals, and take-offs based on plan reviews and specifications in support of commercial sales.
  • Follow-Up: Follow up on quotes, bids, and submittals to finalize the sale.
  • Customer Interaction: Engage extensively with customers, manufacturers, and the sales team via phone and email.
  • Training: Assist with training for our Commercial dealers as needed.
  • Issue Resolution: Resolve customer issues in alignment with the company's mission, values, and financial objectives.
  • Identify Sales Opportunities: Identify and communicate customer needs and sales opportunities to drive future growth.
  • Travel: Travel as needed with the Sales Team to support presentations and trade show activities.

Required Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Applications.
  • Ability to read architectural, mechanical, and electrical blueprints.
  • Basic understanding of electrical and mechanical control systems.
  • Maintain expert-level product knowledge and applications.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM/Database tools.
  • Experience working with contractors is highly desired.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with the competence to make recommendations.

Educational and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field. (Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.)
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • 0-5+ years of commercial HVAC engineering, applications experience, or technical knowledge of HVAC. (Recent graduates with strong foundational knowledge welcome to apply.)

Benefits:

  • Health Insurance
  • Health Savings Account
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance (Short-term and Long-term)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Tuition Reimbursement & Professional Development
  • Paid Vacation & Sick time
  • Company Paid Holiday's
  • 401(k) Plan with Employer Match
  • Employee Discount Program

Invitation to Apply

Full-time and part-time positions are available. To explore this exciting Inside Sales Engineer opportunity and other career opportunities at Carrier Enterprise, visit our careers page at . Learn more about our company and team.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Carrier Enterprise, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, color, race, religion, disability, sex, or national origin. We support a diverse and inclusive workplace where we employ, retain, terminate, and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence.

title: On-site Tekniker till Azeo!
description:
Vill du ha en utvecklande roll där du kombinerar kvalificerad support i Google Workspace med rådgivning och service ute hos spännande kunder i Stockholm? Hos Azeo blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat och kompetent team som sätter stor vikt vid din erfarenhet, din kommunikativa förmåga och din fortsatta yrkesmässiga utveckling.

Om tjänsten

Azeo är ett snabbväxande IT-bolag som stoltserar med Sveriges nöjdaste IT-kunder. Genom att kombinera hög teknisk kompetens med ett personligt bemötande hjälper de små och medelstora företag att bygga moderna, säkra och effektiva IT-miljöer, från support och licenshantering till säkerhet och rådgivning.

Deras kultur präglas av korta beslutsvägar, stark laganda och en vardag där de ständigt hjälps åt och delar kunskap.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som On-site Tekniker spelar du en central roll i deras leverans och kundnöjdhet. Rollen kombinerar supportarbete med arbete ute hos kund och passar dig som gillar att vara nära användarna, bygga relationer och lösa tekniska utmaningar i vardagen. Det innebär att du ena dagen hjälper användare via telefon, Google Meet eller fjärrstyrning och nästa dag är på plats hos kund för installationer, felsökning eller rådgivning.

Vi söker därför dig som trivs i en kundnära roll och tycker om att representera verksamheten ute hos användarna. Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på Google Workspace och vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Googles ekosystem. Samtidigt arbetar Azeo i varierande kundmiljöer, vilket innebär att du även kommer i kontakt med Microsoft 365, klienthantering och andra moderna IT-plattformar.

Arbetet sker i huvudsak internt från kontoret tillsammans med teamet, där kundbesök förekommer ca 1 gång/vecka eller varannan vecka, i Stockholmsområdet. Konkreta uppgifter innebär bland annat:

  • Ge användarsupport via telefon, Google Meet och fjärrstyrning
  • Administrera användare, behörigheter och säkerhetsinställningar i Google Workspace
  • Installera, konfigurera och felsöka datorer, mobila enheter samt kringutrustning
  • Arbeta med endpoint management, enhetshantering och utrullning av klienter
  • Delta i migreringar, onboarding av nya användare och införande av nya tjänster
  • Besöka kunder i Stockholmsområdet för installationer, supportinsatser och teknisk rådgivning
  • Samarbeta med kollegor inom support-, drift- och specialistteam för att säkerställa snabba och kvalitativa lösningar
  • Bidra till en hög kundnöjdhet genom professionellt bemötande, teknisk kompetens och ett starkt servicefokus

Vi söker dig som

  • Har 2-3 års erfarenhet av arbete inom IT-support, servicedesk eller onsite-support
  • Har god erfarenhet av Google Workspace och administration av användare, grupper och behörigheter
  • Har erfarenhet av klienthantering samt grundläggande nätverksförståelse
  • Har ett genuint tekniskt intresse och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom moderna molnbaserade arbetsplatsplattformar
  • Kommunicerar flytande på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Erfarenhet av Microsoft 365

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • Hjälpsam
  • Social
  • Stabil
  • Ansvarstagande
  • Intellektuellt nyfiken

Vi ser att du som söker tjänsten har ett prestigelöst och hjälpsamt förhållningssätt samt en stark vilja att lära och utvecklas. Du är van att bemöta kunder och användare med stort tålamod, lyhördhet och pedagogisk fingertoppskänsla. Oavsett om det gäller komplexa frågeställningar eller mer grundläggande support har du en förmåga att anpassa ditt språk och din kommunikation efter mottagarens tekniska nivå. Du är noggrann med att lyssna in behov, skapa förtroende och hålla berörda parter löpande informerade – och du står alltid för vad du utlovar.

Som person är du lugn, rak och genuint nyfiken. Du trivs i sammanhang där du får representera företaget som vårt ansikte utåt. I teamet bidrar du med öppenhet, ödmjukhet och ett starkt engagemang för dina kollegor. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du är formbar och har rätt inställning för att växa tillsammans med Azeo.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Workday AMS-team - 20098
description:

Meritorious
