Tutti i nostri annunci sono rivolti ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

title: Penetrationstestare
description:
Vi söker en penetrationstestare som tänker som en angripare, men jobbar på rätt sida av lagen.

Du vet känslan när du ser en ny applikation och första tanken inte är ”vad gör den?” utan ”hur tar jag mig in?”.

Då kanske du passar hos oss.

På Certezza hjälper vi organisationer att hitta sina svagheter innan någon annan gör det. Vi söker nu en penetrationstestare eller red team-specialist som älskar tekniska utmaningar, gillar att gräva där andra ger upp och som ser säkerhetsbrister där andra ser funktioner.

Vad kommer du göra?

Kort sagt: försöka ta dig in där du inte borde kunna.

Mer konkret innebär det att du:

  • Genomför penetrationstester och säkerhetsgranskningar
  • Simulerar verkliga angreppsscenarier
  • Identifierar sårbarheter och risker
  • Dokumenterar resultat och rekommenderar åtgärder
  • Presenterar dina slutsatser för både tekniker och beslutsfattare

Du kommer att arbeta med allt från webbapplikationer och interna nätverk till molnmiljöer och andra komplexa system.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du:

  • Har några års erfarenhet av penetrationstester
  • Trivs i Linux lika bra som i Windows
  • Förstår nätverk, webbteknik och moderna IT-miljöer
  • Är nyfiken, analytisk och kreativ
  • Tycker att lärandet aldrig tar slut

Bonuspoäng om du har erfarenhet av bug bounty, reverse engineering, cloud security, mobilsäkerhet, exploit-utveckling, OSINT eller forensik.

Och om förkortningar som OWASP, CVE, MITRE och NIS inte kräver någon googling är det ett gott tecken.

Varför Certezza?

För att du får:

  • Arbeta med några av Sveriges mest spännande säkerhetsuppdrag
  • Kollegor som gärna delar kunskap istället för att vakta den
  • Tid och möjlighet att utvecklas och certifiera dig
  • Stor frihet under ansvar
  • En kultur där människor är lika viktiga som tekniken

Vi har över 20 års erfarenhet inom cybersäkerhet och fortsätter att växa. Nu vill vi gärna göra det tillsammans med dig.

Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare

Placering: Stockholm

Vi intervjuar löpande och ser fram emot din ansökan.

Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta, Mona Faghihi, rekryteringsspecialist, på +46-70 771 66 26 eller mona.faghihi@certezza.net. Skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev så snart som möjligt då vi gör ett löpande urval och intervjuar kontinuerligt. En djupintervju samt bakgrunds- och registerkontroll kommer utföras innan beslut om anställning fattas.

Samtal från rekryterare undanbedes.

title: Physiotherapist
company: The Association of People with Disability
description:
Rehabilitation and Community-Based Rehabilitation

  • Conduct comprehensive physiotherapy assessments for children and adults with disabilities.
  • Develop and implement individualized rehabilitation plans based on functional needs.
  • Provide physiotherapy interventions for neurological, developmental, orthopedic, and musculoskeletal conditions and also address the needs of 21 disabilities.
  • Monitor progress and modify treatment plans based on regular evaluations.
  • Deliver physiotherapy services at Community Rehabilitation Centers (CRCs), schools, Anganwadi Centers, and beneficiaries' homes.
  • Promote functional independence and community participation of persons with disabilities.
  • Support disability inclusion initiatives within the community.

Caregiver and Family Empowerment

  • Train parents and caregivers in home-based therapy, positioning, handling, transfers, mobility, and daily living activities.
  • Develop easy-to-follow home exercise programs.
  • Strengthen caregiver confidence to continue rehabilitation independently.

Early Identification and Early Intervention

  • Screen children aged 0–8 years for developmental delays and disabilities.
  • Provide early intervention services to enhance developmental outcomes.

Assistive Devices and Accessibility

  • Refer and Assess beneficiaries for appropriate assistive devices such as wheelchairs, walkers, standing frames, orthoses, and adaptive equipment along with AAT team.
  • Participate in assessment camps and assistive device distribution programs.
  • Educate beneficiaries and caregivers on the proper use and maintenance of assistive devices.

Coordination and Networking

  • Collaborate with Occupational Therapists, Speech Therapists, Special Educators, Psychologists, Medical Officers, and Community Coordinators.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate beneficiary records, assessment reports, therapy notes, and follow-up documentation.
  • Update beneficiary information in the organization's Management Information System (MIS).
  • Submit monthly reports, field visit reports, and program updates on time.

Monitoring and Quality Improvement

  • Participate in case reviews, supervision visits, and multidisciplinary meetings.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and rehabilitation standards.
  • Contribute to monitoring, evaluation, learning, and documentation of program outcomes.


Requirements

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) – Mandatory.
  • Master of Physiotherapy (MPT) – Preferred.
  • Registration with the State Physiotherapy Council (preferred).

Experience

  • 0 to 1 years of experience in physiotherapy or rehabilitation services.
  • Experience working with NGOs, Community-Based Rehabilitation (CBR), Early Intervention, pediatric rehabilitation, or disability programs are desirable.
  • Fresh graduates with a strong interest in community rehabilitation are encouraged to apply.

Essential Skills

· Strong clinical assessment and treatment skills.

· Knowledge of pediatric, neurological, and orthopedic rehabilitation.

· Excellent communication, counseling, and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently in community settings.

· Strong documentation and report-writing skills.

· Computer proficiency (MS Office and MIS).

​

· Willingness to travel extensively within the project area.

· Commitment to disability inclusion, community participation, and a rights-based approach.

​


Benefits

As per organization norm.

1. PF

2. Medical insurance

3. Gratuity

4. Travel and mobile allowance

title: 2nd shift, Maintenance Tech II, LAF 8HR Dry Vans M&R
description:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. An employee in this position works in an environment in which safety, environmental, and health concerns may demand constant attention. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibrations. The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at job sites such as the noise level in the work environment can be very loud with high temperatures at times.

All employees on the production floor must wear the necessary personal production equipment (PPE). At Wabash, we pride ourselves on being empowering, and there are some things we feel very strongly about. Physical Demands:

As a Maintenance Technician, you are regularly required to stand, walk, lean, push, climb, sit, bend, kneel, stoop, handle and operate tools or controls for the length of their entire shift. The employee needs full range of motion in their arms and hands in this position. All Maintenance Technician's must be able to successfully communicate with fellow employees as well. Some Maintenance Technicians also work in small spaces throughout their shift and frequently lift and/or carry objects up to 50 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus, along with good hand-eye coordination. Maintenance Technicians must be able to work at heights or from a ladder as required. They must also have the ability to push or pull up to 100 pounds intermittently and perform tasks that require twisting, turning, and working in uncomfortable positions. Additionally, technicians must have the ability to see and work in low-light areas. The role also requires the ability to operate and use a tricycle as needed.

  • Shares information with others to help them perform their jobs safer and better.
  • Copes successfully with unexpected events.
  • Develops plans to achieve objectives & identifies resources needed to accomplish objectives.
  • Resolves conflicting priorities and accomplishes work on time.

Leadership Attributes:

At Wabash, we pride ourselves on being empowering, and there are some things we feel very strongly about:

  • Embrace Diversity and Inclusion -- Solicit and respect the input of others, celebrate differences, and strive for transparency and inclusiveness.
  • Seek to Listen -- Actively listen to reach the best solution and make the strongest decisions.
  • Always Learn -- Strive to improve; do not quit or settle or settle for the status quo.
  • Be Authentic -- Demonstrate honesty, incredible energy, and grit in everything you do.
  • Win Together -- Collaborate, seek alignment, and excel at cross-group communication to success as one team and One Wabash.

Affirmative Action/EEO Statement:

Wabash is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for its associates and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, or other protected class or activity under federal, state, or local law. All employment decisions must be based on neutral, legitimate criteria. All employment policies and rules shall be applied equally to similarly situated associates.

title: Legal Project Manager (LPM)
location: Washington, District Of Columbia, United States
description:
You’re looking for a change, and so are we. At Venable, we know that every new hire brings valuable experience, new perspectives, and a chance to raise the bar on our approach to how we work. That’s why we’re looking for a Legal Project Manager to operate as an AI-forward adopter, partnering with attorneys and business professionals to enhance matter efficiency and financial performance.

This is a hybrid position and can be based in any Venable office.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for...

  • Utilizing the suite of firm technology, including AI-enabled tools, to improve legal project management processes, efficiency, decision-making, and matter outcomes.
  • Developing and managing matter budgets, forecasts, and financial plans for client use; preparing financial reports, accruals, and client budget updates for attorneys, clients and firm leadership.
  • Monitoring matter financial performance, including budget-to-actual results, WIP, realization, fees, collections, and budget variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Partnering with attorneys to manage matter scope, staffing, financial risks, and client expectations throughout the matter lifecycle.
  • Collaborating with Pricing, Finance, Billing, and other business services teams to support budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Driving the adoption of consistent legal project management practices, reporting tools, and matter management processes while supporting enhancements to financial systems and technology.

The successful candidate will demonstrate…

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience required; JD or MBA strongly preferred.
  • Five or more years of experience in legal project management, legal finance, pricing, or law firm financial operations.
  • Experience developing matter budgets, financial forecasts, and performance reporting.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and law firm financial systems such as Aderant or Elite; experience and proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, data analysis, modeling, and visualization.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize processes, leverage technology, and enhance reporting while driving consistency across matters.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively with attorneys, clients, and business professionals.

Pay Range for Candidates in Washington, DC: $145,000 - $170,000 per year

The range provided is the minimum and maximum salary that Venable in good faith believes at the time of this posting that it is willing to pay for the advertised position. Exact compensation will be determined based on individual candidate qualifications and location. Additional compensation may include discretionary bonuses and overtime, if eligible. Overtime wages earned will be paid in compliance with applicable law.

Venable’s benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, flexible spending and healthcare savings accounts, 401(k) with firm profit share, paid vacation and sick time, firm paid holidays, wellness and personal advocacy programs, family planning resources and leave programs, tuition reimbursement, and more. New employees are provided a detailed orientation to the firm’s benefit offerings upon hire.

Investing your time and talents is no small matter—we know that superior service to our clients starts with an investment in you. Our competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and programs that support our employees’ well-being, families, and futures reflect our pride in our people. From our legal administrative assistants to our senior partners, Venable prioritizes the whole person in order to cultivate the most successful of relationships.

Here, we strive to offer the kind of care that radiates, from our colleagues to our clients, to our communities, so that success finds everyone.

title: Engineering Market Sector Principal - Infrastructure Practice
description:

The Engineering Market Sector Principal will provide strategic, technical, and market leadership within our Infrastructure Team, with a focus on public works projects across the transportation, water, and wastewater sectors. Your technical expertise will support the successful delivery of moderately sized to complex projects, while your leadership and business acumen will help drive growth, collaboration, and innovation across the organization.

    • Perform quality assurance/control on other's work, verifying methodologies, calculations, outcomes, etc.
    • Attend, participate in and lead client vision sessions

    • Manage/oversee career conversations with your team on an established schedule (annual career conversations, regular check-ins, and the development of career plans for each team member)

    • Develop new client relationships and work proactively to enhance existing partnerships.

What You Bring:

  • A BS or advanced degree in your discipline from an accredited institution and have at least twelve (12) years of related work experience with at least five (5) in a Project Manager role – or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Professional Licensure in your discipline
  • A masterful understanding of the foundational principles of your discipline
  • An ability to manage complexity with a track record of providing quality designs for a wide range of project types
  • In-depth knowledge of construction processes, plans and specifications, as well as their application and relevance to public works and construction projects
  • Proficiency in technical writing as well as verbal communication
  • A strong ability to prioritize and complete critical tasks while maintaining high design standards and adhering to established project timelines.

What We Offer:

Benefits for Regular Full-Time & Part-Time Employees Working 30+ Hours/Week

  • Healthcare for you and your family: Medical, Dental & Vision insurance
    • Single HDHP Medical plan with 100% paid premium
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match
  • Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • FREE Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance for you and your family
  • FREE Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • PTO + Sick Time + 8 Holidays per year
  • Retirement Savings Plan with contribution from CPL to grow your retirement funds

Additional benefits available to FT Employees Working 40+ Hours/Week

What Does It Look Like Working Here?

We believe that building a strong community is about establishing a prevailing sense of fellowship among our team members, friends, and neighbors.

  • Collaboration – working with others towards the best solution, placing great emphasis on the collective wisdom of our internal teams.
  • Family – celebrating others’ successes, genuinely caring about the happiness and well-being of our team members and recognizing their own families as extensions of the CPL family.

  • Integrity – doing what is ethically right and providing reliable follow-through on commitments.
  • Ingenuity – seeking new opportunities and consistently identifying unexpected and practical ways to solve problems.

The rate for this position generally ranges between $140,000 to $175,000. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the New York Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employees already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. A potential new employee's pay history will not be used in compensation decisions.

title: QA-testare till Axis i Lund

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag via Gigstep där du inledningsvis blir anställd av oss, med ambitionen att på sikt gå över till en fast anställning hos Axis. Urval sker löpande.

title: Telecom Network Engineer
description:
Role Title: Telecom Network Engineer

﻿Department: Global Services

Subdepartment: Global Professional Services

Reporting line: Director, Professional Services

Location: Bucharest, Romania

Contract type: Permanent


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Telecom Network Engineer to join Ceragon's Global Professional Services team in Bucharest.

In this role, you will combine advanced network engineering expertise with hands-on operational support, working across complex, multi-vendor telecommunications environments.

You will be involved in network design, optimization, and advanced troubleshooting, helping ensure the performance, stability, and reliability of customer networks. Working closely with global engineering teams, R&D, regional teams, and external customers, you will contribute to delivering and supporting end-to-end network solutions across IP/MPLS, Microwave, DWDM, and 4G/5G technologies.


Key Responsibilities

Network Engineering & Technical Support

  • Provide advanced Level 3 (L3) technical support for complex network issues across multi-vendor telecommunications environments.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, configuration, and technical analysis of end-to-end networks, supporting Network Operations Center (NOC) activities.
  • Investigate and resolve complex network incidents, identifying root causes and recommending corrective or preventive actions.
  • Support the reliable operation and performance of customer networks across IP/MPLS, Microwave, DWDM, and 4G/5G technologies.

Network Design & Optimization

  • Contribute to the design and delivery of end-to-end telecommunications network solutions.
  • Perform network design, traffic engineering, and optimization activities to improve network performance, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Provide technical expertise to regional teams during network deployments, system integration, and rollout activities.
  • Develop technically sound, cost-effective solutions aligned with customer requirements and operational needs.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Technical Expertise

  • Collaborate with Pre-Sales, R&D, Verification & Validation, regional engineering teams, and external customers to support solution delivery.
  • Act as a technical subject matter expert, providing guidance and support to internal teams and customers.
  • Translate operational challenges and customer requirements into technical inputs for R&D, supporting the development of new features and service delivery tools.
  • Share technical knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement across the Global Managed Services organization.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in telecommunications network engineering, network operations, or advanced technical support.
  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical background.
  • Strong hands-on experience in IP networking, including routing, switching, MPLS, and Quality of Service (QoS).
  • Solid knowledge of dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, or EIGRP, including practical configuration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience working with Microwave networks in multi-vendor environments, including an understanding of Microwave planning and radio propagation principles.
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and supporting complex end-to-end telecommunications networks, preferably in NOC or Managed Services environments.
  • Good understanding of 4G/5G network architectures and protocols.
  • Strong understanding of network protocols and OSI layers 2–7.
  • Ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Strong communication and technical presentation skills, with the ability to interact confidently with international teams and customers.
  • Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (up to 20%) and participate in an on-call rotation outside regular business hours.

Nice to Have

  • CCNP, Juniper, or equivalent networking certifications.
  • Experience with DWDM and optical transport technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with network design, traffic engineering, or capacity optimization.
  • Basic scripting or automation skills for network operations and service delivery activities.
  • Previous experience in international, cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or providing technical guidance.

What we offer

  • Access to state of the art laboratory equipped with the entire Ceragon products portfolio.
  • Benefit online through a generous monthly budget.
  • Private medical subscription: Priority Plus at Regina Maria.
  • Special bonuses for life's milestones: whether you're expanding your family or facing difficult times, we provide additional paid days off and financial support to help you through.
  • Additional vacation days that increase with your tenure at the company.
  • Additional time off for health care needs.
  • A day off for your birthday and a birthday gift.
  • Compensation days for public holidays that fall on weekends.
  • Extra vouchers/gifts for special events (Easter, 1st of June, 8th of March, Christmas).
  • Bookster.
  • Glasses allowance.
  • All the modern comforts: daily coffee, a selection of teas, fresh fruits, and warm pastries to start your mornings right.
  • Breakroom with games and a cozy terrace.
  • Social activities: Sports Day, Easter & Christmas Party, other quarterly events and Happy hours.
  • Hybrid Work (2 days from office).
  • Central location on Calea Victoriei and parking facilities.
  • …and last but not the least: the opportunity to grow your career in a friendly, dynamic, multinational environment!

title: Senior Calypso Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenga is an international engineering firm helping businesses operate with AI at the core. With 6,000+ experts worldwide, we combine engineering expertise with AI-native thinking to turn ambitious ideas into real-world impact across industries, technologies, and markets.

At the core of the role

his project is focused on the operation, maintenance, optimization, and modernization of the Calypso platform within a global banking and financial services environment. The platform supports critical capital markets and trading operations, requiring a highly available, secure, and performance-driven infrastructure.

The team will be responsible for managing and enhancing the Calypso ecosystem, ensuring platform stability, reliability, and scalability. A key objective of the project is the migration and modernization of the existing infrastructure toward Microsoft Azure and modern data center technologies, leveraging cloud-native services, automation, and DevOps best practices.

Engineers will work across a broad technology landscape, including Calypso, Microsoft Azure, databases, middleware, deployment and release automation, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and alerting solutions, high-availability environments, and performance optimization. The role involves supporting production environments, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, implementing automation initiatives, and driving continuous improvements in platform operations.



Core skills you’ll bring

  • Hands-on experience with Calypso infrastructure and platform support.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and modern cloud technologies.

  • Experience with databases, middleware, CI/CD, and deployment automation.

  • Scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar).

  • Knowledge of monitoring, performance tuning, and high-availability environments.

  • Experience in infrastructure modernization and cloud migration projects.

  • Background in the banking, capital markets, or financial services sector is a plus.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams.

The impact you'll create

  • Support and maintain the Calypso platform in a banking and capital markets environment.

  • Ensure platform stability, performance, security, and high availability.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and production issues.

  • Manage and optimize cloud and on-premises infrastructure, with a focus on Microsoft Azure.

  • Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and monitoring solutions.

  • Implement infrastructure improvements, performance tuning, and automation initiatives.

  • Collaborate with developers, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver platform enhancements.

  • Support infrastructure modernization and cloud migration projects.

People are at the core of Avenga. We provide equal opportunities regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, or any other characteristic. We are committed to a respectful environment where everyone can be themselves, share their ideas, and feel that they belong.

title: Säljare – Ingen erfarenhet krävs + utbildning
description:
Hos Key Solutions får du mer än arbetslivserfarenhet. Du får utveckla det som gör skillnad i arbetslivet – från försäljning och kommunikation till självförtroende, ledarskap och affärsförståelse.

Vem du är när du börjar är bara början. Vi söker inte den färdiga kandidaten, utan människor med driv, nyfikenhet och viljan att utvecklas. Genom träning, ansvar och människor omkring dig som vill se dig lyckas får du möjlighet att växa från första dagen.

I rollen arbetar du med rådgivning och försäljning till privatkunder, antingen via telefon eller genom personliga kundmöten.

Du lär dig att förstå kundens behov och presentera lösningar som passar. Du får fast månadslön medan du lär dig yrket från grunden, med provision när du skapar resultat. Många av ledarna som stöttar dig började själva i samma roll.

En plats att växa på

• Fast månadslön och provision

• Betald utbildning och daglig coachning från första dagen

• Ett ambitiöst team och tydliga vägar mot mer ansvar och ledarskap

Vi tror på potential

Du behöver ingen tidigare säljerfarenhet. Vi söker dig som vill lära dig ett yrke, utvecklas tillsammans med andra och är beredd att anstränga dig för att bli riktigt bra. Det viktigaste är att du tar ansvar för din utveckling och bidrar med energi som lyfter laget.

Det här är Key Solutions

Sedan 2008 har vi utbildat över 6 000 säljare och i 14 år i rad utsetts till en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place to Work. Här blir du en del av en kultur med höga ambitioner, stark gemenskap och människor som vill framåt.

Välkommen till Key Solutions - A Place to Grow!

title: Administration Officer
description:
• Part-time (0.6 FTE) , 6-month max-term contract
  • Based at Ferntree Gully on the lands of the Wurundjeri People

Help strengthen the support behind services that change lives

Join Each's Housing Supports and Family Connections team and play a vital role in ensuring programs supporting children, young people and families operate smoothly and effectively. Working across services focused on family wellbeing, housing support and reconnection, you'll help maintain the systems, data and administrative processes that allow frontline teams to deliver high-quality support to the community.

This is an opportunity to bring your organisational skills, attention to detail and collaborative approach to a role where your work directly contributes to better outcomes for people experiencing challenges and vulnerability.

Your role, your impact
As the Administration Officer, you'll provide essential administrative and operational support across the Housing Supports and Family Connections program. Your work will help ensure services remain organised, compliant and responsive to community needs.

  • Manage and maintain client records, data systems and administrative processes with accuracy and attention to detail
  • Support quality service delivery through administrative coordination across intake, assessment, referrals, case planning and client engagement processes
  • Monitor and maintain data management, reporting and documentation systems to support program compliance and performance requirements
  • Contribute to continuous improvement activities, helping identify and implementing better ways of working
  • Coordinate administrative support for outreach activities, projects and service initiatives
  • Track program milestones and deliverables to support timely reporting and service outcomes
  • Build positive working relationships with colleagues, program teams and external stakeholders
  • Support reporting and evaluation activities that help inform service planning and continuous improvement

Who we're looking for
You are highly organised, adaptable and enjoy creating structure that helps teams succeed.

  • Demonstrated experience in administration, coordination or data entry roles
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office and client information management systems
  • Experience maintaining records, reports and administrative systems
  • Understanding of, or interest in, community services and supporting positive outcomes for children, young people and families
  • Commitment to inclusion, social justice and providing respectful services to diverse communities
  • Hold a current unrestricted Australian Driver's Licence

What will make you stand out

  • Experience working within community services, health, housing or not-for-profit environments
  • Understanding of homelessness, family support or child and family wellbeing services
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in administration, business or community services
  • Experience supporting program reporting, quality improvement or compliance activities

What's in it for you
At Each you'll be supported to be your best. We provide:

  • Diversity & belonging – We value all backgrounds, abilities, and identities and are committed to cultural safety.
  • Supportive & inclusive culture – Work with like-minded colleagues and leaders who genuinely care.
  • Boost your take-home pay – Not-for-Profit Salary Packaging (up to $15,900 tax-free per year) plus an extra $2,650 tax-free for meals and entertainment.
  • Endless career opportunities – With over 200 programs across QLD, NSW, ACT, TAS and VIC, there are plenty of pathways to progress.
  • Free, confidential support – Our Employee Assistance Program is available for you and your family.
  • Fitness Passport – discounted access to hundreds of gyms, pools and fitness facilities nationwide

title: Maintenance Tech 2nd Shift
description:
About Us

The Michigan Milk Producers Association (MMPA) is a member-owned and operated milk marketing cooperative known for producing high-quality, award-winning dairy products. Established in 1916, MMPA markets 5 billion pounds of milk annually and is the ninth largest dairy farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, serving members in Michigan, Ohio, Indiana and Wisconsin. At MMPA, commitment to milk quality begins on the farm and extends through five processing facilities and wholly owned subsidiary brands, Superior Dairy and Heritage Ridge Creamery. With seven sites across Michigan, Indiana and Ohio, MMPA continues to shape the future of the dairy industry through innovation, product diversification and strategic growth while returning value to its member-owners.


Why you’ll love working here:

  • Competitive salary
  • Health and wellness benefits with medical coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield, including mental health benefits
  • Disability insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement including 401k with employer contributions
  • Personal and professional growth opportunities
  • Employee appreciation events and recognition awards
  • Employee wellness initiatives
  • Employee feedback and suggestion forums

We are seeking a skilled 2nd shift Maintenance Technician to join our team and help ensure the smooth, reliable operation of our production facility. In this role, you’ll be responsible for troubles hooting, repairing, and maintaining production equipment and systems to minimize downtime while upholding the highest safety and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Pump/motor maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.
  • Valve maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.
  • Variable speed drive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.
  • Fan and blower maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.
  • Steam Boiler control monitoring.
  • Ability to fill out monitoring log sheets and charts
  • Air compressor and related systems maintenance, and monitoring.
  • Ammonia system monitoring.
  • Glycol systems operation, maintenance, and monitoring.
  • Basic skill in troubleshooting and repair.
  • Ability to learn Pasteurizer and related systems maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair
  • OSHA Knowledge of safe work practices
  • Understanding of liquid flow in process piping through pumps, valves and lines.

While this list is extensive, it is not comprehensive. Other tasks may be assigned as required to properly maintain production equipment, structures, grounds or utilities.

Qualifications:

  • Journeyman card or four (4) years of equivalent manufacturing experience
  • Ability to obtain an industrial lift truck operator permit
  • HS Diploma or equivalent
  • Ability to pass a drug test and background check

Preferred Experience:

  • Heat exchanger (Plate, Shell/Tube, Triple Tube or other) maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.
  • Hot water set operation, maintenance, and monitoring
  • Ice builder operation, maintenance, and monitoring.
  • Separator and related systems maintenance, troubleshooting and repair
  • Homogenizer pump maintenance and repair
  • HVAC PM, CM, and monitoring. Awareness of and compliance with all HACCP, USDA, FDA, SQF, MDA, GMP, and Food Safety Standard.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each responsibility satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the responsibilities.

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive list of responsibilities that are required of the role. Responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

MMPA provides the opportunity for meaningful work that makes a difference in the dairy industry and in our communities. The diverse talents and perspectives of our employees help us to meet the needs of our member farms and the customers we serve.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States.

MMPA is committed to maintaining a safe, healthy, and productive environment for all employees as one of our top priorities. As part of our commitment to your well-being and workplace safety, all applicants are required to undergo a drug screening and background check as part of the hiring process.

We are not accepting unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or résumés from third-party recruiters or staffing agencies for this position.

MMPA is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Software Engineer (Redmond)
description:
Job Summary

This position offers an exceptional opportunity to drive innovation in automation and software development within a cutting-edge operational environment. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated automation solutions that enhance system reliability and operational efficiency. Working at the intersection of software engineering and operational excellence, you will leverage your extensive programming expertise to build robust monitoring and diagnostic tools while collaborating across multiple teams to achieve strategic objectives. This role demands a seasoned professional who can navigate complex technical challenges, champion code quality, and mentor emerging talent while contributing to mission-critical systems that support advanced technological initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement comprehensive automation solutions to streamline operational processes
  • Develop advanced monitoring and diagnostic tools to ensure system reliability and enable early fault detection
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align automation strategies with operational objectives

title: Project Director - Entertainment Lead
description:
AC Martin, Inc. is an innovative, award-winning architecture and interior design firm with offices in Los Angeles, Sacramento, the Bay Area, and San Diego. Our work is a mix of Market-Rate Housing, Urban Mixed-Use, Hospitality, Industrial, K-12, Community Colleges, Civic/Government, Higher Education, Planning, and Programming. We foster professional and personal development and offer prospects for career advancement.

POSITION SUMMARY

A Project Director oversees the most complex projects of the largest magnitude or larger volume of smaller projects.

This position is specifically to help lead the Entertainment Market, notably Themed Entertainment. This position is based in Los Angeles but has a high probability of travel in the US and internationally.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES Tasks include, but are not limited to:

  • Responsible for the coordination of all project efforts, administrative and technical, to ensure the most efficient and cost-effective execution of assigned projects including contracts, change orders, invoicing, and payments.
  • Prepares strategic plans for project success.
  • Serves as the primary liaison contact with clients to complete projects on schedule, within budget, and with maximum client satisfaction.
  • Actively manages client budgets, schedules, and programs; project communications and documentation; office administrative tasks; and project team assignments.
  • Must utilize and update Deltek for administration of the project.
  • Estimates fees, determines scope of work, and prepares proposals and contracts on the most complex projects.
  • Responsible for contract reviews, consultant contracts, and change orders and ASRs for review with principals.
  • Provides oversight and monitoring of work of less experienced project managers.
  • Acts in a team leader capacity in the absence of the principal.
  • External responsibilities include business development and participation in industry organizations.
  • Works directly with principals, design principals, design directors, senior designers, project managers, and project architects.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be a licensed architect with 15 or more years of experience or equivalent in all technical phases of architecture.
  • Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in architecture or equivalent is required.
  • A portfolio must be submitted for consideration.
  • Additional industry certifications are desired (LEED, DBIA, CDT, etc.).
  • Themed Entertainment experience desired. Applicants that have experience in complex building systems are also welcomed.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

We offer career advancement opportunities and an excellent benefits package which includes:

  • Alternative work schedule of 40 hours per week based on a 4 ½‐day workweek.
  • Hybrid schedule of 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home, and half-day on Fridays.
  • Group medical, dental, and vision plans with HSA and FSA options.
  • Company-paid Life and AD&D coverage.
  • 401(k) Savings Plan.
  • Company paid time off and holidays.
  • Paid monthly parking.

Salary range is between $120,000 and $155,000 annually.

EEO EMPLOYER

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, national origin, disability, or any other consideration made unlawful by law. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Arlington)
description:
Washington, DC — Hybrid

$160,000–$225,000 + bonus + stock options

Build the systems behind mission-critical AI applications

BluJuniper is an AI and optimization company building advanced software for complex operational environments.

Our engineers work on systems that bring together real-time communications, computer vision, audio intelligence, natural language processing, navigation, geospatial data, optimization, and secure cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who wants to build the infrastructure that makes these systems work in the real world.

This is not a role focused on maintaining conventional CRUD services.

You will design distributed systems that move real-time data, coordinate services, enforce security boundaries, support AI/ML workloads, and remain reliable under demanding operational conditions.

You will work primarily in Go and have meaningful ownership over architecture, implementation, and production systems.

What You’ll Build

You may work on systems that:

  • Process and distribute real-time audio, video, geospatial, and operational data.
  • Connect AI/ML services with production applications and real-time workflows.
  • Support secure audio and video communication using WebRTC and LiveKit.
  • Coordinate distributed services through Kafka and event-driven architectures.
  • Enforce fine-grained authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.
  • Power navigation, computer vision, NLP, and audio-processing applications.
  • Operate reliably across cloud environments where observability, latency, security, and failure recovery matter.
  • Support users making time-sensitive decisions with live operational information.

You will help decide how these systems are designed, not simply implement specifications handed to you.

The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will take complex technical problems from architecture through production.

You will define service boundaries, design APIs and data models, choose communication and persistence patterns, evaluate system tradeoffs, write production-quality Go, and operate the systems you build.

You will work closely with engineers specializing in AI/ML, computer vision, audio, NLP, navigation, frontend development, infrastructure, and security.

The problems are often multidisciplinary. A feature may involve distributed backend services, streaming data, AI inference, access control, real-time communications, and operational constraints at the same time.

We are looking for someone who enjoys that kind of complexity.

Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and operate production backend services primarily in Go.
  • Architect distributed systems for reliability, scalability, low latency, observability, and security.
  • Define APIs, service boundaries, event flows, and communication contracts between distributed services.
  • Build event-driven systems using Apache Kafka and similar technologies.
  • Develop real-time communication infrastructure using WebRTC, LiveKit, and related systems.
  • Design data models, database schemas, persistence strategies, and high-performance data-access patterns.
  • Build authentication and authorization systems, including RBAC and least-privilege access models.
  • Integrate backend infrastructure with AI/ML, computer vision, audio, NLP, navigation, and geospatial systems.
  • Diagnose difficult production issues involving performance, concurrency, networking, scaling, and distributed-system failures.
  • Design automated testing and integration strategies for complex backend systems.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, code reviews, and implementation planning.
  • Make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance speed, simplicity, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Mentor engineers and help improve engineering practices across the team.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience focused on backend, platform, or distributed systems.
  • Strong production experience with Go.
  • Experience designing and operating distributed services in production.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, networking, APIs, service boundaries, fault tolerance, and distributed-system fundamentals.
  • Experience with relational databases, schema design, domain modeling, and production data-access patterns.
  • Experience designing authentication and authorization systems, including RBAC or similar access-control models.
  • Experience deploying and operating cloud-based systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong debugging and performance-analysis skills.
  • Experience with automated testing, code review, and production engineering practices.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical architecture and engineering tradeoffs.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Apache Kafka, stream processing, event-driven systems, or message queues.
  • Experience with WebRTC, LiveKit, or real-time audio/video systems.
  • Production experience with Rust.
  • Experience with gRPC, WebSockets, or other high-performance communication protocols.
  • Experience building infrastructure for AI/ML, computer vision, audio processing, NLP, or geospatial systems.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar production data systems.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD, and modern cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience building real-time collaboration or communications platforms.
  • Experience with distributed tracing, metrics, structured logging, and production observability.
  • Experience designing secure systems involving encryption, audit logging, secrets management, and least-privilege access.
  • Experience working in defense, government, public safety, regulated, or high-security environments.
  • Active or previously held U.S. government security clearance.

Why This Role Is Different

You will have direct influence over how major systems are designed and built.

You will work on technically demanding products where backend architecture directly affects system capability, reliability, security, and user experience.

You will collaborate with engineers working across AI, computer vision, audio, navigation, real-time communications, and distributed systems rather than being isolated within a single backend domain.

The team is small enough that strong engineers can make a visible impact and shape the technical direction of the product.

We value engineers who can move quickly without being careless, simplify complicated systems, and think deeply about architecture before writing code.

What Success Looks Like

Success means you can take an ambiguous, technically difficult problem and own it from first principles through production.

You can understand the operational requirements, identify the important constraints, design the architecture, select appropriate technologies, implement the system, and make sure it performs reliably once deployed.

You think about failure modes before they happen.

You understand how your services behave under load.

You know how they will be monitored, debugged, secured, and maintained.

You make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs rather than reaching automatically for complexity.

And you help raise the technical bar for the engineers around you.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $160,000–$225,000 per year , depending on experience, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

Eligible employees may also receive performance bonuses and stock options in addition to base salary.

Location

This is a hybrid role based in Washington, DC .

Benefits

Eligible employees receive:

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Performance bonus opportunities.
  • Stock options.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Significant technical ownership.
  • Direct influence over product and architecture decisions.
  • Opportunities to work across AI/ML, distributed systems, computer vision, audio, NLP, navigation, optimization, and real-time infrastructure.
  • A collaborative engineering environment with direct visibility into company and product strategy.

Work Authorization and Clearance Eligibility

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Certain customer, contractual, or regulatory requirements may require additional eligibility verification.

Equal Opportunity Employer

BluJuniper is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

title: Processoperatör
description:
Vill du vara en del av Team Thomas®?

Vi är ett engagerat team som har kul på jobbet! Hos oss blir du en viktig kugge i teamet som jobbar med att tillverka och leverera högkvalitativ betong och riktigt god service till våra kunder.

Livet på en betongfabrik…

Som processoperatör får du en ansvarsfull och omväxlande roll där du är med och ser till att våra kunder får betong med rätt kvalitet, i rätt tid och med riktigt bra service. Arbetet varierar från dag till dag och kombinerar produktion, praktiska uppgifter och kontakt med kunder och kollegor.

Strömstad är en av tre fabriker i Bohuslän som arbetar tätt tillsammans för att ge bästa tänkbara kundservice. Det innebär att du ibland även kommer arbeta vid närliggande fabriker i området, där Hallinden är den närmsta. På samma sätt kommer kollegor från Hallinden också att arbeta i Strömstad när behovet uppstår.

Grundbemanningen på vår site i Strömstad är en person som driftar fabriken och är behjälplig i den täkt som finns på plats. Det finns också kollegor i form av betongbilschaufförer på plats och övriga kollegor i Team Thomas är inte längre än ett telefonsamtal bort.

I jobbet ingår:

  • Att blanda betong
  • Kunddialoger, framförallt rörande pågående leveranser, samt hantering av kunder i täkten
  • Löpande underhåll och rengöring av fabriken
  • Provtagning för att säkerställa kvalitet på betongen, på fabrik och byggarbetsplats
  • Hjullastarkörning
  • Återkommande tillsyn av lastmaskiner
  • Skötsel av in- och utfartsvägar till täkten, t.ex. snöröjning och halkbekämpning
  • Ordning och reda på fabrik och i täkt

Vi arbetar främst dagtid, kl. 06:30–15:30, men tiderna kan variera beroende på kundernas projekt och betongleveranser. Ibland kör vi på eftermiddagar och kvällar, vilket vi planerar tillsammans i teamet. Vi behöver vara flexibla, men erbjuder också flexibilitet när livet kräver det – så länge vi säkerställer god service till våra kunder.

Kika gärna på denna film som visar hur det är att jobba på en Betongfabrik: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IwS_zogUajg

Vi är Specialisterna på Betong

Vi har arbetat med betong sedan 1955 och tillsammans i Team Thomas har vi både lång erfarenhet och en riktigt stor teknisk kunskap. Vi är stolta över vad vi bidrar med, inte minst ur ett hållbarhetsperspektiv. Hos oss kan du alltid utvecklas, särskilt inom betong.

Vem är du?

  • Du har en god förmåga att bidra till ett gott samarbete och bra service såväl internt och i externa kontakter.
  • Våra dagar är föränderliga så intresse och förmåga att se möjligheter och jobba med problemlösning är viktigt.
  • Egenskaper som engagemang, kvalitetsmedvetenhet, flexibilitet och noggrannhet är viktiga för att leverera en bra produkt och service.
  • Att sköta om och underhålla vår fabrik är en del av uppdraget så det är bra om du är praktiskt lagd och gillar tanken på att bidra i vårt underhållsarbete.
  • Har du erfarenhet från byggbranschen, annan industri eller till och med av betongtillverkning är det meriterande, men vi är främst ute efter att hitta vår nästa lagspelare. Betongtillverkning är vi bra på och dessutom bra på att lära ut!
  • Ett intresse för och ännu hellre erfarenhet av kvalitet, miljö och arbetsmiljöfrågor ser vi som meriterande, då det är en naturlig del av vår vardag.
  • Du är van att arbeta ensam i din roll, driva dina dagar framåt på egen hand och ta stort ansvar.

Vi strävar efter ökad jämställdhet och mångfald i vår organisation. Därför välkomnar vi särskilt kvinnliga sökande, samtidigt som alla kvalificerade kandidater uppmuntras att söka.

Vi gör urval baserat på svaren på de frågor du besvarar i ansökan. Ge dig själv gott om tid när du besvarar frågorna. De mest kvalificerade för rollen kommer vi att bjuda in för att göra tester som ett steg i vår urvalsprocess.

Sista ansökningsdag är 13 november 2026. Tester och telefonavstämningar kan komma att ske löpande under processen, likaså kan tillsättning komma att ske före sista ansökningsdag, så sök så snart som möjligt. Ansök genom att fylla i ansökningsformuläret kopplat till denna annons.

Om Thomas Betong

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett familjeägt och långsiktigt bolag där vi tillsammans med våra kunder bidrar till ett hållbart byggande. Från ett 40-tal fabriker runt om i landet tillverkar vi och levererar både färsk betong och prefabricerade betongelement i riktigt hög kvalitet. Med en önskan om att uppfattas vara bäst i branschen som Specialisterna på betong delar vi gärna med oss av vår erfarenhet och unika betongkompetens.

I Team Thomas bryr vi oss om varandra. Vi ”silar snacket”, tar vara på varandras olikheter och bjuder in varandra i gemenskapen. Thomas Betong ingår i svenska, familjeägda koncernen Thomas Concrete Group AB med verksamhet i Sverige, Norge, USA, Tyskland och Polen. www.thomasbetong.se

title: Städare till Städenheten
description:
Fastighets- och serviceförvaltningen står inför många spännande utmaningar och söker dig som tar initiativ, gillar att samarbeta med andra och delar med dig av din kunskap. Vi erbjuder dig ett arbete där du får möjlighet att utvecklas, ha roligt och att göra skillnad.

Fastighets- och serviceförvaltningen består av cirka 350 medarbetare och ansvarar för kommunens fastigheter, städverksamhet, måltidsservice och intern service.

Avdelning Städ ansvarar för att säkerställa en ren och trivsam inomhusmiljö i kommunens verksamheter samt bidra till minskad smittspridning. I uppdraget ingår också att underhålla och vårda lokalerna och ytskikt så att dessa ska få en ökad livslängd. Städverksamheten består av cirka 90 städare. Arbetet utförs professionellt och kvalitetsmedvetet med fokus på hållbarhet, god arbetsmiljö och miljöhänsyn.

Städenheten drivs som en resultatenhet med stort eget ansvar för verksamhet, ekonomi och personal. Enheten har en egen ledningsgrupp och arbetar med ett tydligt fokus på kvalitet, hållbarhet och verksamhetsutveckling.

Med anledning av kommande pensionsavgångar söker vi nu städare till Städenheten.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som städare arbetar du självständigt med professionell städning och golvvård i offentliga verksamheter, såsom förskolor, skolor, äldreomsorg och kontorslokaler. En viktig del av uppdraget är att vårda och underhålla lokaler samt deras ytskikt för att bidra till en trivsam miljö och förlänga lokalernas livslängd.

Du har ett nära samarbete med kund för att säkerställa hög kvalitet och god service. Arbetet innebär stor möjlighet att planera det dagliga arbetet självständigt.

Tillsammans arbetar vi för att leverera rätt kvalitet, skapa nöjda kunder och bidra till en socialt hållbar och attraktiv arbetsplats.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av lokalvård, arbete inom service eller annat arbete där kundfokus, kvalitet och ansvarstagande varit viktiga delar. Du förstår vikten av god service och trivs med att skapa positiva kundupplevelser.

Som person är du flexibel, initiativtagande och ansvarstagande. Du arbetar strukturerat, både självständigt och tillsammans med andra, och har lätt för att bygga goda relationer. Arbetet kräver en god fysik. Arbetet kräver digital mognad då intern kommunikation och verksamhetsbeställningar sker via digitala kanaler och system

Arbetet kan vara förlagt till flera olika arbetsplatser under veckan, vilket ställer krav på att du är anpassningsbar, gillar variation och känner dig trygg i att möta olika verksamheter och människor. Du behöver ha B-körkort och tillgång till bil.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker dig som delar våra värderingar kring kvalitet, service och samarbete. SRY-utbildning eller annan utbildning inom lokalvård är meriterande. För anställning krävs uppvisat utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Mer om tjänsten

Tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Arbetstiden är förlagd dagtid måndag till fredag.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-08

Dina ansökningshandlingar är allmänna handlingar och hanteras enligt offentlighetsprincipen. Har du beslut om skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig kontakta Rekryteringsteamet för alternativ sökväg på telefon 0911-69 65 10.

Fastighets- och serviceförvaltningen är en av kommunens sju förvaltningar. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att skapa välfärd och hållbar samhällsutveckling. Tillsammans med pitebor, näringsliv och föreningar utvecklar vi Piteå till en ännu bättre plats att bo, leva och verka i.

title: Personlig assistent i Svenljunga  - Fasta pass 50%
description:
