title: AI Adoption Specialist  Generative AI & Developer Enablement - 20102
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Job Overview

Assignment Description

We are looking for an AI Adoption Specialist to drive practical adoption of AI tools within software development teams through hands-on training, workshops, and coaching.

You will plan and deliver several practical workshops each week, tailored to developers' needs and daily workflows. The role focuses on generative AI, GitHub Copilot, prompting, AI agents, and AI-assisted software development and testing.

You will help teams turn AI knowledge into effective working practices, identify adoption barriers, and transfer knowledge to internal AI ambassadors. This is a hands-on training and coaching role rather than a project management or AI architecture position.

What You Will Work On

  • Plan and deliver practical AI workshops and training sessions for development teams.
  • Train developers in generative AI, GitHub Copilot, prompting, context management, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Demonstrate AI agents and AI-supported development and testing techniques.
  • Adapt exercises and training materials to different roles, skill levels, and development tasks.
  • Coach teams in applying AI tools to their everyday software development work.
  • Identify adoption challenges and translate them into targeted training and coaching activities.
  • Explain AI tool limitations, safe usage, and the importance of human review.
  • Develop and maintain reusable training materials, exercises, and practical examples.
  • Support knowledge transfer to internal AI trainers and AI ambassador networks.
  • Work closely with developers using React, MUI, .NET 10, Java, SQL Server, VS Code, and Visual Studio.

What You Bring

  • Practical experience with generative AI and AI-assisted software development.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, including prompting, context, instructions, and AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Ability to independently plan and lead practical AI training sessions and workshops.
  • Experience adapting training to different technical roles, skill levels, and real-world tasks.
  • Ability to identify team needs and turn them into effective coaching and training activities.
  • Understanding of AI tool limitations, secure usage, and human oversight.
  • Strong communication and teaching skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • A proactive, self-directed, and delivery-focused working style.
  • Ability to engage development teams and communicate both the benefits and limitations of AI tools.

Meritorious

  • Experience in regulated industries such as banking or insurance.
  • Practical experience with AI agents and automated workflows.
  • Experience using AI for test design, test automation, and quality assurance.
  • Experience supporting multiple development teams in large organisations or SAFe environments.
  • Experience building internal AI ambassador networks or knowledge-sharing programmes.

title: Technology Onboarding Project Manager
description:
Role Purpose


The Onboarding Project Manager will lead the planning, coordination and controlled delivery of EUSL’s
onboarding to Group technology services and operating arrangements. Acting as the primary local delivery
interface between EUSL and stakeholders across ERGO and Munich Re Group, the role will translate Group
onboarding requirements into an executable local plan with clear milestones, priorities, decision points and
accountable owners.


The role will coordinate EUSL business, IT and enabling functions throughout delivery; maintain the local plan,
RAID, dependencies, decisions, resources and evidence; and ensure timely inputs across all workstreams. It
will provide concise executive reporting directly to the Head of IT and Operations and escalate material risks,
issues, costs, constraints and decisions without delay through the appropriate EUSL and Group governance
routes.


Working closely with the Lead of IT Delivery and Strategy, the Project Manager will integrate the onboarding
activity into the wider EUSL delivery roadmap and manage dependencies, sequencing and resource conflicts.


They will not replace accountable owners but will provide hands-on coordination where SME capacity is
constrained, personally close documentation gaps, and lead business readiness through testing, migration,
communications, training, hypercare and operational acceptance.


People Leadership and Matrix Working


The role has no direct line management responsibility but carries significant matrix leadership accountability.
The postholder will lead cross-functional delivery teams, influence senior stakeholders across EUSL, ERGO
and Munich Re Group, and establish clear ownership and accountability across workstreams. They will be
expected to challenge constructively, secure timely decisions and maintain delivery momentum where
resources remain functionally managed within existing teams.


Duties and Responsibilities


• Own the EUSL onboarding plan, scope, milestones, actions, dependencies, resources, readiness and
acceptance criteria, aligned to the Group plan and wider EUSL delivery roadmap.
• Lead local discovery, remediation, implementation, migration, transition and closure, acting as the primary
EUSL interface to the relevant Group onboarding teams and workstreams.
• Maintain governance, RAID, decision and change controls, with clear ownership, deadlines and timely
escalation.
• Mobilise business owners, IT teams, SMEs, workstream leads and sponsors; coordinate requirements,
evidence, testing, approvals and decisions.
• Track SME capacity, costs, procurement, contracts and vendor dependencies, escalating conflicts with
clear impacts, options and decisions required.
• Provide concise, decision-focused executive reporting directly to the Head of IT and Operations, covering
progress, risks, dependencies, resources, costs and decisions; escalate urgent or material matters without
delay.
• Identify documentation gaps and personally draft, maintain and quality-assure the programme, technical,
operational, governance, testing, transition and BAU artefacts required for delivery.
• Lead workshops and EUSL readiness, including validation, UAT, migration waves, device rollout,
communications, training, support and hypercare.
• Secure operational acceptance, complete BAU handover, track residual actions and capture lessons
learned.


Key Deliverables and Success Measures


• EUSL obligations, decisions, evidence and inputs are delivered on time and aligned to the Group plan and
EUSL roadmap.
• Owners and SMEs are mobilised, with capacity, cost, risk and dependency issues managed and escalated
early.
• The Head of IT and Operations receives clear, timely reporting and material matters are escalated early
enough to enable intervention.
• Complete, controlled and audit-ready documentation is available when needed for delivery, assurance,
transition and BAU.
• Business and users are ready for migration and cutover, with effective communications, training, support
and hypercare.
• Operational acceptance and BAU handover are completed, with residual actions owned and lessons
learned captured.


Stakeholder Relationships


• Head of IT and Operations, Lead of IT Delivery and Strategy, and EUSL executive sponsors.
• IT Services, Development & Architecture, Information Security, Operations and PMO colleagues.
• Risk & Compliance, Finance, HR and impacted business functions.
• ERGO and Munich Re Group programme, shared service, security, infrastructure and operational
stakeholders.
• Third-party suppliers and specialist delivery partners where relevant


Conduct Requirements


• You must act with integrity.
• You must act with due care, skill and diligence.
• You must be open and cooperative with the FCA and other regulators.
• You must pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly.
• You must observe proper standards of market conduct.
• The company will be required to report to the FCA any disciplinary action taken in relation to a breach of
these rules.
• The company requires you to complete all training assigned to you and in accordance with allocated
deadlines


Skills and Competencies


• Transformation delivery – Leads complex, cross-functional technology and operating-model change from
discovery to transition.
• Governance and judgement – Maintains strong planning, RAID, financial, resource and change controls,
distinguishing material issues from routine delivery noise.
• Matrix leadership – Influences executives and Group stakeholders, creates clear ownership and sustains
momentum through ambiguity.
• Communication – Translates business, technical and regulatory requirements into clear actions, decisions
and executive reporting.
• Documentation – Independently produces high-quality programme, technical, operational and governance
artefacts with limited SME input.
• Risk and control – Maintains evidence, traceability and proportionate escalation within a regulated
environment.
• Delivery discipline – Manages competing priorities, resolves problems pragmatically and balances pace
with control.


Experience and Qualifications


Essential
• Proven delivery of complex IT onboarding, migration, integration or transformation programmes within a
regulated environment.
• Strong planning, RAID, dependency, readiness and stakeholder governance, with evidence of resolving
blockers and driving decisions.
• Experience coordinating business owners, IT teams, SMEs, service owners, vendors and external
partners in a matrix environment.
• Excellent written, communication and facilitation skills, including business readiness, service transition and
operational handover.


Desirable
• Recognised project management qualification such as PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, APM, PMP, AgilePM
or equivalent.
• Experience of local business change, IT service transition, technology migration, organisational
onboarding or regulated insurance delivery.
• Experience of Group-led transformation, enterprise shared services or multinational matrix organisations.
• Knowledge of cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity, applications, workplace technology, operational
resilience, DORA, outsourcing or third-party risk expectations


Information Security Responsibilities


• Ensure onboarding delivery adheres to applicable information security policies, standards, procedures and
Group requirements.
• Ensure security, privacy, operational resilience, risk and control requirements are identified early, included
in plans and supported by appropriate evidence and approvals.
• Identify, track and escalate security risks, incidents, control gaps, supplier concerns or delivery decisions
with material security implications.
• Protect confidential information and ensure project documentation is created, shared, retained and
disposed of in line with company requirements.
• Complete required security training and support secure-by-design delivery practices across
the programme


What we Offer



You will join a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can contribute to key business priorities and help strengthen operational ways of working.


Our benefits are designed to support and add value, offering recognition for your work and fair reward. We offer a range of benefits including hybrid working, life insurance, private medical and dental cover and volunteering days.


Why ERGO?


The ERGO brand is well-established in its target markets, supported throughout the year by Group A-rated securities and the strong economic ownership of ERGO Versicherung AG.


ERGO UK Specialty continues to both secure profitable, sustainable business in the UK and Ireland and strengthen our capacity management and operational capabilities. This is leading to continued efficiencies through the drive for simplicity in products, processes and wordings.


The client management of ERGO UK Specialty is focused on the acquisition of profitable business in close cooperation with its clients. ERGO UK Specialty is a leading expert in its chosen segments of its target markets through consistency, continuity and quality of capacity. We have been underwriting successful specialty business in the UK since 2001 and under ERGO ownership since 2013.

title: Market Sector Principal - Landscape Architect
description:
Why This Role Matters:

As the Market Sector Principal - Landscape Architect, you will be a trusted technical expert, mentor, and leader within a growing practice. You will champion design excellence, guide technical standards, lead growth of the practice, and support project pursuit, development, and delivery efforts.

Working across large-scale multidisciplinary initiatives and complex mid-sized projects, you will inspire teams to create thoughtful, sustainable, and client-focused landscape solutions while contributing to the continued growth and reputation of CPL.

What You’ll Do:

  • Act as a culture guardian, promoting all that is good in the culture
  • Develop relationships and networks internally to advance our multi-discipline capabilities
  • Demonstrate an understanding of the business and CPL’s Value Proposition and how technical excellence supports that Value Proposition
  • Ensure appropriate resources are allocated throughout the organization to deliver a high-quality client experience
  • Expand our practice both in geography and in total sales volume through a combination of internal cross-selling and external business development.
  • Supervisory requirements, including recruitment and retention of talent including:
    • Engage and foster the growth of CPL team members. Provide encouragement and regular feedback; and serve as a mentor/example for all levels of the team.
    • Manage/oversee career conversations with your team on an established schedule (annual career conversations, regular check-ins, and the development of career plans for each team member)
    • Develop future leaders within the organization (train your replacement)
    • Engage, motivate, and lead internal and external stakeholders to develop strategies and plans to move the organization in the desired direction.
    • Influence people through effective communication
    • Promote justice, diversity and fairness in the organization
  • Execute work by managing the work of others, providing direction and removing obstacles.
    • Fulfill the role of Project Manager as needed
    • Oversee project schedules and budgets
    • Perform quality assurance/control on other's work, verifying methodologies, calculations, outcomes, etc.
    • Develop project scopes and objectives and coordinate all efforts – administrative and technical – to ensure the most efficient and cost-effective execution of assigned projects
    • Advocate for sustainable approaches to design solutions
    • Provide management of internal finances, which include billing, invoice generation and asset/resource allocation.
  • Collaborate with the other CPL leaders in preparing and implementing annual business development plans


What You Bring:

  • Professional degree in your field of expertise and have at least fifteen (15) years of experience, with at least five (5) served in a Studio Manager or Practice Manager role or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Professional Licensure with the ability and willingness to be licensed in multiple states
  • You have a thorough understanding of current trends and areas of growth within the AEC/LA industry
  • You are considered a subject matter expert, internally and in the community
  • You’re an excellent communicator with resolute interpersonal skills
  • Highly accountable, you approach every project with a positive attitude and an eagerness to exceed client expectations
  • You have previous leadership experience, having worked to identify thoughtful solutions to complicated design problems
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, team-based and entrepreneurial environment
  • Ability to travel regionally and nationally (as necessary) in support of firm goals


What We Offer:

Benefits for Regular Full-Time & Part-Time Employees Working 30+ Hours/Week

  • Healthcare for you and your family: Medical, Dental & Vision insurance
    • Single HDHP Medical plan with 100% paid premium
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match
  • Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • FREE Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance for you and your family
  • FREE Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • PTO + Sick Time + 8 Holidays per year
  • Retirement Savings Plan with contribution from CPL to grow your retirement funds
  • Internal Mobility & Career Advancement
  • Licensure Assistance

Additional benefits available to FT Employees Working 40+ Hours/Week

  • Tuition Assistance: You may be eligible for continuing education assistance
  • Student Loan Assistance Program: CPL will contribute up to $100/month for 5 years ($6,000 total) toward student loan debt

What Does It Look Like Working Here?

We believe that building a strong community is about establishing a prevailing sense of fellowship among our team members, friends, and neighbors.

  • Collaboration – working with others towards the best solution, placing great emphasis on the collective wisdom of our internal teams.
  • Family – celebrating others’ successes, genuinely caring about the happiness and well-being of our team members and recognizing their own families as extensions of the CPL family.
  • Fun – not taking oneself too seriously, fully understanding that fun at work is conducive to productivity.
  • Inspiration – contributing to an uplifting workplace that facilitates growth and success by maintaining a positive, upbeat attitude.
  • Integrity – doing what is ethically right and providing reliable follow-through on commitments.
  • Ingenuity – seeking new opportunities and consistently identifying unexpected and practical ways to solve problems.

The rate for this position generally ranges between $156,000 to 190,000 annually. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the New York Pay Transparency Law. It is based on what a successful New York applicant might be paid and assumes that the successful candidate will be in New York or perform the position from New York. Similar positions located outside of New York will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by New York Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employees already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. A potential new employee's pay history will not be used in compensation decisions.

CPL is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such affirms the right of every person to participate in all aspects of employment without regard to gender, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, disability, citizenship, military or veteran status, gender expression and/or identity, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

CPL does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiting professionals or agencies, nor do we accept resumes from any source that does not reference a specific, open position. CPL will not be responsible for any fees arising from the use of resumes submitted by recruiting professionals or agencies that do not have a current placement fee agreement with CPL. All initial communication with recruiting professionals or agencies must go through our Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Meewerkstage Werkvoorbereiding en/of Uitvoering
description:
Werken op een dijk die altijd in beweging is? Ga het maar doen!

Werk mee aan het versterken van de KIJK-dijk tussen Rotterdam en Gouda. Een project met impact, waarbij veiligheid, bereikbaarheid en omgeving samenkomen. Terwijl de dijk wordt versterkt, blijft de weg bovenop in gebruik en wonen er langs het traject zo’n 800 mensen. Dit vraagt om slimme oplossingen, goede afstemming en een strakke organisatie.

Binnen dit veelzijdige project werk je samen met specialisten uit verschillende disciplines, zoals funderingen, grondwerk en civiele techniek. Of je nu kiest voor werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of een combinatie van beide: jij draagt actief bij aan het project.

Zo ziet jouw meewerkstage eruit:

Tijdens je stage maak je volledig deel uit van het projectteam en krijg je een goed inzicht in zowel de werkvoorbereiding als de uitvoering. Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en leerdoelen kun je kiezen om je te verdiepen in één van beide, of juist een combinatie te maken.

Als stagiair werkvoorbereiding houd je je bezig met:

  • Het opstellen en uitwerken van werk- en uitvoeringsplannen
  • Het aanvragen van vergunningen en het inkopen van materialen
  • Ondersteuning bieden bij calculaties en het opstellen van offertes
  • Meedenken over en bijdragen aan de planning, kwaliteit en budgetbewaking

Binnen de uitvoering:

  • Werk je mee op de bouwplaats en ondersteun je de uitvoerder bij dagelijkse taken, zoals meetwerk, materiaalcontroles en het monitoren van de voortgang
  • Help je samen met de uitvoerder om het project soepel te laten verlopen en krijg je inzicht in hoe planning, veiligheid en kwaliteit in de praktijk worden gewaarborgd
  • Ondersteun je bij diverse voorbereidende en administratieve werkzaamheden
  • Leer je door mee te lopen met uitvoerders en werkvoorbereiders hoe een project van voorbereiding tot oplevering wordt gerealiseerd

Tijdens je stage krijg je de ruimte om veel te leren, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en te ontdekken welke rol het beste bij jou past.

Jij helpt Nederland vooruit, wij jou
Dit kun je van ons verwachten:

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 510,- bruto per vier weken.
  • Beschikking over een bedrijfsauto om naar projecten te rijden.
  • Een warm welkom zodat je je snel thuis voelt bij Boskalis Nederland.
  • Goede begeleiding. Vanaf dag één helpen we je om alles uit je stage te halen.
  • Een dynamische werkomgeving waarin je als volwaardig teamlid meedraait.
  • Boeiende events. Je kunt aanhaken bij onze inspirerende sessies – van webinars tot career-events met collega’s die vertellen over hun loopbaanstappen binnen Boskalis.
  • Projecten op locaties door het hele land. De Boskalis-campus in Papendrecht is de uitvalsbasis – hier vind je restaurants, een sportveld mét wekelijkse sportlessen, een state-of-the-art auditorium, een hippe koffieplek én een prachtig uitzicht op onze eigen scheepskade.
  • Waardevolle ontmoetingen met collega’s. Bijvoorbeeld via netwerk- en kennissessies en andere events. Of de activiteiten van onze community’s. Zo kun je als stagiair aanhaken bij Young Boskalis.

Herken je jezelf hierin?

Als stagiair werk je graag samen met collega’s op en rondom het project tussen Rotterdam en Gouda. Je bent leergierig, wilt jezelf ontwikkelen en pakt zowel praktische als voorbereidende werkzaamheden met enthousiasme op. Met jouw actieve houding draag je bij aan verschillende facetten van het project.

Verder:

  • Volg je een opleiding in de weg-en waterbouw, civiele techniek of international land and water management.
  • Ben je een echte doener.

Zo word jij onze nieuwe stagiair

  • Upload vóór 1 januari je cv via het sollicitatieformulier.
  • Houd je inbox of telefoon in de gaten: binnen 5 dagen ontvang je een persoonlijke reactie.
  • Voor meer informatie over de stage of sollicitatieprocedure kun je contact opnemen met Jenna de Waard, campus recruiter, via 06-50185190 of campus@boskalis.com.

title: Drainage Jetting Engineer

Manchester

title: Architectural Market Sector Principal- K 12 Practice
description:

title: Speciallärare i språk till Hultdalsskolan
description:
Alla elever kan utvecklas med rätt stöd och förutsättningar. Är du en engagerad speciallärare i språk, då kan du vara den vi söker!

Vilka är vi?

Hultdalsskolan är en 7-9 skola som ligger i Åby ungefär en mil norr om Norrköping.

Här går cirka 370 elever fördelade på 14 klasser. Hos oss står lärande och trygghet i fokus!

Våra gemensamma regler och mål är tydliga och bidrar till en god arbetsmiljö för både elever och personal.

Vi är drygt 40 medarbetare som tillsammans försöker skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för våra elever.

Lärarna är uppdelade på tre arbetslag, ett för varje årskurs.

Förutom lärarlagen finns ett lag bestående av speciallärare som tillsammans med elevhälsoteam, närvaroteam och trygghetsteam finns till för att stötta både elever och pedagoger i det dagliga arbetet.

Hos oss möter du kollegor som är vana att diskutera pedagogiska frågor och utmaningar, alltid med elevernas bästa i fokus!

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som speciallärare på Hultdalsskolan arbetar du aktivt för att skapa tillgängliga och inkluderande lärmiljöer.

Med din expertis bidrar du till skolans utveckling genom förebyggande insatser och systematiskt stöd till elever och personal.

Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter innefattar specialundervisning av elever individuellt eller i mindre grupp, samtidigt som du erbjuder stöd och handledning till arbetslag och lärare.

Kartläggning av elevers behov, upprättande av utredning kring särskilt stöd samt ansvar för att ta fram, följa upp och utvärdera åtgärdsprogram ingår också i arbetsuppgifterna.

Du ingår i skolans specialteam och samarbetar nära med skolans elevhälsoteam och skolledningen.

Att bygga goda relationer och samverka med vårdnadshavare samt externa aktörer är en viktig del av uppdraget för att säkerställa att varje elev får det stöd som behövs.

Vem är du?

Du har en speciallärarexamen med inriktning språk, samt lärarlegitimation i svenska för årskurs 7-9.

Det är meriterande om du är legitimerad i engelska.

Du har erfarenhet av pedagogiskt arbete i skolan och vi ser positivt på om du har jobbat med undervisning av elever i behov av stöd, gärna i språk.

Vidare ser vi även positivt på om du har erfarenhet av att handleda lärare och att arbeta med elevhälsa.

Som person är du trygg och lyhörd med förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor.

Du inspirerar, motiverar och coachar elever utifrån deras individuella förutsättningar och ger positivt stöd för att de ska nå sin fulla potential.

Du är flexibel och anpassar ditt arbetssätt efter förändrade behov och situationer.

Du är lösningsfokuserad, kreativ och öppen för att pröva nya arbetssätt för att hitta de bästa lösningarna för varje elev.

Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, planerar självständigt och driver processer framåt i samverkan med kollegor och elevhälsa.

Vi ser också att du är väl förtrogen med skolans styrdokument och har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Information om tjänsten

Antal lediga tjänster: 1

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning på heltid

Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse

Arbetstid: Dag

Möjlighet till distansarbete: Nej

Sista ansökningsdatum: 1 november

Kontakt: Rektor Malin Wåhlstedt 011-151394 malin.wahlstedt@norrkoping.se eller biträdande rektor Lina Aréus 011-151399 lina.areus@norrkoping.se

Övrig information: Vi har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet, och ersätta det med urvalsfrågor relevanta för tjänsten. Det gör det lättare att göra en objektiv bedömning av din kompetens. Du skickar in ditt CV som vanligt.

Registerutdrag: För tjänster inom äldreomsorg, verksamhet för personer med funktionsnedsättning, vuxenutbildning samt verksamhet för barn och ungdomar, ingår kontroll av registerutdrag som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.

KÄNSLAN AV ATT BIDRA. MÖJLIGHETEN ATT PÅVERKA

Att arbeta i Norrköpings kommun betyder att du är med och skapar välfärden. Våra 11 000 medarbetare bidrar och gör skillnad. Varje dag. Vi erbjuder en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats för nyfikna och öppna människor som vill ha mer än ett jobb. Tillsammans skapar vi Norrköpings framtid.Vi söker dig som har kompetens att bidra till våra verksamheter oavsett kön, könsidentitet eller könsuttryck, ålder, etnisk tillhörighet, religion eller annan trosuppfattning, sexuell läggning eller funktionsnedsättning.När du söker jobb hos oss i Norrköpings kommun använder du dig av vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Du påbörjar din ansökan genom att klicka på ansök längst ner i annonsen. Du som har skyddade personuppgifter ska inte skicka in din ansökan via vår hemsida. Ta en direktkontakt med rekryterande chef alternativt rekryteringsspecialist för att diskutera hur du bäst ansöker utifrån ditt skyddsbehov. Kontaktuppgifter finner du i annonsen. Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: Software Engineer Team Lead
description:
ScyllaDB is the leading next-generation NoSQL database, built for teams that need extreme throughput and predictable low latency at massive scale. Our engineers work across 15+ countries, and we hold ourselves to the highest standards of software engineering and performance optimization. Every microsecond counts here, and so does every engineer.


The Role:

We’re looking for a hands-on Software Development Team Leader to lead a small, exceptionally talented team at the heart of the ScyllaDB server. This is not a “manager who used to code” role. You’ll spend about half your time writing and reviewing code, and the other half helping your team do the best work of their careers.


What Your Team Owns:

Your group is responsible for the ScyllaDB server core, the layers that decide how data is stored, moved, protected, and recovered:

  • The I/O stack and caches that keep latency low under heavy load
  • Data placement with tablets, ScyllaDB’s approach to elastic, dynamic data distribution
  • Compaction, repair, and compression, which keep data correct, consistent, and efficient over time
  • Encryption, backup, restore, and object storage management, so customers can trust ScyllaDB with their most critical data

You’ll work closely with other core development teams, the cloud team, and our field teams, so you’ll see firsthand how your work affects some of the world’s most demanding production deployments.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a distributed team of 4–6 talented engineers
  • Stay deeply hands-on, spending roughly 50% of your time designing, coding, and reviewing performance-sensitive software
  • Develop in the open, as part of a collaborative open-source community
  • Champion the use of AI tools to make the team faster and more effective
  • Communicate clearly and publicly through mailing lists, commit messages, design discussions, and bug reports
  • Partner with field, cloud, and core teams to turn real-world customer needs into robust engineering solutions

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing kernel or server-side systems
  • Strong, modern C++ skills (C++20)
  • A highly analytical mindset and a love of solving hard problems
  • A track record of raising the bar, both in your own code and in the people around you
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially in a distributed environment


Nice to Have

  • Experience with database internals
  • Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as AWS S3 or Google Cloud Storage
  • Open-source development experience
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

title: Quality Engineering Specialist
description:
Prolec GE Waukesha is seeking a Quality Engineering Specialist to serve as a technical authority on quality systems, product reliability, and continuous improvement within our large-scale manufacturing operation. In this role, you will lead complex failure investigations, drive root cause analysis efforts, strengthen quality systems, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to eliminate defects and prevent recurrence. You'll play a key role in ensuring compliance with strict quality standards while ensuring the highest level of product performance and customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead root cause investigations for in-house non-conformances, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) failures, and field-returned failures using advanced methodologies such as 5-Why, Fishbone, and 8D.
  • Conduct detailed forensic analysis of components and assemblies to understand failure modes then implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurrence.
  • Author technical reports that translate complex investigation findings into actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the organization.
  • Analyze quality trends and perform Cost of Quality (COQ) assessments to support data-driven decision making.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean principles and process optimization techniques.
  • Support and enhance ISO 9001 compliance, quality audits, and quality management systems.
  • Define and modify manufacturing processes to optimize efficiency while maintaining quality standards.
  • Partner with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and leadership teams to resolve complex quality challenges.
  • Develop and deliver training on inspection methods, testing equipment, and quality standards.

title: Cyber Security Information Assurance Lead (Pre Ops)

The Opportunity

As the Cyber Security Information Assurance Lead (Pre Ops), you'll play a key role in preparing Hinkley Point C for safe and secure operations. Pay, Benefits and Culture

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are proud to be a Disability Confident employer. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process, we'll be happy to support you.

Join us and help shape the future of low-carbon energy.

#SuccessIsPersonal #EDFcareers #LI-Onsite #DestinationNuclear

Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us. Join us and drive the transition towards An Electric Britain.

title: In-House Counsel
description:
In‑House Counsel

Location: Conti LLC Headquarters – Sterling Heights, MI
Reports To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
Travel: Minimal (occasional domestic travel as needed)

Position Overview

Conti LLC, a national MEP construction company and subsidiary of Equans, is seeking an experienced In‑House Counsel to support its U.S. operations. This role is headquartered in Sterling Heights, Michigan, and reports directly to the CEO. The In‑House Counsel will provide legal leadership across construction operations, contracts, labor and employment matters, claims, and corporate reporting, while serving as the key liaison between Conti LLC, its outside counsel, and the Equans North America General Counsel and Ethics Officer.

Applicants must include their Bar ID number with their application to verify licensure and professional standing.

Scope of Work

Legal Strategy & Executive Support

  • Serve as the primary legal advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team
  • Advise on legal risk, compliance, and strategic decision‑making across daily operations
  • Balance legal exposure with business practicality in a fast‑paced construction environment

Contracts & Construction Law

  • Lead the legal review of customer contracts, with emphasis on:
    • One‑sided contract language
    • Risk allocation, indemnification, insurance, and limitation of liability provisions
  • Provide legal guidance related to:
    • Specialty construction products
    • Subcontracted and self‑performed scopes of work
  • Review vendor and supplier agreements (secondary focus)

Claims, Risk & Dispute Management

  • Oversee claims, disputes, and potential litigation matters
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on strategy, reporting, and resolution
  • Support risk mitigation efforts related to construction projects and contracts

Employment & Labor Law

  • Review and support employment agreements and executive contracts
  • Partner with the HR Director on labor and employment law matters, including:
    • Workplace compliance
    • Employee relations issues
    • Labor law and statutory interpretation
    • Ethics and Compliance Reporting

External & Parent Company Liaison

  • Serve as Conti LLC’s point of contact with its outside counsel
  • Coordinate legal reporting and updates to the Equans North America General Counsel including:
    • Reporting through external counsel
    • Communication and documentation that is required by headquarters in Paris (to be submitted through the Equans North America General Counsel)
  • Ensure alignment between U.S. legal matters and parent‑company expectations

Regional & Corporate Support

  • Provide legal support to regional leadership teams as needed
  • Periodically meet with Vice Presidents across the country
  • Support corporate governance and compliance initiatives

Day‑to‑Day Responsibilities

  • Review and markup customer contracts for legal and commercial risk
  • Advise project teams and executives on contract language before execution
  • Identify legal exposure in one‑sided agreements and recommend mitigation strategies
  • Respond to ongoing legal questions from operations, HR, and leadership
  • Coordinate calls and correspondence with outside counsel on claims or disputes
  • Track open claims, employment issues, and legal action items
  • Provide periodic legal updates to the CEO and executive team
  • Collaborate with HR on employee‑related legal matters as they arise
  • Prepare or review legal summaries and reports for the Equans North America General Counsel
  • Participate in meetings with regional leaders as legal issues arise
  • Maintain awareness of construction law developments, lien statutes, and labor regulations impacting operations

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school
  • Active license to practice law in the State of Michigan
    • Bar ID number required at application
  • Strong background in:
    • Construction law
    • Contract review and negotiation
    • Construction‑focused clients or projects
  • Experience in the construction or engineering industry strongly preferred
  • Candidates from the public sector transitioning to private industry are encouraged to apply
  • Excellent communication skills and executive presence

Compensation & Incentives

  • Competitive base salary, commensurate with experience
  • Performance‑based bonus opportunities, including:
    • Annual incentive bonuses tied to company and individual performance
    • Discretionary bonuses for exceptional contributions, risk mitigation, or claims outcomes
  • Comprehensive benefits package

Why Conti LLC

  • Opportunity to serve as the senior legal leader for a national construction organization
  • Direct access to executive leadership and meaningful influence on company strategy
  • Exposure to complex, high‑value construction projects and national operations
  • Collaborative relationship with an international parent company (Equans)

title: Drilled Shafts Superintendent
description:
Drilled Shafts Superintendent

Conti LLC – Road & Infrastructure Division
Locations: Florida (Various Project Sites)
Full-Time

Position Overview

Conti LLC's Road & Infrastructure Division is seeking an experienced Drilled Shafts Superintendent to lead drilled shaft and miscellaneous foundation operations on transportation infrastructure projects throughout Florida. This position requires a strong background in FDOT projects, deep foundation construction, and field leadership. The successful candidate will oversee daily operations, maintain production and quality standards, coordinate project resources, and ensure all work is completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with FDOT specifications and project requirements.

This role requires travel to various project locations throughout Florida.

Key Responsibilities

Safety & Compliance

  • Lead and promote a strong safety culture on all project sites.
  • Ensure the overall jobsite is safe for employees, subcontractors, and visitors.
  • Enforce company safety policies, site-specific safety plans, and established project rules.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable federal, state, local, and project safety regulations.

Project Execution & Field Operations

  • Plan, organize, implement, execute, and control daily construction activities with assigned crews.
  • Direct and supervise drilled shaft and miscellaneous foundation operations.
  • Monitor production performance and workmanship quality, implementing corrective actions as necessary.
  • Review construction contract documents, plans, and specifications to ensure constructability and accuracy.
  • Coordinate daily activities to meet project schedules and production goals.

FDOT Foundation Construction

  • Manage construction activities involving FDOT miscellaneous foundations, including:
    • Sign Structure Foundations
    • Mast Arm Foundations
    • High Mast Light Foundations
    • Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Pole Foundations
  • Ensure all work is performed in accordance with applicable FDOT specifications and project requirements.

Resource & Material Coordination

  • Work closely with management to ensure timely availability of:
    • Access and traffic control requirements
    • Utility locates
    • Concrete
    • Slurry materials
    • Water supply
    • Equipment
    • Construction materials
  • Coordinate steel cage fabrication, delivery, and installation activities.
  • Schedule and coordinate concrete deliveries to support production requirements.
  • Order, track, and release project materials as necessary.

Equipment Management

  • Maintain assigned foundation drilling tools and specialty equipment.
  • Monitor equipment utilization and coordinate maintenance needs to minimize downtime.
  • Ensure equipment is properly operated, inspected, and maintained.

Client & Agency Relations

  • Work directly with FDOT representatives, inspectors, and other agencies to ensure successful project execution.
  • Participate in project meetings and maintain positive working relationships with stakeholders.
  • Resolve field issues while maintaining schedule, quality, and budget objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum experience performing and supervising work on FDOT transportation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of FDOT miscellaneous foundation construction.
  • Thorough understanding of FDOT Specification Section 346 (Portland Cement Concrete).
  • Thorough understanding of FDOT Specification Section 455 (Miscellaneous Structures).
  • Demonstrated experience leading construction crews and managing daily field operations.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and contract documents.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel throughout Florida as project assignments require.

Equipment Experience Required

Candidates must be capable of safely operating equipment required to perform the scope of work, including:

  • Backhoe
  • Mini Excavator
  • Boom Truck
  • Auger Truck
  • Vacuum Truck
  • Other foundation and support equipment as required

Licensing Requirements

  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver's License (CDL-A) required.
  • Clean driving record preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Opportunities for advancement within a growing infrastructure contractor
  • Steady work on major transportation and roadway projects throughout Florida
  • Safety-focused work environment
  • Company-supported training and professional development
  • Comprehensive benefits package available to eligible employees

title: IEA Employment Consultant - Muswellbrook
description:
Make a real impact – create opportunities and change lives!!!

Are you passionate about supporting people with disability to secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant within our Inclusive Employment Australia Program.

Location: This role is based across our Muswellbrook and Singleton, NSW locations, with occasional outreach responsibilities supporting our Merriwa and Scone, NSW sites.

Who Are We: -

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of over 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation.

About the role: -

This is a dynamic role where you get to combine people support with sales, relationship building and administration, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference every day.

You will:

  • Support participants (many facing barriers such as disability, injury, or long-term unemployment) to become job-ready
  • Actively market candidates to employers and generate job opportunities
  • Build strong relationships with local businesses to create sustainable employment pathways
  • Success in this role comes from your ability to balance people support with proactive employer engagement and outcome delivery.

Key Responsibilities: -

  • Build strong relationships with participants to understand their employment goals and position them for success.
  • Coach participants to be job-ready, competitive, and interview confident.
  • Assist participants with resumes, interview preparation, job search strategies and facilitate access to training and upskilling opportunities.
  • Drive employment outcomes by actively advocating on behalf of participants to employers and securing job placements.
  • Generate new employment opportunities through cold calls, employer visits, and face-to-face engagement with employers to generate job opportunities.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of employers to consistently convert opportunities into placements.
  • Identify and capitalise on hidden job opportunities through proactive business development.
  • Pitch candidates confidently, positioning their skills to meet employer needs.
  • Influence hiring decisions by promoting the commercial and social value of inclusive recruitment
  • Negotiate job trials, work experience placements, and wage subsidies to secure employment outcomes.
  • Maintain and grow employer relationships to drive repeat business and ongoing vacancies.
  • Achieve and exceed KPI targets across placements, engagement, and activity levels.
  • Conduct regular appointments and track participant progress toward employment outcomes.
  • Manage compliance, documentation, and data entry in line with program requirements.
  • Track performance against KPIs and achieve employment outcome targets.
  • Celebrate milestones and successful placements to build participant confidence and engagement.

What Success Looks Like: -

  • Strong employment outcomes for participants.
  • A growing network of engaged local employers.
  • Consistent achievement of KPIs and performance targets.
  • Positive, long-term placements that change lives.

About You: -

You are:

  • A natural communicator and relationship builder with confidence engaging employers.
  • Experienced in sales, business development, recruitment, or customer-facing roles.
  • Passionate about helping people overcome barriers and succeed.
  • Resilient, target-driven, and motivated by achieving outcomes.
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

Why You’ll Love It: -

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping people with disability thrive by securing and supporting them into employment.

  • Base salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success.
  • Ongoing training and career development – we are committed to your growth.
  • Supportive and inclusive team environment where your contributions make a difference every day.
  • Celebrating milestones – we love to recognise and rewards hard work with fun events.
  • EAP | Employee Wellbeing Program.
  • Purchased Annual Leave.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Funded Certificate IV in Community Services or Mental Health Peer Support (eligibility criteria applies).
  • Service recognitions.
  • APM Family Hub.
  • Maxxia | Vehicle salary packaging.

To be considered, you will have...

  • Eligibility to work in Australia.
  • A current driver’s licence and a comprehensively insured vehicle.
  • A MyGovID (Standard level).
  • Willing to complete a National Police Check.
  • Able to pass a Working with Children Check.
  • Available to work Full-Time Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm.

At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures including indigenous peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people with disability.

Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! Let’s work together to break down barriers, shatter expectations and build a more inclusive world- one individual at a time.

title: Assistant Project Manager - EIA & Consenting
description:
The Role

As an Assistant Project Manager, you will support the wider EIA & Consenting team in the successful planning, coordination and delivery of environmental consultancy projects. You will work closely with clients, stakeholders, technical specialists and subcontractors to ensure projects are delivered to scope, on programme and within budget.

You will have the opportunity to contribute to projects across sectors including:

· Renewable energy (wind, solar, battery storage and emerging technologies)

· Major infrastructure and utilities

· Residential and mixed-use developments

· Commercial and industrial projects

· Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and non EIA consenting projects

This role combines project coordination, client liaison, commercial awareness and technical understanding, providing an excellent platform for progression into a Project Manager position.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Coordination

· Support the planning, coordination and administration of projects.

· Assist the team in managing project scope, programmes, budgets, resources and deliverables.

· Help coordinate multidisciplinary teams, specialist consultants and subcontractors.

· Monitor project progress and maintain project schedules, action trackers and financial records.

· Support the preparation of project reports, technical documents, tender documents and presentations.

· Attend project meetings, client meetings and site visits as required.

· Assist in identifying project risks, constraints and opportunities, escalating issues where necessary.

· Ensure project documentation is maintained accurately and efficiently.

Client & Stakeholder Management

· Develop positive working relationships with clients, contractors, local authorities and project stakeholders.

· Support client communications and provide regular updates on project progress.

· Help manage client expectations by ensuring timely and proactive communication.

· Assist with project enquiries and day-to-day client liaison activities.

Commercial & Business Support

· Support project financial management, including budget monitoring, invoicing and cost tracking.

· Assist with the preparation of fee proposals, tenders and framework submissions.

· Contribute to identifying opportunities for additional services and future work.

· Support business development, networking and marketing activities where appropriate.

Health, Safety & Quality

· Promote a positive health, safety and environmental culture across all activities.

· Assist in ensuring project compliance with company procedures, relevant legislation and industry best practice.

· Support the identification and management of project risks.

· Ensure high standards of quality are maintained throughout project delivery.

Team Working & Professional Development

· Work collaboratively with colleagues across environmental, planning and technical disciplines.

· Share knowledge and contribute positively to team development.

· Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and deliver work to a high standard.

· Demonstrate a willingness to learn and develop project management skills.

· Support the continuous improvement of project delivery processes and systems.

About You

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

· Experience or an interest in project management within an environmental, planning, engineering or consultancy environment.

· An understanding of the development process and Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA).

· Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. · Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Commercial awareness and attention to detail.

· A proactive and solution-focused approach to problem solving.

· A genuine interest in renewable energy, infrastructure and sustainable development.

Why Join Atmos?

At Atmos, you'll work alongside experienced environmental professionals on projects that help deliver the UK's transition to a more sustainable future. We invest in our people, encourage professional development and provide opportunities to work on some of the most exciting renewable energy and infrastructure projects across the country.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career in environmental project management while contributing to projects that make a positive difference to communities and the environment.

Adler and Allan are committed to fostering diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We proudly embrace equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. If you require any support with your application, whatever the circumstance, please let us know.

title: PR Executive - (FTC - 6-Months)
description:
We’re not just another bike brand - we're an iconic, British motorcycle brand with over 120 years of history behind us. Our new state-of-the-art facilities in Solihull, West Midlands are home to a tight-knit, but ever-expanding team that's passionate about delivering exquisite riding experiences to our customers.

Under new ownership and proud to be part of the TVS Motor family, we're entering a new era of global success. And we want you to be a part of it!

At Norton, we value respect, trust, and responsibility. We trust our employees to execute their roles exceptionally and professionally, and we value personal development, teaching, and learning. When you join our team, you'll have the opportunity to grow and learn alongside some of the most talented and dedicated people in the business.

So if you're passionate about motorcycles and looking to join a team that's shaping the future of this legendary brand, we'd love to hear from you!

The Role

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented PR Executive to provide essential operational, administrative and coordination support to the PR and Communications function.

This is a varied role that sits at the heart of the PR team, supporting the smooth running of day-to-day activities across financial administration, media monitoring, presentations, marketing information and media travel and logistics.

The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple priorities, working to deadlines and coordinating with internal teams, external agencies, media contacts and other stakeholders. You will have excellent attention to detail and be confident working with information, presentations and administrative processes.

his is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career within PR, communications or marketing while gaining broad exposure to the activities behind a high-profile global motorcycle brand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the PR and Communications team

  • Support the processing and tracking of PR-related invoices, purchase orders and expenditure

  • Maintain accurate records of PR spend, budgets and supplier activity

  • Liaise with Finance and external suppliers to resolve invoice and payment queries

  • Maintain PR databases, contact lists, trackers and other administrative records

  • Support the organisation and maintenance of PR documentation and team resources

  • Conduct daily media monitoring across relevant print, digital, online and social media channels

  • Track coverage relating to Norton Motorcycles, competitors, products, campaigns and key industry topics

  • Maintain accurate media coverage reports and coverage databases

  • Identify key coverage, trends and opportunities and share relevant updates with the wider team

  • Support the preparation of regular PR and media performance reports

  • Assist with the preparation and updating of internal PR and marketing presentations

  • Collate information, data, media coverage and campaign updates from relevant stakeholders

  • Ensure presentations and reports are accurate, consistent and professionally presented

  • Support the preparation of materials for internal meetings, management updates and business reviews

  • Maintain and update marketing and PR information across relevant internal systems and platforms

  • Ensure product, campaign, brand and marketing information is accurate and up to date.

  • Coordinate information updates with relevant Marketing, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams

  • Support the PR team with the organisation and distribution of product information, imagery and other marketing assets

  • Help maintain an organised library of PR and marketing materials

  • Coordinate travel and logistical arrangements for visiting journalists, influencers and other media contacts

  • Arrange flights, accommodation, transfers, itineraries and other travel requirements

  • Support the planning and coordination of media visits, product launches, test rides and PR events

  • Liaise with hotels, travel providers, agencies, dealerships and internal stakeholders

  • Prepare detailed media itineraries and ensure all logistical requirements are communicated clearly

  • Provide on-the-ground administrative support at selected media events and activities where required

  • Provide wider administrative and operational support to the PR and Marketing teams as required

  • Assist with the coordination of PR activities, events, product launches and media programmes.

  • Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners

  • Support the team with ad-hoc projects and activities aligned to the wider Marketing and Communications strategy

  • Maintain a proactive approach to identifying ways to improve PR processes, organisation and efficiency

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in an administrative, coordination, marketing, PR or communications environment

  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint

  • Experience supporting journalists, influencers or media events

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and competing deadlines

  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills

  • Proactive approach with the ability to work independently

  • Experience working with media monitoring tools or platforms

  • Comfortable handling financial and confidential information

  • Ability to coordinate multiple parties and manage logistical arrangements effectively

  • Previous experience within PR, communications, marketing, events or media

  • Experience with purchase orders, invoices or budget administration

  • Interest in motorcycles, automotive, lifestyle or premium consumer brands

  • Experience working within a fast-paced or internationally focused organisation

Rewards of working for Norton:

We like to take care of our Nortoneers and we think we offer some pretty decent rewards. Here's what you'll get when you join the team:

  • Competitive salary package that recognises your skills and experience

  • 33 days of holiday (inc. Bank Hols) to relax and recharge

  • Generous pension scheme that sets you up for the future, with access to personalised advice.

  • Private Medical Insurance and a Cash Back Programme to keep you feeling your best

  • Life insurance (4x salary) because we've got your back no matter what

  • FREE fruit, got to have your five-a-day!

  • WeCare Employee Assistance Programme, which includes access to online GP services, dietary advice, mental health support, bereavement counselling, and a fitness programme

  • Experience the thrill of an entrepreneurial environment within a larger, well-funded company with ambitious long-term goals.

  • Elevate your career with our Ideas for Excellence scheme, where every brilliant idea is not just valued, but also rewarded!

  • A diverse and international team that brings together different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

  • Join the fun with our twice-yearly employee events, payday socials, and loads of exciting activities in between!

  • Want to go green? You can enjoy free electric bicycle hire

  • Plus, no need to stress about finding a parking spot - we've got on-site free parking covered and FREE electric charge points.

We know how important it is to take care of our team, and we're committed to continually improving our reward offering in line with the business growth plan.

Join us and see for yourself!

title: Psychologist
description:
Make a Real Difference – Join a vibrant Team that has clients at its core.

Are you a high-performing clinician ready to use your expertise where it truly matters? At APM, we are a values-led, customer-obsessed team committed to delivering best-in-class service to people when they need it most.

If you thrive in a dynamic environment, bring exceptional clinical reasoning skills, and are passionate about making a meaningful impact across a diverse range of clients and settings this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

🌟 Great opportunity based in Henderson, West Auckland 🌟

This role is based in our Henderson office. We’re on the lookout for experienced Psychologists looking for full, part time or subcontractor work. We do require at least 2 days work per week.

What's in it for you

To enable you and your clients to thrive, you will be provided with all the tools and professional development you need, such as:

  • Ongoing learning and development to keep your skills sharp.
  • A genuine commitment to flexibility and trust to take ownership of your day.
  • The opportunity for career progression at APM or another of our partner brands globally.

What you’ll be doing

No two days are ever the same! You’ll be exposed to diverse cultures and clinical opportunities, working with a range of clients and mental health conditions. You will be supported by a dedicated team leader, as well as the clinical lead for psychology and the clinical advisory team in developing and honing your skills in the services APM provides.

APM employs general, counselling, clinical and neuropsychologists, and APM psychologists:

  • manage a clinical case load equivalent to 6.5 hours of client contact time a day
  • work across a variety of contracts including, ACC contracts such as Sensitive Claims, Psychological Services, Training for Independence and Pain Management Services, as well as other services such as Police and private referrals.
  • Provide evidence-based talking therapy
  • Deliver high quality clinical assessments and reports
  • Engage in collaborative, multi-disciplinary treatment of clients.

Clinical psychologists and neuropsychologist can deliver or develop into delivering neuropsychological assessment services.

Your Perks & Rewards

  • Professional development and supervision support
  • Laptop & phone provided
  • Support from national clinical and cultural panels, focus groups and special interest groups.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Hold an NZPB accredited Master's degree or higher in Psychology.
  • Ability to provide high quality, evidence based talking therapies, for example CBT, EMDR, DBT, Schema therapy, ACT, etc.
  • Complete and deliver high quality clinical assessments and reports
  • Have excellent communication skills and a team-orientated approach to delivering intervention
  • Have excellent time-management skills and the ability to work independently and prioritise tasks effectively
  • For positions involving neuropsychological assessment, vocational registration as a clinical or neuropsychologist is required. Clinical psychologist will need to demonstrate completion of graduate level coursework in Neuropsychology.
  • Must have training in psychopathology and in diagnostic frameworks such as DSM-5-TR or ICD 10/11.

Professional Credentials

  • Must be registered with the Psychologists Board of New Zealand before starting
  • Possess a valid Annual Practising Certificate (APC)
  • Registration with the New Zealand Psychological Society or The New Zealand College for Clinical Psychologist

Other Essentials

  • Current full NZ driver license
  • NZ/AU Citizen

For more information or a copy of the job description, please reach out to Roz, Talent Coordinator at roz.kamoto@apmworkcare.co.nz

title: Client Service Representative, Heart of Chelsea, New York
description:
Heart of Chelsea Veterinary Group, Prospect Heights, part of the Suveto network of hospitals, is committed to providing outstanding care to pets and the people who love them. Our full-service animal hospital combines advanced technology with a dedicated team of veterinary professionals who continually pursue the latest advancements in veterinary medicine, ensuring every patient receives compassionate, personalized care.

We are seeking a full-time Client Service Representative to join our team. As the first point of contact for our clients, this role is essential in creating a welcoming and supportive experience for clients and their pets through concierge-level service, knowledgeable guidance, and effective coordination with our medical team. Successful candidates are professional, empathetic, and committed to upholding the high standards of client experience and patient care that define Heart of Chelsea Veterinary Group.

THIS IS A FULL-TIME POSITION

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Deliver concierge-level client service by scheduling appointments, managing patient flow for multiple doctors, and creating a welcoming experience for clients and their pets both in person and over the phone

  • Manage a high-volume, multi-line phone system, triage client inquiries, and provide accurate information regarding hospital services, preventive care, and treatment recommendations

  • Admit patients, maintain accurate medical and client records, and support efficient daily hospital operations

  • Collaborate with doctors, technicians, and hospital staff to ensure seamless communication, coordination, and continuity of patient care

  • Build positive client relationships through professionalism, empathy, and attention to detail while supporting the comfort and well-being of patients during their visit

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Experience with EzyVet or similar veterinary practice management software preferred

  • Proficiency with computer systems and multi-line phone systems

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, professionalism, and exceptional client service

  • Ability to provide compassionate, empathetic support to clients during both routine and emotionally sensitive situations

VSOP® is an ownership program that tracks the value of the entire Suveto organization.

Heart of Chelsea Veterinary Group, part of the Suveto network of hospitals, is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Lindningsoperatör| Lernia | Piteå

  • Säkerställa att produktionen uppfyller kvalitetskrav och specifikationer

  • Arbeta enligt säkerhetsföreskrifter och rutiner

  • Placeringsort: Piteå

  • Är noggrann och har ett högt kvalitetstänk

  • Har god datorvana

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Vi erbjuder spännande uppdrag hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och stödjer din utveckling både kort- och långsiktigt.

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Christina Rönnegard på mejl: christina.ronnegard@lernia.se

Vissa tjänster kan innefatta bakgrundskontroll som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Om du går vidare kan du behöva verifiera din identitet via BankID innan kontrollen genomförs.

title: Donation Attendant - PT
company: Goodwill of the Olympics and Rainier Region
description:
Our vision is that every person has the opportunity to learn, work, and thrive in all aspects of life.

To achieve our vision, we are committed to dismantling racism and advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion so we can help people reach their fullest potential through our education, job placement, and career pathway services. We do our work with great gratitude for the community donations, purchases, and partnerships that make our mission possible.

Right now our North Tacoma, WA store is seeking a Part Time Donation Attendant!

Salary: $17.13 Per Hour

Position Summary: As a member of the Goodwill production team you will be responsible for processing and sorting the donations provided by our community.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: The Donation Attendant responsibilities include the following and other duties as assigned:

  • Accepting donations from donors and issues receipts as necessary
  • Keeps donation area both inside/outside areas clean, neat and free of debris at all times
  • Training on Gaylord and pallet use will be provided
  • Assists in the unloading/loading of trucks and/or trailers

Customer Service

  • Must possess exceptional customer service skills, greets donors and carries donations from the donor's vehicle to the center and gives donor a receipt if requested.

Determining Acceptable Donations

  • Exercises good judgement in determining which donations are acceptable while communicating that decision to the customer effectively and politely as possible.

Record Keeping

  • Maintains all required records and delivers them to supervisors or drivers as scheduled.
